text: Sa wakas, napatunayan: kahit gising sa gitna ng operasyon, kayang isalba ang buhay, at ang pag-asa.
english: Finally, it was proven: even awake in the middle of surgery, can save life, and hope.

text: Ginpasalamatan ni Kris Aquino ang iya ex-boyfriend nga si Dr. Mike Padlan nga nagbulig sa pagtatap sa iya samtang ginabatuan sini ang iya 11 ka autoimmune diseases.
english: Kris Aquino thanked her ex-boyfriend Dr. Mike Padlan who helped care for her as she battled her 11 autoimmune diseases.

text: Kabahin ini sang statement ni Kris matapos ginkumpirma nga nakaguwa na siya sa ospital kag nakasaylo sa iya bag-o nga puluy-an matapos ang anum ka semana nga pagtinir sa balay bululngan kag pagpaidalom sa isa ka minor surgery.
english: This is part of Kris' statement after confirming that she has been discharged from the hospital and moved into her new home after six weeks in the hospital and undergoing a minor surgery.

text: Gintawag sang aktres si Dr. Mike bilang “one call away” sang Christmas nga nakahibalo gilayon sang husto nga mga doktor nga makabulig sa iya nga kondisyon.
english: The actress called Dr. Mike as the “one call away” of Christmas who immediately knew the right doctors to help him with his condition.

text: Pahayag ni Kris, bilog nga kabuhi sini nga tamdon ang kabalaslan kay Dr. Mike bangud kun wala ini, pat-od nga wala naman siya subong bangud sang mga hitabo sang Disyembre 25 kag 26.
english: Kris said she has been looking forward to rewarding Dr. Mike because if it wasn't for him, he wouldn't be here now because of the events of December 25 and 26.

text: “My former boyfriend, who was literally one call away on Dec.
english: “My former boyfriend, who was literally one call away on Dec.

text: 25 and 26 and facilitated my confinement, Dr. Mike Padlan — I AM FOREVER INDEBTED BECAUSE WITHOUT HIM, I WOULD NO LONGER BE HERE,” pahayag sini.
english: 25 and 26 and facilitated my confinement, Dr. Mike Padlan — I AM FOREVER INDEBTED BECAUSE WITHOUT HIM, I WOULD NO LONGER BE HERE,” it said.

text: Dugang niya, bisan nga natapos man ang ila relasyon bilang magkahagugma, nagpabilin naman ang ila koneksyon bilang physician kag pasyente.
english: He added that although their relationship as lovers ended, their connection as physician and patient remained.

text: “We didn’t work as a couple, BUT we do work as physician and patient because Dr. Mike knows me and how my body works; he has seen and continues to witness me at my weakest and instinctively knows which doctors I will get along with,” dugang pa sang Queen of All Media.
english: “We didn’t work as a couple, BUT we do work as physician and patient because Dr. Mike knows me and how my body works; he has seen and continues to witness me at my weakest and instinctively knows which doctors I will get along with,” the Queen of All Media added.

text: Nag-umpisa ang ila relasyon sang 2024, apang nagbulagay man pagkasunod nga tuig.
english: They started dating in 2024, but also broke up the following year.

text: Sa bahin sang iya ikaayong lawas, ginlaragway ni Kris ang iya kaugalingon subong nga “super lampa” ukon “super frail” ukon tuman pa kahina.
english: In terms of her health, Kris described herself as “super lampa” or “super frail” or very weak.

text: Una na sini ginpakigbahin nga nagasuprer siya sang deep vein thrombosis magluwas pa sang iya nga autoimmune conditions.
english: He previously shared that he suffers from deep vein thrombosis in addition to his autoimmune conditions.

text: SALAMAT sa Diyos nga wala nagdangat sa “wara data”, sunu pa sa kinaray-a ni anhing lola, ang protest rallies sang Nobyembre 30.
english: THANK GOD that the protest rallies on November 30 did not reach “wara data”, according to the Kinaray-a of the former grandmother.

text: Now, pwede na kita liwat mag-seryoso sa imbestigasyon angot sa anomaliya sa pagtukod sang multi-Bilyon nga flood projects.
english: Now, we can get serious again in the investigation into the anomaly in the construction of multi-billion flood projects.

text: Sa ulihi nga balita nga nabaton naton may 16 na nga nahulogan sang warrant of arrest agud mapasakaan na sang kaso sa Ombudsman kag Sandiganbayan.
english: According to the latest news we received, 16 people have been issued warrants of arrest to be charged with the Ombudsman and Sandiganbayan.

text: Kag gasalig ang mga pumuluyo nga mapadali man nga mapaatubang ining mga akusado sa husgado, samtang sige man ang pagdiskubre sa kon sin-o pa ang dapat manabat.
english: And the residents hope that these accused will be brought to justice soon, while discovering who else should be held accountable.

text:
***

Madugay man kag nakatugda diri sa aton kolum ang aton abyan nga si Pedro.
english:
***

Our friend Pedro has been in our column for a long time.

text: Siling niya nabuwisitan na gid siya sa isa ka kongresista nga gapahero-hero nga wala man sing maayo nga nahimuan sa Kamara.
english: He said he is fed up with a congressman who is a hero who has done nothing good in the House.

text: Akusar kag akusar lang siya kuno sang kon ano ukon sin-o ang paukpan sang naiskandalo nga kapalpakan sang linibo nga flood control projects, samtang wala naman sing piho nga matudlo luwas sa tinikal.
english: He is only accusing and accusing of what or who will be blamed for the scandalous failure of thousands of flood control projects, while nothing specific can be pointed out except technically.

text: Wala man lang siya sing nakadtuan kag nakita sang bisan isa lang sining mga proyekto agud mapamatud-an ini bisan sa iya lang kaugalingon.
english: He hasn't been there and seen any of these projects to prove it even to himself.

text: Wala man lang siya nagtomar interes nga magpakigkita sa isa man lang ka eyewitness agud makasugid sini sa iya sang kon ano.
english: He didn't even bother to meet with a single eyewitness to tell him what it was.

text: Pero kon mag-akusar siya, dugang ni Pedro, daw nakapangusisa gid siya sa natabo sa bisan isa lang sining mga flood project.
english: But if he accuses, Pedro added, it seems that he has investigated what happened in at least one of these flood projects.

text: Daug pa niya si Senador Ping Lacson nga nakakadto gid sa pila ka proyekto sa Bulacan kag Oriental Mindoro kag nangutana dira kon sin-o ang may responsibilidad kag mabasulan sang kamalamalahan.
english: He even defeated Senator Ping Lacson who visited several projects in Bulacan and Oriental Mindoro and asked who is responsible and blameworthy.

text: Tinamad kag pinalagpat ina ya ang imo congressman, tugda pa gani ni Pedro.
english: Your congressman is lazy and stupid, Pedro even suggested.

text: Ginapakamalaut pa gani siya sang iya pamilya, siling ni Pedro, nga amo tani ang una magdepensa sa iya kag magkilala sang iya maayo nga hinimuan kon may ara gid man.
english: He is even cursed by his family, Pedro says, who should be the first to come to his defense and acknowledge his good deed if anything.

text: Ginsikway man siya sang iya partido kay gindalahig pa niya sila sa kalainan sang iya tinikal sa Kamara nga tani makaunong pa sa iya bisan paano.
english: He was also rejected by his party because he implicated them in the evil of his technique in the House of Representatives, which should have supported him anyway.

text:
***

Well, siling ko kay Pedro, pabay-i lang da siya sa iya tinikal.
english:
***

Well, I told Pedro, let him do his job.

text: In fact, indi man gani kinahanglan pa akusaran siya sang Sedition ukon Inciting to Rebellion.
english: In fact, he doesn't even need to be charged with Sedition or Inciting to Rebellion.

text: Kon may madala siya nga mga pumuluyo, amo gid lang ang diutay nga grupo nga nagpasaway sa Forbes Park kon diin ginpakamalaut niya ang mga maggaranon dira, lakip na si Manny Pacquiao nga aton pambansang kamao nga kilala sa iya kaalwan sa mga kubos.
english: If he can bring any citizens, it is the small group that criticized Forbes Park where he condemned the rich there, including Manny Pacquiao, our national boxer who is known for his generosity to the poor.

text: Hala ka Manny, korap ka man gali, sunu sa sining bulyaw nga ini!
english: Come on Manny, you're corrupt, according to this bully!

text:
***

Agud madugangan ang ihibalo ni Pedro parti sa flood projects, i-share ko na lang diri sa iya kag sa iban nga luyag man makahibalo sing dugang parti sining problema naton sa flood control projects nga nahibal-an naton.
english:
***

In order to increase Pedro's knowledge about flood projects, I will share it here with him and others who want to know more about this problem of flood control projects that we know.

text: Una nga gin-expose ni PBBM sa iya 2025 SONA sadtong Hulyo 28 ining flood control project anomaly, nga ginsalo man sang media kag gin-updan pa nila sing dugang nga mga detalye sa ila mga investigative report.
english: PBBM first exposed this flood control project anomaly in its 2025 SONA on July 28, which was also picked up by the media and accompanied by more details in their investigative reports.

text: Sunu sa expose ni PBBM, may 15 gid dira ka mga flood control projects nga daku ang nahul-ab, mga 20% gid, sang mga 10,000 ka proyekto nga gintukod sugod sadtong pagpungko niya sang 2022.
english: According to PBBM's expose, there are 15 flood control projects that have been severely damaged, about 20%, of the 10,000 projects built since he took office in 2022.

text: Mga 5,500 dira ang allegedly “completed” , samtang madamo gali sini mga “ghost projects”.
english: About 5,500 of them are allegedly “completed”, while many of them are actually “ghost projects”.

text: Obviously, indi masarangan sang Presidente ang tanan nga resposibilidad sa iya pagdumala sa pungsod.
english: Obviously, the President cannot take all the responsibility in his leadership of the country.

text: Sa aton Demokrasya, may ginasiling nga delegation of power nga paagi sini matugyan niya ang pila ka responsibilidad sa iya mga salaligan.
english: In our Democracy, there is a so-called delegation of power through which he can delegate certain responsibilities to his trustees.

text: Ang problema kay igu murahon indi man masaligan ang madamo dira kag korap man.
english: The problem is that many of them are not trustworthy and corrupt.

text: Balor PhP545.64 ka Bilyon ining tanan nga mga proyekto nga gintukod sadtong Hulyo 2022 tubtub Mayo 2025 nga na-award sa mga sumunod nga 15 ka contractors: Legacy Construction Corporation, Alpha and Omega Gen.
english: These projects are worth PhP545.64 billion from July 2022 to May 2025 and were awarded to the following 15 contractors: Legacy Construction Corporation, Alpha and Omega Gen.

text: Contractor and Development Corp; St.
english: Contractor and Development Corp; St.

text:
Ini sila amo ang masunod:

english: This totals 3,297 projects.

text: Nanotaran  ugaling sang Presidente nga madamo sa sining mga flood control projects ang nahamtang sa mga probinsya nga indi man flood-prone.
english: The President noted, however, that many of these flood control projects are located in provinces that are not flood-prone.

text: Samtang ang pila ka probinsya nga “most flood-prone” wala nakabaton sang kadamuon nga mga proyekto nga bagay sa kinahanglanon nila.
english: Meanwhile, some provinces that are “most flood-prone” have not received as many projects as they need.

text: Galakip ini  sila, sunu sa Presidente, sang: Nueva Ecija, Metro Manila, Maguindanao, North Cotabato, kag Oriental Mindoro.
english: These include, according to the President, Nueva Ecija, Metro Manila, Maguindanao, North Cotabato, and Oriental Mindoro.

text: Nga, expectedly, mas nag-antos gid sa pagbinaha nga dala sang nagligad nga mga bagyo!
english: Which, expectedly, suffered more from the flooding caused by the previous typhoons!

text: Ngaa ayhan?
english: Why maybe?

text: Sa aton nahibal-an nga abilidad sang mga pulitiko, fuera los buenos, posible tungod sang mas daku nga kitaon dira ukon agud mapalipay ang ila ale-ale nga mga supporter para sa ila personal nga benepisyo!/PN
english: As far as we know, the ability of politicians, fuera los buenos, may be because of bigger profits or to please their alleged supporters for their personal benefit!/PN

text: Ginbawian sang kabuhi ang isa ka empleyado sang Municipal Disaster Risk Reduction and Ma­nagement Office (MDRRMO) sang Sariaya, Quezon matapos gintiro sang riding in tandem sa Barangay Lutucan 1 sa amo nga banwa.
english: An employee of the Municipal Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Office (MDRRMO) of Sariaya, Quezon was shot dead by a riding in tandem in Barangay Lutucan 1 in the town.

text: Ang biktima amo si alyas “Pepe”, 37-anyos, residente sang amo man nga banwa.
english: The victim was identified as “Pepe”, 37, resident of the same town.

text: Suno sa otoridad, padulong ang biktima sa munsipyo sakay sa iya kotse sang hinali lang nag-ulhot ang mga suspek kag ginpaulanan ini sang bala.
english: According to the police, the victim was on his way to the municipality in his car when the suspects suddenly appeared and opened fire on him.

text: Gindala pa sa ospital ang biktima apang dead-on-arrival.
english: The victim was rushed to the hospital but was pronounced dead on arrival.

text: Padayon pa nga ginapangita ang mga suspek.
english: The suspects are still being sought.

text: Gintakod sa tiil sang isa ka babaye ang nabitas sini nga dulunggan bangud sa isa ka aksidente.
english: A woman's ear was attached to her leg in an accident.

text: Natabo ini sa Shandong, China.
english: It happened in Shandong, China.

text: Isa ka adlaw, naaksidente ang nasambit nga babaye sa ginaubrahan sini nga factory sang ginlamon sang makina ang iya buhok nga nagresulta sa pagkagisi sang iya panit sa nawong kag ulo pag pagkabitas sang iya dulunggan.
english: One day, the woman had an accident at her factory when the machine swallowed her hair, resulting in her skin being torn from her face and head and her ear being cut off.

text: Bangud sang natabo, ginkinahanglan niya nga magpaidalom sa serye sang reconstructive surgeries.
english: Because of the incident, he had to undergo a series of reconstructive surgeries.

text: Suno sa mga doktor, indi gilayon mahimo nga mabalik ang iya dulunggan bangud sa damage sa ugat nga nagasuplay sang dugo.
english: Doctors said his ear could not be reattached immediately due to damage to the blood supply vein.

text: Apang agud mapataas ang tsansa nga mabalik ang napaksi nga dulunggan, gindesisyunan nga itapik anay ini sa tiil sang babaye.
english: But to increase the chances of getting the severed ear back, it was decided to attach it to the woman's leg first.

text: Ginpili nga sa tiil ini sang babaye itapik bangud ang panit sa area ang manipis kag ang blood vessels diri ang pareho ang kadakuon  sa ugat sa dulunggan gani mas mahapos ang transplantation.
english: It was chosen to be applied to the woman's leg because the skin in the area is thin and the blood vessels here are the same size as the vein in the ear so the transplantation is easier.

text: Naglab-ot sa 10 ka oras ang una nga operasyon.
english: The first operation lasted 10 hours.

text: Kritikal ang mga una nga adlaw sang transplant apang nangin estable man ang kondisyon sang pasyente.
english: Kritikal ang mga una nga adlaw sang transplant apang nangin estable man ang kondisyon sang pasyente.

text: Sa sulod sang lima ka bulan, ginkinahanglan sang babaye nga magsuksok sang halog nga sapatos kag maglakat sang mahinay agud malikawan ang pressure kag mapabilin ang sirkulasyon sang dugo.
english: For five months, the woman was required to wear soft shoes and walk slowly to avoid pressure and maintain blood circulation.

text: Sang Oktubre, ginpatigayon ang operasyon agud ibalik ang dulunggan sa orihinal sini nga puwesto kag madinalag-on nga nahimo ini sang mga doktor.
english: In October, surgery was performed to restore the ear to its original position and the doctors successfully did so.

text: Ginalantaw nga mas magabudlay ang energy situation sa Pilipinas bangud sang padayon nga pagsarurot ang balor sang Philippine peso batok sa US Dollar.
english: The energy situation in the Philippines is expected to worsen due to the continued appreciation of the Philippine peso against the US Dollar.

text: Panibag-o nga record low ang narekord kahapon samtang padayon ang krisis sa Middle East.
english: A new record low was recorded yesterday as the crisis in the Middle East continues.

text: Nagsirado ang trading nga P60.30 ang baylo sang US dollar nga mas manubo pa sa nauna na-record nga P60.10 sang Huwebes.
english: The US dollar closed trading at P60.30, lower than the previous record of P60.10 on Thursday.

text: Sa kabug-usan subong nga bulan, masobra na sa 4% ang ginpierde sang peso.
english: Overall this month, the peso has lost more than 4%.

text: Ginalantaw nga mas mabudlayan ang Pilipinas bangud kun magluya ang peso, mas magamahal ang pagbakal sang langis bangud dolyar ang ginagamit sa purchase.
english: The Philippines is expected to suffer more because if the peso weakens, it will be more expensive to buy oil because dollars are used for purchase.

text: Gina-import sang Pilipinas ang masobra 90% sang langis.
english: The Philippines imports more than 90% of its oil.

text: Kun magtaas ini, ginalantaw man nga magadasig pa ang inflation, gani nga nabutang man sa mabudlay nga sitwasyon ang Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas kaangot sa interest rate hikes.
english: If it rises, inflation is expected to accelerate, putting the Central Bank of the Philippines in a difficult situation regarding interest rate hikes.

text: Una na nga nagpaandam ang head sang International Energy Agency nga ang krisis nga nag-umpisa sa gyera sang US, Israel, kag Iran ang maghimo maglapaw pa sa combined shock sang 1970s oil crises kag disruption dala sang 2022 invasion sang Russia sa Ukraine.#
english: The head of the International Energy Agency has earlier warned that the crisis that began with the war between the US, Israel, and Iran will go beyond the combined shock of the 1970s oil crises and disruption caused by Russia's 2022 invasion of Ukraine.

text: Walo na ang patay kag halos 100 ang nasamaran matapos nga gin-atake sang pwersa sang Estados Unidos ang B-1 bridge nga naga-angot sang Tehran kag Karaj sa Iran.
english: Eight people have been killed and nearly 100 injured after US forces struck the B-1 bridge linking Tehran and Karaj with Iran.

text: Ini nga taytay ang makabig nga major infrastructure project kag malapit na lang matapos sang natabo ang pagpamomba sang US.
english: This bridge is considered a major infrastructure project and was nearing completion when the US bombing occurred.

text: Sandig sa Fars/Iranian media, ang B-1 bridge amo ang pinakamataas nga taytay sa Middle East.
english: According to Fars/Iranian media, the B-1 bridge is the highest bridge in the Middle East.

text: Gintawag man ini ni US President Donald Trump nga pinakadaku nga taytay sa Iran, nga indi na magamit matapos ang ila pagpamomba.
english: US President Donald Trump also called it the largest bridge in Iran, which will be unusable after their bombing.

text: Sa video nga gin-post sang presidente, makit-an nga naga-aso ang taytay nga nahamtang 20 milya (35 kilometros) nabagatanan-nakatundan sang Tehran.
english: In a video posted by the president, the bridge, located 20 miles (35 kilometers) southwest of Tehran, can be seen burning.

text: “The biggest bridge in Iran comes tumbling down, never to be used again — much more to follow!
english: “The biggest bridge in Iran comes tumbling down, never to be used again — much more to follow!

text: It is time for Iran to make a deal before it is too late, and there is nothing left of what still could become a great country,” pahayag ni Trump.
english: It is time for Iran to make a deal before it is too late, and there is nothing left of what still could become a great country,” stated Trump.

text: Sabat naman ni Iran foreign minister Abbas Araghchi, indi sini mapilit ang Tehran nga mag-surrender.
english: Iranian foreign minister Abbas Araghchi said he could not force Tehran to surrender.

text: “Striking civilian structures, including unfinished bridges, will not compel Iranians to surrender,” suno sa opisyal.#
english: “Striking civilian structures, including unfinished bridges, will not compel Iranians to surrender,” the official said.#

text: Nag-request si BICOL Saro party‑list Rep.
english: BICOL Saro party‐list Rep.

text: Terry Ridon kay Vice President Sara Duterte nga eksplikar ang ginapahayag P50 Million “wealth gap” sini.
english: Terry Ridon to Vice President Sara Duterte to explain her alleged P50 Million “wealth gap”.

text: Sa isa ka press conference, ginplastar ni Ridon nga miyembro man sang House Committee on Justice ang posible nga pagpangayo sang amo nga komitiba sang financial documents ni Duterte nahanungod sa proceedings sang iya impeachment complaints.
english: In a press conference, Ridon, who is also a member of the House Committee on Justice, raised the possibility of the committee requesting Duterte's financial documents regarding the proceedings of his impeachment complaints.

text: Gintuad man ni Ridon nga sarang ang mga ini nga magpangayo sang subpoena para sa income tax returns kag business records ni VP Duterte agud nga i-eksplikar ang ginapahayag P50-million “wealth gap” sa tunga sang iya estimated government salary kag declared net worth.
english: Ridon also admitted that they can seek a subpoena for VP Duterte's income tax returns and business records to explain the alleged P50-million “wealth gap” between his estimated government salary and declared net worth.

text:
(SARA)

Dugang pa ni Ridon nga posible i-request sang House Committee on Justice ang SALNs, bank records, income tax returns, kag SEC registration sang tanan nga negosyo sang pamilya Duterte-Carpio agud mahibaluan ang ginahalinan sang makaduluda nga manggad sang mga ini nga suno kay Ridon ang gulpiyada nga nagtaas sa nagliligad nga mga tuig.
english:
(SARAH)

Ridon added that the House Committee on Justice may request the SALNs, bank records, income tax returns, and SEC registration of all businesses of the Duterte-Carpio family to determine the source of their suspicious wealth which Ridon said has increased dramatically in recent years.

text: Naka-record sang halos 7,000 ka mga pasyente nga gin-respondihan ang Philippine Red Cross (PRC) sa bilog nga pungsod halin sang nagsugod ang Semana Santa 2026, suno sa ahensya.
english: The Philippine Red Cross (PRC) has recorded nearly 7,000 patients responded to nationwide since the beginning of Easter 2026, the agency said.

english: According to PRC data, from March 29, Palm Sunday, until 9 am on Black Saturday, they received an estimated 7,137 individuals seeking assistance.

text: Sa amo nga numero, 6,514 ang na-monitor ang vital signs, kaupod ang 26 major cases kag 583 minor cases.
english: Of these, 6,514 were monitored for vital signs, including 26 major cases and 583 minor cases.

text: 14 naman ka mga pasyente ang na-transfer sa mga ospital para sa nagakaigo nga pagbulong.
english: 14 patients were transferred to hospitals for proper treatment.

english: On the 21-year-old American player's Instagram story, he explained that he didn't want the game to end that way.

english: This is only the second time in Gauff’s career that he has been sidelined by injury.

english: Gauff also sent a message of “good luck” to Eala, who also faced him last month at the Dubai Open.

text:
Nagbyahe sang masobra 900 kilometro ang isa ka lalaki sa pungsod China agud magpangita sang obra, apang wala gid ini mabaton bangud sa porma sang iya nawong nga “square.”

Ini amo si G. Zhang nga makapila na ka beses magpangita sang obra kag nagaisahanon nga nagatrabaho para sa iya pamilya agud masuportahan ang iya tigulang nga mga ginikanan.
english:
A man traveled more than 600 miles [900 km] in China to find work, but was rejected because of his square face.

This is Mr. Zhang who has looked for work several times and works alone for his family to support his elderly parents.

text: Matapos ini maghalin sa Zhumadian sa Henan Province padulong sa Jiashan County sa Zhejiang, kun sa diin ginbalibaran siya sang kapin sa napulo ka electronics factories apisar pa nga kwalipikado siya sa trabaho nga iya gina-applyan.
english: This was after he left Zhumadian in Henan Province for Jiashan County in Zhejiang, where he was rejected by more than 10 electronics factories despite being qualified for the job he was applying for.

text: Suno kay Zhang, may mga job interviewer nga direkta nga nagsiling nga indi siya angayan bangud sang iya nawong, nga nagahatag sa iya sang kahuy-anan kag sakit sang buot.
english: According to Zhang, some job interviewers have directly said that she is not suitable because of her face, which causes her embarrassment and heartache.

text: Nagapakita lamang ini sang diskriminasyon base sa pisikal nga aspeto sa pagkuha sang empleyado, kun sa diin ginahimo nga basehan ang hitsura imbes nga abilidad kag kaalam sang tawo.
english: It only shows discrimination based on physical aspects in hiring employees, where appearance is used as a basis instead of ability and intelligence.

text: Ginpasugtan sang Department of Energy (DOE) ang temporaryo nga paggamit sang lower-grade petroleum products.
english: The Department of Energy (DOE) has allowed the temporary use of lower-grade petroleum products.

text: Ini agud masigurado anay ang fuel supply subong sa pungsod samtang nga magamo pa ang sitwasyon sa Middle East kag nagapanglakaak ang presyo sang produktong petrolyo sa global market.
english: This is to ensure the current fuel supply in the country while the situation in the Middle East is still turbulent and the price of petroleum products in the global market is rising.

text: Ginpaguwa sang ahensya ang Department Circular No.
english: The agency issued Department Circular No.

text: DC2026-03-0010 nga amo ang nagatugot sang interim and controlled introduction sang Euro II fuels para sa pili lang nga transport and industrial uses.
english: DC2026-03-0010 which allows the interim and controlled introduction of Euro II fuels for select transport and industrial uses only.

text: Suno kay Energy Secretary Sharon Garin, temporaryo lamang ini nga tikang sang gobyerno.
english: Energy Secretary Sharon Garin said the government's move is only temporary.

text: Subject ini gihapon sa istrikto nga quality control, klaro nga notification requirements, kag husto nga consumer protection measures.
english: It is still subject to strict quality control, clear notification requirements, and proper consumer protection measures.

text: “We are adopting a prudent and temporary measure to help ensure an adequate and accessible fuel supply for sectors that may require limited flexibility during this period,” suno sa press release sang ahensya.
english: “We are adopting a prudent and temporary measure to help ensure an adequate and accessible fuel supply for sectors that may require limited flexibility during this period,” according to the agency’s press release.

text: “This interim authority is subject to strict quality controls, clear notification requirements, and appropriate consumer protection measures,” dugang sang tiglikom.
english: “This interim authority is subject to strict quality controls, clear notification requirements, and appropriate consumer protection measures,” the secretary added.

text: Ang paggamit sang Euro II fuels limitahan lamang sa in-use vehicle models halin sa 2015 ukon mas temprano pa, traditional jeepneys, industrial applications kaangay sang power plants kag generators, kag marine and shipping operations.
english: The use of Euro II fuels will be restricted to in-use vehicle models from 2015 or earlier, traditional jeepneys, industrial applications such as power plants and generators, and marine and shipping operations.

text: Agud wala sang misuse, gina-require sa mga kumpaniya sang langis nga istrikto nga iseparar ang Euro II kag Euro IV fuels sa tanan nga storage, transport, kag retail systems.
english: To avoid misuse, oil companies are required to strictly separate Euro II and Euro IV fuels in all storage, transport, and retail systems.

text: Dapat man ipahibalo sa ahensya kun ano nga gas stations ang magabaligya sang lower-grade fuel.
english: The agency should also be informed which gas stations will sell lower-grade fuel.

text: “It warned that fuel adulteration, non-compliance with prescribed quality specifications, and other violations will be subject to penalties under existing laws, rules, and regulations,” dugang pa sa statement sang ahensya.#
english: “It warned that fuel adulteration, non-compliance with prescribed quality specifications, and other violations will be subject to penalties under existing laws, rules, and regulations,” the agency added in a statement.#

text: Ginhugasan kag ginhalukan ni Pope Leo XIV ang tiil sang 12 ka mga pari sa Roma bilang kabahin sang espesyal nga ritwal nagapakita sang pagkamapainubuson ni Hesukristo sa gab-i antes ang iya kamatayon.
english: Pope Leo XIV washed and kissed the feet of 12 priests in Rome as part of a special ritual showing the humility of Jesus Christ on the night before his death.

text: Ginhiwat ang espesyal nga ritwal sa Basilica of St.
english: A special ritual was held at the Basilica of St.

text: John Lateran nga amo ang cathedral church sang Santo Papa.
english: John Lateran which is the cathedral church of the Pope.

text: Naglain ini sa kinaandan nga tradisyon.
english: It departed from the usual tradition.

text: Kun matandaan, ginpili anay ni Pope Francis nga patigayunon ang service sa gwa sang mga simbahan, kaangay sang mga presuhan kag puluy-an sang mga tigulang kaangay sang iya ginahimo sang yara pa ini sa Argentina.
english: Pope Francis chose to hold the service outside churches, prisons and nursing homes as he did when he was in Argentina.

text: Sang nagligad nga tuig, apisar maluya na bangud sa double pneumonia kag inadlaw antes ang iya kamatayon, nagkadto pa si Pope Francis sa Regina Coeli sa Roma nga isa sa pinakamagutok nga presuhan sa Italya.
english: Last year, despite being weak from double pneumonia and days before his death, Pope Francis went to the Regina Coeli in Rome, one of the most crowded prisons in Italy.

text: Subong nga tuig, suno sa Vatican officials, ginpili ni Pope Leo nga hugasan ang tiil sang mga pari bilang suporta sa Catholic clergy nga nagatrabaho sang malawig nga inoras kag nagapanguna sa masobra isa ka parokya.
english: This year, Vatican officials said, Pope Leo chose to wash the feet of priests in support of the Catholic clergy who work long hours and lead more than one parish.

text: Sa iya monthly prayer intention subong nga Abril, gindedikar man ini ni Pope sa mga pari, kag ginhingyo sa mga Katoliko sa bilog nga kalibutan nga ipangamuyo sa Ginuo nga tatapon sila.
english: In his monthly prayer intention this April, the Pope also dedicated it to priests, and asked Catholics around the world to pray for the Lord to take care of them.

text: Sa iya mensahe kadungan sang Huwebes Santo, nagpahayag si Pope Leo nga ang akto ni Hesus dapat magserbe nga inspirasyon para sa mga tumuluo nga magtatap para sa mga nagakinahanglan.
english: In his message on Holy Thursday, Pope Leo said that the act of Jesus should serve as an inspiration for the faithful to care for those in need.

text: “As humanity is brought to its knees by so many acts of brutality, let us too kneel down as brothers and sisters alongside the oppressed,” suno sa Santo Papa.
english: “As humanity is brought to its knees by so many acts of brutality, let us too kneel down as brothers and sisters alongside the oppressed,” according to the Pope.

text: “God has given us an example — not of how to dominate, but of how to liberate,” dugang sini.#
english: “God has given us an example — not of how to dominate, but of how to liberate,” it added.#

text: ANG pork barrel allocation padayon nga gina-praktis sa Estados Unidos, despite sang mga kritisismo batok sini tungod sang daku nga posibilidad sang wasteful, misuse kag corrupt spending.
english: PORK barrel allocation continues to be practiced in the United States, despite criticisms against it for its high potential for wasteful, misuse and corrupt spending.

text: Ina tungod sang bentaha sini sangsa indi mapatuman ini.
english: That’s because of its advantage over its inability to implement it.

text: Mahapos mapatuman sang gobyerno ang local development, nga tumod sini, paagi sa pork barrel allocation bangod sa kakulang sang oversight sa  pagbantay sang paggamit sini.
english: The government can easily implement local development, which is its focus, through pork barrel allocation because of the lack of oversight to monitor its use.

text: Labi na gid kay ginahatag ini sing tingub (lumpsum) nga ginatugyan lang sa ginatagaan ang paggamit sini.
english: Especially since it is given in a lumpsum that is left to the recipient to use it.

text: Ma-source man ini sa surplus kag unprogrammed budget nga available nga indi maghulat sa dason nga General Appropriations Act (GAA).
english: It will also be sourced from the surplus and unprogrammed budget available without waiting for the next General Appropriations Act (GAA).

text: Ginabawi lang ang negatibo nga epekto sini sa mapatuman nga transparency sang pag-monitor sini kag sang mabungahon nga pagpanglagas sa mga korap.
english: It only offsets its negative impact on the enforceable transparency of its monitoring and the fruitful pursuit of the corrupt.

text: Nga napamatud-an man sang mabantayon nga mga ahensya sang gobyerno.
english: Which has also been proven by vigilant government agencies.

text: Sadtong 2019-2025 gani, 30 gid ka corruption cases ang nadiskubrihan, napasakaan kaso kag napasabat ang mga akusado sang ila mga kasal-anan, NGA WALA SING PINILIAN, ordinaryo man nga empleyado ukon gung-an nga opisyal.
english: From 2019-2025, 30 corruption cases were discovered, charged and the accused were held accountable for their crimes, WITHOUT DISCRIMINATION, whether ordinary employees or high-ranking officials.

text: In fact, isa sang naakusahan kag nasentensyahan gid amo ang House Speaker sang estado sang Missouri bangod sa pagpangarakot sang daku nga kantidad.
english: In fact, one of the most accused and convicted was the House Speaker of the state of Missouri for embezzlement of large sums of money.

text:
***

Sa Filipinas, may indi maayo kita ugaling nga kinaiya sa pork barrel spending.
english:
***

In the Philippines, however, we have a bad habit of pork barrel spending.

text: Matudlo ini sa “sense of impunity” ukon “selective justice”, kon si Senador Ping Lacson pa ang pahambalon, kon ang involve amo ang dalagku nga mga opisyales nga, unfortunately, ginapabay-an man lang sang mga pumuluyo kon matigayon man ang ila kaayuhan.
english: This can be pointed to the “sense of impunity” or “selective justice”, if Senator Ping Lacson is to be asked, if the involved are big officials who, unfortunately, are neglected by the people when their welfare is achieved.

text: Na-highlight gani sa aton experyensya ang Harry Stonehill Bribery Case sadtong 1962, nga si Stonehill na-deport lang sa United States kag wala man lang namung-an ni isa sang 200 nga yara sa iya Blue Book kay basta lang dula.
english: Highlighted in our experience is the Harry Stonehill Bribery Case in 1962, when Stonehill was deported to the United States and did not find any of the 200 in his Blue Book because it was simply lost.

text: Subong man ang Pork Barrel Scam sadtong 2013 angot sa misuse sang mga PhP10 ka Bilyon nga lumpsum PDAF kag paggamit sini sa private organizations (NGOs) sang public funds halin sadtong 2000-2013, kon diin ang namung-an lang amo si master middleman Janet Napoles sing 100 ka tuig nga pagkabilanggo.
english: Similarly, the Pork Barrel Scam of 2013 regarding the misuse of about PhP10 billion lumpsum PDAF and its use to private organizations (NGOs) of public funds from 2000-2013, where the only one who was sentenced was master middleman Janet Napoles to 100 years in prison.

text: Gapati kita ugaling nga basi maliwat man ining sayop nga pamatasan sa ginahiwat karon nga People Power nga mga hublag sang mga pumuluyo.
english: We believe, however, that this wrong behavior may be repeated in the ongoing People Power movements.

text: In fact, ang ulihi nga mga balita nagasiling nga may na-file na nga mga graft cases, pati na warrant of arrest, batok sining mga opisyales nga ginapangunahan ni  House Speaker Romualdez, Partylist Rep.Zaldy Co, pila ka senador, dinosena nga mga DPWH officials kag kaugyon nila nga mga flood control project contractors.
english: In fact, recent reports say that graft cases, including warrants of arrest, have already been filed against these officials led by House Speaker Romualdez, Partylist Rep. Zaldy Co, several senators, dozens of DPWH officials and their fellow flood control project contractors.

text: Gin-deklarar na sang Korte Suprema ang lumpsum allocations sang PDAF nga “unconstitutional” sadtong 2013.
english: The Supreme Court declared the PDAF's lumpsum allocations unconstitutional in 2013.

text: Kag nagsuhestyon sang mas maamligon nga paggamit sang discretionary funds.
english: And suggested a more protective use of discretionary funds.

text:
***

Naungkat pa gani ang isyu sang budget insertions sa 2025 GAA angot sa multi-trillion nga flood control project anomaly nga na-trace halin sadtong 2016.
english:
***

The issue of budget insertions in the 2025 GAA was even raised regarding the multi-trillion flood control project anomaly that has been traced since 2016.

text: Naglabag kuno ini sang 2025 GAA sa idalom sang Separation of Power kay may yara kuno nga mga budget insertions sang mga kongresista kag mga senador nga napasulod sa 2025 GAA bisan pa approved na ini sang Presidente.
english: It allegedly violated the 2025 GAA under the Separation of Power because there were budget insertions by congressmen and senators that were included in the 2025 GAA even though it was approved by the President.

text:
Ang ebidensya amo ang stamped notice: “For release later.”

a expose ni Lacson, halos tanan kuno nga mga senador nakapasulod sang PhP100-M nga insertion sa 2025 GAA.
english:
The evidence was the stamped notice: “For release later.”

Lacson exposed that almost all senators have included PhP100-M insertion in the 2025 GAA.

text: Sugod sang panahon ni Cory, nagabaton sang pork ang congressman, senador, kag Bise Presidente, nga  sadto ginpasugtan pa sang Korte Suprema sang 1994.
english: Since Cory's time, the congressman, senator, and Vice President have received pork, which was then allowed by the Supreme Court in 1994.

text: Gin-describe pa gani ini sang Korte Suprema nga “innovative”.
english: The Supreme Court even described it as “innovative”.

text: Sang 1993, ang specific allocations sa kada congressman amo ang PhP12.5 ka Milyon, senador (PhP18 ka Milyon), kag Bise Presidente PhP20 ka Milyon.
english: In 1993, the specific allocations per congressman were PhP12.5 million, senator (PhP18 million), and Vice President PhP20 million.

text: Understandably, wala malakip dira ang Presidente tungod ang Presidente may natalana nga Presidential Discretionary Fund sa GAA nga gina-aprubahan sang Kongreso sa ila pag-review sang proposed Executive Budget sang Presidente.
english: Understandably, the President is not included because the President has a designated Presidential Discretionary Fund in the GAA that is approved by Congress in their review of the President's proposed Executive Budget.

text: Tungod sini naham-ot gani ang iban kon ngaa nakabaton kuno si PBBM sang PhP100 ka Milyon nga  pork barrel allocation.
english: Because of this, some people wonder why PBBM received PhP100 million pork barrel allocation.

text: Sobra-sobra na ina ya ka malisyoso nga panghuna-huna.
english: That's too much malicious thinking.

text:
***

By the way, sa aton ordinaryo nga mga pumuluyo pwede naton makilala kon pork barrel allocation gid man ang isa ka allocation.
english:
***

By the way, to our ordinary citizens we can recognize if an allocation is really a pork barrel allocation.

text:
Sunu sa non-profit nga grupo nga Citizens Against Government Waste (CAGW), nga naglista sadtong 1991 sang criteria para sa pork barrel legislation, kag earmarks, ini ang masunod:

Gin-request lang sang isa ka chamber sang Kongreso; Indi specifically authorized; Indi competitively awarded; Wala ma-request sang Presidente; Ga-exceed sang President’s budget request, ukon sang previous year’s funding; Indi subject sang congressional hearings; ukon Ga-serve lang sang lokal ukon special interest.
english:
According to the non-profit group Citizens Against Government Waste (CAGW), which listed in 1991 criteria for pork barrel legislation, and earmarks, these are as follows:

Just requested by one chamber of Congress; Not specifically authorized; Not competitively awarded; Not requested by the President; Exceeds the President’s budget request, or the previous year’s funding; Not subject to congressional hearings; or Serves only a local or special interest.

text: Ma-differentiate man ang Pork Barrel sa Earmarking, although pagkaparyente man sila.
english: Pork Barrel will also be differentiated in Earmarking, although they are related.

text: Ang Pork Barrel spending nagatumod sa allocation sang  taxpayer funds para sa localized projects nga ginapatoon primarily sa galastuhon sa distrito sang kongresista kag iban nga opisyal lokal.
english: Pork Barrel spending refers to the allocation of taxpayer funds for localized projects that are primarily focused on the district expenditures of congressmen and other local officials.

text: Earmarks, on the other hand, mga pondo ini nga na-set aside para  sa special projects.
english: Earmarks, on the other hand, are funds set aside for special projects.

text: Sa masami, may mga specific start date, kag targeted sa isa ka partikular nga siyudad ukon distrito.
english: Usually, there are specific start dates, and targeted to a particular city or district.

text: Ang mga proyekto diri galakip sang infrastructure improvements sa public works, although ma-criticize man sing masami ini nga “unnecessary” ukon “wasteful”./PN
english: The projects here include infrastructure improvements to public works, although they are often criticized as “unnecessary” or “wasteful”./PN

text: Isa ka man sa nagdaku sa mga kanta sang SexBomb Girls?
english: Are you one of those who grew up on SexBomb Girls songs as well?

text:
Wala pa natapos ang ila nga reunion show bangud ila gin-anunsyo nga may ara pa gid sila sang “Round 6!”

Sa Get Get Aw!
english:
Their reunion show is not over yet as they announced that they have another “Round 6!”

The Get Get Aw!

text: Round 5 show sini nga Domingo, ginpahayag sang grupo nga may Round 6 ang ila in-demand nga concert.
english: Round 5 show this Sunday, the group announced that there will be Round 6 of their in-demand concert.

text: Samtang, gin-anunsyo man nga may palaabuton nga world tour ang grupo, apang wala pa sang detalye kun san-o ini pagahimuon kag kun diin nga mga pungsod.
english: Meanwhile, it was also announced that the group has an upcoming world tour, but there are no details on when it will be held and in which countries.

text: Una nga ginhiwat ang SexBomb Girls reunion concert sa Araneta Coliseum sang Disyembre 4, kag ginsundan sang ikaduha nga show Mall of Asia Arena sang Disyembre 9.
english: First held the SexBomb Girls reunion concert at Araneta Coliseum on December 4, followed by a second show Mall of Asia Arena on December 9.

text: Ang ikatlo, ika-apat, kag ikalima nga shows ginhiwat man sa MOA Arena sang Pebrero 6, 7, kag 8.
english: The third, fourth, and fifth shows were also held at the MOA Arena on February 6th, 7th, and 8th.

text: Kilala ang SexBomb Girls nga ginabug-usan nanday Rochelle Pangilinan, Jopay Paguia, Mia Pangyarihan, Aira Bermudez, Sunshine Garcia, Aifha Medina, Weng Ibarra, kag iban pa.
english: The SexBomb Girls are known to consist of Rochelle Pangilinan, Jopay Paguia, Mia Pangyarihan, Aira Bermudez, Sunshine Garcia, Aifha Medina, Weng Ibarra, and others.

text: Magluwas sa ila abilidad sa pagsaot, bantog man sila sa ila nga hit songs pareho sang “The Spaghetti Song,” “Halukay Ube,” kag iban pa gid.
english: Besides their dancing skills, they are also famous for their hit songs such as “The Spaghetti Song,” “Halukay Ube,” and many more.

text: Nagbabala ang isang dermatologist na maaaring magdulot ng sunburn at skin cancer ang labis na pagbabad sa araw, lalo na sa gitna ng matinding init.
english: A dermatologist warns that excessive sun exposure, especially in the midst of extreme heat, can cause sunburn and skin cancer.

text: Ayon kay Dr. Henedina “Dina” Belicena, mahalagang alagaan ang balat hindi lang para sa kagandahan kundi para sa kalusugan.
english: According to Dr. Henedina “Dina” Belicena, it is important to take care of the skin not only for beauty but for health.

text: Sa panayam ng Bombo Radyo kay Dr. Belicena, isang dermatologist at miyembro ng Public Safety group ng Philippine Dermatological Society, binigyang-diin niya ang kahalagahan ng edukasyon sa publiko hinggil sa “skin health.” Aniya, hindi lamang ito tungkol sa pagpapaganda kundi sa wastong pagprotekta sa balat laban sa mga sakit mula sa kapaligiran, partikular ang sikat ng araw.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Dr. Belicena, a dermatologist and member of the Public Safety group of the Philippine Dermatological Society, stressed the importance of public education on skin health. He said it's not just about beauty but also about protecting the skin against environmental diseases, particularly the sun.

text: Ipinaliwanag niya na may tatlong pangunahing uri ng ultraviolet (UV) rays mula sa araw: ang UVA, na tumatagos sa balat at nagpapabilis ng pagtanda; UVB, na nagdudulot ng sunburn; at UVC, ang pinaka-mapanganib at maaaring magdulot ng skin cancer.
english: He explained that there are three main types of ultraviolet (UV) rays from the sun: UVA, which penetrates the skin and accelerates aging; UVB, which causes sunburn; and UVC, the most dangerous and capable of causing skin cancer.

text: Bukod sa sunburn, binanggit ni Dr. Belicena ang mga kondisyon tulad ng melasma, na lumalala sa sobrang init at paggamit ng ilang cosmetics na nagpapasensitibo sa balat.
english: In addition to sunburn, Dr. Belicena said conditions such as melasma, which are exacerbated by excessive heat and the use of certain cosmetics that sensitize the skin.

text: Pinakaapektado, aniya, ang mga may light complexion, may family history ng cancer, at yaong madalas na na-e-expose sa araw, bagamat may mga kaso rin sa morena o dark-skinned individuals.
english: Most affected, he said, are those with light complexion, family history of cancer, and those who are often exposed to the sun, although there are also cases in brunettes or dark-skinned individuals.

text: Dagdag niya, may dalawang pangunahing uri ng skin cancer: Basal Cell Carcinoma at Melanoma.
english: He added that there are two main types of skin cancer: Basal Cell Carcinoma and Melanoma.

text: Bagamat may genetic factors, malaki ang epekto ng environmental exposure, kabilang na ang maling paggamit ng produkto.
english: Although there are genetic factors, environmental exposure, including product misuse, has a significant impact.

text: Nagbabala rin si Dr. Belicena laban sa paggamit ng mga unregistered whitening products na may delikadong sangkap gaya ng mercury, na maaaring magdulot ng kondisyong tinatawag na ochronosis.
english: Dr. Belicena against the use of unregistered whitening products containing dangerous ingredients such as mercury, which can cause a condition called ochronosis.

text: Aniya, dapat iwasan ang self-medication at palaging suriin ang label ng mga produktong ginagamit.
english: He said self-medication should be avoided and always check the label of the products used.

text: Bilang proteksyon, inirerekomenda niya ang paggamit ng sunblock o sunscreen na may SPF at “clean form” na active ingredients.
english: For protection, he recommends using a sunblock or sunscreen with SPF and “clean form” active ingredients.

text: Ayon sa kanya, sapat na ang 15 minutong sun exposure kada araw para sa Vitamin D, ngunit dapat iwasan ang araw mula 10:00 AM hanggang 3:00 PM.
english: According to him, 15 minutes of sun exposure per day is enough for Vitamin D, but the sun should be avoided from 10:00 AM to 3:00 PM.

text: Paalala pa niya, may ilang sangkap sa sunscreen tulad ng oxybenzone at octinoxate na maaaring makasira ng coral reefs, kaya’t mahalagang suriin ang nilalaman at pinanggalingan ng bawat produktong ginagamit.
english: He reminded that there are some ingredients in sunscreen such as oxybenzone and octinoxate that can damage coral reefs, so it is important to check the contents and origin of each product used.

text: Giit ni Dr. Belicena, ang balat ay hindi lamang panlabas na anyo kundi pananggalang ng ating kalusugan , kaya’t ito ay nararapat pangalagaan.
english: Giit by Dr. Belicena, the skin is not only an outward appearance but also a protection of our health, so it deserves to be cared for.

text: Nagtaliwan na sa edad nga 47-anyos si Brad Arnold nga founder kag lead singer sang American rock band nga 3 Doors Down.
english: Brad Arnold, founder and lead singer of the American rock band 3 Doors Down, has died at the age of 47.

text: Natabo ini siyam ka bulan matapos ginsapubliko sang singer nga na-diagnose siya nga may Stage 4 kidney cancer.
english: This happened nine months after the singer made it public that she was diagnosed with Stage 4 kidney cancer.

text: Mayo 2025 sang ginkumpirma ni Arnold nga may yara siya sang advanced-stage clear cell renal carcinoma (ccRCC)nga naglapta na sa isa sa iya lungs.
english: In May 2025, Arnold confirmed that he had advanced-stage clear cell renal carcinoma (ccRCC)which had spread to one of his lungs.

text: Ini amo ang pinaka-common nga sahi sang kidney cancer suno sa National Cancer Institute nga ang sintomas nagalakip sang tuman nga sakit, pagniwang, kag hilanat.
english: It is the most common form of kidney cancer according to the National Cancer Institute with symptoms including severe pain, weight loss, and fever.

text: Bangud sadto, ginkanselar sang 3 Doors Down ang ila plano nga 2025 summer tour.
english: Because of that, 3 Doors Down canceled their planned 2025 summer tour.

text:
Gintukod ang banda sang 1996 sa Escatawpa, Mississippi, kag nangin popular sang 2000 paagi sa ginsulat ni Arnold nga single nga “Kryptonite.” Lakip sa iban nila nga hits amo ang “When I’m Gone” kag “Here Without You.”

Luwas kay Arnold, yara ang bassist nga si Todd Harrell, ang lead guitar kag backup singer nga si Matt Roberts, kag sang ulihi gin-updan sila ni Chris Henderson nga amo naman ang sa rhythm guitar kag singing backup vocals.
english:
The band formed in 1996 in Escatawpa, Mississippi, and rose to prominence in 2000 with the Arnold-penned single “Kryptonite.” Among their other hits are “When I’m Gone” and “Here Without You.”

In addition to Arnold, there was bassist Todd Harrell, lead guitar and backup singer Matt Roberts, and later they were joined by Chris Henderson who was also on rhythm guitar and singing backup vocals.

text: Sang 2017, nag-perform man ang 3 Doors Down sa una nga inauguration concert ni President Donald Trump.
english: In 2017, 3 Doors Down also performed at President Donald Trump’s first inauguration concert.

text: Nagsaka naman ang presyo sang produktong petrolyo nga ginagamit sa mga international flights sa pungsod sang Nepal suno sa Nepal Oil Corporation (NOC).
english: The price of petroleum products used in international flights in Nepal has increased, according to the Nepal Oil Corporation (NOC).

text: Ini matapos nga nagtimbuok na sa 84% tubtob 117.4% ang saka sang aviation fuels para sa mga international flights halin sa mga siudad sang nasambit nga pungsod kaangay sang Kathmandu, Pokhara, kag Bhairahawa.
english: This comes after the increase in aviation fuels for international flights from cities such as Kathmandu, Pokhara, and Bhairahawa has increased by 84% to 117.4%.

text: Suno sa NOC, kinahanglan nga ipatuman ang fuel price hike agud nga mabaydan sa insakto nga tion ang Indian Oil Corporation nga amo ang ila ginakuhaan sang gatong.
english: According to the NOC, the fuel price hike must be implemented in order to pay the Indian Oil Corporation, which is their source of fuel, on time.

text: Nahibaluan nga limitado naman ang pagbakal sang mga residente sang lugar sa cooking gas bangud limitado naman ang ila suplay sang gatong sa bilog nga pungsod.
english: It is learned that the residents of the area are limited in their purchase of cooking gas due to the limited supply of fuel nationwide.

text: Napierde sa kaso ang isa ka empleyada sa Alicante, Spain matapos niya nga ginkasuhan ang iya nga employer bangud sa unfair dismissal.
english: An employee in Alicante, Spain lost a case after she sued her employer for unfair dismissal.

text: Ang rason sang pagpahalin sa iya amo ang masami nga pagsulod sa trabaho sang tuman ka aga.
english: The reason for his dismissal was frequently coming into work too early in the morning.

text: Suno sa report, naandan sang babaye nga magsulod sa opisina sang 6:45 sang aga bisan pa nga 7:30 pa ang iya nga shift.
english: According to the report, the woman used to enter the office at 6:45 am even though her shift was still at 7:30 am.

text: Ginrason sang kompaniya nga nagresulta ini sa problema bangud wala man ini sang ulubrahon sa amo nga oras.
english: The company argued that this resulted in problems because it was not working at that time.

text: Ginpaandaman na ini sang 2023, apang ginbalewala niya ini tubtob nga ginpahalin siya sa ubra.
english: He had been warned about it in 2023, but he ignored it until he was fired.

text: Sa desisyon naman sang korte, nagpabor ini sa employer bangud ang pagpakatig-a sang babaye ang makabig nga “disloyalty,” “breach of trust,” kag “disobedience,” nga bastante nga rason agud kakson ini sa trabaho.
english: In its decision, the court ruled in favor of the employer because the woman's stubbornness was considered “disloyalty,” “breach of trust,” and “disobedience,” which was enough reason to fire her.

text: Buhi pa ang paglaum sang Philippine women’s national football team nga makasulod sa quarterfinals sang AFC Women’s Asian Cup 2026 matapos ginlutos ang Iran sa katapusan nga group stage match, 2-0.
english: The Philippine women's national football team's hopes of reaching the quarterfinals of the AFC Women's Asian Cup 2026 are still alive after beating Iran in the final group stage match, 2-0.

text: Sa hampang sa Gold Coast, Australia, naka-goal para sa Filipinas si Sara Eggesvik sa ika-29 nga minuto kag ginsundan ni Chandler McDaniel sa ika-82 nga minuto.
english: In the match in Gold Coast, Australia, Sara Eggesvik scored for the Philippines in the 29th minute followed by Chandler McDaniel in the 82nd minute.

text: Ini ang una nga kadalag-an sang team sa tournament matapos ang magkasunod sang kalutusan sa kamot sang powerhouse teams nga Australia kag South Korea.
english: This is the team's first victory in the tournament after consecutive defeats at the hands of powerhouse teams Australia and South Korea.

text: Nagapangatlo na subong ang Filipinas sa Group A nga may tres puntos, apang kinahanglan pa nga hulaton ang resulta sang duha ka iban pa nga grupo.
english: The Philippines is now third in Group A with three points, but the results of the other two groups will have to wait.

text: Ang duha ka best third placers sa tournament amo ang maga-upod sa top two teams sa kada tatlo ka grupo sa quarterfinals.
english: The two best third placers in the tournament will join the top two teams in each of the three groups in the quarterfinals.

text: Didto kag maga-compete sila para sa anum ka spot para sa confederation sa 2027 FIFA Women’s World Cup.
english: There and they will compete for six spots for the confederation in the 2027 FIFA Women’s World Cup.

text: Ang goal difference amo ang posible basehan kun sin-o ang mangin best two third-placers.#
english: The goal difference is the likely basis for who will be the best two third-placers.#

text: Hugot nga ginakondenar ni Iloilo City Mayor Raisa Treñas ang nangin pahayag ni Quezon City 4th District Representative Jesus “Bong” Suntay batok sa aktres nga si Anne Curtis sa ginpatigayon nga deliberasyon sang House Committee on Justice para sa impeachment complaints batok kay Vice President Sara Duterte, kun sa diin ginsal-ot ni Suntay ang iya kaugalingon nga imahinasyon.
english: Iloilo City Mayor Raisa Treñas strongly condemns the statement of Quezon City 4th District Representative Jesus “Bong” Suntay against actress Anne Curtis in the deliberation of the House Committee on Justice for the impeachment complaints against Vice President Sara Duterte, where Suntay expressed his own imagination.

text: Madumduman nga sa amo nga hearing, ginpakigahin ni Suntay nga nakit-an sini anay sa isa ka mall si Anne Curtis, kag bangud sa tuman sini nga katahum, nakabatyag ini sang “desire” suno sa iya kag na-“imagine” na lamang niya kun ano ang iya himuon sa amo nga actress.
english: During the hearing, Suntay shared that he saw Anne Curtis in a mall, and because of her beauty, he felt a desire and imagined what he would do to the actress.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Joy Fantilaga Gorzal, spokesperson ni Mayor Treñas, iya ginpahayag nga bilang isa ka babaye kag bilang mayor sang Iloilo City, indi siya pwede nga maghipos lamang sa amo nga pahayag bangud isa ini ka “unacceptable” nga pahayag kag wala ini sang lugar sa bisan ano nga public discourse.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Joy Fantilaga Gorzal, spokesperson of Mayor Treñas, said that as a woman and as mayor of Iloilo City, she cannot remain silent on the statement because it is an “unacceptable” statement and has no place in any public discourse.

text: Dugang pa sini nga ang kada tinaga sang isa ka public official ang may yara gid sang kabug-atun sa ano man nga tion, bisan pa hambalon nga isa lamang ini ka “imagination”.
english: He added that every word of a public official has weight at any time, even if it is said that it is just an “imagination”.

text: Nagpangabay sa karun ang alkalde nga respetuhon ang tagsa ka kababaehan sa tanan nga ti-on.
english: The mayor urged the public to respect each woman at all times.

text: Nagpanawagan man ini kay rep Suntay nga magpagua sang isa ka “sincere” public apology.
english: He also called on Rep. Suntay to issue a “sincere” public apology.

text: MADAMO ang nagpabutyag, lakip si Presidente Marcos Jr., sang pagdayaw sa daku nga rolyo sang 4.75 km.
english: MANY expressed, including President Marcos Jr., admiration for the massive 4.75 km roll.

text: nga Jaro Floodway sa pagsalo sang tanan nga tubig-baha halin sa mga kabanwahanan nga gindala sang Bagyo Tino sadtong Nobyembre 4.
english: Jaro Floodway to catch all the flood waters from the towns brought by Typhoon Tino on November 4.

text: Tungod sini, naluwas sa mapintas nga pagbinaha ang madamo nga mga pumuluyo sa Siyudad sang Iloilo.
english: As a result, many residents in Iloilo City were saved from the severe flooding.

text: Kag kon  may nabahaan gid man, apat (4) lang sa 180 ka barangay – sing manabaw man lang – nga dala sang sobra 200 ka milimetro nga ulan nga ginbubu sang Bagyo Tino sa mapatag (flatlands) nga bahin sang siyudad.
english: And if there were any flooded, only four (4) of the 180 barangays – even superficially – were caused by more than 200 millimeters of rain that Typhoon Tino dumped on the flatlands of the city.

text: Kag, salamat man sa Diyos nga wala gid sing napatay sa mga pumuluyo sa kon ano man nga panghalit nga ginhimo sang Bagyo Tino.
english: And, thank God that no one was killed in any of the damage caused by Typhoon Tino.

text: Luyag na gani himuon ni PBBM ang Jaro Floodway nga modelo sang matukod pa nga flood control projects sa pungsod.
english: PBBM even wants to make the Jaro Floodway a model for future flood control projects in the country.

text: Samtang, ang Cebu nga, kasubong sang Syudad sang Iloilo, nasentruhan man sang Bagyo Tino natam-an gid sa pag-awas sang ila multi-bilyon nga mga flood control project nga gintukod sa apat (4) ka major rivers dira sa balor nga PhP17.44 ka Bilyon.
english: Meanwhile, Cebu, which, like Iloilo City, was also hit by Typhoon Tino, was severely affected by the overflow of their multi-billion flood control projects built on four (4) major rivers at a cost of PhP17.44 billion.

text: Ginkilala ini nga hitabo sang gobernador sang Cebu nga “the worst flashflood caused by a typhoon” sa kasaysayan sang probinsya.
english: The governor of Cebu described the incident as “the worst flashflood caused by a typhoon” in the history of the province.

text: Sobra 150 ang napatay diri, laban sa pagkalumos sa tubig-baha nga nag-lab-ot sa pitu (7) ka tapak ang kadalom sa madamo nga lugar, kag nag-displace sang linibo ka pumuluyo nga nakaluwas.
english: More than 150 people died here, mostly drowning in flood waters that reached seven (7) feet deep in many places, and displaced thousands of residents who survived.

text:
***

Ang pamangkot: ”Paano natabo ang kasubong kasubo nga hitabo sa sobra ka mahal nga flood control projects (PhP17.44-B) dira sa Cebu, samtang nangin madinalag-on ang 4.75 km.
english:
***

The question: “How did such a sad incident happen in the very expensive flood control projects (PhP17.44-B) here in Cebu, while the 4.75 km was successful.

text:
nga Jaro Flooway nga gingastuhan lang sang PhP5 ka Bilyon?”

Well, sa lakat sang mga akusasyon karon batok sa korapsyon sa pagtukod sang linibo ka mga flood control project sa pungsod, indi na kita seguro mamangkot pa sa mga pumuluyo kon ano ang rason.
english:
Jaro Flooway that cost only PhP5 billion?”

Well, with the current accusations against corruption in the construction of thousands of flood control projects in the country, we probably won't ask the people what the reason is.

text: Ang buot bala silingon sini nga ang Jaro Floodway natukod nga wala korapsyon kag natigayon lang tungod sa “honest engineering works” nga wala sing ginbaldog nga pondo kag ginlapas nga work ethics nga ga-resulta sa substandard projects?
english: Does this mean that the Jaro Floodway was built without corruption and was achieved only because of “honest engineering works” without embezzlement of funds and violation of work ethics that resulted in substandard projects?

text: Sunu sa report sang DPWH mismo, ang Jaro Floodway gintukod nga yara sa pensar ang critical development sang Siyudad sang Iloilo bilang Economic Hub sang Western Visayas.
english: According to the DPWH's own report, the Jaro Floodway was built with the critical development of Iloilo City as the Economic Hub of Western Visayas in mind.

text: In fact, ginkilala ni anay Presidente Gloria Arroyo (2001-2010) ang Jaro Floodway nga isa ka “life-saving project” nga napamatud-an sa tion sang mapintas nga Bagyo Tino.
english: In fact, former President Gloria Arroyo (2001-2010) recognized the Jaro Floodway as a “life-saving project” that was proven during the fierce Typhoon Tino.

text: Gapati man sadto si Arroyo sang daku nga rolyo sang Jaro Floodway sa pagpasanyog sang overall economic development sang Western Visayas, nga makita karon sa siyudad.
english: Arroyo also believed in the great role of the Jaro Floodway in promoting the overall economic development of Western Visayas, which can now be seen in the city.

text:
***

Ang wake-up call agud aksyunan ang problema sang pagbinaha sa Siyudad sang Iloilo ginpanawagan na sadtong Hulyo 1994 pa, sang gin-igu ang siyudad sang sige-sige nga pag-ulan nga nagpalubog sa tubig-baha sang madamo nga lugar sa siyudad, kun diin ang mayor nga igu amo ang mga pumuluyo malapit sa Jaro River.
english:
***

The wake-up call to address the flooding problem in Iloilo City was called back in July 1994, when the city was hit by heavy rains that submerged many areas in the city, with the main hit being the residents near the Jaro River.

text: Sadtong 1998 liwat gin-igu sang pagbinaha ang siyudad, nga tubtub sang 2001 ang naapektuhan naglab-ot sa 119,028 ka panimalay sa sunod-sunod nga anom (6) ka beses nga pagbinaha.
english: In 1998, the city was again hit by floods, which until 2001 affected 119,028 households in six consecutive floods.

text: Gani, sadtong 1998 mismo ginduso na sang mga opisyales lokal, business groups, kag mga pumuluyo agud padasigon na ang pagtukod sang Jaro Floodway ng ginaunat-unat pa sugod sadtong 1999 tungod sa isyu sang economic benefits sang proyekto.
english: Therefore, in 1998, local officials, business groups, and residents proposed to accelerate the construction of the Jaro Floodway, which has been delayed since 1999 due to the issue of economic benefits of the project.

text: Ugaling, napadasig na ang trabaho sa proyekto tubtub natapos ini sadtong 2011 pagkatapos nga iguon ang siyudad sang Bagyo Frank sadtong Hunyo 2008, nga naglublob sa baha sang halos 80 porsyento gid sang siyudad.
english: However, work on the project was accelerated until it was completed in 2011 after Typhoon Frank hit the city in June 2008, flooding nearly 80 percent of the city.

text: Ang 4.75-kilometer nga floodway gin-design agud ilikaw ang runoff flow halin sa Aganan kag Tigum Rivers liw-as sa Jaro River sa bag-o nga alagyan (floodway) pakadto sa Iloilo Strait.
english: The 4.75-kilometer floodway is designed to divert runoff flow from the Aganan and Tigum Rivers besides the Jaro River to the new floodway to the Iloilo Strait.

text: Sadtong 2000 kag 2001-2016 Senate President na ang Ilonggo Senator nga si FranklinDrilon nga tungod sini ginpanguhan na sini ang mga lokal nga mga opisyales sa pag-lobby kag coordinate sa gobyerno nasyonal agud matigayon ining proyekto sa paggasto sang gobyerno nasyonal kag sang pagpamuno sang DPWH.
english: In 2000 and 2001-2016, Ilonggo Senator Franklin Drilon was Senate President and therefore he hired local officials to lobby and coordinate with the national government to achieve this project at the expense of the national government and the leadership of the DPWH.

text: Si anay Mayor Treñas ang may mas malawig nga panahon sa pag-coordinate sa DPWH sang problem sang pagtukod sang Jaro Floodway, lakip ang pagpatuman sang maintenance sini sunu sa nahisugtan sa DPWH.
english: Former Mayor Treñas has a longer period to coordinate with the DPWH on the problem of the construction of the Jaro Floodway, including the implementation of its maintenance as agreed with the DPWH.

text: Meyor na siya sadtong 1992 kag sang 2001-2010, kag kongresista pa sadtong 2010-2019.
english: He was mayor in 1992 and 2001-2010, and a congressman from 2010-2019.

text: Bag-o sini, nangin myembro man siya sang City Council  sadtong1986-1992.
english: Before that, he was also a member of the City Council from 1986-1992.

text: Naabtan man ang pag-ubra sang Jaro Floodway ni anay Mayor Mansueto Malabor nga nangin meyor sadtong 1992-2001.
english: The construction of the Jaro Floodway was also caught up with former Mayor Mansueto Malabor who served as mayor from 1992-2001.

text: Subong man ni anay Mayor Jed Parick Mabilog sadtong 2010-2017.
english: Likewise, former Mayor Jed Parick Mabilog from 2010-2017.

text:
***

Ginpatuman ang pagtukod sang Jaro Floodway in partnership sa mga masaligan nga mga foreign partners, nga makahatag sang bagay nga pondo, bagay nga kinaalam kag experyensya, kag may reputasyon sang honest work.
english:
***

The construction of the Jaro Floodway was implemented in partnership with reliable foreign partners, who can provide the right funding, the right knowledge and experience, and have a reputation for honest work.

text: Gin-finance ini sang Japan Bank for International Cooperation (JICA), nga ka-partner ang China International Water & Electric Corp.
english: It was financed by the Japan Bank for International Cooperation (JICA), in partnership with China International Water & Electric Corp.

text: (Phase 1), kag sa Phase 2 sang Hanjin Heavy Industries Co.
english: (Phase 1), and in Phase 2 of Hanjin Heavy Industries Co.

text: Ltd.
english: Ltd.

text: (Korea), kag Construction Supervision: CTI Engineering International Co., Ltd.
english: (Korea), and Construction Supervision: CTI Engineering International Co., Ltd.

text: (Japan) tubtub matapos sadtong 2011.
english: (Japan) until the end of 2011.

text: Segurado nga indi gid malimtan namon nga mga pumuluyo ang inyo nabulig sa pagtukod sang Jaro Floodway.
english: We will surely never forget your contribution to the construction of the Jaro Floodway.

text: Kag salamat, on behalf sang mga pumuluyo nga nakabenepisyo direkta sa Jaro Floodway, labi na sa tion sang pagtodo ulan sa siyudad, kag sa amot sini sa pagpasanyog sang ekonomiya sang siyudad./PN
english: And thank you, on behalf of the residents who benefited directly from the Jaro Floodway, especially during the heavy rains in the city, and for its contribution to the city's economic development./PN

text: Posible nga mangin epektibo na masunod nga bulan ang pagsaka sa balayran sa kuryente bangud sang epekto sang gyera sa Middle East kag bangud sa padayon nga pagluya sang balor sang Philippine Peso batok sa US Dollar.
english: The increase in electricity bills is likely to take effect next month due to the impact of the war in the Middle East and the continued depreciation of the Philippine Peso against the US Dollar.

text: Suno kay Energy Regulatory Commission (ERC) Chairperson Francis Saturnino Juan, maga-reflect ini sa bills sa Abril bilang epekto na sa presyo sang suplay sa generation companies, distribution utilities, kag mga retailer.
english: According to Energy Regulatory Commission (ERC) Chairperson Francis Saturnino Juan, this will be reflected in the bills in April as an impact on the price of supply to generation companies, distribution utilities, and retailers.

text: Sa subong, wala pa natumod sang komisyon kun pila eksakto ang ipasaka sa power rates.
english: At present, the commission has not yet determined the exact amount of power rates to be increased.

text: Una na nga nagpaguwa sang projection ang National Association of Electricity Consumers for Reforms (NASECORE).
english: Earlier, the National Association of Electricity Consumers for Reforms (NASECORE) released a projection.

text: Kun ibase sa additional cost suno sa asosasyon, posible nga may dugang sa electricity rate nga P2 tubtub P4, apang i-cover lamang sini ang supply nga ginhatag sang Wholesale Electricity Spot Market (WESM).
english: Based on the additional cost, the association said, there may be an increase in the electricity rate of P2 to P4, but it will only cover the supply provided by the Wholesale Electricity Spot Market (WESM).

text: Ang dugang nga dos pesos ang katumbas sang P400 nga dugang nga payment para sa mga balay nga may konsumo nga 200 kilowatt hours.
english: The additional two pesos is equivalent to a P400 additional payment for households with a consumption of 200 kilowatt hours.

text: Ginklaro man sang ERC nga naghatag ini sang direktiba sa electric utilities kag generation suppliers nga magpanukot kag magpasaka sang charges sa staggered basis ukon utay-utay ukon pahat-pahat lamang agud indi man matam-an ang mga konsumidor sang kuryente.
english: The ERC also clarified that it has given directives to electric utilities and generation suppliers to collect and raise charges on a staggered basis or in small amounts or in installments so that consumers do not have too much electricity.

text: Nagtipon-tipon ang pila ka mga magpamilya subong nga adlaw sa beach agud iselebrar ang Domingo sang pagkabanhaw.
english: Some families gathered today at the beach to celebrate Easter Sunday.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Joshua Asuncion, isa sa mga nagpaligo sa Oton Beach, iya ginpahayag nga kada tuig ginahimo nila ini agud nga maka-bonding man sa ila nga pamilya.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Joshua Asuncion, one of the bathers at Oton Beach, said they do this every year to bond with their families.

text: Suno pa sa iya nga bilang isa ka katoliko importante nga iselebrar ini nga adlaw sang pagkabanhaw kaupod ang pamilya agud mangin kumpleto kag mangin masadya ini.
english: He said that as a Catholic it is important to celebrate this day of resurrection with the family so that it will be complete and happy.

text: Dugang pa sini nga ila gid ginapreparahan ang ini nga tion bangud nga malaka lang sila nga magkaupod nga kumpleto kag ang iban sa ila ang may trabaho naman matapos ang ini nga holiday.
english: He added that they are preparing for this time because they are rarely together complete and some of them have jobs after this holiday.

text: Atensyon sa mga wakalan ukon baba-an!
english: Attention to the lips or mouths!

text: Nahibaluan niyo bala nga ang pagkawakalan ninyo ang ang may yara sang negatibo nga epekto sa imo ikaayong lawas?
english: Did you know that your loneliness can have a negative impact on your health?

text: Santu sa pagtuon nga ginpangunahan ni Dr. Artour Rakhimov, napamatud-an nga ang wala untat nga paghambal ang mahimo nga magdulot sang dizziness ukon paglingin sang ulo , light-headache ukon pagsakit sang ulo, pagkadula sang konsentrasyon, emotional instability, muscular tension, kag abnormal posture.
english: According to a study led by Dr. Artour Rakhimov, it has been proven that non-stop talking can cause dizziness, light-headache, loss of concentration, emotional instability, muscular tension, and abnormal posture.

text: Suno kay Dr Rakhimov ang 10 tubtob 20 minutos nga pagwakal ang nagapabag-o sang pattern sang pagginhawa nga kabangdanan sang pagnubo sang arterial and brain CO2 levels nga ginatunaan sang hyperventilation ukon madasig nga pagginhawa nga indi kasubong sang normal, tissue hypoxia ukon pagkadula sang oxygen sa nagkalain-lain nga mga tissues sa lawas kag chronic diseases.
english: According to Dr. Rakhimov, 10 to 20 minutes of breathing changes the breathing pattern causing a decrease in arterial and brain CO2 levels causing hyperventilation or rapid breathing that is not normal, tissue hypoxia or loss of oxygen in various tissues and chronic diseases in the body.

text: May kaangtanan diri, nagpanugyan ang doktor nga buhin-buhinan ang oras sang pagwakal bangud nga kasubong sang iban nga mga butang ang sobra ang ginakabig nga delikado.
english: In this regard, the doctor advised to reduce the time of waking because like other things, too much is considered dangerous.

text: Madamo sang butang nga magagmay pero manamit.
english: Lots of things that are small but delicious.

text: Kaangay sang prutas nga sarisa ukon aratiles ukon Kerson Fruit sa English.
english: Like the sarisa fruit or aratiles or Kerson Fruit in English.

text: Suno kay Dr. Paul Haider,isa ka Spiritual Teacher kag Master Herbalist, ang sarisa makabulig sa pagpanubo sang blood sugar, nagabulig sa paglikaw sa cancer, naga promote sang cardiovascular health, nagapanubo man sang blood pressure, kag naga-block sang pain sa lawas.
english: According to Dr. Paul Haider, a Spiritual Teacher and Master Herbalist, sarisa helps lower blood sugar, helps prevent cancer, promotes cardiovascular health, lowers blood pressure, and blocks pain in the body.

text: Ang sarisa naga- contain sang fiber, water, carbs, protein para sa strong muscles, calcium kag phosphorus para sa strong bones, iron para sa anemia, kag B-Vitamins para sa vitality kag manami nga modo.
english: Sarisa contains fiber, water, carbs, protein for strong muscles, calcium and phosphorus for strong bones, iron for anemia, and B-Vitamins for vitality and good mood.

text: Ang sarisa naga- contain man sang bastante nga amount sang Vitamin C, isa ka potent antioxidant nga nagabulig sa pagbato sa trangkaso.
english: Sarisa also contains a sufficient amount of Vitamin C, a potent antioxidant that helps fight the flu.

text: Magluwas sa prutas, ang dahon sini ang pwede mahimo nga tsaa kag makabulig sa pagpanubo sang blood pressure bangud naga-contain ini sang nitric oxide nga nagapakalma sang blood vessels gani nagaimprove ang imo blood flow.
english: Besides the fruit, the leaves can be made into a tea and help lower blood pressure because it contains nitric oxide which calms the blood vessels thus improving your blood flow.

text: Ano pa ang ginahulat mo, magkaon ka na sang sarisa!
english: What are you waiting for, eat some sarisa!

text: Wala nadulaan sang paglaum ang isa ka estudyante nga tumandok sang Brgy.
english: A student from Brgy.

text: San Francisco, Anini-y, Antique nga naga-eskwela subong sa West Visayas State University sa Iloilo City, apisar nga gintagaan ini sang dako nga pagtilaw sa iya nga kabuhi.
english: San Francisco, Anini-y, Antique who is currently studying at West Visayas State University in Iloilo City, despite being given a big test in his life.

text: Ini amo si Paul Stanford Loquias, nga na diagnose sa sakit nga Arteriovenous Malformation kun sa diin nagakatabo kun may ara sang abnormal blood flow sa ulo sang isa ka tawo.
english: This is Paul Stanford Loquias, who was diagnosed with Arteriovenous Malformation which occurs when there is abnormal blood flow in a person's head.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Loquias, iya ginpahayag nga sang tuig 2024, gulpi na lang ini nga natumba sa ila klase kun sa diin gindala ini sa ospital bangud indi na sini mahulag ang iya lawas.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Loquias said that in 2024, he suddenly fell in class and was taken to the hospital because he could not move his body.

text: Gin-operahan man ini pagkatapos sang pila ka therapy kag sang nagbalik na sya sa pag-eskwela sa kolehiyo sini lamang nga Marso 2026 samtang naga-demo ini sa isa ka eskwelahan sa probinsya sang Iloilo gulpi lang ini liwat nga nagcollapse kag gindala sa ospital.
english: He also underwent surgery after several therapies and when he returned to college in March 2026 while he was demoing at a school in Iloilo province, he suddenly collapsed again and was taken to hospital.

text: Apisar nga wala nagakadulaan sang pagtilaw bangud sa kahimtangan sang iya ikaayong lawas, padayon ini sa gihapon nga nagatuo sa Diyos nga sa pila ka adlaw mangin maayo na ang tanan para sa iya.
english: Although he is not losing his temper due to his health condition, he continues to believe in God that in a few days everything will be all right for him.

text: Sa subong, aktibo ini sa gihapon nga myembro bilang lector, commentator amo man bilang choir kag dancer sa ila simbahan.
english: Today, he is still an active member as a lector, commentator as well as a choir and dancer in their church.

text: Nagapasalamat man ini sa mga tawo nga padayon nga nagbulig sa iya agud nga matalampuwasan sini ang mga pagtilaw nga gina-agyan sa kabuhi.
english: He also thanked the people who continued to help him to overcome the trials he was going through in life.

text: Nakuha sang Filipino pole vaulter nga si EJ Obiena ang gold medal sa Internationales Stadionfest Indoor (ISTAF) Indoor sa Berlin, Germany matapos madinalag-un nga nalampuwasan ang 5.78 meters.
