english: Filipino pole vaulter EJ Obiena won the gold medal at the Internationales Stadionfest Indoor (ISTAF) Indoor in Berlin, Germany after successfully clearing 5.78 meters.

text: Nakuha ni Obiena ang amo nga score sa isa lamang ka attempt, samtang nakuha naman sini ang 5.60 meters sa ikaduha sini nga attempt.
english: Obiena got the score in just one attempt, while he got 5.60 meters in his second attempt.

text: Nakuha naman ni Sondre Guttormsen sang Norway ang silver medal, kag ikatatlo naman sa pwesto sanday Menno Vloon sang Netherlands kag Bo Kanda Lita Baehre sang Germany.
english: Sondre Guttormsen of Norway won the silver medal, while Menno Vloon of the Netherlands and Bo Kanda Lita Baehre of Germany came in third.

text: Ginpakigbahin ni Obiena ang amo nga kadalag-an sa iya social media nga may caption nga “Brick by brick we build,” samtang gin-gamit sini ang kanta sang Parokya ni Edgar bilang background music.
english: Obiena shared the achievement on his social media with the caption “Brick by brick we build,” as he used Edgar’s Parish song as background music.

text: Madinalag-un nga nakuha sang Olympian Pole Vaulter nga si EJ Obiena ang bulawan nga medalya sa Asian Indoor Athletics Championships sa Tianjin, China.
english: Olympian Pole Vaulter EJ Obiena successfully won the gold medal at the Asian Indoor Athletics Championships in Tianjin, China.

text: Natigayun sini nga nalampuwasan ang 5.70 meters sa final round sang kompetisyon.
english: He managed to clear 5.70 meters in the final round of the competition.

text: Liwat nga nagpasimpalad si Obiena sa 5.80 meters, apang napaslawan ini sa iya tatlo ka attempts.
english: Obiena again competed in the 5.80 meters, but failed in his three attempts.

text: Nagasunod naman kay Obiena ang Bronze Medalist nga si Li Chenyang sang China, matapos nga na-clear ang 5.40 meters.
english: Obiena was followed by Bronze Medalist Li Chenyang of China, after clearing 5.40 meters.

text: Sa karun, gina-uyatan ni Obiena ang Asian indoor record nga 5.93 meters, nga iya na-set sang Pebrero 2024 sa ‘Internationales Stadionfest’ (ISTAF) Indoor meet.
english: Obiena currently holds the Asian indoor record of 5.93 meters, which he set in February 2024 at the ‘Internationales Stadionfest’ (ISTAF) Indoor meet.

text: Nagpasugot ang pila ka food manufacturers nga magpatuman sang price freeze tubtub sa duha ka bulan.
english: Some food manufacturers have agreed to implement a price freeze for up to two months.

text: Ginkumpirma ini ni President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.
english: This was confirmed by President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.

text: subong nga adlaw, Marso 20, kasunod sang koordinasyon sa industry players.
english: today, March 20, following coordination with industry players.

text: Kadungan ini sang iya pagbisita sa pasilidad sang Century Pacific Food Inc.
english: This coincided with his visit to the Century Pacific Food Inc. facility.

text: sa Calamba, Laguna kun sa diin gin-check sini ang food supply kag pricing conditions.
english: in Calamba, Laguna where he checked the food supply and pricing conditions.

text: “Not only Century but various food processors and retailers as well, we have adequate stock,” suno kay Marcos.
english: “Not only Century but various food processors and retailers as well, we have adequate stock,” according to Marcos.

text: Ang iya ginbisita amo ang isa sa pinakadaku nga branded food companies sa Pilipinas nga may mga produkto nga nagalakip sang canned tuna, sardinas, meat, dairy, kag plant-based alternatives.
english: What he visited was one of the largest branded food companies in the Philippines with products that include canned tuna, sardines, meat, dairy, and plant-based alternatives.

text: Suno pa sa punong ehekutibo, nagapakig-angot ang gobyerno sa suppliers agud masigurado nga may bastante nga basic goods.
english: The chief executive said the government is liaising with suppliers to ensure that there is enough basic goods.

text: Suno naman kay Trade Secretary Cristina Roque, sa ginpatigayon nga mga inspeksyon sa groceries kag manufacturing plants, nakit-an nga makalawig pa sang isa ka bulan ang current food supply ilabi na ang basic necessities kag prime commodities nga yara sa idalom sang government monitoring.
english: According to Trade Secretary Cristina Roque, in the inspections conducted at groceries and manufacturing plants, it was found that the current food supply will last for another month especially the basic necessities and prime commodities that are under government monitoring.

text: Wala pa ang na-report suno sa tiglikom nga mga kaso sang hoarding ukon profiteering.#
english: The secretary said no cases of hoarding or profiteering have been reported.

text: Nagpatigayun sang hublag protesta sa atubang sang Iloilo City Hall ang pila ka mga progresibo nga grupo, lakip na ang pila ka mga bolantero sa Iloilo Terminal Market kag Iloilo Central Market.
english: Several progressive groups, including some volunteers at the Iloilo Terminal Market and Iloilo Central Market, held a protest in front of the Iloilo City Hall.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Jossel Gabuan, isa ka bulantera sa Iloilo Terminal Market, iya ginpahayag nga nagpromisa si Iloilo City Mayor Raisa Trenas sa ila nga pagahatagan sang nagakaigo nga pwesto ang tanan nga mga vendors nga wala makasulod sa Terminal Market, apang asta subong nagahulat sa gihapon sila sa katumanan sang amo nga promisa.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Jossel Gabuan, a volunteer at the Iloilo Terminal Market, said Iloilo City Mayor Raisa Trenas promised to give them a proper place to all the vendors who did not enter the Terminal Market, but they are still waiting for the fulfillment of that promise.

text: Suno pa sa iya nga nahulogan ini sang iya ginabusong sang tion nga nagpatigayun ang mga personnel sang city hall sa amo nga merkado sang clearing operation kag tuman gid ini kasakit sa iya bilang isa ka iloy, apang wala ini sang mahimo.
english: She said she fell pregnant when the city hall personnel conducted a clearing operation in the market and it was very painful for her as a mother, but she could not do anything.

text: Gi-alegar man sini nga indi mayo ang pagtratar sa ila ni Local Economic Enterprise Office (LEEO) head Maricel Mabaquiao kag gina-harass sila sang mga personnel sang amo nga opisina.
english: He also alleged that they were treated badly by Local Economic Enterprise Office (LEEO) head Maricel Mabaquiao and were harassed by the personnel of the office.

text: Sa karun, nagapanawagan ang mga ini kay Mayor Trenas nga mabalik ang tanan nga mga vendors sa merkado kag mapahanugotan ang mga bolantero nga makabaligya sa palibot sang merkado sa natalana nga oras, lakip na ang pag-isyu sang “goodwill” kag iban pa nga mga balayran sa merkado.
english: They are now calling on Mayor Trenas to return all vendors to the market and allow volunteers to sell around the market at the scheduled time, including the issuance of goodwill and other market fees.

text: Sa separado naman nga interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Public Order and Safety Management Office (POSMO) head Ret.
english: In a separate interview with Bombo Radyo, POSMO head Ret.

text: Pcol.
english: Pcol.

text: Uldarico Garbanzos, iya man ginpaathag nga iya gid nahangpan ang mga panawagan sang bulantero apang ginadumilian na sa karun ang pagbaligya sa bisan diin lamang nga bahin sang dalanun sang siyudad, bangud posible ini magtuga sang huol sa dalagan sang trapiko.
english: Uldarico Garbanzos, he also explained that he understands the calls of the volunteers but it is now prohibited to sell in any part of the city streets, because it may cause disruption to the flow of traffic.

text: Ginklaro man sini nga apisar may yara sila sang joint operation sa Iloilo Terminal kag Central Market, wala “nagapang-confiscate kag nagapang-harass” ang iya mga personnel.
english: He also clarified that although they have a joint operation in Iloilo Terminal and Central Market, his personnel are not “confiscating and harassing”.

text: Nanindugan ang Revolutionary Guards sang Iran nga indi nila pagbuksan ang Strait of Hormuz sa indi nila kaalyado ukon sa kaaway nila nga mga pungsod.
english: Iran's Revolutionary Guards insist that they will not open the Strait of Hormuz to non-allied or enemy countries.

text: Ini amo ang ila mensahe matapos ang pagpamahog sang Presidente sang Estados Unidos nga si Donald Trump kun sa diin nagpahayag ini nga magapadayun ang gyera samtang wala pa nabuksan sang Iran ang Strait of Hormuz.
english: This is their message after US President Donald Trump threatened to continue the war until Iran opened the Strait of Hormuz.

text: Suno pa sa Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) Navy, sila sa gihapon ang may control sa nasambit nga strait rason nga wala sang shipping vessel sang Estados Unidos ang makalabay.
english: According to the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) Navy, they still have control of the strait, which is why no US shipping vessel can pass through.

text: Nahibaluan nga nagapangabay man ang Pilipinas nga makonsiderar sang Iran nga “non-hostile country” ang pungsod agud nga hilway nga makaagi ang shipping vessels sang Pilipinas samtang nagapadayun pa ang tension sa Middle East.
english: The Philippines is also asking Iran to consider the country a “non-hostile country” so that Philippine shipping vessels can pass freely while tensions in the Middle East continue.

text: Nalaskaran ang plano sang mga abyan sang ginapahayag “source” sang maglive-in partner nga si alyas Badoy kag Tami Muya, matapos nga nadakpan ang mga ini nga nagdul-ong sang shabu sa presuhan.
english: The plan of the friends of the alleged “source” of the live-in partners, alias Badoy and Tami Muya, was foiled after they were arrested for bringing shabu to the jail.

text: Nahibaluan nga nadakpan man sa isa ka drug buy bust operation sang La Paz PNP ang mag-live-in partner nga una man gintudlo sang pamilya Provido nga source sang illegal nga droga ni Johnny Provido nga isa sa apat ka nagkalamatay sa stabbing incident sang gintalikdan nga Marso 21 sa Brgy.
english: It was learned that in a drug buy bust operation of La Paz PNP, the live-in partner who was previously identified by the Provido family as the source of illegal drugs of Johnny Provido, one of the four killed in the stabbing incident last March 21 in Brgy.

text: San Isidro, La Paz.
english: San Isidro, La Paz.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay PCPT Gimel Acuesta, hepe sang Iloilo City Police Station 2, iya ginpahayag nga sa pagbisita sang mga abyan sang ginapahayag source ni Alyas Badoy sa presuhan, didto kag natukiban sang mga kapulisan nga may ready to use nga shabu nga natakpan sang kan-on kag nasulod sa isa ka plasticware.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, PCPT Gimel Acuesta, chief of Iloilo City Police Station 2, said that when friends of the alleged source of Badoy visited the jail, the police discovered that there was ready to use shabu covered with food and in a plasticware.

text: Suno pa kay Acuesta nga madamo sang koneksyon si Tami Muya sa dalagkuan nga mga drug personality sa Metro Manila kun sa diin didto man sini ginakuha ang iban niya nga supply sang illegal drugs.
english: Acuesta said Tami Muya has many connections with big drug personalities in Metro Manila from where he also gets some of his supply of illegal drugs.

text: Ululupod sa karon sa prisohan sang ICPS 2 ang tanan nga nadakpan nga mga drug subject lakip na si Tami Muya kag alyas Badong.
english: All the arrested drug subjects including Tami Muya and alias Badong are currently being held in the ICPS 2 jail.

text: ANG KORAPSYON nagakatabo sa bisan diin nga pungsod, labi na gid sa gobyerno.
english: CORRUPTION is common in any country, especially in government.

text: Depende sa kahimtangan, mainly sa problema sang ekonomiya, kag kon ano ang ginahimo sang gobyerno, pwede ma-classify ang mga ini halin sa “most safeguarded” tubtub sa “least safeguarded” sa korapsyon.
english: Depending on the situation, mainly the economic problem, and what the government is doing, they can be classified from “most safeguarded” to “least safeguarded” in corruption.

text: Sadly, Ika-84 ang Filipinas sa 112 ka mga pungsod nga  vulnerable sa korapsyon halin sa No.
english: Sadly, the Philippines ranks 84th out of 112 countries vulnerable to corruption from No.

text: 1 (most safeguarded) panaog sa 112 (least safeguarded),  sunu sa 2025 Global Fraud Index sang verification service firm Sumsub.
english: 1 (most safeguarded) down to 112 (least safeguarded), according to the 2025 Global Fraud Index by verification service firm Sumsub.

text: Which explains seguro kon ngaa madali matabo ang korapsyon diri sa aton pungsod.
english: Which probably explains why corruption is so easy to happen in our country.

text: In fact, experyensya naton diri ang pila ka dalagku nga mga kaso nga naga-involve pa gani sang pila ka dalagku man nga mga personalidad sa gobyerno, samtang padayon nga wala sing mahimo ang gobyerno agud mapahagan-hagan man lang ini.
english: In fact, we are experiencing here some big cases that even involve some big personalities in the government, while the government continues to do nothing to mitigate it.

text: About time nga seryosohon na gid sang gobyerno ang pagpahagan-hagan sang korapsyon to a significant extent halin sa bagay nga transparency measures to accountability to an effective  independent justice system nga indi mapahog ukon mabakal.
english: About time for the government to take seriously the reduction of corruption to a significant extent from transparency measures to accountability to an effective independent justice system that cannot be intimidated or bought.

text: Sa sining mga dalagku nga mga corruption cases, nagapanguna diri ang Harry Stonehill bribery cases sadtong 1962 nga ang nagbaton bribe ginlista gid niya sa iya Blue Book.
english: Among these major corruption cases, the Harry Stonehill bribery cases of 1962 lead the way in which the recipient of the bribe was listed in his Blue Book.

text: Nalista diri ang indi magkulang sa 200 nga mga opisyales sa gobyerno, lakip pa ang tatlo ka presidente sang pungsod.
english: It lists at least 200 government officials, including the country's three presidents.

text: Grrrr!
english: Grrrr!

text: Kag basta na lang nadula ang Blue Book kag na-deport lang si Harry Stonehill sa Estados Unidos nga na-outlive pa niya ang tatlo naton ka presidente.
english: And as soon as the Blue Book disappeared and Harry Stonehill was deported to the United States, he outlived our three presidents.

text: A case of lost evidence!
english: A case of lost evidence!

text: Nadumduman man sang aton mga pumuluyo ang Pork Barrel (PDAF) Scam nga ang mga corruption cases napasaka sadtong 2013, nga kun si Senador Ping Lacson pa isa ka kaso sang “Selective Justice”.
english: Our people also remember the Pork Barrel (PDAF) Scam that the corruption cases were filed in 2013, which if Senator Ping Lacson was still a case of “Selective Justice”.

text: Man samtang ang mastermind na-sentensyahan sing 100 ka tuig nga pagka-bilanggo ang iya kasosyo nga senador sa korapsyon na-libre bisan pa mas daku ang kasal-anan sini kay public official ini nga natulinan sang “public trust”.
english: While the mastermind was sentenced to 100 years in prison, his corruption partner, a senator, was acquitted despite his greater guilt because he was a public official who was entrusted with public trust.

text: Kon sa kaso pa sang nangawat nga kabulig sa puluy-an isa ka “qualified theft” nga may mas mabug-at nga penalidad bangod gintugyanan siya sang pagsalig sang iya mga amo sa ila puluy-an.
english: In the case of the domestic helper, it is a qualified theft with a heavier penalty because she was entrusted with the trust of her employers in their home.

text: Kag sang sini gid lang, ang multi-bilyon ka pesos nga anomaliya sa pagtukod sang flood control projects nga sa lugar makabulig sa mga pumuluyo, nangin kabangdanan pa sang bangungot sa ila pangabuhi.
english: And recently, the multi-billion pesos anomaly in the construction of flood control projects that in the area will help the residents, has become a cause of nightmare in their lives.

text: Mga palpak gali ining mga flood project, nga ginahampangan lang sang nagaragasa nga baha nga wala lang nanghalit sang mga pagkabutang kundi sang madamo man nga kabuhi.
english: These flood projects are actually failures, only to be played with by raging floods that not only damaged property but also many lives.

text: Kag sa halos kabug-usan gid sang pungsod nga dala sang pila ka bagyo sa una nga binulan sang 2025!
english: And in almost the entire country brought by several hurricanes in the first month of 2025!

text: May mga 5,500 nga flood projects ang natukod sa bug-os nga pungsod sugod sadtong 2016, sunu sa pahayag sang DPWH, nga linibo gali ang depektoso tungod sa korapsyon sang pagpatigayon sini sang mga buaya dira sa gobyerno – kongresista, senador, DPWH officials – nga kasosyo ang kasubong man sa pagka-buaya nga mga project contractors, fuera los buenos.
english: About 5,500 flood projects have been built nationwide since 2016, according to the DPWH, thousands of which are defective due to the corruption of crocodiles in the government – ​​congressmen, senators, DPWH officials – who are also partners in the projects.

text: Kag indi lang linibo, kundi binilyon ka pesos ang ginpalitog gid sang mga buaya, upod ang mga buwitre nga bisan ang patay ginapamentahan pa.
english: And not only thousands, but billions of pesos have been destroyed by crocodiles, including vultures that even the dead are painted.

text: Ghost project diri kag ghost project didto.
english: Ghost project here and ghost project there.

text: Substandard projects diri kag didto.
english: Substandard projects here and there.

text: Kickback diri kag didto sa mga gina-endorso nila nga mga proyekto.
english: Kickback here and there on the projects they endorse.

text: Iligal nga campaign donations.
english: Illegal campaign donations.

text: SOP “commissions” nga PhP10K tubtub P30K sa kada proyekto sa ila distrito.
english: SOP “commissions” of PhP10K to P30K for each project in their district.

text: Nadaug nga bidding paagi sa areglo kag gin-kwarta.
english: Won bidding by arrangement and monetized.

text: Etcetera!!!
english: Etc!!!

text: Tungod sini, indi na kita matingala kon nga luyag na sang mga pamuluyo nga maniguro nga may resulta nga matarong ang mga imbestigasyon sa ila padayon nga hingyo sang People Power, nga ang  masunod sini amo ang ginaplano nila sa  Nobyembre 30.
english: Therefore, we should not be surprised if the people want to ensure that the investigations have a fair outcome in their continuous demand of People Power, the next of which they plan on November 30.

text: Nga daan halos wala aputan ang mga imbestigasyon sang Senate Blue Ribbon Committee kag sang Independent Committee on Infrastructre (ICI), samtang, sa panghuna-huna naton nga mga pumuluyo bastante na ang mga ebidensya agud matum-ok ang ining mga wala huya nga mga korap.
english: The investigations of the Senate Blue Ribbon Committee and the Independent Committee on Infrastructure (ICI) have already been almost completely untouched, while, in the minds of the people, there is enough evidence to convict these shameless corrupt people.

text: May mga nakasumpa na nga mga testigo, na-corroborate man ini sang pag-aku sang mga natungdan kag ebidensya sang palpak nga mga proyekto nga mismo ang mga pumuluyo ang makatestigo.
english: There are already sworn witnesses, corroborated by the confessions of the concerned and evidence of failed projects that the residents themselves can testify.

text: May na-identify naman nga mga tawo nga dapat manabat (accountable), ti, ano pa ang ginahulat sang Ombudsman kag Sandiganbayan agud maaktuhan na ang mga akusasyon?
english: There are already identified people who should be accountable, so what are the Ombudsman and Sandiganbayan waiting for to act on the accusations?

text: Kalokalohon pa anay bala ang mga kaso agud malipat-lipatan?
english: Are the cases still ridiculous to be forgotten?

text: Nga daan may mga suspetso na ang mga pumuluyo sang pagkalokalo sang mga corruption cases batok sa mga daku ulo dira sa gobyerno sandig sa experyensya mismo sang mga pumuluyo sa nagliligad nga mga tinuig.
english: The people already have suspicions of corruption cases against government officials based on the people's own experience in recent years.

text: Nga ang  madamo dira nahulog na gid lang sa “wara kamaan” nga desisyon.
english: That many of them have fallen into the “ignorant” decision.

text: Gani, tani may mahulugan na sang sentensya ang pila ka akusado bag-o ang Nobyembre 30 agud mapatihan pa ang Hustisya diri sa pungsod./PN
english: Therefore, I hope that some of the accused will be sentenced before November 30 so that justice can be believed in the country./PN

text: INDI kita kaseguro kon paano nagsugod ang social life sunu sa natural dynamics sang pagkinabuhi  sang tawo sa kalibutan.
english: WE ARE not sure how social life began according to the natural dynamics of human life on earth.

text: Kag kon paano nag-branch out ang nagakalain-lain nga panghuna-huna kag inisyatibo angot sa pag-inupod nila sa isa ka katilingban.
english: And how different ideas and initiatives branched out about their integration into a society.

text: Tubtub nga nagtuhaw sa karon ang mayor nga mga political/social ideology sang Authoritarianism sa idalom sang isa ka strongman ukon diktador, nga masami ginatib-ong sang military coup; party rule sang Socialismo kag Kommunismo; kag ang ginatawag karon nga Free World.
english: Until the emergence of the present major political/social ideologies of Authoritarianism under a strongman or dictator, often promoted by a military coup; party rule of Socialism and Communism; and what is now called the Free World.

text: Ang Free World nga pangabuhi kag pagginahom mas kilala subong sa tawag nga Demokrasya.
english: The Free World way of life and governance is better known today as Democracy.

text: Gahatag ini sing malawak nga Kahilwayan, lakip ang hilway nga pag-negosyo (Free Enterprise) kag pag-elejer sang mga pamunuan sa gobyerno (Republicanism), kag Kinamatarong sang mga pumuluyo sa idalom sang “Rule of Law”.
english: It provides for broad freedoms, including free enterprise and election of government officials (republicanism), and the right of the people under the “Rule of Law”.

text: Labaw kag labi, ginakilala diri ang lubos nga gahom (Supreme Sovereignty) sang katilingban sang mga pumuluyo nga ang pagmuno ginatulin sa gobyerno nga may check-and-balance sa tunga sang Ehekutibo, Kongreso kag Hudikatura.
english: Above all, it recognizes the Supreme Sovereignty of the people's society whose leadership is vested in the government with checks and balances between the Executive, Congress and the Judiciary.

text:
***

Tungod ang Free World gatugot sang nagakalain-lain nga panghuna-huna kag pagtuo, indi katingalahan kon ngaa magtuhaw sa aton tunga ang nagakalain-lain pa gid nga panan-awan sa kabuhi  sang tawo, nga ginamedyosan sang gobyerno ma-“reconcile” para sa kalinongan sang pag-inupod.
english:
***

Since the Free World allows for a diversity of thoughts and beliefs, it is not surprising that even more diverse views of human life arise among us, mediated by the government to be “reconciled” for the sake of peaceful coexistence.

text: Ginapatuman ining “reconciliation” paagi sa “Secularization”, katulad sang pagdumili sang State Religion kag kon diin ang pagbahin-bahin sang mga pumuluyo – sa relihiyon man kag iban pa nga differentiating concerns – ginapahigad pabor sa pagpatuman sang “Tolerance” kag “Ecumenism”.
english: This reconciliation is implemented through Secularization, such as the prohibition of State Religion and where the division of peoples – both in religion and other differentiating concerns – is set aside in favor of the implementation of Tolerance and Ecumenism.

text: Pati na gani ang pagkilala gihapon sang Monarkiya nga ang gahom ginalimitahan na sang Konstitusyon katulad sang yara sa pila ka nasyon sa Europa.
english: Even the Monarchy's recognition that its power is limited by the Constitution as in some European countries.

text: Ining klase nga Monarkiya, sa karon, ginakilala sa European countries sang Norway, Sweden, Denmark, Netherlands, Luxembourg kag UK, lakip na ang yara sa Japan kag pila pa ka nasyon sa Asya.
english: This kind of Monarchy, today, is recognized in the European countries of Norway, Sweden, Denmark, the Netherlands, Luxembourg and the UK, including those in Japan and several other Asian countries.

text:
***

Yara naman gani ang mga Fundamentalist sa relihiyon, pulitika kag pilosopiya sa kinaalam sa ila panindugan nga dapat sa ila maghalin gid ang Kamatuoran paagi sa ila religious faith sa makita (seen) kag indi makita (unseen/spiritual); sa pagtukib sang kamatuoran paagi sa human senses kag correct reasoning (logic); kag sa pilosopiya sang maangay-angayon nga kabuhi sang sosyedad.
english:
***

There are even Fundamentalists in religion, politics and philosophy in their position that the Truth must come from them through their religious faith in the seen and unseen/spiritual; to discover truth through human senses and correct reasoning (logic); and in the philosophy of harmonious social life.

text: Yara man ang impluwensya sang  Renaissance Thought nga luyag pasanyogon ang Kahilwayan kag Innovation sa art, science, kag mix-culture growth.
english: There is also the influence of Renaissance Thought that wanted to promote Freedom and Innovation in art, science, and mix-culture growth.

text: Karon, yara naman gani ang Woke Generation, nga sa ila “awakening” kontra “Injustice and Discrimination”, unfortunately, gabanggaanay pa gani sa ila conflicting concerns – sang puti kontra itom, Western versus Asian discrimination, isyu sang abortion kag LGBT+, pati na ang pagduso sang “Cancel Culture” batok sa kon sin-o man kilala nga mga personalidad kag grupo katulad sang mga celebrities, nga masami ginapautwas nila sa social media.
english: Now, there is the Woke Generation, which in its “awakening” against “Injustice and Discrimination”, unfortunately, even clashes with its conflicting concerns – of white against black, Western versus Asian discrimination, issues of abortion and LGBT+, as well as the push of “Cancel Culture” against well-known groups and personalities. like celebrities, which they often post on social media.

text: So, here we are in a “mad world” sang indi pag-intiendihanay nga ginapilit naton ma-“reconcile” para sa malinong nga pag-inupod agud matigayon ang “Unity in Diversity”.
english: So, here we are in a “mad world” of misunderstandings that we are trying to reconcile for peaceful coexistence in order to achieve “Unity in Diversity”.

text:
***

Yara man gani ang isyu sa tunga sang mga Conservatives sa ila traditional values kag Innovators nga gaduso sang pagbag-o sa social values kag methods of modernization, pati na ang panghuna-huna, sa pangabuhi.
english:
***

There is also the issue between the Conservatives in their traditional values and the Innovators who are pushing for change in social values and methods of modernization, including the mindset, in life.

text: Katulad na gid lang sa isyu sang “Heritage versus Innovation” sa pag-redevelop sang Iloilo Central Public Market (ICPM).
english: It is similar to the issue of “Heritage versus Innovation” in the redevelopment of the Iloilo Central Public Market (ICPM).

text: Angot ini sa plano sang pag-preservar sang Art Deco structure sa ganhaan sang ICPM nga matandog sang pag-redevelop sang ICPM paagi sa PPP (Public, Private Partnership).
english: This is in connection with the plan of preserving the Art Deco structure at the entrance of ICPM which will be affected by the redevelopment of ICPM through PPP (Public, Private Partnership).

text: Naakusaran diri si anay Mayor Jerry Treñas nga naka-violate sang kasuguan angot sa iya plano sa pagligwat sang orihinal nga kahimtangan sang Art Deco structure.
english: Former Mayor Jerry Treñas is accused of violating the law in connection with his plan to restore the original state of the Art Deco structure.

text: Gin-insistiran gid ni anay Mayor Jerry ang ining pagligwat sang kahimtangan sang Art Deco tungod kinahanglanon gid ini (utilitarianism), sunu sa iya.
english: Former Mayor Jerry insisted on this revival of the Art Deco status because it was necessary (utilitarianism), he said.

text: Salamat kay nangin madinalag-on naman ini sa pagpasugot sang National Commission for Culture and the Arts (NCCA) pagkatapos ginpatigayon, upod sa City Building Office, ang joint inspection kag structural assessment.
english: Thankfully, it was successfully approved by the National Commission for Culture and the Arts (NCCA) after conducting, together with the City Building Office, a joint inspection and structural assessment.

text: Ang plano amo lang ang pagpataas sang building upod ang orihinal nga Art Deco structure, sa kataason nga 3 tubtub 4 ka metro halin sa orihinal nga kataason nga 10 ka metro para maakomodar ang kon ano man nga future improvement kag agud ma-proteksyunan ang redeveloped nga building  batok sa baha nga masami nagaigu sa City Proper.
english: The plan is to raise the building with the original Art Deco structure, to a height of 3 to 4 meters from the original height of 10 meters to accommodate any future improvement and to protect the redeveloped building against floods that often hit the City Proper.

text: Ang revised three-floor design sang SM Iloilo Central Public Market (Tienda Mayor) , nga na-set inagurahan kag buksan sadtong Okture 30 upod sa SM Iloilo Terminal Market (Super), galakip sang extra parking nga kinahanglan man pataason.
english: The revised three-floor design of SM Iloilo Central Public Market (Tienda Mayor) , which is set to be inaugurated and opened on October 30 along with SM Iloilo Terminal Market (Super), includes extra parking that also needs to be increased.

text: Ang investment diri sang SM Prime Holdings, ang Private Partner, galab-ut sa PhP3 Billion para sa duha ka merkado.
english: The investment here by SM Prime Holdings, the Private Partner, amounts to PhP3 Billion for the two markets.

text: Samtang, amat-amat man gina-modernize ang pila pa ka public market sa siyudad./PN
english: Meanwhile, several other public markets in the city are also being gradually modernized.

text: Duguon ang gobernador sang Surigao del Sur matapos naaksidente samtang sakay sa iya nga motorsiklo.
english: The governor of Surigao del Sur was bleeding after he was involved in an accident while riding his motorcycle.

text: Suno sa imbestigasyon, sakay si Governor Johnny Pimentel sa iya motorsiklo sang nadulaan ini sang control sa madanlog kag kurbadahon nga dalan sa Sitio Puting Buhangin, Brgy.
english: According to the investigation, Governor Johnny Pimentel was riding his motorcycle when he lost control of the bumpy and winding road in Sitio Puting Buhangin, Brgy.

text: Bitaugan East, sa banw sang Cagwait.
english: Bitaugan East, in the town of Cagwait.

text: Gindala ini sa ospital sa Cagwait apang ginsalyo sa Manila para sa specialized medical care.
english: He was taken to a hospital in Cagwait but was transferred to Manila for specialized medical care.

text: Yara na ini sa stable nga kondisyon matapos nag-angkon sang pilas sa tiil.
english: He is in stable condition after sustaining injuries to his leg.

text: Isa ka 67-anyos nga lalaki sa Chengdu, China ang natukiban nga may lighter sa sulod sang iya nga tiyan sa sulod sang 30 ka tuig.
english: A 67-year-old man in Chengdu, China was found to have had a lighter inside his stomach for 30 years.

text: Suno sa report, sang dekada 90, gintulon ni Deng ang lighter bilang kabahin sang “dare” sang iya mga abyan.
english: Reportedly, in the 1990s, Deng swallowed a lighter as part of a “dare” by his friends.

text: Matapos ang insidente, gindumdom niya nga napagwa man niya ini sa iya higko sa tion nga siya ang magpamuhin gani wala ini nanugid sa iya pamilya.
english: After the incident, he remembered that he also got it out of his shit when he was going to clean it so he didn't tell his family.

text: Tubtob nga nag-eksperyensiya ini sang tuman nga pagsakit sang tiyan.
english: Until it experienced severe abdominal pain.

text: Didto na ini kag gindala sa doctor kag natukiban nga yara pa ang lighter.
english: He was taken to the doctor and discovered that the lighter was still there.

text: Ginpaidalom ini sa operasyon agud makuha ang lighter gikan sa tiyan.
english: She underwent surgery to remove the lighter from the stomach.

text: Matapos makuha, ginkakibot nila nga sarang pa magsiga ang lighter.
english: After retrieving it, they were surprised that the lighter could still be lit.

text: Paathag sang mga eksperto, human sa mapag-on nga plastik (polypropylene o ABS) ang casing sang lighter gani wala ini natunaw sang stomach acid sa sulod sang tatlo ka dekada.
english: Experts explained that the casing of the lighter is made of durable plastic (polypropylene or ABS) so it has not been dissolved by stomach acid for three decades.

text: Paagi sa Executive Order No.
english: Through Executive Order No.

text: 010, Series of 2025, ginpabakod ni Mayor Raisa S. Treñas ang kampanya batuk sa pagpanigarilyo kag paggamit sang ‘vape’ sa syudad pinaagi sa pagreconstitute sang Iloilo City Anti-Smoking Task Force (ICAST) kag pagdeputize sang mga enforcers sini.
english: 010, Series of 2025, Mayor Raisa S. Treñas strengthened the campaign against smoking and vape use in the city by reconstituting the Iloilo City Anti-Smoking Task Force (ICAST) and deputizing its enforcers.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay ICAST Director Iñigo Garingalao, iya ginpahayag nga positibo kag angay gid sa tiun ang mando ukon adbokasiya ni Mayor Raisa, nga nagapakita sang matuod-tuod nga pagtutok sini sa ikaayong-lawas sang mga Ilonggo.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, ICAST Director Iñigo Garingalao said that Mayor Raisa's mandate or advocacy is positive and timely, showing his genuine focus on the health of Ilonggos.

text: Ginpahayag man ni Garingalao nga ang pag-issue sang EO naga-‘underline’ gid sang seryoso nga tinutuyo sang alkalde nga padayon nga panindugan ang kampanya batuk sa passive smoking, ilabi na para sa kabataan kag vulnerable nga sektor.
english: Garingalao also said that the issuance of the EO underlines the mayor's serious intention to continue the campaign against passive smoking, especially for children and vulnerable sectors.

text: Ginklaro man sang EO ang awtoridad sang ICAST agents nga magadakop kag maga issue sila sang citation tickets sa mga magalapas, kag ginapanawagan ni Mayor Raisa ang bug-os nga kooperasyon sang publiko para sa isa ka mas himsog kag ‘smoke-free’ nga Iloilo City.
english: The EO also clarified the authority of ICAST agents to arrest and issue citation tickets to violators, and Mayor Raisa called for the full cooperation of the public for a healthier and smoke-free Iloilo City.

text: Engaged na ang model-actress kag Miss International 2016 nga si Kylie Verzosa sa iya non-showbiz fiancée nga si Emil Eriksen.
english: Model-actress and Miss International 2016 Kylie Verzosa is engaged to her non-showbiz fiancée Emil Eriksen.

text: Sa Instagram post ni Kylie, ginpakigbahin sini ang mga laragway nga suksok ang iya engagement ring.
english: In Kylie’s Instagram post, she shared pictures wearing her engagement ring.

text: Suno pa sa post, nangin magkahagugma si Kylie kag Emil sang halos tatlo ka tuig kag ginpasapubliko ini ni Kylie paagi sa isa ka TikTok video sang tuig 2024.
english: According to the post, Kylie and Emil have been in love for almost three years and Kylie made it public through a TikTok video in 2024.

text: Halin nga nangin opisyal na ang ila relasyon, mag-kaupod na sila nga magtravel sa nagkalain-lain nga lugar kaangay sang France kag Japan.
english: Since their relationship became official, they have been traveling together to different places like France and Japan.

text: Nahibaluan nga nangin karelasyon man ni Kylie sang una ang aktor nga si Jake Cuenca kag nagbulagay ang mga ini sang tuig 2022.
english: Kylie was also previously in a relationship with actor Jake Cuenca and they broke up in 2022.

text: Nagpalab-ot sang mensahe ang isa sa mga opisyal sang Iran nga luyag na sang ila pungsod sang ceasefire ukon tapuson na ang gyera nga nagaluntad sa Middle East suno kay US President Donald Trump.
english: One of the Iranian officials conveyed a message that their country wants a ceasefire or end the war in the Middle East, according to US President Donald Trump.

text: Suno kay Trump, ila lang nga ikonsiderar ang nasambit nga pag-untat sang pagpang-atake sa Iran kun matigayon na nga mabuksan para sa tanan nga pungsod ang Strait of Hormuz.
english: Trump said they will only consider the ceasefire once the Strait of Hormuz is opened to all countries.

text: Ginpakigbahin man sini paagi sa iya nga social media post nga samtang wala pa mabuksan ang Strait, padayun sila nga magalunsar sang pagpang-atake sa Iran.
english: He also shared through his social media post that while the Strait is not opened, they will continue to launch attacks on Iran.

text: Nangin dako nga isyu ang pagsarado sang Strait of Hormuz, bangud 20 tubtob 30% sang langis ang nagatabok sa Strait antes nga madeliver sa iban nga pungsod kaangay sang Estados Unidos.
english: The closure of the Strait of Hormuz has become a major issue, as 20 to 30% of oil crosses the Strait before being delivered to other countries such as the United States.

text: Madumduman nga ginpalab-ot man ni Trump sa publiko nga possible nga magauntat na ang Estados Unidos sa pagpang-atake sa masunod nga duha tubtob 3 ka semana.
english: It can be recalled that Trump also conveyed to the public that it is possible that the United States will stop attacking in the next two to three weeks.

text: Posible nga magbag-o ang lineup sang Boston Celtics sa masunod nila nga hampang batok sa Dallas Mavericks bangud posible na nga makabalik ang superstar nga si Jayson Tatum.
english: The Boston Celtics lineup is likely to change in their next game against the Dallas Mavericks as superstar Jayson Tatum is likely to return.

text: Gin-upgrade si Tatum sa status nga “questionable” sa injury report matapos ang iya recovery halin sa nauna nga Achilles tendon injury.
english: Tatum was upgraded to “questionable” status on the injury report after his recovery from a previous Achilles tendon injury.

text: Nagbalik na ini sa training halin sang Pebrero 9 kag aktibo na sa 5-on-5 scrimmages nga nagsugod sang All-Star break.
english: He has been back in training since Feb. 9 and was active in 5-on-5 scrimmages that started the All-Star break.

text: Suno sa iya teammate nga si Derrick White, maayo na ang kondisyon ni Tatum kag kaangay nga handa na ini nga maghampang.
english: Teammate Derrick White said Tatum is in good shape and appears ready to play.

text: Bisan wala si Tatum sa daku nga bahin sang season, yara gihapon sa ikaduha nga pwesto ang Celtics sa Eastern Conference.
english: Even without Tatum for much of the season, the Celtics are still in second place in the Eastern Conference.

text: Para naman sa Mavericks, nagbalik ang rookie nga si Cooper Flagg matapos ang wala ini makahampang bangud sa foot injury.
english: For the Mavericks, rookie Cooper Flagg returned after missing the game with a foot injury.

text: Apisar nga napierdi ang Dallas sa ila nagligad nga hampang batok sa Orlando, nagpakita naman ini sang maayo nga performance.
english: Although Dallas lost their previous game against Orlando, they showed a good performance.

text: Nagpahayag si Senate President Pro Tempore Panfilo Lacson nga kinahanglan nga sikyarun ang kredibilidad sang source kag kamatuoran sang impormasyon may kaangtanan sa alegasyon nga nag-deliver sang mga maleta nga puno sang kuwarta ang anay miyembro sang Philippine Marine Corps sa pila ka mga opisyal sang gobyerno, lakip na kay President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.
english: Senate President Pro Tempore Panfilo Lacson said it is necessary to verify the credibility of the source and the truth of the information regarding the allegation that the former member of the Philippine Marine Corps delivered suitcases full of money to several government officials, including President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.

text: kag anay House speaker Martin Romualdez.
english: and former House speaker Martin Romualdez.

text: Suno kay Lacson, ang imbestigasyon sang Senate Blue Ribbon Committee sa ginaalegar ‘cash delivery scheme; ang nakadepend lamang sa ebidensya.
english: According to Lacson, the Senate Blue Ribbon Committee’s investigation into the alleged ‘cash delivery scheme; is solely dependent on evidence.

text: Ang pahayag ang sabat sa panawagan sang Iglesia Ni Cristo spokesperson Edwil Zabala para sa pagpasabat sa ginapahayag kurapsyon sa mga flood control projects.
english: The statement is in response to the call of Iglesia Ni Cristo spokesperson Edwil Zabala for accountability for alleged corruption in flood control projects.

text: Matandaan man nga ang nasambit nga ‘cash delivery scheme’ sang mga anay suldado, ang pormal na nga gin-file ni Atty. Levi Baligod sa Office of the Ombudsman.
english: It can also be recalled that the said 'cash delivery scheme' of former soldiers, which was formally filed by Atty. Levi Baligod to the Office of the Ombudsman.

text: Ginpaguwa ni Mayor Raisa Treñas ang Executive Order No.
english: Mayor Raisa Treñas issued Executive Order No.

text: 018 nga naga-deklarar sang kada Sabado bilang Clean-Up Day sa bilog nga syudad sang Iloilo.
english: 018 declaring every Saturday as Clean-Up Day throughout Iloilo City.

text: Ang ini nga inisyatibo magasugod sa Hulyo 12, 2025, halin alas 7:00 sang aga tubtob alas 11:00 sang udto, kag target sini nga tinluan ang mga drainage, stagnant nga tubig, basura, kag iban pa nga lugar nga posible puy-an sang lamok kag ilaga.
english: This initiative will begin on July 12, 2025, from 7:00 a.m. to 11:00 p.m., and targets cleaning drainages, stagnant water, garbage, and other potential breeding grounds for mosquitoes and rats.

text: Ginpahayag sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Joy Fantillaga-Gorzal, tagpamaba ni Mayor Treñas, nga ginpasulod ini nga tikang bilang kabahin sang preparasyon sa panahon sang tig-ululan kun sa diin nagataas ang risgo sang mga masakit pareho sang dengue, leptospirosis, kag iban pa nga dala sang lamok kag ilaga.
english: Joy Fantillaga-Gorzal, spokesperson of Mayor Treñas, said in an interview with Bombo Radyo that the move was introduced as part of preparations for the rainy season where the risk of diseases such as dengue, leptospirosis, and others carried by mosquitoes and rats increases.

text: Ginapanawagan sang alkalde ang partisipasyon sang tanan nga Ilonggo sa ila tagsa ka panimalay kag komunidad, agud magbinuligay sa pagpanglimpyo sang palibot.
english: The mayor called for the participation of all Ilonggos in their respective homes and communities, to work together in cleaning up the environment.

text: Ginasugid man nga ang mga barangay nga nagakinahanglan sang teknikal nga bulig ukon kagamitan, pwede magpadala sang sulat sa opisina sang alkalde agud mabuligan sang mga ahensya sang City Hall.
english: It is also reported that barangays that need technical assistance or equipment, can send a letter to the mayor's office for assistance from City Hall agencies.

text: Luyag sang liderato ni Mayor Treñas nga mapabaskug ang kampanya para sa mas malimpyo, mayo nga ikaayong-lawas, kag malinong nga Iloilo City.
english: Mayor Treñas' leadership wants to strengthen the campaign for a cleaner, healthier, and more peaceful Iloilo City.

text: Ginpabutyag pa nga ang paglimpyo indi lang ubra sang gobyerno, kundi trabaho sang tanan nga pumuluyo sa syudad.
english: He said that cleaning is not only the job of the government, but the job of all residents in the city.

text: Nagapati si Senate President Pro Tempore Panfilo Lacson nga pangamuyo ang sabat sa mga tikang ni United States of America President Donald Trump bangud sa dako sini nga partisipasyon sa nagapadayun nga tension indi lang sa Middle East, apang sa bilog nga kalibutan.
english: Senate President Pro Tempore Panfilo Lacson believes that prayer is the answer to the actions of United States of America President Donald Trump because of his great participation in the ongoing tension not only in the Middle East, but around the world.

text: Suno kay Lacson, matapos ang isa ka pandemya nga gin-atubang sang kalibutan nga Corona Virus ukon CoVid-19, kinahanglan naman nga pangamuyuan sang publiko ang ‘Trump-26’.
english: According to Lacson, after a pandemic that the world faced Corona Virus or CoVid-19, the public needs to pray for 'Trump-26'

text: Ini kasunod man sang epekto sang gyera sa Middle East sa suplay sang langis sa Pilipinas kun sa diin nagtimbuok na ini sa masobra P100.
english: This follows the impact of the war in the Middle East on the supply of oil in the Philippines where it has risen to more than P100.

text: Dugang pa sang senador, mas naglala na ang sitwasyon sang ekonomiya sang pungsod bangud sa gyera.
english: The senator added that the country's economic situation has worsened due to the war.

text: Napa-throwback si Senior House Deputy Majority Leader kag Iloilo Third District Representative Lorenz “Nonoy” Defensor sang pictures sang campaign rally ni former Vice President kag subong Naga City Mayor Leni Robredo sang 2022 presidential elections.
english: Senior House Deputy Majority Leader and Iloilo Third District Representative Lorenz “Nonoy” Defensor was thrown back by the pictures of the campaign rally of former Vice President and now Naga City Mayor Leni Robredo in the 2022 presidential elections.

text: Kuha ang mga laragway sang nagpangampanya si Robrero sa Iloilo City.
english: Take the pictures when Robrero campaigned in Iloilo City.

text: Isa si Defensor sa mga opisyal sa Iloilo nga nagsuporta kay Robredo sa amo nga presidential run.
english: Defensor is one of the officials in Iloilo who supported Robredo in the presidential run.

text: “Look at us, Iloilo.
english: “Look at us, Iloilo.

text: If we did it four years ago, we are ready to do it all over again,” caption sang kongresista sa iya nga post nga naka-tag pa kay Robredo.
english: If we did it four years ago, we are ready to do it all over again,” the congressman captioned his post tagged Robredo.

text: Positibo naman nga mga komento ang ginbilin sa post sang mamalidha, kag may iban nga nagapamangkot kag nag-share nga may caption kun “sign” ukon “hint” na bala ang ginahatag sini ilabi na nga gina-istoryahan na ang 2028 elections.
english: Positive comments were left on the lawmaker's post, and some asked and shared with a caption whether it was a "sign" or a "hint" especially since the 2028 elections are being discussed.

text: Myembro si Defensor sang National Unity Party ukon NUP.
english: Defensor is a member of the National Unity Party or NUP.

text: Sang nagligad nga adlaw, nagpaguwa ang NUP sang statement nga pirmado sang ila secretary general nga si Reginald Velasco nga indi magboto ang ila partido pabor sa impeachment complaint batok kay Vice President Sara Duterte, bangud wala sang nakit-an nga bag-o nga ebidensya nga gin-presentar sa apat ka bag-o nga complaints nga gin-file sa Kamara.
english: Last day, the NUP issued a statement signed by its secretary general Reginald Velasco that the party will not vote in favor of the impeachment complaint against Vice President Sara Duterte, as no new evidence was found in the four new complaints filed in the House of Representatives.

text: Naghatag naman sang iya paathag si Defensor nga indi sini pag-ilisan ang iya pagpanindugan sa impeachment batok sa vice president apisar sang statement sang NUP.
english: Defensor explained that he will not change his stand on the impeachment against the vice president despite the NUP statement.

text: “As a prosecutor, I said I will maintain my position that if the evidence during the previous impeachment, especially the evidence on betrayal of public trust [is present in the complaints], I will not take back my previous vote during the previous impeachment,” kabahin sang nangin statement sang kongresista.“For as long as the allegation that the vice president has contracted an assassin to kill the president [is there], there will always be betrayal of public trust, and betrayal of public trust is an impeachable offense under the 1987 constitution,” dugang sini.#
english: “As a prosecutor, I said I will maintain my position that if the evidence during the previous impeachment, especially the evidence on betrayal of public trust [is present in the complaints], I will not take back my previous vote during the previous impeachment,” the congressman said in a statement. to kill the president [is there], there will always be betrayal of public trust, and betrayal of public trust is an impeachable offense under the 1987 constitution,” it added.#

text: Posible mag-atubangay liwat ang Pinay tennis star nga si Alex Eala kag ang world No.
english: Filipino tennis star Alex Eala and world No. 1 are likely to face each other again.

text: 4 nga si Coco Gauff sa Indian Wells Open.
english: 4 Coco Gauff at the Indian Wells Open.

text: Antes ini matabo, atubangon anay ni Eala ang winner sa tunga nanday Zhang Shuai sang China kag Dayana Yastremska sang Ukraine.
english: Before that happens, Eala will first face the winner between Zhang Shuai of China and Dayana Yastremska of Ukraine.

text: Sa pihak nga bahin, makasumpong naman ni Gauff ang winner sa tunga sang qualifier kag Bianca Andreescu sang Canada.
english: On the other hand, Gauff will face the winner between the qualifier and Bianca Andreescu of Canada.

text: Pareho ang bracket ni Eala kag ni Gauff, gani nga balantayan ang ila pagkit-anay liwat pananglitan pareho man nila malutos ang una nila nga mga kasumpong.
english: Eala and Gauff are in the same bracket, so watch out for their rematch if they both defeat their previous opponents.

text: Katapusan nga nagkit-anay sanday Eala kag Gauff sa Dubai Tennis Championships kun sa diin gindominar sang American player ang hampang, 6-0, 6-2.
english: Eala and Gauff last met at the Dubai Tennis Championships where the American player dominated the match, 6-0, 6-2.

text: Ginauyatan ni Gauff ang rekord bilang two-time Grand Slam Champion, apang todo-dayaw man ini kay Eala ilabi na sa kadamuon sang fans nga mahakot sini sa venue.
english: Gauff holds the record as a two-time Grand Slam Champion, but he is also proud of Eala especially for the number of fans he will attract to the venue.

text: Kun matapos na sa Indian Wells Open, maga-compete ang world no.
english: After the Indian Wells Open, the world no.

text: 32 nga Filipina star sa Miami Open ukon ang tournament kun sa diin nangin bantog ang iya pangalan bangud nagsulod siya bilang wildcard apang ginpanglutos sini ang tatlo ka Grand Slam champions sang nagligad nga tuig.
english: 32 Filipino star at the Miami Open or the tournament where he became famous because he entered as a wildcard but defeated three Grand Slam champions last year.

text: SAMTANG madasig ang paghunos sang mga tinuig, gadugang man ang kabalaka naton, labi na gid para sa mga taga-Metro Manila kon diin madamo man kita dira sang mga himata,  sa ginapaabot nga The Big One.
english: AS THE years pass by, we are also increasingly concerned, especially for the people of Metro Manila where we have many relatives, about the expected The Big One.

text: Matabo  ining The Big One, sunu sa Phivolcs, sa liwat nga paghulag sang 100-km nga kalawig nga West Valley Fault 400 tubtub 600 ka tuig despues, earlier or sooner, sa tuig 2058 ukon sa tuig 2258 kon ma-delay.
english: The Big One, according to Phivolcs, will occur with the re-movement of the 100-km-long West Valley Fault 400 to 600 years later, earlier or sooner, in 2058 or in 2258 if delayed.

text: Meaning, posible na ini matabo sa ini nga tuig 2025 ukon sa indi lang naton mahibal-an nga tuig nga kasunod sini.
english: Meaning, it's possible that it will happen in this year 2025 or we just don't know the year after that.

text: Major earthquake ining The Big One nga may pwersa nga magnitude 7.2 sa iya paghulag on a series of earthquake events nga manalaytay dira sa kalawigon nga 100 ka kilometro sang West Valley Fault.
english: The Big One is a major earthquake with a magnitude of 7.2 in its movement on a series of earthquake events that will span the length of 100 kilometers of the West Valley Fault.

text: Iguon sini sa iya faultline ang apat (4) ka probinsya sang Bulacan, Rizal, Laguna kag Cavite kag ang lima (5) sang mga highly populated cities sang Metro Manila nga Quezon, Pasig, Marikina, Taguig kag Muntinlupa.
english: It will hit the four (4) provinces of Bulacan, Rizal, Laguna and Cavite and the five (5) highly populated cities of Metro Manila of Quezon, Pasig, Marikina, Taguig and Muntinlupa.

text: Labi nga ginakabalak-an sang mga earthquake authorities ining lima ka siyudad sa MM tungod overpopulated ang mga ini kag kon diin nahamtang ang madamo nga mga dalagku kag matag-as nga mga bilding.
english: The earthquake authorities are particularly concerned about these five cities in MM because they are overpopulated and where many large and tall buildings are located.

text: Sa ina nga pwersa (magnitude 7.2) sang linog, sunu sa pagtech.com.ph , kaya sini patumbahon (collapse) ang mga bilding, nga amo gid ginakabalak-an sang Philvolcs kag iban pa nga mga disaster agencies sa ila priority concern agud maluwas ang mga okupante sa mga bilding.
english: With that force (magnitude 7.2) of the earthquake, according to pagtech.com.ph, it can collapse buildings, which is the concern of the Philvolcs and other disaster agencies in their priority concern to save the occupants of the buildings.

text: Sang sini lang  gani, gin-igu ang Cebu sang magnitude 6.9 nga nangguba sang pila ka well-built  structures, kag ang Davao Oriental sang magnitude 7.4 nga nagpatumba kag nagguba sang mga bilding kag nagpatay sang madamo naton nga mga kautoran.
english: Recently, Cebu was hit by a magnitude 6.9 earthquake that destroyed several well-built structures, and Davao Oriental by a magnitude 7.4 earthquake that knocked down and destroyed buildings and killed many of our brothers and sisters.

text: Sa aton priority concern nga maluwas ang mga okupante sang bilding, una ta gid nga concern nga indi gid mag-collapse ang bilding sa tion sang linog agud mahigayon nga makagwa ang mga okupante pakadto sa mga hilway sa peligro nga mga lugar.
english: In our priority concern to save the occupants of the building, our first concern is that the building will not collapse during the earthquake so that the occupants can escape to safe areas.

text: Una nga nakita sang Japan ang kinahanglanon nga indi gid mag-collapse ang mga bilding sang iguon ang Japan sang magnitude 7.9 nga linog sadtong 1923 nga nagpatay sang sobra 140,000 ka tawo nga madamo sini bangod sang pagkaguba sang mga bilding.
english: Japan first saw the need for collapse-resistant buildings when a magnitude 7.9 earthquake struck Japan in 1923, killing more than 140,000 people, many of them due to building collapse.

text: Dayon nga ginpatuman sini ang seismic regulation nga nagatalana sang building code sa standard range nga magnitude 7.0-7.9 nga maka-withstand sang linog.
english: It then implemented the seismic regulation that sets the building code in the standard range of magnitude 7.0-7.9 to withstand an earthquake.

text: Sa pag-amendar sadtong 1981 sang 1950 Act of Japan, nagpatuman pa ini sang dugang nga pagpabakod sang bilding, katulad sang pagpahulag sang bilding upod sa duta agud makapaayon ini sa hulag sang linog.
english: In the 1981 amendment of the 1950 Act of Japan, it implemented additional building strengthening, such as moving the building with the ground to adapt to earthquake movements.

text: Sunu man gani sa pgatech.com.ph, ang magnitude 7.0 – 7.9 indi lang makapa-collapse sang bilding, makabuka man sang duta kag dalanon, kag makaguba sang underground pipes.
english: According to pgatech.com.ph, a magnitude 7.0 – 7.9 can not only collapse buildings, but also open land and roads, and destroy underground pipes.

text: Ang aton experyensya sa mabaskog nga linog sa Filipinas amo yadtong Moro Gulf Earthquake sadtong 1976 nga may pwersa nga magnitude 8.1, nga tungod sa dala man sini nga tsunami, nagpatay gid sang mga 8,000 ka tawo kag nagguba sang 9,000 ka puluy-an kag bilding.
english: Our experience with a strong earthquake in the Philippines is the Moro Gulf Earthquake in 1976 with a force of magnitude 8.1, which because of the tsunami, killed about 8,000 people and destroyed 9,000 homes and buildings.

text: Nag-obligar dayon ang aton gobyerno mismo sadtong 1976 agud ipatuman ang magnitude 8.0 nga standard sang kabakod sang bilding sa pungsod nga maka-withstand sang kasubong kakusog nga  linog.
english: Our government itself immediately obliged in 1976 to implement the magnitude 8.0 standard of building strength in the country that can withstand such a strong earthquake.

text: In fact, napatindug ang bag-o nga Iloilo City Hall nga maka-withstand sang kasubong nga magnitude 8.0.
english: In fact, the new Iloilo City Hall was built to withstand a magnitude 8.0 earthquake.

text: Sadtong 2004, isa ka Metro Manila Earthquake Impact Reduction Study (MMWEIRS) ang ginhiwat diri sa pungsod nga ginpasakupan sang Japan International Cooperation Agency (JICA) upod ang Manila Development Authority (MMDA) kag sang Phivolcs.
english: In 2004, a Metro Manila Earthquake Impact Reduction Study (MMWEIRS) was conducted in the country with the participation of the Japan International Cooperation Agency (JICA) together with the Manila Development Authority (MMDA) and the Phivolcs.

text: Sa ina nga pagtuon sang MMWEIRS, 34,000 ka tawo sa Metro Manila ang pwede mapatay bangod sang The Big One, samtang 114,000 ang masaktan (injured).
english: According to the MMWEIRS study, 34,000 people in Metro Manila could die from The Big One, while 114,000 could be injured.

text: Mga 170,000 ka puluy-an kag bilding ang mag-collapse samtang 340,000 sa ila ang ma-partly damaged.
english: About 170,000 homes and buildings will collapse while 340,000 of them will be partially damaged.

text: Ang report nagpahayag man sang posibilidad sang fire breakout sa rehiyon nga gasakop sang West Valley Fault sa mga 1,710 ka ektariya nga kalaparon sang lugar kag 18,000 pa ang dugang nga mapatay.
english: The report also stated the possibility of a fire breakout in the region covering the West Valley Fault in about 1,710 hectares of area and 18,000 more deaths.

text: Nga tungod sini, sunu sa MMWEIRS, kinahanglan gid ang mga medyos posibles agud mapahagan-hagan ang ining mga kahalitan.

text: Sang 2015, the MMDA nagpagwa gani sang Metro Manila Earthquake Contingency Plan katulad sang Oplan Metro Yakal Plus agud mapanubo ang posible nga mga kahalitan.

text: Ginaduso sa karon sang Department of Agriculture (DA) ang pagpatuman sang price cap sa mga retailers nga nagabaligya sang imported nga bugas.
english: The Department of Agriculture (DA) is currently proposing the implementation of a price cap on retailers selling imported rice.

text: Ini agud mapunggan ang indi insakto nga pagsaka sang presyo sini sa merkado.
english: This is to prevent the unreasonable increase in its price in the market.

text: Suno kay Agriculture Secretary Francisco Tiu Laurel Jr., nagalab-ot na sa P55 tubtob P58 kada kilo ang presyo sang imported nga bugas sa pila ka mga retailers.
english: According to Agriculture Secretary Francisco Tiu Laurel Jr., the price of imported rice is already reaching P55 to P58 per kilo at some retailers.

text: Suno sa ahensya nga ginahimo nga rason sang pila ka negosyante ang global oil shock kag krisis sa Middle East agud magpataas man ang mga ini sang presyo.
english: The agency said some traders are using the global oil shock and the crisis in the Middle East as reasons to raise prices.

text: Ginpahayag ni Laurel nga indi dapat maglab-ot sa amo nga presyo ang nasambit nga produkto bangud wala pa nagataas ang gasto sa pag-import sini.
english: Laurel said the product should not reach that price because the cost of importing it has not yet increased.

text: Bilang temporaryo nga tikang agud malikawan ang pagsaka sang presyo, magasumiter ang DA sang pormal nga rekomendasyon sa Malacañang para sa implementasyon sang price cap magapanagtag man ang ahensya sang bugas nga ginabaligya sa P45 tubtob P48 kada kilo.
english: As a temporary measure to avoid price increases, the DA will submit a formal recommendation to Malacañang for the implementation of the price cap. The agency will also distribute rice sold at P45 to P48 per kilo.

english: A factory worker in Khanty-Mansiysk, Russia, was sued by his company after it refused to return more than ₱4.9 million (7 million rubles or $87,000) that was accidentally sent to his bank account due to a software glitch.

text: Ginkilala ini nga si Vladimir Rychagov, nga nakabaton sang 7.1 milyon nga rubles magluwas pa sa iya nga 46,954 rubles nga vacation pay.
english: He was identified as Vladimir Rychagov, who received 7.1 million rubles in addition to his 46,954 rubles vacation pay.

text: Suno kay Rychagov, may mga istorya sadto sa ilanga pabrika angot sa “13th month bonus,” gani gindumdom niya nga kabahin ini sang amo nga benepisyo.
english: According to Rychagov, there were rumors in their factory about the “13th month bonus,” so he thought it was part of the benefit.

text: Apang makaligad ang pila ka adlaw, gintawagan siya sang accounting department kag ginhambalan nga nagsala sang padala ang kumpaniya kag dapat ibalik niya ang kwarta.

text: Apang namalibad si Rychagov kag nanindugan nga may kinamatarung siya sa amo nga kwarta.
english: But Rychagov refused and insisted that he was entitled to the money.

text: Base sa mga dokumento nga gin-file sa korte, ang kwarta nakatigana para sa suweldo sang 34 ka empleyado.
english: Based on documents filed with the court, the money was earmarked for the salaries of 34 employees.

text: Nagapadayon ang pagtaas sang paggamit sang family planning sa mga kababainhan sa probinsya sang Iloilo base sa datos nga ginpahayag sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Dr. Maria Socorro Quiñon, head sang Provincial Health Office.
english: The use of family planning among women in Iloilo province continues to increase based on data revealed in an interview with Bombo Radyo Dr. Maria Socorro Quiñon, head of the Provincial Health Office.

text: Suno sa iya, isa sa mga rason kun ngaa indi malab-ot sang probinsya ang target nga fully immunized child coverage amo ang pagnubo sang kabataan nga ginatawo, bangud man sang pagtaas sang contraceptive prevalence rate.
english: He said one of the reasons why the province cannot achieve the target of fully immunized child coverage is the decline in the number of children born, also due to the increase in the contraceptive prevalence rate.

text: Halin 2020 tubtob 2024, nagapakita ang datos nga padayon ang pagsanyog sang mga kababainhan nga nagapraktis sang family planning.
english: From 2020 to 2024, data shows that women practicing family planning will continue to rise.

text: Ginklaro ni Quiñon nga ang national target para sa contraceptive prevalence rate amo ang 30%, apang nalab-ot na sang probinsya ang 36.85% ukon kapin 185,000 nga mga kababainhan ang naga-praktis sang family planning.
english: Quiñon clarified that the national target for contraceptive prevalence rate is 30%, but the province has already reached 36.85% or more than 185,000 women are practicing family planning.

english: It was expanded through the cooperation of the Department of Health, Provincial Health Office, Municipal Health Offices and City Health Office.

text: STRANGE para sa aton nga mga ordinaryo nga mga pumuluyo ang ginsiling ni Phivolcs Director Teresito Bacolcol sa isa ka interbyu, nga indi man makamamatay ang linog.
english: Phivolcs Director Teresito Bacolcol said in an interview that the earthquake was not fatal.

text: Aba!!!
english: Aba!!!

text: Nga daan sa sining nagligad nga paglinog sa Cebu, Davao sa Mindanao, kag sa Ilocos sa Luzon madamo ang nabalita nga nagkalamatay.
english: Already in the past earthquakes in Cebu, Davao in Mindanao, and Ilocos in Luzon many were reported dead.

text: Kag sadtong panahon pa nanday lolo kag lola, kag nanday iluy kag ilay!
english: And back in the days of grandparents, and mothers and fathers!

text: Taken out of context lang seguro si Philvolcs director sa sina nga una niya nga pahayag.
english: The Philvolcs director must have been taken out of context in his first statement.

text:
Ini ang iya bug-os nga ginsiling sa sinang interbu sa iya: “’Yung lindol naman ay hindi ‘yan nakakamatay…but human-built structures such as buildings, walls, bridges, may claim lives.”

In other words, ang matuod gid nga makamamatay amo ang epekto sang linog sa palibot sa pagkaguba sang buildings, walls, bridges, kag iban pa nga human-built structures.
english:
This is what he said in full in that interview with him: “'The earthquake is not fatal...but human-built structures such as buildings, walls, bridges, may claim lives.”

In other words, what is truly deadly is the effect of an earthquake on the environment in the destruction of buildings, walls, bridges, and other human-built structures.

text: “So we really have to make sure we follow the building code,” panugyan gani ni Bacolcol sa nagapatindog kag naga-check sang kabakod sang puluy-an kag building agud malikawan ang daku nga kahalitan sa mga okupante sa tion sang paglinog.
english: “So we really have to make sure we follow the building code,” Bacolcol advised those who are building and checking the strength of homes and buildings to avoid serious damage to occupants during an earthquake.

text: Paathag pa ni Bacolcol nga kon naga-sway ang isa ka building indi buot silingon sini nga mahuyang ini kag manug-collapse gid.
english: Bacolcol explained that if a building is swaying, it does not mean that it is weak and will collapse.

text: Gapakilala ini, siling niya, nga “pliant” ini, nga daw goma nga maunyat kag magbalik nga indi dale-dale mabugto.
english: It shows, he said, that it is “pliant,” like a rubber band that can be stretched and come back without breaking.

text: Kon kasubong seguro kabakod sang mga building, lakip ang skyscraper, nga ginapatindug sa Japan, nga kilala sa kalibutan nga mas masami iguon sang linog.
english: It is probably as strong as the buildings, including the skyscraper, being built in Japan, which is known in the world to be more prone to earthquakes.

text: Maguba lang sa pila ka bahin apang indi mag-collapse.
english: Just break in some parts but not collapse.

text: Ginpakita gani ang subong nga kabakod sang isa ka taytay sa Cebu nga ubra sang Japanese engineers nga nagpabilin nga mabakod bisan sa pag-igu sadtong magnitude 6.9 nga linog.
english: A bridge in Cebu built by Japanese engineers has shown such strength that it remained strong despite the magnitude 6.9 earthquake.

text: In other words, dapat gid kita makagwa sa puluy-an kag sa building sa una nga kahigayunan pakadto sa mga lugar nga hilway sa peligro (safe spaces) nga indi kinahanglan mag-panic.
english: In other words, we should be able to leave the home and the building at the first opportunity to safe spaces without panic.

text: Labi na gid kon mabaskog ang igu sang linog kag may earthquake alert na nga ginapatigayon ang gobyerno, katulad sang pagpatonog sang sirena (siren), kon nagapuyo malapit sa baybayon kag sa kilid sang bukid, kag sa iban nga lugar nga peligroso.
english: Especially if the earthquake is strong and the government has an earthquake alert, such as sounding a siren, if you live near the coast and on the slopes of mountains, and in other dangerous areas.

text: Man pwede kita iguon sang tsunami sa baybayon, landslide kag mudslide sa gapuyo sa kilid sang bukid kag bisan sa suba nga pwede mag-awas sa paglinu sang linog sang tubig-suba dira.
english: We can also be hit by tsunamis on the coast, landslides and mudslides in the mountainsides and even in the river that can overflow from the earthquake of the river water there.

text: Dapat may pagpangamlig man kita sa sulod sang puluy-an kag ang mga otoridad sa building batok sa tanan nga bagay nga peligroso.
english: We must also have protection inside the home and the authorities in the building against all things dangerous.

text: Katulad sang fire extinguisher batok sa sunog, kag pagpangamlig batok sa kuryente kag sa mga blast-prone nga mga kagamitan, mahuyang nga mga furniture, kag iban pa nga alamligan.
english: Such as fire extinguishers against fire, and protection against electricity and blast-prone equipment, fragile furniture, and other protection.

text: Updan ta man ang “drop, cover and hold” nga panugyan sa tion sang linog tubtub makagwa sa hlway nga mga lugar, katulad sang plaza, playground, evacuation center kag wayang nga malayo sa peligro.
english: Let's also follow the “drop, cover and hold” advice during the earthquake until we can get out of safe places, such as plazas, playgrounds, evacuation centers and wayang away from danger.

text: Kag dira sa mga hilway na sa peligro nga mga lugar, labi na gid kon mabaskog gihapon ang linog, ang magpangamuyo sa Diyos agud ubayan kita sa kon ano pa nga mahimo agud malubos ang aton pagkahilway sa peligro.
english: And to those who are already free from danger, especially if the earthquake is still strong, to pray to God to guide us in what else can be done to complete our freedom from danger.

text: Meantime, mag-relax kag hulaton nga magkunta ang linog sing lubos nga may katawhay kag kumpyansa sa aton panghuna-huna.
english: Meantime, relax and wait for the earthquake to subside completely with peace and confidence in our minds.

text: Expektaron ta man ang aftershocks nga basi kinahanglan pa naton magtener sa wayang kag kinahanglan masuportahan sang bulig sang gobyerno kag sang mabuligon nga mga grupo (NGO).
english: Let's also expect aftershocks that we may have to stay in the wayang and need to be supported by the help of the government and humanitarian groups (NGOs).

text: Katulad sang mahatag nila nga temporary tents, gamit sa pagtulog upod sa mga kabataan, lugar palautwasan, tubig kag pagkaon samtang ginaangan-angan pa ang masunod nga aftershocks.
english: Such as temporary tents, sleeping bags for children, shelter, water and food while waiting for the next aftershocks.

text: In fact, kay masami man ginaigu sang linog ang aton pungsod, dapat nakapreparar na kita sa aton mga puluy-an kag mga upisina sang pang-emergency nga kinahanglanon.
english: In fact, since our country is often hit by earthquakes, we should be prepared in our homes and offices for emergency needs.

text: Katulad sang flashlight nga magamit sa dulom, portable nga radyo agud makapamati sang balita, batteries sa flashlight kag radyo, first-aid needs, kag tubig kag pagkaon kon magdugay ang pagbalik-balik sang linog at least sa sunod nga tatlo ka adlaw.
english: Such as a flashlight that can be used in the dark, a portable radio to listen to the news, batteries for the flashlight and radio, first-aid needs, and water and food if the earthquake lasts for at least the next three days.

text: Ukon sa sobra pa kon nahamtang sa mga lugar nga indi dayon matabangan sang relief/rescue units.
english: Or even more if located in areas that cannot be immediately assisted by relief/rescue units.

text: ag remember gid, sunu liwat sa Phivolcs, “indi makakamatay ang earthquake” basta malikawan ang makahalalit nga epekto sang linog sa palibot kag makapalayo dayon sa hilway sa peligro nga mga lugar./PN
english: and remember, according to the Phivolcs, “an earthquake is not fatal” as long as the harmful effects of the earthquake on the environment are avoided and immediately away from safe areas./PN

text: Nagpangabay ang Pilipinas sa Iran nga ikonsiderar ang pungsod nga isa ka “non-hostile country” agud nga masiguro nga hilway sa ano man nga pagpang-atake ang mga shipping vessels sang pungsod nga magalabay sa Strait of Hormuz samtang nagapadayun ang gyera sa Middle East.
english: The Philippines has asked Iran to consider the country a “non-hostile country” to ensure that the country's shipping vessels passing through the Strait of Hormuz are free from any attack as the war in the Middle East continues.

text: Ini matapos ang ginpatigayon nga pagsinapol sang pila ka mga opisyal sang Pilipinas sa pagpanguna ni Department of Foreign Affairs (DFA) Secretary Tess Lazaro kay Iranian Ambassador to the Philippines Yousef Esmaeilzadeh.
english: This follows a meeting of several Philippine officials led by Department of Foreign Affairs (DFA) Secretary Tess Lazaro with Iranian Ambassador to the Philippines Yousef Esmaeilzadeh.

text: Suno kay Palace Press Officer Undersecretary Atty. Claire Castro, nagpalab-ot man sang positibo nga sabat si Esmaeilzadeh nga handa sila nga magbulig ilabi na sa suplay sang langis, samtang ini amo ang nagpahayag nga ipaagi gid sa iban pa nga mataas nga opisyal ang nasambit nga diskusyon.
english: According to Palace Press Officer Undersecretary Atty. Claire Castro, Esmaeilzadeh also gave a positive response that they are ready to help especially in the supply of oil, while he said that the discussion will be through other senior officials.

text: Nahibaluan nga padayun nga nagaubra sang tikang kag diskusyon ang Pilipinas kun sa diin magapakig-angot man si Lazaro sa Foreign Minister sang Iran agud nga mas mapasangkad ang relasyon sini sa nasmabit nga pungsod ilabi na subong nga padayun pa nga nagasaka ang presyo sang gatong.
english: It is known that the Philippines is continuing to take steps and discussions where Lazaro will also liaise with the Foreign Minister of Iran to further expand its relations with the said country especially now that fuel prices continue to rise.

text: Nakigsugilanon si Pope Leo XIV paagi sa telepono kanday Israeli President Isaac Herzog kag Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky, agud istoryahan ang padayon nga kinagamo sa amo nga mga pungsod.
english: Pope Leo XIV spoke by telephone with Israeli President Isaac Herzog and Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky, to discuss the ongoing unrest in those countries.

text: Suno sa Vatican, ginkasugtan ni Pope Leo kag Herzog ang importansya sang liwat nga pagbukas sang tanan nga posible diplomatic channels agud untaton ang kinagamo sang amo nga pungsod kag makaangkon sang dalayun nga kalinong sa Middle East.
english: According to the Vatican, Pope Leo and Herzog agreed on the importance of reopening all possible diplomatic channels to end the country's unrest and achieve lasting peace in the Middle East.

text: Nangin kabahin man sang amo nga talakayan ang pagprotektar sa mga sibilyan, iban pa nga kapungsuran kag ang humanitarian law.
english: The protection of civilians, other nations and humanitarian law were also part of the discussion.

text: Sa nangin sugilanon naman sang Santo Papa kay Zelensky, ginpahayag sini ang iya pagtamyaw para sa adlaw sang pagkabanhaw kag ang pagtalakay sang gilayun nga bulig sa mga biktima sang gyera, ilabi na ang paghilway sa mga preso kag iban pa nga humanitarian initiative.
english: In his conversation with Zelensky, the Pope expressed his greetings for the day of the resurrection and the discussion of immediate assistance to the victims of the war, especially the release of prisoners and other humanitarian initiatives.

text: Matandaan nga matapos ang pag-invade sang Russia sa Ukraine sang 2022, padayon ang paghimakas sang Vatican sa pagpatunga sa amo nga kinagamo agud makaangkon sang dalayun nga kalinong sa rehiyon.
english: It can be recalled that after the Russian invasion of Ukraine in 2022, the Vatican continues to struggle to mediate such unrest in order to achieve lasting peace in the region.

text: Gintawag ni Palace Press Officer Undersecretary Claire Castro nga “lousy script, not award-worthy” ang mga alegasyon sang 18 ka mga anay Marines nga nag-alegar nga nagdul-ong sang bilyones pesos kay Presidente Ferdinand Marcos Jr.
english: Palace Press Officer Undersecretary Claire Castro called “lousy script, not award-worthy” the allegations of 18 former Marines who allegedly delivered billions of pesos to President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.

text: kag kay anay House Speaker Martin Romualdez.
english: and to former House Speaker Martin Romualdez.

text: Matandaan nga kahapon nga adlaw sa isa ka press conference, kaupod si Atty. Levito Baligod, ginpahayag sini nga ang mga ginahingadlan nga mga ‘ex-Marines’ ang anay security personnel ni former Ako Bicol Rep.
english: It can be recalled that yesterday in a press conference, Atty. Levito Baligod, he said the so-called 'ex-Marines' are former security personnel of former Ako Bicol Rep.

text: Zaldy Co nga nagadeliver sang kwarta sa pila ka mga opisyal sang gobyerno.
english: Zaldy Co delivering money to some government officials.

text: Gintuad man ni Baligod nga ang 18 ka mga ex-marines ang nagpabaylo sang $2 million nga ginpahayag para kuntani sa mga International Criminal Court (ICC) investigators apang gintugyan ini kay anay Senador Antonio Trillanes IV nga hugot man nga ginpanginwala ini nga alegasyon.
english: Baligod also admitted that the 18 ex-marines exchanged $2 million that was supposed to be for International Criminal Court (ICC) investigators but handed it over to former Senator Antonio Trillanes IV who also strongly denied the allegation.

text: Suno kay Castro, mga ‘smear campaign’ lamang ini batok kay Marcos kag gintugyan na sa National Bureau of Investigation (NBI), Philippine National Police (PNP) kag Department of Justice (DOJ) ang pag-imbestigar batok sa mga ginapahayag sala nga alegasyon kay Marcos.
english: According to Castro, these are just smear campaigns against Marcos and the investigation against the alleged false allegations against Marcos has been handed over to the National Bureau of Investigation (NBI), Philippine National Police (PNP) and Department of Justice (DOJ).

text: Patay ang duwa ka pulis kag isa ka empleyado sang Bureau of Corrections (BuCor), matapos nga matiruhan sa Barangay Irawan sa Puerto Princesa City, Palawan, gab-i sang Byernes Santo, Abril 3, 2026.
english: Two policemen and an employee of the Bureau of Corrections (BuCor) were shot dead in Barangay Irawan in Puerto Princesa City, Palawan, on Good Friday night, April 3, 2026.

text:
Suno sa nakakita nga residente sa lugar, may ara sang komprontasyon nga natabo sa tunga sang mga pulis kag pila ka mga tambay sa lugar pasado 9:40 sang gab-i.

Naghalin ang mga pulis sa lugar apang sang nagbalik ang mga ini may dala na nga mga back-up nga nagresulta sa panibag-o nga komprontasyon sa tunga sang mga ini kun sa diin may ara na sang pagbinaslanay sang lupok.
english:
According to a resident in the area, there was a confrontation between the police and some hangouts in the area around 9:40 pm.

The police left the scene but when they returned with back-ups which resulted in a new confrontation between them where there was an exchange of fire.
