text: Ginkilala ang mga napatay nga sanday Police Staff Sergeants Ryan Cris Cabaña kag Jayson Fernandez, nga pareho nga na-assign sa Puerto Princesa City Police Station 2, kag si Jerson Ojario Talon sang BuCor.
english: The dead were identified as Police Staff Sergeants Ryan Cris Cabaña and Jayson Fernandez, both assigned to Puerto Princesa City Police Station 2, and Jerson Ojario Talon of BuCor.

text: Ginmanduan na ni Puerto Princesa City Police Office (PPCPO) Director Police Colonel Cristine Tabdi sang ma-id-id nga imbestigasyon ang krimen.
english: Puerto Princesa City Police Office (PPCPO) Director Police Colonel Cristine Tabdi has ordered a thorough investigation into the crime.

text: Naglunsyar naman ang mga ini sang manhunt operation agud mahibaluan kag maaresto ang mga suspek.
english: They launched a manhunt operation to identify and arrest the suspects.

text: Dugang pa diri nagmandu man ang Police Director sang pagsugod sang case buildup kag estrikto nga operasyon.
english: In addition, the Police Director also ordered the start of case buildup and strict operations.

text: Dalawa ang nasawi habang apat pa ang isinugod sa ospital matapos malason sa pagkain ng isdang butete sa bayan ng Olutanga, ayon sa ulat ng pulisya nitong Sabado.
english: Two people died while four others were rushed to hospital after being poisoned by eating butete fish in Olutanga town, according to a police report on Saturday.

text: Kinilala ang mga nasawing biktima na sina Mary Joy Gumata at Repsine Galliner, parehong 15 taong gulang.
english: The victims were identified as Mary Joy Gumata and Repsine Galliner, both 15 years old.

text: Kasalukuyan namang nilalapatan ng lunas sa pagamutan ang apat na iba pa: sina Jerome Gumata, 44; Joash, 13; at dalawa pang biktima na kinilala lamang sa pangalang Chrisel at Edmundo.
english: Four others are currently undergoing treatment: Jerome Gumata, 44; Joash, 13; and two other victims identified only as Chrisel and Edmundo.

text: Batay sa imbestigasyon ng Zamboanga Sibugay Police, nahuli ni Galliner ang isang malaking isdang butete na dinala niya sa pamilya Gumata upang iluto at pagsaluhan.
english: According to the investigation of Zamboanga Sibugay Police, Galliner caught a large butete fish that he brought to the Gumata family to cook and eat.

text: Ngunit makalipas lamang ang ilang minuto matapos kainin ang isda, nagsimula nang makaranas ng pananakit ng tiyan, matinding pagkahilo, pamamanhid ng katawan, pagsusuka, at matinding diarrhea ang mga biktima.
english: However, within minutes of eating the fish, the victims began to experience abdominal pain, severe dizziness, numbness, vomiting, and severe diarrhea.

text: Ayon kay Eduardo Gumata, ama ng ilan sa mga batang biktima, nadatnan niya ang mga ito na namimilipit sa sakit kaya agad silang isinugod sa pagamutan.
english: According to Eduardo Gumata, father of some of the child victims, he found the puppies suffering from the disease so he immediately started treating them.

text: Idineklarang dead-on-arrival sina Galliner at Mary Joy, habang inilipat sa ibang ospital ang apat pang nalason.
english: Galliner and Mary Joy were declared dead-on-arrival, while four others were shifted to other hospitals.

text: Ayon sa mga eksperto, ang butete ay naglalaman ng tetrodotoxin, isang matinding neurotoxin na lubhang mapanganib at nakamamatay sa tao kahit sa maliit na dami lamang kung mali ang preparasyon o pagluluto.
english: According to experts, butete contains tetrodotoxin, a potent neurotoxin that is very dangerous and deadly to humans even in small amounts if prepared or cooked incorrectly.

text: Patuloy ang paalala ng mga awtoridad sa publiko na iwasan ang pagkain ng mga delikadong uri ng isda tulad ng butete, lalo na kung walang sapat na kaalaman sa tamang pagproseso nito.
english: Authorities continue to remind the public to avoid eating dangerous species of fish such as butete, especially if there is not enough knowledge on proper processing.

text: Natalana na nga maglupad subong nga aga ang Artemis II mission pakadto sa bulan.
english: The Artemis II mission to the moon is scheduled to lift off this morning.

text: May yara sang 10 ka adlaw nga mission ang nasambit nga rocket agud maglibot sa bulan.
english: The rocket has a 10-day mission to orbit the moon.

text: Indi kaangay sang Apollo-era crews nga puro mga White Americans nga may military backgrounds, ang Artemis II astronauts ang magarepresentar sang maragtason nga paglupad.
english: Unlike Apollo-era crews that were all White Americans with military backgrounds, the Artemis II astronauts will represent historic flight.

text: Ginalakipan ini nanday Reid Wiseman, ang Navy test pilot kag commander sang mission halin sa NASA.
english: This includes Reid Wiseman, the Navy test pilot and commander of the mission from NASA.

text: Kalakip man si Victor Glove, isa man ka naval test pilot nga mangin una nga Black person nga magabiyahe sa kahawaan.
english: Also included was Victor Glove, also a naval test pilot who would become the first Black person to travel in space.

text: Samtang si Christina Koch nga isa ka engineer ang record-holding astronaut nga una nga babaye man nga magalupad pagwa sang kalibutan.
english: Meanwhile, Christina Koch, an engineer, is the record-holding astronaut who is also the first woman to fly outside the earth.

text: Ang ulihi nga crew ang halin sa Canadian Space Agency nga si Jeremy Hansen, isa ka fighter pilot nga una nga non-NASA astronaut nga magaupod sa lunar mission.
english: The latter crew is from Canadian Space Agency Jeremy Hansen, a fighter pilot who will be the first non-NASA astronaut to join a lunar mission.

text: Patigayunon ang paglupad sang rocket alas-6:30 subong nga aga sang Huwebes, Abril 2 oras sa Pilipinas.
english: The rocket will launch at 6:30 am on Thursday, April 2 Philippine time.

text: Isa ka 70-anyos nga babae sa Hérault region sang France ang ginmultahan sang €1,250 (katumbas sang ₱83,000) matapos ginreklamo sang iya nga tupadbalay ang masami nga pagkadto sang iya nga kuring sa piyak nga ugsaran.
english: A 70-year-old woman in France's Hérault region was fined €1,250 (equivalent to ₱83,000) after her neighbor complained about her cat's frequent visits to the backyard.

text: Suno sa report, nagreklamo ang tupadbalay bangud sa mga marka sang tiil sa dingding, ihi sa habol, kag higko sa hardin nga ginbilin ang kuring ni Dominique nga si Rémi.
english: According to the report, the neighbor complained about paw prints on the wall, urine on the blanket, and dirt in the garden left behind by Dominique’s cat Rémi.

text: Sang Enero, nagdesisyon ang korte pabor sa nagreklamo kag ginpabayad si Dominique sang amo nga kantidad.
english: In January, the court ruled in favor of the complainant and ordered Dominique to pay the amount.

text: Wala pa diri natapos ang kaso bangud liwat na naman nga ginpatawag sa korte si Dominique subong nga Disyembre, matapos liwat nga naglumpat sa piyak nga kudal si Rémi.
english: The case is not over yet because Dominique was summoned to court again this December, after Rémi jumped over the fence again.

text: Mahimo nga maglab-ot sa €2,000 (₱133,000) ang panibag-o nga multa kay Dominique.
english: Dominique could face a new fine of up to €2,000 (₱133,000).

text: Ginkabos ang Gilas Pilipinas nga malutos ang New Zealand Tall Blacks, 66-69, sa second window sang FIBA Basketball World Cup 2027 Asian Qualifiers sa Mall of Asia Arena subong nga gab-i, Pebrero 26.
english: Gilas Pilipinas lost to the New Zealand Tall Blacks, 66-69, in the second window of the FIBA ​​Basketball World Cup 2027 Asian Qualifiers at the Mall of Asia Arena tonight, February 26.

text: Ini ang una nga kalutusan sang Philippine National Team sa qualifiers matapos ang 2-0 sweep batok sa Guam sa first window.
english: This is the first loss of the Philippine National Team in the qualifiers after a 2-0 sweep against Guam in the first window.

text: Nangin top scorer para sa New Zealand si Max Darling nga may 11 puntos, samtang may double-double performance si Sam Mennenga nga may 10 points kag 14 rebounds.
english: Max Darling was the top scorer for New Zealand with 11 points, while Sam Mennenga had a double-double performance with 10 points and 14 rebounds.

text: Sa Gilas, nagpanguna si Dwight Ramos nga may 16 points kag eight rebounds, kag may 15 points naman si CJ Perez.
english: For the Gilas, Dwight Ramos led the way with 16 points and eight rebounds, and CJ Perez had 15 points.

text: Ginbudlayan naman nga makapuntos si Justin Brownlee nga naka-kuwatro lamang sa pagtakop sang hampang.
english: Justin Brownlee struggled to score with four at the end of the game.

text: 2-1 na subong ang record sang Gilas sa Group A. Sunod nga atubangon ni Coach Tim Cone kag sang national team ang Australia sa Domingo sa amo man gihapon nga venue.
english: The Gilas now have a 2-1 record in Group A. Coach Tim Cone and the national team will next face Australia on Sunday at the same venue.

text: Nagsaka naman ang record sang Kiwis sa 1-2.
english: The Kiwis' record improved to 1-2.

text: Wala nagapati ang isa ka human rights lawyer sa mga alegasyon sang ex-Marines sa pila ka mga kongresista nga ginaalegar ila gindul-ungan sang mga maleta nga may unod nga kuwarta.
english: A human rights lawyer does not believe the allegations of ex-Marines to some congressmen that they allegedly delivered suitcases containing money.

text: Matandaan nga kahapon nga adlaw nagpaguwa sang alegasyon ang mga nagpakilala nga anay mga miyembro sang Philippine Marines nga naga-claim man nga nag-deliver sila sang P805 billion nga cash nga nakabutang sa maleta kanday President Ferdinand Bongbong Marcos Jr.
english: It can be recalled that yesterday, former members of the Philippine Marines released allegations claiming that they delivered P805 billion cash in a suitcase to President Ferdinand Bongbong Marcos Jr.

text: kag former House Speaker Martin Romualdez.
english: and former House Speaker Martin Romualdez.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Atty. Jobert Pahilga, iya ginpahayag nga isa ini ka ‘politically motivated’ nga mga alegasyon.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Atty. Jobert Pahilga, he said that these are 'politically motivated' allegations.

text: Dugang pa sini nga makaduluda ang amo nga pahayag, bangud halos tanan nga pangalan nga gin-mention amo ang mga anti-Duterte nga mga politiko.
english: He added that the statement is suspicious, because almost all the names mentioned are anti-Duterte politicians.

text: Ginkwestyon man ni Pahilga ang timing sang pagpagwa sang amo nga mga pahayag, bangud kaangay gintuon gid ini sa confirmation of charges sa International Criminal Court (ICC) ini anay President Rodrigo Duterte kag sa damlag lang nga pag-anunsyo ni Vice President Sara Duterte sang kandidatura sa 2028 election.
english: Pahilga also questioned the timing of the release of these statements, as it seems to have been studied in the confirmation of charges in the International Criminal Court (ICC) by former President Rodrigo Duterte and the recent announcement of Vice President Sara Duterte's candidacy in the 2028 election.

text: Sa karun, ginahangkat ni Pahilga ang mga ex-Marines, nga pamatud-an ang ila mga alegasyon nga para sa iya ang isa ka kabutigan.
english: Pahilga is now challenging the ex-Marines, to prove their allegations that for him are a lie.

text: Nagnubo sang 8.5% ang baligya sang mga salakyan sa Pilipinas sa bulan sang Pebrero kun ipaanggid sang nagligad nga tuig.
english: Vehicle sales in the Philippines fell by 8.5% in February compared to the previous year.

text: Base sa datos sang Chamber of Automotive Manufacturers of the Philippines, Inc.
english: Based on data from the Chamber of Automotive Manufacturers of the Philippines, Inc.

text: kag Truck Manufacturers Association, naglab-ot sa 35,842 units ang nabaligya, mas manubo sa 39,164 units sang nagligad nga tuig.
english: and Truck Manufacturers Association, sold 35,842 units, down from 39,164 units last year.

text: Ginpahayag nga isa sa mga rason amo ang pagsaka sang presyo sang gatong bangud sang tensyon sa Middle East.
english: One of the reasons was said to be the rise in fuel prices due to tensions in the Middle East.

text: Sa pihak nga bahin, nagtaas naman ang baligya sang electric vehicles (EVs) sa 3,098 units sang Pebrero.
english: On the other hand, sales of electric vehicles (EVs) increased to 3,098 units in February.

text: Suno sa industriya, padayon sila nga nagatanyag sang mas makinot sa gatong kag electric nga mga salakyan bilang alternatibo sa mga pumuluyo.
english: According to the industry, they continue to offer more fuel-efficient and electric vehicles as an alternative to citizens.

text: SA PANUGOD pa lang sang pag-imbestigar sang Senate Blue Ribbon Committee (SBRC) sa flood control project anomaly (FCPA), sa pagpamuno ni  Senator Rodante Marcoleta, may suspetso na nga indi maayo ang publiko.
english: AT THE beginning of the Senate Blue Ribbon Committee (SBRC) investigation into the flood control project anomaly (FCPA), headed by Senator Rodante Marcoleta, there is a suspicion that the public is not good.

text: Kag ina agud pakalainon ang administrasyon ni Presidente Marcos Jr.
english: And that's to criticize the administration of President Marcos Jr.

text: bisan pa ang Presidente mismo ang nagtulak sang imbestigasyon sang FCPA sa iya 2025 SONA sadtong Hulyo 28.
english: even though the President himself pushed the FCPA investigation in his 2025 SONA back on July 28th.

text: Nga daan kaugyon ni Marcoleta sa mayoriya ang mga diehard pro-Duterte nga mga senador nga sanday Bato dela Rosa, Bong Go, Robin Padilla, kag Imee Marcos, nga gin-updan man sang iban nga mga senador nga luyag makatilaw sang pan de sal samtang mainit pa.
english: Marcoleta already agreed in the majority with diehard pro-Duterte senators Bato dela Rosa, Bong Go, Robin Padilla, and Imee Marcos, who were also joined by other senators who wanted to taste the pan de sal while it was still hot.

text: Natublag ugaling sila sang ginpa-imbestigar ni Senador Panfilo”Ping” Lacson ang mga proyekto sa Bulacan nga, incidentally, nagtudlo sang pagbaton sang kickback ni Senador Joel Villanueva sang PhP30 ka Milyon.
english: However, they were disturbed when Senator Panfilo”Ping” Lacson investigated the projects in Bulacan which, incidentally, pointed to the receipt of a kickback by Senator Joel Villanueva of PhP30 million.

text: Kahimbon pa gani ini sang mga DPWH official upod sa mga contractor agud mapadasig ang pagtigayon sang mga proyekto nga ila gindaug sa bidding.
english: This is even a collaboration between DPWH officials and contractors to expedite the implementation of projects they won in the bidding.

text: Ang ginatumod diri nga mga contractor amo ang mag-asawa nga Curlee kag Sarah Discaya nga may  siyam (9) ka kompaniya nga nakadaug sa bidding sang govt-funded project dira sa Bulacan kag sa iban pa nga parti sang pungsod.
english: The contractors in question are Curlee and Sarah Discaya who have nine (9) companies that won the bidding of govt-funded projects in Bulacan and other parts of the country.

text: Nagwa man sa mga imbestigasyon sa Bicol nga may kasubong nga kickback nga PhP30M nga nabaton ni Senador Chiz Escudero, luwas sa pag-angot pa sa iya kag iya pamilya sa pila ka proyekto sa Bicol.
english: Investigations in Bicol also revealed that Senator Chiz Escudero received a similar kickback of PhP30M, besides linking him and his family to several projects in Bicol.

text: Sa kabug-usan, ang mga pag-imbestigar sang SBRC kag sang Independent Committee on Infrastructure (ICI) nakadiskubre sang madamo lang nga  anomaliya.
english: Overall, the investigations by the SBRC and the Independent Committee on Infrastructure (ICI) uncovered few anomalies.

text: Katulad sang SOP “commission”, illegal campaign donations, mga “tulong” kag sang kon ano pa nga mga “pabuya” halin sa mga contractor, nga nagresulta sa kapalpakan sang pagtukod sang mga proyekto halin sa nahiwa na sing tadtad nga mga project funds.
english: Such as SOP “commission”, illegal campaign donations, “help” and other “rewards” from contractors, which resulted in the failure to build projects from already cut project funds.

text: Nalamita man sa mga imbestigasyon ang 21 ka kongresista nga, sunu sa sources sang ICI, nakabaton man sang kickbacks nga nagresulta sa ghost projects, nga sunu sa COA, galakip sang mga proyekto nga substandard, “completed” kuno gali kay poste pa lang ang nagatindug, kag ang indi ma-locate, ukon sa “guni-guni lang” sunu gani sa Presidente.
english: Also involved in the investigations are 21 congressmen who, according to ICI sources, also received kickbacks that resulted in ghost projects, which according to the COA, include projects that are substandard, “completed” because only posts are standing, and those that cannot be located, or “guni-guni lang” according to the President.

text: Sa pagkambyo sang lealtad, ugaling, natukod ang bag-o nga mayoriya sa Senado nga ginapangunahan na ni Senador Tito Sotto bilang Senate President  kag ni Lacson bilang tsirman sang SBRC.
english: With the change of loyalty, however, a new majority was formed in the Senate now led by Senator Tito Sotto as Senate President and Lacson as chairman of the SBRC.

text: Kilala sa pagkaisganan si Lacson bilang Chief PNP  kag sang limpyo niya nga record bilang senador sa sulod sang tatlo ka termino tubtub karon, gani ginsaligan siya sa pagpamuno sang SBRC.
english: Lacson is known for his courage as Chief PNP and his clean record as a senator for three terms so far, so he was trusted to lead the SBRC.

text: Kag nagdugang pa ang kaisog sang SBRC agud mag-expose sa ila BUNAYAG kag BUKAS sa publiko nga pag-imbestigar sandig mismo sa mando sang Presidente nga “iguon ang dapat iguon nga wala sang pinilian”.
english: And the SBRC has increased its courage to expose its BUNAYAG and OPEN to public investigation based on the President's mandate to “hit what should be hit without discrimination”.

text: Samtang padayon man ang pag-validate sang mga impormasyon nga nagaabot sa ICI, lakip ang halin sa SBRC, agud mapasaka na ang mga kaso sa Ombudsman kag sa Sandiganbayan kon diin dapat ipasaka.
english: Meanwhile, the validation of information received by the ICI, including that from the SBRC, is ongoing so that cases can be filed with the Ombudsman and the Sandiganbayan where they should be filed.

text: In fact, sunu kay DPWH Sec.Vince Dizon nakapasaka na gani sila sang kaso sa 25 ka DPWH official sa Ombudsman.
english: In fact, according to DPWH Sec. Vince Dizon, they have already filed cases against 25 DPWH officials with the Ombudsman.

text: Kag sa pagpadayon sang imbestigasyon sang SBRC napadaluman pa ang kaso sang mga senador nga nalamita sa anomaliya.
english: And as the SBRC continues its investigation, the case of the senators involved in the anomaly has deepened.

text: Kag kon sin-o ang bagay nga mga state witness, ukon whistleblower, agud maipit gid sing husto ang mga suspetsado.
english: And who are the right state witnesses, or whistleblowers, to nail the suspects properly.

text: Ginkwestyon ini nanday Escudero kag Villanueva kay kuno ngaa sila gid ang ginatutukan kag ngaa wala sing may nalakip nga mga kongresista, nga sang nahibal-an nila sa ulihi, may 21 na gali ka kongresista nga gina-imbestigar sang ICI.
english: Escudero and Villanueva questioned why they were being targeted and why no congressmen were included, when they later learned that there were 21 congressmen under investigation by the ICI.

text: Gin-insistir man ni Marcoleta nga himuon state witness ang mag-asawa nga Curlee kag Sarah Discaya.
english: Marcoleta also insisted that Curlee and Sarah Discaya be made state witnesses.

text: Ginbalabagan ini ni Lacson kay indi sila maka-qualify.
english: Lacson blocked it because they could not qualify.

text:
Sunu sa kasuguan, “The state witness must not be the most guilty person in the crime.”

Na-iskandalo na ang mga palpak nga mga proyekto sang mga Discaya kag laban-laban sila gid ang “most guilty”.
english:
According to the law, “The state witness must not be the most guilty person in the crime.”

The failed projects of the Discayas have already been scandalized and they are the “most guilty”.

text: Gintudlo man ni Lacson ang “conflict of interest” ni Marcoleta bangod ang iya gali asawa opisyal sang Stronghold Insurance nga nag-issue sang surety bond para sa mga proyekto sang mga Discaya.
english: Lacson also pointed out Marcoleta's “conflict of interest” because his wife is actually an official of Stronghold Insurance who issued a surety bond for the Discaya projects.

text: Tungod sini, nagagwa nga luyag gid ni Marcoleta nga mangin state witness ang mag-asawa nga Discaya agud mahilway sila sa kaso.
english: Because of this, it turns out that Marcoleta wants the Discaya couple to become state witnesses so that they can be freed from the case.

text: Kliyente gali sila sang iya asawa.
english: They were his wife's clients.

text: Indi gid ugaling magpasubali si Marcoleta kag iya mga kaugyon sa minoriya, kag napilitan na gid lang mag-resign si Lacson kay indi na niya mapadalagan sing husto ang SBRC sa sige panabad nanday Marcoleta.
english: However, Marcoleta and his minority allies will not compromise, and Lacson was forced to resign because he could no longer run the SBRC properly due to Marcoleta's constant requests.

text: Kag indi lang sa ina nga rason.
english: And not just for that reason.

text: Hambalon pa, kon indi si Lacson mapasugtan agud mabuyagyag ang tanan sa publiko, maayo pa matuod nga mag-resign na gid lang siya.
english: In other words, if Lacson is not allowed to reveal everything to the public, it is better for him to resign.

text: Maayo na lang nga magpabilin siya nga “true to his job” sangsa pasugtan ang luyag sang iban nga makapahuyang sang kredibilidad sang SBRC sa atubangan sang mga pumuluyo.
english: It is better for him to remain “true to his job” than to allow the wishes of others to undermine the credibility of the SBRC in the eyes of the people.

text: Nga ginakahadlukan naton nga makapadabok pa sang reklamo sang mga pumuluyo.
english: Which we fear will fuel the complaints of the people.

text: Husto!
english: Proper!

text: Kon Lapsus Calami pa ang pahambalon./PN
english: If you're talking about Lapsus Calami./PN

text: Natalana subong nga adlaw, Pebrero 2, ang sashing ceremony sang Miss Iloilo 2026.
english: The sashing ceremony of Miss Iloilo 2026 is scheduled for today, February 2.

text: Maga-umpisa ini alas-kuatro sa hapon sa SM City Iloilo Northpoint.
english: It will start at 4 pm at SM City Iloilo Northpoint.

text: Sa sini nga seremonya mahibaluan kun sa diin nga national pageant ipadala si Miss Iloilo 2026 Zestah Shalom Espinosa kag ang Heartfelt Queens.
english: The ceremony will determine which national pageant Miss Iloilo 2026 Zestah Shalom Espinosa and the Heartfelt Queens will be sent to.

text: Matandaan nga sa ginhiwat nga koronasyon sang Miss Iloilo sa West Visayas State University (WVSU) Cultural Center sang Enero 17, nangibabaw si Espinosa nga nagtiglawas sang Anilao.
english: It can be recalled that in the coronation of Miss Iloilo held at the West Visayas State University (WVSU) Cultural Center on January 17, Espinosa, who represented Anilao, won.

text: Naga-edad ini sang 21-anyos kag isa ka architecture student sa University of San Agustin.
english: He is 21-years-old and an architecture student at the University of San Agustin.

text: Nagkadto man sa iya ang awards nga Best in Gown, Best in Swimsuit, kag Best in Introduction Video.
english: The awards for Best in Gown, Best in Swimsuit, and Best in Introduction Video also went to her.

text: Ginkilala naman nga Heartfelt Queens ang nabilin sa Top 5 finalists nga amo sanday Patricia Lynn Beerda sang La Paz, Lorraine Manguiat sang Tubungan, Angel Ann Teruel sang Pototan, kag Jessica Mae Gatungay sang Guimbal.
english: The remaining Top 5 finalists were Patricia Lynn Beerda of La Paz, Lorraine Manguiat of Tubungan, Angel Ann Teruel of Pototan, and Jessica Mae Gatungay of Guimbal.

text: Una na nga ginpahayag ni Espinosa nga himuon nila ang tanan nga masarangan agud nga itib-ong ang Iloilo pananglitan nga mag-compete na sila sa national stage.
english: Espinosa earlier said they will do everything they can to unite Iloilo if they compete on the national stage.

text: Pahayag sini, madamo pa sila sang mga pasabog agud nga ma-represent sang maayo ang syudad.
english: He said they still have many opportunities to represent the city well.

text: Ginatutukan sa bulan sang Hulyo ang selebrasyon sang National Cleft Lip and Craniofacial Awareness Month bilang kabahin sang kampanya sa pagpasangkad sang kaalam parte sa cleft lip kag cleft palate, mga kondisyon nga ginakabig congenital nga may deperensya sa baba kag ngala-ngala.
english: The month of July focuses on the celebration of National Cleft Lip and Craniofacial Awareness Month as part of a campaign to raise awareness about cleft lip and cleft palate, conditions that are considered congenital with defects in the mouth and palate.

text: Sa exclusive interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Dr. Gabriel Tecson, isa ka espesyalista sa ENT – Head and Neck Surgery, ginpahayag nga ang cleft lip kag cleft palate isa ka congenital nga balatian.
english: In an exclusive interview with Bombo Radyo, Dr. Gabriel Tecson, a specialist in ENT – Head and Neck Surgery, stated that cleft lip and cleft palate is a congenital disease.

text: Nagakatabo ini samtang ginabusong pa ang bata, kung sa diin indi nagaporma sang husto ang mga istruktura sang nawong, labi na ang bibig kag ngala-ngala.
english: This occurs during pregnancy, when the structures of the face, especially the lips and palate, do not form properly.

text: Ang cleft lip nagaresulta sang gisi sa tuo o wala nga bahin sang bibig, kag may mga kaso man nga duha ka bahin ang apektado.
english: A cleft lip results in a tear on either the right or left side of the lip, and there are also cases where both sides are affected.

text: Samtang ang cleft palate naman amo ang buho sa ngala-ngala, nga nagahatag sang kabudlay sa pagkaon, paghambal, kag makadala sang komplikasyon kun indi dayon maoperahan.
english: A cleft palate is a hole in the palate, which makes it difficult to eat, speak, and can lead to complications if not treated immediately.

text: Sa Pilipinas, may yara sang pilakalibo ka kaso kada tuig, ilabi na sa mga lugar nga kulang sa serbisyo medikal antes magbata ang mga iloy.
english: In the Philippines, there are several thousand cases each year, especially in areas that lack medical services before mothers give birth.

text: May yara sang epektibo nga mga pamaagi para masolusyunan ang cleft lip kag cleft palate kag ginahimo ang operasyon sa cleft lip sang bata nagaedad 3 tubtob 6 ka bulan.
english: There are effective methods to solve cleft lip and cleft palate and cleft lip surgery is performed when the child is 3 to 6 months old.

text: Ang operasyon para sa cleft palate ginahimo antes pa magsugod ang kabataan sa paghambal sang mga tinaga, sa edad nga 9 tubtob 18 ka bulan.
english: Surgery for a cleft palate is performed before children begin to say words, between the ages of 9 and 18 months.

text: Ginapangunahan sang mga eksperto nga naga-upod ang mga espesyalista sa Ear, Nose, and Throat (ENT) specialist, plastic surgery, pediatrics, dentistry, kag speech therapy ang pag-atipan sa mga pasyente nga may cleft condition.
english: Experts that include Ear, Nose, and Throat (ENT) specialists, plastic surgery, pediatrics, dentistry, and speech therapy lead the care of patients with cleft conditions.

text: Ang selebrasyon sang National Cleft Lip and Craniofacial Awareness Month nagapadayon nga isa ka importante nga panawagan sa publiko agud maghatag suporta, magbulig sa pagpalapnag sang kasayuran, kag magpakita sang paghangop sa mga kabataan kag pamilya nga nagaatubang sang amo nga kondisyon.
english: The celebration of National Cleft Lip and Craniofacial Awareness Month continues to be an important call to action to the public to offer support, help spread awareness, and show understanding to children and families dealing with the condition.

text: Mga minor nga mga insidente lamang, kaangay sang mga kinagamo bangud sa pag-inom, ang narekord sang Iloilo City Police Office (ICPO) subong nga Semana Santa.
english: Only minor incidents, such as drinking riots, were recorded by the Iloilo City Police Office (ICPO) this Easter Season.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay PCol.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, PCol.

text: Wibert Parilla, Officer-in-Charge sang Iloilo City Police Office, iya ginpahayag nga matalunsay ang ila nga operasyon sa syudad kag ma-control nila ang sitwasyon sini.
english: Wibert Parilla, Officer-in-Charge of the Iloilo City Police Office, said their operation in the city is smooth and they can control the situation.

text: Suno pa sa iya nga dako ang bulig sang dugang nga augmentation halin sa Mobile Force Battalion nga nagpabaskog pa gid sa seguridad sang publiko.
english: He said the additional augmentation from the Mobile Force Battalion will help strengthen public security.

text: Dugang pa ni Parilla, wala sang break ang duty sang mga kapulisan gani naka-full alert ini asta sa Lunes, Abril 6, agud masiguro sang mga personnel nga safe ang mga tawo sa syudad.
english: Parilla added that there is no break in the duty of the police so they are on full alert until Monday, April 6, to ensure that the personnel are safe in the city.

text: Nagapahanumdom man ini sa publiko, ilabi na gid subong nga adlaw, Abril 5, Domingo sa Pagkabanhaw nga indi magpatama sang inom sang makahulubog nga ilimnon kag mangin responsible sa pagselebrar subong nga adlaw.
english: It also reminds the public, especially today, April 5, Easter Sunday, not to drink alcoholic beverages and be responsible in celebrating today.

text: Magahiwat sang hublag protesta ang Kabataan Panay sa siyudad sang Iloilo, bilang panawagan sang hustisya sa mga biktima sang Extra Judicial Killing (EJK) ni anay President Rodrigo Roa Duterte kadungan sang iya man confirmation of charges subong nga adlaw sa International Criminal Court.
english: Kabataan Panay will hold a protest rally in Iloilo City, calling for justice for the victims of the Extra Judicial Killing (EJK) of former President Rodrigo Roa Duterte during his confirmation of charges today at the International Criminal Court.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Arlie Bosque, Secretary General sang Kabataan Panay Party list, iya ginpahayag nga ang nasambit nga protesta sang amo nga grupo ang ila lihok agud isinggitan ang pagpanabat sa madugo nga hitabo sang administrasyon ni former PRRD nga nag-utas sang linibo ka mga kabuhi sang mga Pilipino.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Arlie Bosque, Secretary General of the Kabataan Panay Party list, said the group's protest is their move to demand accountability for the bloody events of the former PRRD administration that claimed thousands of lives.

text: Ginpatpat man ni Bosque ang ginapahayag kurapsyon sang opisina ni Vice President Sara Duterte sang ini ang nangin Secretary sang Department of Education (DepEd).
english: Bosque also explained the alleged corruption of Vice President Sara Duterte's office when she became Secretary of the Department of Education (DepEd).

text: Magluwas sa amo nga protesta sa subong nga adlaw, magaupod man ang amo nga grupo sa palaabuton nga prayer rally sang simbahan agud magpanawagan sang accountability batok sa mga korap nga opisyal sang gobyerno sa Pebrero 25, bilang pagkomemorar sang EDSA Poeple Power Revolution.
english: Besides today's protest, the group will also join the church's upcoming prayer rally to call for accountability against corrupt government officials on February 25, in commemoration of the EDSA People Power Revolution.

text: Ginpakita sang National University (NU) ang ila abilidad sa University Athletic Association of the Philippines (UAAP) Season 88 women’s volleyball matapos makumpleto ang reverse sweep batok sa Far Eastern University (FEU).
english: National University (NU) showed its skills in the University Athletic Association of the Philippines (UAAP) Season 88 women’s volleyball after completing a reverse sweep against Far Eastern University (FEU).

text: Nalutos sang three-peat-seeking Lady Bulldogs ang Lady Tamaraws sa score nga 17-25, 16-25, 25-19, 25-21, 15-12, sa ila una nga five-set nga hampang sa karun nga season sa Mall of Asia Arena.
english: The three-peat-seeking Lady Bulldogs defeated the Lady Tamaraws 17-25, 16-25, 25-19, 25-21, 15-12, in their first five-set match of the season at the Mall of Asia Arena.

text: Si Arah Panique ang nanguna sa NU nga may career-high 27 nga puntos, samtang si Camilla Lamina ang nangibabaw sa open nga may 19 set kag 3 digs.
english: Arah Panique led NU with a career-high 27 points, while Camilla Lamina dominated the open with 19 sets and 3 digs.

text: Sa pihak nga bahin, ginpangunahan ni Gerz Petallo ang FEU nga may 14 puntos, apang wala sini nadepensahan ang ila team sa late-game advantage, rason nga nadugangan ang ila pagkalutos sa nasambit nga season.
english: Meanwhile, Gerz Petallo led FEU with 14 points, but he failed to defend his team's late-game advantage, adding to their loss of the season.

text: Isa ka 44-anyos nga lalaki nga nurse sa isa ka ospital sa Wuerselen, Germany, ang ginpamatbatan sang life imprisonment nga wala sang parole matapos mapamatud-an nga nagpatay sang indi magnubo sa 10 ka pasyente kag pagtuyo nga patyon man ang 27 ka iban pa sa tunga-tunga sang Disyembre 2023 kag Mayo 2024.
english: A 44-year-old male nurse at a hospital in Wuerselen, Germany, has been sentenced to life imprisonment without parole after being found guilty of murdering at least 10 patients and attempting to murder 27 others as well between December 2023 and May 2024.

text: Suno sa mga imbestigador, sekreto nga ginatublukan sang nasambit nga nurse ang mga tigulang nga pasyente sang pampatulog kag painkillers kaangay sang morphine kag midazolam, isa ka muscle relaxant nga ginagamit man sa mga execution sa Estados Unidos.
english: According to investigators, the nurse secretly injected elderly patients with sleeping pills and painkillers such as morphine and midazolam, a muscle relaxant also used in executions in the United States.

text: Katuyuan niya nga mapadasig ang iya nga night shift paagi sa pagpatulog sa mga pasyente.
english: He aims to speed up his night shift by putting patients to sleep.

text: Sa trial, ginpanindugan sang wala ginpangalanan nga akusado nga luyag lamang niya nga “patulugon ang mga pasyente kag wala siya sang ihibalo nga makamamatay ang iya ginahimo sa ila.
english: At trial, the unnamed defendant insisted that he only wanted to “put the patients to sleep and that he had no knowledge that what he was doing to them was fatal.

text: Apang suno sa korte, madugay na nga ginapakita sang nurse nga wala ini sang pag-ulikid sa iya pasyente kag sa iya trabaho.
english: But the court said the nurse had long demonstrated a lack of care for her patient and her job.

text: GINAPALAB-OT naton ang aton kabalaka kag pangamuyo sa aton mga kautoran dira sa Cebu, labi na gid sa Bogo nga component city sang Cebu Province kon diin nasentro ang igu sang magnitude 6.9 nga linog sadtong Setyembre 30.
english: WE extend our concern and prayers to our brothers and sisters in Cebu, especially in Bogo, a component city of Cebu Province where the impact of the magnitude 6.9 earthquake on September 30 was centered.

text: Nabatyagan ining linog sa kalapit nga mga lugar.
english: The earthquake was felt in nearby areas.

text: Kag bisan diri sa Iloilo sa Intensity 5, nga ang kahalitan diri ginapa-tsek pa sang mga otoridad sa karon.
english: And even here in Iloilo in Intensity 5, the damage here is still being checked by the authorities.

text: Masakit matuod ang inyo nadangatan nga napatyan sang mga 72 ka mga tawo kag nasaktan ang malapit sa 400 pa, pati na ang kahalitan nga naagom sang inyo kasapatan kag pangabuhian.
english: Your experience is painful, killing about 72 people and injuring nearly 400 others, as well as the damage to your livestock and livelihoods.

text: Naguba man ang madamo nga mga puluy-an, mga eskwelahan, heritage churches, business buildings, mga taytay, mga dalanon, kag iban pa nga mga infrastruktura.
english: Many homes, schools, heritage churches, business buildings, bridges, roads, and other infrastructure were also destroyed.

text: Gapasalamat kita ugaling sa Diyos sa madasig nga pag-alabot sang mga bulig sa inyo sa pagpanguna sang gobyerno, nga galakip sang PhP5 ka Milyon nga donasyon ni 2022 Miss Universe PH Celeste Cortesi in partnership sa Angat Buhay Foundation ni anay VP Leni Robredo.
english: We are thankful to God for the quick arrival of aid to you under the leadership of the government, which includes the PhP5 million donation of 2022 Miss Universe PH Celeste Cortesi in partnership with the Angat Buhay Foundation of former VP Leni Robredo.

text:
***

Ang komtrobersya sa flood control project anomaly nagbukas pa gid sang aton mga mata sa nahimo, kag mahimo pa, nga korapsyon sang public officials, katulad sang DPWH officials kag elective officials nga kahimbon ang private contractors.
english:
***

The controversy over the flood control project anomaly has further opened our eyes to the corruption of public officials, such as DPWH officials and elective officials in collusion with private contractors.

text: Ang mga imbestigasyon, nga ginapangunahan sang Independent Committee on Infrastructure (ICI),  sa karon nagatudlo sa madamo nga kaso sang papangawat sa kaban sang banwa.
english: Investigations, led by the Independent Committee on Infrastructure (ICI), currently point to multiple cases of looting of the town coffers.

text: Lakip sa sining mga akusasyon ang kickbacks, ghost projects, illegal campaign donations, kag SOP “commission” nga 30% (sa proponent) kag dugang pa nga porsyento para sa mga kahimbon, nga napasaka na sa Ombudsman.
english: These accusations include kickbacks, ghost projects, illegal campaign donations, and an SOP “commission” of 30% (to the proponent) and an additional percentage for accomplices, which have already been filed with the Ombudsman.

text: Ang problema na lang kon paano mapadutlan sang kaso ang mga suspetsado sa pag-abot sa Sandiganbayan.
english: The only problem is how to prosecute the suspects when they arrive at the Sandiganbayan.

text: Ang problema pa gid kay pulos batid ining mga suspetsado sa pagbinutig kag magpalusot agud mabalewala ang ila kasal-anan tungod sang ila kwarta kag poder.
english: The problem is that these suspects are all good at lying and sneaking around to ignore their crimes because of their money and power.

text: Ti, ano ayhan ang maayo ta nga mahimo?
english: Well, what good can we do?

text: Makabulig seguro ang Balaan nga Kasulatan (Bibliya) nga naga-requirer sa idalom sang Mosaic Law sa Old kag New Testament nga kinahanglan ang duha ukon tatlo ka testigo agud mahibal-an gid ang kamatuoran sa mga natabo.
english: It may help that the Holy Scriptures (Bible) require under the Mosaic Law in the Old and New Testaments that two or three witnesses are needed to know the truth about what happened.

text: Sunu sa  Deuteronomy 19:15: “A lone witness is not sufficient to establish any wrongdoing or sin against a man… A matter must be established by the testimony of two or three witnesses.” Ukon, logically, bisan isa na lang ka testigo nga masaligan gid, nga mahangpan naton sa penalidad nga ginapataw sini.
english: According to Deuteronomy 19:15: “A lone witness is not sufficient to establish any wrongdoing or sin against a man… A matter must be established by the testimony of two or three witnesses.” Or, logically, at least one more reliable witness, which we can understand from the penalty it imposes.

text: Note nga ining Mosaic Law may ginapatuman nga maximum penalty nga Kamatayon (Death) batok sa Perjury ukon False Testimony, nga seryoso nga kasal-anan sa idalom sining Mosaic Law.
english: Note that this Mosaic Law has a maximum penalty of Death against Perjury or False Testimony, which is a serious offense under this Mosaic Law.

text: Tungod sini, masaligan ang testigo diri agud magsugid sing matuod nga makapadulot sang kaso bisan sa kakulangan sang iban pa nga testigo kag ebidensya.
english: Therefore, the witness here can be trusted to tell the truth that can lead to the case even in the absence of other witnesses and evidence.

text: It appears nga ang ining Mosaic Law isa ka “conscience law” nga nagahatag sing daku nga importansya sa panestigo nga indi makabutig – sa konsyensya sang testigo kag sa kahadlok sa silot nga Kamatayon kon magbutig siya.
english: It appears that this Mosaic Law is a “conscience law” that places great importance on the witness who cannot lie – on the conscience of the witness and on the fear of the death penalty if he lies.

text: Ini nga klase sang panestigo sa idalom sang Mosaic Law, may kasubong (similar) nga epekto sa idalom sang karon nga Whistleblower Law, nga  ginapatuman sa US, sa South Korea, sa iban pa nga pungsod kag diri man sa aton pungsod, kon diin ang testigo ginatagaan sini sang kaisog agud magsugid sang matuod.
english: This type of testimony under the Mosaic Law, has a similar effect under the current Whistleblower Law, which is implemented in the US, South Korea, other countries and here in our country, where the witness is given the courage to tell the truth.

text: Ang whistleblower witnessing isa ka panestigo sang “insider witness” nga may tuman nga ihibalo sang nagakatabo dira mismo sa iya upisina ukon organisasyon, pribado man ukon sa gobyerno.
english: Whistleblower witnessing is the testimony of an insider witness who has extensive knowledge of what is happening in his or her own office or organization, whether private or government.

text: Sa idalom sa sining Whistleblower Law, protektado ang testigo (kag iya pamilya) sa pagduso sang tulak sang iya konsyensya nga indi na niya masarangan hipsan pa agud isugid ang kamatuoran nga may kaisog kag wala sing hadlukan.
english: Under this Whistleblower Law, the witness (and his family) is protected from pushing the throat of his conscience that he can no longer hold back to tell the truth with courage and fearlessness.

text: Ang katulad sining kasuguan amo ang RA Act No.6981, “An Act Providing For A Witness Protection, Security And Benefit Program And For Other Purposes” nga napasar sang aton Kongreso sadtong Abril 24, 1991.
english: A similar law is RA Act No.6981, “An Act Providing For A Witness Protection, Security And Benefit Program And For Other Purposes” which was passed by our Congress on April 24, 1991.

text: Ginakilala ining Whistleblower Law nga  “the best line of defense against corruption and wrongdoings,” sang mga toso nga mga opisyales sa gobyerno nga sa ila pensar malutsan nila ang kasuguan “with impunity”, ukon sing wala penalidad.
english: This Whistleblower Law is recognized as “the best line of defense against corruption and wrongdoings,” by cunning government officials who think they can break the law “with impunity”, or without penalty.

text: Labi pa kay ang maximum penalty sa Perjury, sunu sa Respicio & Co.
english: Moreover, the maximum penalty for Perjury, according to Respicio & Co.

text: Law Firm, tubtub lang sa duha (2) ka tuig kag apat (4) ka bulan sa idalom sang Article 183 sangRevised Penal  Code, nga daku nga tentasyon sa may huyog mang-korap.
english: Law Firm, up to two (2) years and four (4) months under Article 183 of the Revised Penal Code, which is a great temptation to those who have a tendency to corrupt.

text: Sa matandaan pa sang publiko, napadutlan sang kaso si Janet Napoles, nga middleman sa minilyon ka pesos nga korapsyon sa Pork Barrel Scam, tungod sa whistleblowing ni  Benhur Luy nga iya salaligan.
english: As the public remembers, Janet Napoles, the middleman in the millions of pesos corruption in the Pork Barrel Scam, was charged with whistleblowing by Benhur Luy, whom she trusted.

text: Na-sentensyahan gid si Napoles, sa kabug-usan, sang 100 ka tuig nga pagka-priso.
english: Napoles was actually sentenced, in total, to 100 years in prison.

text: Napasakaan man, tungod sini, sang kaso ang duha ka senador kag isa ka bise gobernador.
english: Two senators and a vice governor were also charged.

text: Although mamag-an lang ang ila penalidad.
english: Although their penalties were light.

text: Tungod sini, gapati  kita nga may malaskaran gid nga opisyales sa gobyerno upod sang private contractors sa ining mga imbestigasyon kag mapanabat sang ila pagpangawat sa kaban sang banwa.
english: Because of this, we believe that there are government officials and private contractors who will be held accountable for their theft of the city coffers.

text: Nga daan may mga nag-apply na bilang testigo sa idalom sining RA 6981./PN
english: That there are already those who have applied as witnesses under this RA 6981./PN

text: Magabakal ang gobyerno sang Pilipinas sang 2 million barrels sang langis sa tunga sang nangin epekto sang gyera sa Middle East.
english: The Philippine government will buy 2 million barrels of oil amid the impact of the war in the Middle East.

text: Suno kay Finance Secretary Frederick Go, nagapakig-istorya na ang Philippine National Oil Company Exploration Corporation (PNOC EC) sa nanuhay-tuhay nga suppliers kag ginalantaw nga may malab-ot na nga mga kasugtanan subong nga semana.
english: According to Finance Secretary Frederick Go, the Philippine National Oil Company Exploration Corporation (PNOC EC) is already in talks with various suppliers and is expected to reach agreements this week.

text: Makabulig ini suno kay Go agud nga wala na sang kahangaw-an nga magkulang pa ang suplay sa pungsod.
english: Go said this will help ensure that there is no worry of shortage of supply in the country.

text: “PNOC EC has the resources to be able to acquire 2 million barrels of oil as a precautionary measure to add to our oil buffer stock.
english: “PNOC EC has the resources to be able to acquire 2 million barrels of oil as a precautionary measure to add to our oil buffer stock.

text: They’re doing a global procurement for the oil.
english: They’re doing a global procurement for the oil.

text: I believe they have a lot of offers on the table,” suno kay Go.
english: I believe they have a lot of offers on the table,” Go said.

text: Ang 2 million barrels nga langis ang katumbas na sang 10 ka adlaw nga fuel stock.
english: The 2 million barrels of oil is equivalent to 10 days of fuel stock.

text: Magadugang ini sa current oil supply stock sang Pilipinas nga makaigo pa sa masulusobra 50 ka adlaw.
english: This will add to the Philippines' current oil supply stock that will last for more than 50 days.

text: Kun may dugang nga suplay, ginalantaw man nga magahagan-hagan ang presyo sang local nga langis.
english: If there is more supply, the price of local oil is also expected to ease.

text: “After we acquire, we offload it.
english: “After we acquire, we offload it.

text: We download it to the oil companies.
english: We download it to the oil companies.

text: You can replenish the stock.
english: You can replenish the stock.

text: When you put out a big order into the global market, the belief is you should be able to get some economies of scale and procure at lower prices,” suno pa sa tiglikom.
english: When you put out a big order into the global market, the belief is you should be able to get some economies of scale and procure at lower prices,” the secretary added.

text: Kadam-an sang suplay sang langis ang ginabakal sang Pilipinas sa South Korea, Japan, Singapore kag China.
english: The Philippines buys most of its oil supplies from South Korea, Japan, Singapore and China.

text: Una naman nga ginkumpirma sang gobyerno nga nakapalapit naman ini sa Russia agud magnegosyar sa posible nga supply contract para sa oil export.
english: The government earlier confirmed that it had approached Russia to negotiate a possible supply contract for oil export.

text: Matandaan nga ginpahayag ni Energy Secretary Sharon Garin kahapon nga may sufficient fuel inventory pa sa Pilipinas nga magalawig tubtub sa Abril.#
english: Energy Secretary Sharon Garin said yesterday that there is still sufficient fuel inventory in the Philippines that will last until April.

text: Gin-aresto sang otoridad sang Thailand ang isa ka Pinay nga manunudlo matapos nagbilin ini sang patay nga lapsag sa isa ka mall.
english: Thai authorities have arrested a Filipina teacher after she left a dead baby in a mall.

text: Nadakpan ini sa isa ka bus station pila ka oras matapos nagbiya sa mall ang nasambit nga maestra.
english: He was arrested at a bus station hours after the teacher left the mall.

text: Suno kay Don Pancog, labor attaché sang Pilipinas sa Thailand, nadiskubrehan sang isa ka concerned citizen ang lapsag kag ginpahibalo sa otoridad.
english: According to Don Pancog, labor attaché of the Philippines in Thailand, a concerned citizen discovered the baby and informed the authorities.

text: Sang gin-check ang CCTV footage, didto nakit-an ang Pinay.
english: When the CCTV footage was checked, the Filipina was found there.

text: Suno naman sa Thai police, napilitan nga magbun-ag ang nasambit nga Pinay teacher sa sulod sang cr apang padayon pa ini nga ginaimbestigahan.
english: According to Thai police, the Filipina teacher was forced to give birth inside the toilet but is still being investigated.

text: Base sa impormasyon, pito ka bulan nga nagabusong ang amo nga babaye nga tumandok sang Mindanao.
english: According to reports, the woman, a native of Mindanao, was seven months pregnant.

text: Nagpaidalom sa isa ka komplikado nga operasyon ang isa ka 13 anyos nga solterito sa New Zealand matapos nakatulon sang 100 ka mga magnets.
english: A 13-year-old boy in New Zealand underwent a complicated operation after swallowing 100 magnets.

text: Suno sa report sang mga doctor, ang mga magnet ang ginbakal sang teenager halin sa sikat nga online shopping flatform sa China.
english: According to the doctors’ report, the magnets were purchased by the teenager from a popular online shopping flatform in China.

text: Gindala ang wala ginhingadlan nga solterito sa Tauranga hospital matapos makabatyag sang apat ka adlaw nga palanakit sang tiyan.
english: The unnamed young man was taken to Tauranga hospital after suffering from stomach pain for four days.

text: Didto kag gin-ako niya nga nakatulon siya sang magagmay nga neodymium magnets.
english: That's when he admitted to swallowing small neodymium magnets.

text: Ang nasambit nga mga magnet ang hugot nga ginadumili sa New Zealand humalin pa sang Hunyo 2013.
english: These magnets have been strictly banned in New Zealand since June 2013.

text: Sa X-ray, Nakita sang mga doctor nga ang mga magnet ang nagdululukot sa sulod sang tiyan sang solterito kag nahimo nga apat ka linya.
english: On X-rays, doctors found that the magnets had clumped together inside the boy's stomach and formed four lines.

text: Nagakabalaka ka bala sa imo abyan nga may indi maayo nga baho?
english: Are you worried about your friend having an unpleasant odor?

text: Luyag mo siya prangkahon apang nagaduha-duha ikaw bangud mahimo nga maglain ang iya nga buot ukon mahuy-an siya?
english: You want to be honest with him but you are hesitant because he might get upset or embarrassed?

text: Indi magkabalaka bangud may yara na sang solusyon dira agud nga mahibaluan niya mismo nga may yara siya sang indi manami nga baho nga indi siya ma-offend.
english: Don't worry because there is a solution there so that he knows for himself that he has a bad smell without being offended.

text: Ang tawo nga may yara sang ‘body odor’ ang isa ka seryoso nga isyu.
english: A person who has ‘body odor’ is a serious issue.

text: Gani sa pungsod Japan, may yara sang high tech device nga makabulig sa isa ka tawo nga mahibaluan kun mabaho ini ukon indi.
english: So in Japan, there is a high tech device that can help a person know if it smells bad or not.

text: Ginhimo ni Tanita ang isa ka handheld smell checker nga ginatawag ES-100 kag naga-analyze sang body odor sang tawo kag naga guwa ang numero humalin 1 tubtob 10 bilang intensity kun ano ka baho ang ilok sang isa ka tawo, sa diin 10 ang pinakamabaho.
english: Tanita developed a handheld smell checker called ES-100 that analyzes a person's body odor and produces a number from 1 to 10 as the intensity of how bad a person's nose smells, with 10 being the smelliest.

text: Ang ini nga device ang mahapos nga gamiton.
english: This device is easy to use.

text: Sa sulod sang 10 ka segundo, mahibaluan mo na gilayon ang baho sang imo nga ilok.
english: Within 10 seconds, you can immediately recognize the smell of your nose.

text: Kun maguwa sa device nga 0, ini buot silingon nga wala ikaw sang body odor, ang 1-4 amo ang acceptable pa nga lebel sang body odor, kun makakuha ka naman sang 5-9 ini buot silingon nga kinahanglan na nga hatagan sang igtalupangod kag kun 10 naman, kumpirmado na nga may yara ikaw sang body odor.
english: If the device comes out with 0, it means you have no body odor, 1-4 is the acceptable level of body odor, if you get 5-9 it means you need to pay attention and if you get 10, it means you have body odor.

text: Ginpakigbahin ni ”Mr. Pure Energy” Gary Valenciano nga sa karon nagapadayon ini sa pagpabulong sa cellulitis.
english: ”Mr. Pure Energy” Gary Valenciano shared that he is currently undergoing treatment for cellulitis.

text: Ang cellulitis isa ka impeksyon sa panit sang tawo nga naghalin sa bacteria.
english: Cellulitis is an infection of the human skin caused by bacteria.

text: Nagakatabo ini sa mga magamay nga pilas kag kagat sang insekto nga ginsudlan sang mikrobyo.
english: It occurs in small cuts and insect bites that have been infected with germs.

text: Suno kay Gary, napilas ang nawala sini nga tiil rason nga may yara sang nagsulod nga bacteria gani kinahanglan sini nga magpaidalom sa nagkalain-lain nga test.
english: According to Gary, his left leg was injured causing bacteria to enter and he had to undergo various tests.

text: Apisar nga madamo sang test ang kinahanglan sini nga himuon, na-amat-amat na ini nga nagabalik sa iya nakaandan nga gina-obra.
english: Although he needs to undergo many tests, he is slowly returning to his usual activities.

text:
Dala na diri ang pag-rekord sang podcast kag makipag-angot sa mga nagakalain-lain nga personalidad sa industriya paagi man sa “honest, soul-searching conversations sa ila nga ‘shaking seasons.’

Nahibaluan nga sang tuig 2018, na-diagnose man si Gary sa sakit nga may bara ini sa iya wala nga artery kag nagpaidalom man ini sa isa ka emergency cardiac bypass surgery.
english:
This includes recording a podcast and interacting with various personalities in the industry through “honest, soul-searching conversations during their ‘shaking seasons.’

In 2018, Gary was also diagnosed with a blockage in his left artery and underwent emergency cardiac bypass surgery.

text: Sa amo man nga tuig, nahibaluan sini nga may ara ini sang cancer sa kidney gani nagpaidalom man ini sa isa ka partial nephrectomy kun sa diin kinahanglan nga kuhaon ang kidney sini nga may cancer.
english: In the same year, he learned that he had kidney cancer and underwent a partial nephrectomy where his cancerous kidney had to be removed.

text: Nancer-free ini pagkatapos sang amo nga operasyon.
english: It is nancer-free after such an operation.

text: Kilala man si Gary bilang aktibo sa iya Christian ministry kag inspirational speaking nga permi sini ginadala sa iya musika nga ginapakigbahin sa iban nga tawo.
english: Gary is also known for his active Christian ministry and inspirational speaking that he always brings to his music that he shares with others.

text: Madali na nga makit-an liwat nga magkaupod sa entablado sanday Lea Salonga kag Rachelle Ann Go para sa ila pagbalik sa isa ka concert sa Les Misérables.
english: Lea Salonga and Rachelle Ann Go will soon be seen on stage together again for their return to a concert in Les Misérables.

text: Nahibaluan nga gintagaan sang karakter ni Lea si Madame Thénardier sa Manila run kag gin-portray man sini si Fantine sa 25th anniversary concert sang 2010 kag Éponine sa 10th anniversary concert sang 1995.
english: Lea played Madame Thénardier in the Manila run and also portrayed Fantine in the 25th anniversary concert in 2010 and Éponine in the 10th anniversary concert in 1995.

text: Samtang, masobra isa ka dekada naman nga gintagaan papel ni Rachelle An Go ang karakter ni Fantine nga subong isa na ka iloy.
english: Meanwhile, Rachelle An Go played the character of Fantine, who is now a mother, for more than a decade.

text: Naghatag naman sang pahayag ang mga miyembro sang cast kaangay nanday Red Concepción kag Earl Carpenter nga ang kadalumon sang istorya nagahatag sang padayon nga rason kag kahulugan sa ila mga bataon kag mga may edad na nga mga audience.
english: Cast members such as Red Concepción and Earl Carpenter said that the depth of the story gives continued reason and meaning to their young and old audiences.

text: Dugang pa nila, ang musika sang Les Misérables may yara sang kaugalingon nga “heartbeat” nga nagapahanugot nga magpangibabaw ang istorya bisan sin-o pa ang naga-uyat sang papel sini.
english: They add that the music of Les Misérables has its own “heartbeat” that allows the story to prevail regardless of who plays its role.

text: GINATAMYAW naton ang aton mga manudnudlo sa ila pagselebrar sang Teachers’ Month, Setyembre 5 tubtub Oktubre 5, although mas temprano pa tani nahimo naton ini.
english: We congratulate our teachers on their celebration of Teachers' Month, September 5 to October 5, although we could have done it earlier.

text: Mabuhay ang aton mga manunudlo!
english: Long live our teachers!

text: Nga sa masami   madumduman lang ang ila kaayuhan sang aton gobyerno kon gahilab na ang ila tiyan sa gutom!
english: That often our government only remembers their welfare when their stomachs are burning with hunger!

text: Kag daw mga wala kabalaslan sa pagsakripisyo ni ma’am kag ni sir agud makita sila karon sa ila mga trono sa gobyerno.
english: And it seems that they are not rewarded for the sacrifice of ma’am and sir to see them now on their thrones in government.

text: Lipat kamo, haw?
english: Move over, huh?

text: Sorry, naulihi ang aton pagtamyaw sa aton mga manunudlo.
english: Sorry, we were late to greet our teachers.

text: Naunahan lang kita sang daku nga problema sang aton pungsod angot sa anomaliya sa flood control projects, nga nakadakop anay sang aton atensyon.
english: We are just ahead of our country's big problem regarding anomalies in flood control projects, which caught our attention earlier.

text: But, of course, indi buot silingon sini nga wala naton ginatagaan importansya ang mga manunudlo sa ila pagselebrar sang Teachers’ Month.
english: But, of course, this does not mean that we do not give importance to teachers in their celebration of Teachers' Month.

text: Sa matuod, importante sa aton ining okasyon.
english: In fact, this occasion is important to us.

text: Una, tungod nangin manunudlo man kita katulad sang akon manghod nga babaye nga karon retirado na nga public school superintendent.
english: First, because we became teachers like my sister who is now a retired public school superintendent.

text: Sa karon, manunudlo man ang isa ko ka anak.
english: Today, one of my children is also a teacher.

text: Ang isa ko ka hinablos isa na gani karon ka Deputy Executive Director sang Philippine Science High School System (PSHS) sa Dept.
english: One of my nephews is now a Deputy Executive Director of the Philippine Science High School System (PSHS) in the Dept.

text: of Science and Technology Central Office.
english: of Science and Technology Central Office.

text: Nagpahuway, ugaling, ako bilang manunudlo sang magdesidir ako sa pagpasanyog pa sang kinaalam kag nagbalik sa eskwelahan, tubtub naudlot ato sang 1972 Marcos Martial Law.
english: However, I retired as a teacher when I decided to further my education and returned to school, until the 1972 Marcos Martial Law.

text: Sadto, gatudlo ako sang HS Mathematics, nga akon major, kag HS Economics sa University of Iloilo (UI) tungod tapos man ako sang Banking & Finance.
english: I was teaching HS Mathematics, my major, and HS Economics at the University of Iloilo (UI) because I also graduated from Banking & Finance.

text: Nakatudlo man ako sa kolehiyo sa subject nga “The Life and Works of Dr. Jose P. Rizal” sa pagkilala sa akon sang UI bilang gradwet sang YMCA Rizal Youth Leadership Training Institute.
english: I was also able to teach college on the subject “The Life and Works of Dr. Jose P. Rizal” upon UI’s recognition of me as a graduate of the YMCA Rizal Youth Leadership Training Institute.

text: Nagsaylo ako, ugaling, sang ulihi sa Iloilo City (Molo) National High School tubtub nagpahuway ako agud magpasanyog pa sang kinaalam.
english: I, however, later moved to Iloilo City (Molo) National High School until I took a break to improve my knowledge.

text: Indi mahapos ang magtudlo sadto sa public high school.
english: Teaching in public high school was not easy.

text: Kulang ang libro nga kon kis-a ginapa-xerokan ko pa sang kopya ang wala libro nga mga estudyante.
english: There are not enough books that sometimes I have to xerox copies for students who do not have books.

text: Ma-problema man ang mga kabataan kay halos tanan halin sa pigado nga panimalay.
english: The children will also have problems because almost all of them come from poor families.

text: Bilib me, pero kon kis-a gapangayo pa ang iban sa akon sang inugplete kon gaulan agud makasakay sa dyep pauli kay ang iban laway lang ang  balon.
english: I admire it, but sometimes others ask me for a fare when it rains to ride a jeep home because others only have saliva.

text: Ang iban pa gid halin sa problemado nga mga pamilya nga kon kis-a kinahanglan duawon sa ila balay agud masugilanon ang ila mga ginikanan labi na gid ang  masami ga-absent.
english: Others are from troubled families who sometimes need to be visited at home to talk to their parents especially those who are often absent.

text: Gaproblema man gani ang mga manunudlo sa ila gamay nga sweldo nga PhP212 kada bulan lang, nga ginaantos lang nila tungod sa ila gugma kag natural nga kabalaka sa mga kabataan labi na gid ang halin sa kubos nga panimalay, nga ginapaantos pa sang gobyerno sang kakulangan sang ila kinahanglanon sa pagtuon.
english: Teachers are also suffering from their small salary of PhP212 per month, which they suffer because of their love and natural concern for the children especially those from poor families, who are still suffering from the government's lack of educational needs.

text: Sa pag-desidir ko sa pagbalik sa eskwelahan, natabuan man nga wala pa ang isa ka tuig gin-deklarar ni sadto Presidente Ferdinand Marcos Sr.
english: When I decided to go back to school, it happened that less than a year ago, then President Ferdinand Marcos Sr. declared a state of emergency.

text: ang martial law, ukon ang pagginahom militar, sa pungsod sadtong 1972.
english: martial law, or military rule, in the country in 1972.

text: Natapos lang ini sang 1986 sang napalayas na ini kag ang iya pamilya sang Edsa Revolution sa Hawaii.
english: It only ended in 1986 when he and his family were driven out of Hawaii by the Edsa Revolution.

text: Sa amo nga tion nagamasakit man ang amon iloy nga nagakinahanglan sing mahalongon nga pagtatap.
english: At the same time, our mother was also ill and needed careful attention.

text: In fact, bedridden siya sa sulod sang anom ka tuig tubtub nagtaliwan.
english: In fact, he was bedridden for six years until he passed away.

text: Tungod sang sige pag-init sang sitwasyon, gintapok ako sang akon iloy sa amon diutay nga uma sa Guimaras agud malikaw ako sa mga kakilala ko nga mga aktibista, nga indi ako makabalibad tungod sang kahimtangan sang amon iloy.
english: As the situation escalated, my mother gathered me in our small farm in Guimaras to avoid the activists I knew, which I could not refuse because of our mother's condition.

text: Nga daan nangin student leader man ako bilang presidente sang  Iloilo College Editors’ Guild (ICEG) kag vice chairman sa isa ka regional (WV) student leaders’ group nga nagatulod sang “Student Power” sa ina nga panahon.
english: I was also a student leader as president of the Iloilo College Editors' Guild (ICEG) and vice chairman of a regional (WV) student leaders' group that promoted “Student Power” at that time.

text: Didto sa amon baryo sa Guimaras, nangabuhi ako upod sa akon mga katiyoan kag mga katiyaan.
english: In our village in Guimaras, I lived with my aunts and uncles.

text: Gabulig sa pagtanom sa gamay namon nga talamnan, gapangopras, gapanapas kahoy agud ulingon kag ibaligya nga gatong sa siyudad, kag gapanagat (hook-and-line deepsea fishing) upod sa akon tiyo kag mga kasimaryo sakay sa may layag nga sakayan tubtub sa mga tatlo ka milya ang kalayo halin sa amon baybay.
english: Helping to plant our small farm, farming, cutting wood for charcoal and selling fuel in the city, and fishing (hook-and-line deepsea fishing) with my uncle and neighbors in a sailboat up to about three miles from our shore.

text: Kag, sa pagdul-ong sang amon hulik sa fishing port, ugaling ako nagaduaw sa amon iloy diri sa siyudad.
english: And, to deliver our boat to the fishing port, I'm visiting our mother here in the city.

text: Sa pagtaliwan na sang amon iloy sadtong 1979, nagbalik na ako sa siyudad kag nagsugod magpakigbahin sa media work.
english: After my mother died in 1979, I returned to the city and began to participate in media work.

text: Nag-upod ako sa radio commentary program ni German Gonzales nga sadto kaupod ko sa student movement, nga na-release lang pagkatapos ma-stockade sang pila ka bulan.
english: I joined the radio commentary program of German Gonzales who was then with me in the student movement, which was only released after being stockaded for several months.

text: Siya sadto  presidente sang UP-Iloilo Student Republic samtang ako presidente sang CEG-Iloilo.
english: He was then president of UP-Iloilo Student Republic while I was president of CEG-Iloilo.

text: Sang gahingapos na ang rehimen ni Marcos nagsaylo na ako sa Panay News bilang reporter kag weekend editor.
english: When the Marcos regime was coming to an end, I moved to Panay News as a reporter and weekend editor.

text: Nangin editor-in-chief pa sang duha ka English daily, isa ka tri-weekly nga pamantalaan sa Ilonggo kag isa ka weekly magazine sa English.
english: He was also editor-in-chief of two English dailies, a tri-weekly newspaper in Ilonggo and a weekly magazine in English.

text: Kag sa akon pag-retiro, nga nagauribay sang nalutsan ko nga sobra 25 ka libel cases, yari na ako diri balik sa Panay News kon diin nagasulat na sining akon kolum, nga gin-ayu gid ni PN Publisher Danny, nga nagtaliwan na, nga isulat ko sa Ilonggo./PN
english: And in my retirement, with more than 25 libel cases, I am back here in Panay News where I am writing this column, which PN Publisher Danny, who passed away, asked me to write in Ilonggo./PN

text: Ginakabig sang isa ka human rights lawyer nga mapagu-an ang mga ebidensya nga igapresentar sa International Criminal Court (ICC) subong nga adlaw, kasunod sang Confirmation of Charges batok kay anay President Rodrigo Duterte.
english: A human rights lawyer considers the evidence to be presented at the International Criminal Court (ICC) today, following the Confirmation of Charges against former President Rodrigo Duterte, to be weak.

text:
Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Atty. Jobert Pahilga, iya ginpahayag nga madamo sang mga ebidensya nga ginsumiter ang abogado sang mga biktima sang lapnagon nga pagpamatay sa idalum sang administrasyon ni Duterte, nga mas kilala bilang kampanya kontra iligal nga droga ukon “war on drugs.”

Ginklaro man ni Pahilga nga wala sang basehan ang impormasyon nga ginapalapta sang pila ka mga supporter ni Duterte nga mabasura gilayun ang kaso sa tion pa lamang sang confirmation of charges sa ICC.
english:
In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Atty. Jobert Pahilga, he said that there is a lot of evidence submitted by the lawyers of the victims of the widespread killings under the Duterte administration, better known as the campaign against illegal drugs or “war on drugs.”

Pahilga also clarified that there is no basis for the information spread by some Duterte supporters that the case will be dismissed immediately upon confirmation of charges in the ICC.

text: Paathag ni Pahilga, ang tinutuyo sang confirmation of charges hearing amo ang paghibalo kun may husto kag mabug-at nga ebidensya batok sa akusado agud ipadayon ang kaso sa full trial.
english: Pahilga explained that the purpose of the confirmation of charges hearing is to determine if there is accurate and strong evidence against the accused to continue the case to full trial.

text: Apang kun mapamatud-an nga kulang ang ebidensya, posible man nga ibasura ang kaso.
english: However, if the evidence is found to be insufficient, the case may also be dismissed.

text: Ginpasalig sang Iran nga paagyon sini nga hilway sa katalagman ang mga barko sang Pilipinas kag ang Filipino seafarers sa Strait of Hormuz.
english: Iran has assured that it will ensure the safe passage of Philippine ships and Filipino seafarers in the Strait of Hormuz.

text: Nakuha ni Foreign Affairs Secretary Theresa Lazaro ang commitment paagi sa iya pagtawag kay Iranian Foreign Minister Seyed Abbas Araghchi.
english: Foreign Affairs Secretary Theresa Lazaro got the commitment through her call to Iranian Foreign Minister Seyed Abbas Araghchi.

text: Suno sa Department of Foreign Affairs (DFA), nagpromisa ang Iran nga tugutan sini nga maglabay nga wala sang obstruction ukon indi pagbalabagan ukon pagbombahan ang mga barko kag energy shipments sang Pilipinas kag ang tanan nga Filipino seafarers.
english: According to the Department of Foreign Affairs (DFA), Iran has promised to allow unobstructed passage or not to block or bomb Philippine ships and energy shipments and all Filipino seafarers.

text: “During the call, the Iranian Foreign Minister assured the Secretary that Iran will allow the safe, unhindered, and expeditious passage through the Strait of Hormuz of Philippine-flagged vessels, energy sources, and all Filipino seafarers,” suno sa statement sang DFA.
english: “During the call, the Iranian Foreign Minister assured the Secretary that Iran will allow the safe, unhindered, and expeditious passage through the Strait of Hormuz of Philippine-flagged vessels, energy sources, and all Filipino seafarers,” the DFA statement said.

text:
Dugang sang ahensya: “These assurances from Iran will greatly facilitate the steady delivery of critical oil and fertilizer supplies to the Philippines.”

Isa ini ka daku nga development nga ginahulat sang Pilipinas agud nga mapahagan-hagan ang krisis sa enerhiya nga tuga sang masobra isa ka bulan na nga gyera sa Middle East.
english:
The agency added: “These assurances from Iran will greatly facilitate the steady delivery of critical oil and fertilizer supplies to the Philippines.”

This is a major development that the Philippines has been waiting for to ease the energy crisis caused by more than a month of war in the Middle East.

text: Gina-import sang Pilipinas halin sa Middle East ang 98% sang krudo nga ginagamit sini, gani nga tuman man ka daku ang epekto halin sang ginsiradhan sang Iran ang Strait of Hormuz sa temprano nga bahin sang Marso.
english: The Philippines imports 98% of the oil it uses from the Middle East, so the impact has been severe since Iran closed the Strait of Hormuz in early March.

text: Suno pa sa DFA, bangud sang pasalig sang Iran, ginalantaw nga mangin steady na ang pag-deliver sang langis kag fertilizers supplies sa Pilipinas.
english: According to the DFA, due to Iran's assurance, the delivery of oil and fertilizers supplies to the Philippines is expected to be steady.

text: Nahibaluan nga may amo man sini nga kasugtanan ang Iran sa iban nga mga pungsod sa kondisyon nga indi lang sila magpasilabot sa gyera.
english: It is known that Iran has similar agreements with other countries on condition that they do not interfere in the war.

text: Sang Marso 26, matandaan nga nag-anunsyo ang Foreign Ministry sang amo nga pungsod nga tugutan nila nga makalabay sa Strait ang mga barko halin sa China, Russia, India, Iraq, kag Pakistan.#
english: On March 26, the country's Foreign Ministry announced that it would allow ships from China, Russia, India, Iraq, and Pakistan to pass through the Strait.

text: Aprubado na sang Senado sa third and final reading ang hagna nga nagahatag sang emergency powers kay President Ferdinand “Bongbong” Marcos, Jr.
english: The Senate has approved in third and final reading the bill that gives emergency powers to President Ferdinand “Bongbong” Marcos, Jr.

text: nga magsuspinde ukon magbuhin sang excise tax sa produktong petrolyo.
english: to suspend or reduce the excise tax on petroleum products.

text: Nakalusot sa Senado ang Senate Bill No.
english: Senate Bill No.

text: 1982 matapos nakakuha sang 17 ka affirmative votes, wala sang negative votes, kag wala sang abstentions.
english: 1982 after receiving 17 affirmative votes, no negative votes, and no abstentions.

text: Sa idalom sini nga hagna, may gahum ang presidente nga mag-suspend ukon magbuhin sang excise tax pananglitan maglapaw na sa $80 per barrel ang presyo sang Dubai crude oil.
english: Under the bill, the president has the power to suspend or reduce the excise tax if the price of Dubai crude oil exceeds $80 per barrel.

text: Sa interpellation, ginklaro naman sang nag-sponsor sang hagna nga si Senator Pia Cayetano nga indi pa gilayon mabatyagan sang publiko ang epekto sang tax suspension.
english: In the interpellation, the bill's sponsor, Senator Pia Cayetano, clarified that the public will not immediately feel the effects of the tax suspension.

text: Ini bangud kun mapasar na bilang layi kag i-execute na ang buhin ukon suspension sang buwis, dapat nga ubuson anay sang mga kumpaniya sang langis ang ila nga existing inventories nga nabakal nga may taxed rates.
english: This is because once the tax suspension is passed into law and executed, oil companies must first exhaust their existing inventories purchased with taxed rates.

text: Bangud sini, posible nga 30-45 ka adlaw pa antes mag-reflect ang tax suspension ukon mas mas madali naman kun maubos na ang suplay subong.
english: Because of this, it is possible that it will be 30-45 days before the tax suspension reflects or sooner if the supply runs out now.

text: Kun maubos naman ang daan nga stocks, diri na kag maganubo ang presyo sang gasolina sang tubtub sa P11.2 per liter, samtang mabuhinan naman ang presyo sang diesel sang tubtub sa P6.72 per liter.
english: If the old stocks run out, the price of gasoline will drop to P11.2 per liter, while the price of diesel will drop to P6.72 per liter.

text: Matandaan nga sang Lunes sang gin-aprubahan man sa third and final reading sa Kamara ang kaangay nga hagna matapos nga gin-certify ini sang presidente bilang urgent.
english: It can be recalled that on Monday, the same bill was approved on third and final reading in the House of Representatives after the president certified it as urgent.

text: Subong nga adlaw, Marso 18, dapat nga ma-ratify na sang Kamara kag Senado ang amo nga hagna agud nga ma-consolidate ukon masibo ang ila tagsa ka mga bersyon para nga mapasa na sa presidente para nga mapirmahan sini.
english: Today, March 18, the House and Senate should ratify the bill in order to consolidate their respective versions for submission to the president for his signature.

text: Subong man ang katapusan nga adlaw sang Kamara kag Senado antes ang isa ka bulan nga congressional break para sa Semana Santa.
english: Also the last day of the House and Senate before a month-long congressional break for Easter.

text: Naghinulsuol sa karon ang isa ka construction worker matapos nga ginsunog sini ang kaugalingon nga balay sa Brgy.
english: A construction worker is now regretting after he set fire to his own house in Brgy.

text: Barasalon, Janiuay, Iloilo kaagahon sang Byernes Santo, Abril 3.
english: Barasalon, Janiuay, Iloilo on Good Friday morning, April 3.

text: Isa ang napatay kag tatlo naman ang pilason sa nasambit nga insidente.
english: One person was killed and three others were injured in the incident.

text: Ang suspek ginkilala kay Remos Brasileño 31-anyos.
english: The suspect was identified as Remos Brasileño, 31 years old.

text: Samtang, ang napatay naman nga bayaw sini amo si Wilgie Macero.
english: Meanwhile, the deceased was his brother-in-law, Wilgie Macero.

text: Ang mga na-ospital amo sanday Shiela Brasileño Macero, asawa sang napatay kag utod sang suspek kag ang duwa pa sini ka mga utod nga sanday Ivy Brasileño Perez, 35 anyos kag Richard Brasileño, 39 anyos.
english: Those hospitalized were Shiela Brasileño Macero, wife of the deceased and sister of the suspect and her two brothers Ivy Brasileño Perez, 35 years old and Richard Brasileño, 39 years old.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo sa suspek, iya ginpahayag nga naglain ang ang iya buot bangud may nagapanugid sa iya asawa nga naga-inom ini sang makahulubog nga ilimnon sa iya ulubrahan kag ginapasibangdan sini ang iya utod nga nagapanugid.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, the suspect said he was upset because someone told his wife that he was drinking alcohol at work and he blamed his brother for telling him.

text: Suno sa suspek, bangud sa iya kalain sang buot, gin-ula-an sini sang gas kag ginsindutan ang ila balay nga human sa ligh materials rason kun ngaa madali nga naglapta ang kalayo.
english: According to the suspect, in his anger, he poured gas and set fire to their house made of light materials, which caused the fire to spread quickly.

text: Samtang nagadako ang kalayo, natumbahan naman sang refrigerator ang bayaw sang suspek kag sa malain nga palad wala na ini nakaluwas sa sunog.
english: As the fire grew, the refrigerator fell on the suspect's brother-in-law and unfortunately he did not survive the fire.

text: Nagpangayo ini sang kapatawaran sa Diyos kag sa iya pamilya kag handa sini nga bayran ang sala nga iya nahimo.
english: He asked God and his family for forgiveness and was willing to pay for the sin he had committed.

text: Nahibaluan nga nagtakas pa ang suspek matapos ang insidente apang nagdesisyon ini nga ma-surrender kahapon nga adlaw paagi kay Dr. Allen Camering, Law Enforcement Evaluation Officer II sang NAPOLCOM Region 6.
english: The suspect fled the scene after the incident but decided to surrender yesterday through Dr. Allen Camering, Law Enforcement Evaluation Officer II of NAPOLCOM Region 6.

text: Sa interview naman sang Bombo Radyo kay PCpt Marlon Perez, hepe sang Janiuay Municipal Police Station, ginatun-an pa sang pamilya kun magapasaka sila sang kaso batok sa suspek.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, PCpt Marlon Perez, chief of the Janiuay Municipal Police Station, said the family is still studying whether to file a case against the suspect.
