text: Ginlaslasan ni US President Donald Trump ang mga pungsod sa Europa nga nagapakatig-a nga mag-intra sa gyera sang Estados Unidos sang Amerika batok sa Iran.
english: US President Donald Trump has slammed European countries for insisting on joining the United States' war against Iran.

text: Espesyal nga namensyonar ni Trump ang United Kingdom sa iya post sa Truth Social.
english: Trump specifically mentioned the United Kingdom in his post on Truth Social.

text: May yara si Trump sang duha ka mga suhestyon sa mga indi mag-intra agud maguba ang Iran.
english: Trump has a couple of suggestions to those who won’t get involved to destroy Iran.

text: Una suno sa iya, mabakal na lang sila sa Estados Unidos bangud madamo man sila sang langis.
english: First, he said, they can only buy from the United States because they have a lot of oil.

text: Ikaduha suno pa kay Trump, mangisog na lang ini nga mga pungsod, magkadto sa Strait of Hormuz, kag magmato-mato kuha sang langis.
english: Second, Trump said, these countries should be brave, go to the Strait of Hormuz, and take oil.

text: “All of those countries that can’t get jet fuel because of the Strait of Hormuz, like the United Kingdom, which refused to get involved in the decapitation of Iran, I have a suggestion for you: Number 1, buy from the U.S., we have plenty, and Number 2, build up some delayed courage, go to the Strait, and just TAKE IT,” post sang US leader.
english: “All of those countries that can’t get jet fuel because of the Strait of Hormuz, like the United Kingdom, which refused to get involved in the decapitation of Iran, I have a suggestion for you: Number 1, buy from the U.S., we have plenty, and Number 2, build up some delayed courage, go to the Strait, and just post the USTA IT leader sang.

text: Suno pa kay Trump, dapat nga magtuon na lang sila sa pagbato para sa ila kaugalingon, bangud indi na magbulig sa ila ang Estados Unidos sang Amerika, bangud wala man gani sila ginabuligan.
english: Trump said they should learn to fight for themselves, because the United States of America will not help them, because they are not even helped.

text: “You’ll have to start learning how to fight for yourself, the U.S.A. won’t be there to help you anymore, just like you weren’t there for us.
english: “You’ll have to start learning how to fight for yourself, the U.S.A. won’t be there to help you anymore, just like you weren’t there for us.

text: Iran has been, essentially, decimated.
english: Iran has been, essentially, decimated.

text: The hard part is done.
english: The hard part is done.

text: Go get your own oil,” dugang niya.
english: Go get your own oil,” he added.

text: Matandaan nga antes sini, nasapubliko nga ginbalabagan sang French government ang Israeli planes nga magpalupad sang ila weapons sa airspace sang France.
english: It can be recalled that earlier, the French government publicly blocked Israeli planes from flying their weapons in French airspace.

text: Wala man naghatag sang permiso ang Italya sa US bombers nga makahugpa sa Sicily.
english: Italy also did not give permission to US bombers to land in Sicily.

text: Una naman nga nagbalibad ang Spain nga magamit sang US ang ila bases kag airspace para sa gyera.
english: Spain initially refused to allow the US to use its bases and airspace for war.

text: Sa pihak nga bahin, nagsugot naman ang UK nga gamiton sang US ang British bases kun mag-atake sila sa Iranian sites nga amo ang naga-puntariya sang Strait of Hormuz.
english: Meanwhile, the UK has agreed that the US will use British bases if they attack Iranian sites targeting the Strait of Hormuz.

text: Apisar sini, indi kuntento si Trump sa amo nga tikang.#
english: However, Trump is not satisfied with the move.

text: Ginselebrar sang Balay Pagbag-o sang Iloilo Provincial Government ang kadalag-an sang tatlo sa ila mga residente — duha ang naka-gradwar na sa Senior High School (SHS) samtang isa naman ang nakatapos sa Junior High School (JHS).
english: The Iloilo Provincial Government celebrated the success of three of its residents — two who graduated from Senior High School (SHS) while one graduated from Junior High School (JHS).

text: Ginpakigbahin sang provincial government ang mga laragway sang mga estudyante suksok ang ila toga samtang upod ang ila pamilya.
english: The provincial government shared pictures of students wearing their togas while with their families.

text: “The success of these graduates reflects the facility’s commitment to providing a supportive environment where transformation is possible.
english: “The success of these graduates reflects the facility’s commitment to providing a supportive environment where transformation is possible.

text: By fulfilling their educational requirements, these residents have demonstrated a clear resolve to reshape their futures and contribute positively to the community,” suno sa probinsya.
english: By fulfilling their educational requirements, these residents have demonstrated a clear resolve to reshape their futures and contribute positively to the community,” according to the province.

text: Nahibaluan nga kabahin ang edukasyon sa comprehensive intervention sang amo nga programa para sa Children in Conflict with the Law (CICL).
english: Education is part of the comprehensive intervention of the Children in Conflict with the Law (CICL) program.

text: Nakasanto man ini sa Bulig Eskwela sang Probinsya (BES Probins) thrust sang Iloilo Provincial Government.
english: This is also in line with the Bulig Eskwela sang Probinsya (BES Probins) thrust of the Iloilo Provincial Government.

text: “Balay Pagbag-o remains dedicated to its mission of guiding every resident toward a path of restoration, using education as a cornerstone for long-term success,” suno pa sa post sang probinsya.
english: “Balay Pagbag-o remains dedicated to its mission of guiding every resident toward a path of restoration, using education as a cornerstone for long-term success,” the province said in a post.

text: Ang Balay Pagbag-o nga kilala man bilang Bahay Pag-Asa amo ang nagahatag sang short-term residential care para sa lalaki nga CICL edad 15-17 anyos nga nagahulat pa sang desisyon sang korte ukon posible nga pagsaylo sa ila sa nagakaigu nga mga ahensya sang gobyerno.
english: Balay Pagbago also known as Bahay Pag-Asa provides short-term residential care for male CICL age 15-17 years old who are still awaiting court decisions or possible transfer to appropriate government agencies.

text: Nagatanyag ini nga pasilidad sang nanari-sari nga rehabilitation kag reintegration services para nga masuportahan ang development sang mga pamatan-on amo man ang ila nga ikaayo.
english: This facility offers a variety of rehabilitation and reintegration services to support the development of youth as well as their well-being.

text: Lakip sa sini nga suporta amo ang case management, family-centered support, homelife and health care, faith-based and values formation programs, educational and developmental services, livelihood and entrepreneurship training, psychosocial interventions, kag recreational and cultural activities.#
english: This support includes case management, family-centered support, homelife and health care, faith-based and values ​​formation programs, educational and developmental services, livelihood and entrepreneurship training, psychosocial interventions, and recreational and cultural activities.#

text: Magapatigayun sang all-senators caucus ang Senado sa Lunes, Pebrero 23, agud iplastar ang mga topiko nga posible mangin sentro sang diskusyon sa Chinese Embassy may kaangtanan sa tensyon sa West Philippine Sea (WPS), suno kay Senate President Pro Tempore Panfilo Lacson.
english: The Senate will hold an all-senators caucus on Monday, February 23, to lay out topics that are likely to be the focus of discussion at the Chinese Embassy regarding tensions in the West Philippine Sea (WPS), according to Senate President Pro Tempore Panfilo Lacson.

text: Ginlaragway ni Lacson ang pagbukas sang China sa dayalogo bilang “breath of fresh air” kag bilang kahigayunan agud mabuhinan ang mainit nga debate sa tunga sang mga senador kag opisyal sang China.
english: Lacson described China’s opening to dialogue as a “breath of fresh air” and as an opportunity to reduce the heated debate among Chinese senators and officials.

text: Ginpaathag niya nga indi tinutuyo sang amo nga pagsinapol nga istoryahan ang Kalayaan Island Group, kundi maghimo sang klaro nga komunikasyon agud malikawan ang gamo.
english: He explained that the purpose of the meeting was not to discuss the Kalayaan Island Group, but to make clear communication to avoid conflict.

text: Ginmensionar man ni Lacson nga handa siya nga bisitahun ang Pag-asa Island sa Kalayaan Island Group, nga amo ang nagaisahanon nga gina-istaran nga barangay sa isla.
english: Lacson also mentioned that he is ready to visit Pag-asa Island in the Kalayaan Island Group, which is the only inhabited barangay on the island.

text: Gindayaw niya ang pagpatindog sang high school sa isla bilang sabat sa kakulangan sa imprastruktura.
english: He praised the construction of the high school on the island as a response to the infrastructure deficit.

text: Suno kay Lacson, importante nga maprotektahan sang Pilipinas ang Pag-asa Island kag siguraduhon nga padayon nga magamit sang mga residente ang ila kinamatarung, lakip na ang pagboto kag pag-eskwela.
english: Lacson said it is important for the Philippines to protect Pag-asa Island and ensure that residents continue to exercise their rights, including voting and education.

text: Nagpasalig ang Department of Agriculture (DA) Western Visayas (WV)nga indi pa mabatyagan sa karun nga mga tinion ang kamahal sang mga nagapanguna nga mga balaklon sa merkado kadungan man sang nagatimbuok nga presyo sang produktong petrolyo.
english: The Department of Agriculture (DA) Western Visayas (WV) has assured that the high prices of basic commodities in the market will not be felt at this time along with the rising prices of petroleum products.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Maria Teresa Solis, Regional Technical Director for Operations and Extension, DA-WV, iya ginpahayag nga ang stock sa merkado sa karun ang gin-deliver pa sang nagliligad nga mga semana, rason nga indi pa mabatyagan ang pagsaka sang presyo sang mga balaklon sa merkado, ilabi na sa mga farm products pareho sang utan kag karne.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Maria Teresa Solis, Regional Technical Director for Operations and Extension, DA-WV, said the stock in the market was delivered in recent weeks, which is why the price increase in the market, especially in farm products such as vegetables and meat, is not yet felt.

text: Ginpaathag man ni Solis nga kun ma-deliver na subong nga semana ang panibag-o nga stock, magasaka sang halos 10% tubtub 20% ang ginapaabot nga pagsaka sang mga balaklon sa merkado.
english: Solis also explained that if the new stock is delivered this week, the expected increase in prices in the market will increase by almost 10% to 20%.

text: Nagpahanumdum man si Solis sa publiko nga magkinot sa paggamit sa gatong, amo man ang paggamit sang organic fertilizers sa mga mangunguma, agud indi ang mga ini matam-an sa gastos sa ila mga produkto.
english: Solis also reminded the public to save on fuel use, as well as the use of organic fertilizers to farmers, so that they do not have to pay too much for their products.

text: SO FAR, sunu sa media report sang The Inquirer, September 18, 2025, nga issue, ang Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH0 sa idalom na ni Secretary Vince Dizon nakabaton na sang mga 100 ka report parti sa ghost projects.
english: SO FAR, according to a media report of The Inquirer, September 18, 2025, issue, the Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH0) under Secretary Vince Dizon has received about 100 reports about ghost projects.

text: Natipon ining mga report sang DPWH in close coordination sa Independent Commission for Infrastructure (ICI) nga gintukod sang Presidente agud mag-imbestigar sang anomaliya sa flood control projects upod sa National Bureau of Investigation (NBI), Commission on Audit (COA) kag iban pa nga ahensya.
english: These reports were compiled by the DPWH in close coordination with the Independent Commission for Infrastructure (ICI) established by the President to investigate anomalies in flood control projects with the National Bureau of Investigation (NBI), Commission on Audit (COA) and other agencies.

text: Upod man dira gani ang media sa ila madamo nga investigative report.
english: The media is also included in their many investigative reports.

text: Samtang, sunu sa think tanks sang AI, naka-identify na ang COA sang mga 1,000 ka ghost projects sa mga 5,500 ka flood control projects nga natukod sa pungsod sugod sadtong 2022 pa.
english: Meanwhile, according to AI think tanks, the COA has identified about 1,000 ghost projects out of about 5,500 flood control projects established in the country since 2022.

text: Sunu man sa The Inquirer, naka-file na ang COA kag DPWH sa idalom ni Sec.
english: According to The Inquirer, the COA and DPWH have already filed under Sec.

text: Dizon sang at least apat (4) ka Fraud Report sa Ombudsman, ang prosecution arm sang gobyerno, angot sa ghost projects sa idalom sang DPWH Bulacan 1st District Engineering Office.
english: Dizon of at least four (4) Fraud Reports to the Ombudsman, the prosecution arm of the government, regarding ghost projects under the DPWH Bulacan 1st District Engineering Office.

text: Gamit ining Fraud Report, nga ginaupdan sang gapamatuod nga ebidensya, pwede na ma-submit ini sang investigating body, katulad sangCOA, sa Ombudsman nga maka-rekomendar agud mapasaka na ang kaso sa Sandiganbayan.
english: Using this Fraud Report, accompanied by supporting evidence, the investigating body, such as the COA, can submit it to the Ombudsman who can recommend that the case be filed with the Sandiganbayan.

text: Samtang, ang Senate Blue Ribbon Committee wala pa batia kon bala nakahanda na sila mag-file sang bisan isa lang ka Fraud Report sa Ombudsman, nga pwede man nila mahimo luwas sa paggamit sang ila imbestigasyon agud makapasar sing kasuguan angot diri.
english: Meanwhile, the Senate Blue Ribbon Committee has yet to hear whether they are prepared to file at least one Fraud Report with the Ombudsman, which they could also do in addition to using their investigation to pass legislation on the matter.

text: Gakumod na gani ang madamo kon ngaa kadugay gid sang Blue Ribbon Committee sa paghimo sang ila Fraud Report agud mapasaka na sa Ombudsman, samtang mahimo man gani ini sang COA kag DPWH.
english: Many are even joking why the Blue Ribbon Committee is taking so long to prepare their Fraud Report to be submitted to the Ombudsman, while the COA and DPWH can do the same.

text: Suspetso gani sang iban nga daw ginahungod gid sang pila dira sa Senado nga labugayon anay ang imbestigasyon sang Blue Ribbon nga daw may ginahinakpan sila.
english: Some even suspect that some in the Senate are trying to delay the Blue Ribbon investigation as if they have something to hide.

text: Nga daan daw may apat  dira – si Chiz, si Joel, si Mark kag si Raffy (nga wala labot Si Aida, si Lorna, o Si Fe” sa kanta ni Marco Sison) – nga nadala man sa mga suspetsado.
english: It seems that there are four of them – Chiz, Joel, Mark and Raffy (not including Aida, Lorna, or Fe” in Marco Sison's song) – who are also involved in the suspects.

text: Daw amo man gani ang ginahimo sang Kamara, labi na gid kay madamo gid dira sa ila ang suspetsado sa natabo nga ghost projects sa ila mga distrito.
english: It seems that the House of Representatives is doing the same, especially since many of them are suspected of ghost projects in their districts.

text: Sa kadugay sang ila imbestigasyon, nagsuspetso na gani ang mga lideres sang mga nagareklamo nga wala gid man seguro maaputan ining ila imbestigasyon, nga nagdabok pa sa ila pagmartsa kag ginahod sa mga dalanon.
english: During the course of their investigation, the leaders of the complainants even suspected that their investigation might not have been successful, which led to their march and shouting in the streets.

text: Sunu sa aton abyan nga si Pedro, ang Senate investigation isa lang ka Fact-Finding agud makatipon sang ebidensya nga maka-establisar sang Probable Cause, nga kon ma-verify sang Ombudsman, pwede na makapasaka sang kaso sa Sandiganayan, ang korte nga gaaksyon sa mga akusasyon batok sa mga public officials, lakip na ang mga pribado nga mga persona nga nangin kahimbon man sang mga akusado nga public officials.
english: According to our friend Pedro, the Senate investigation is just a Fact-Finding to gather evidence to establish Probable Cause, which if verified by the Ombudsman, can be filed in the Sandiganayan, the court that acts on accusations against public officials, including private persons who have become public accused officials.

text: Kag tungod nga Fact-Finding lang ini, sa paathag ni Pedro, ang importante lang diri ang mga ebidensya nga makatudlo sa kon ano gid ang kasal-anan nga nahimo kag kon sin-o ang may kahilabtanan diri, indi kay kon sin-o ang kampyon sa debate.
english: And since this is Fact-Finding, Pedro explained, the only thing that matters is the evidence that can point to what the crime was and who was involved, not who is the champion in the debate.

text: Tuod no?
english: True no?

text: Katulad sang ginhimo sang COA kag DPWH sa idalom ni Sec.
english: As the COA and DPWH did under Sec.

text: Dizon sa pag-estalbisar sang kon ano gid ang nahimo nga kasal-anan kag kon sin-o ang may kahilabtanan dira, kag gani nakapadala na sila sang Fraud Report sa Ombudsman.
english: Dizon to establish what exactly was committed and who was involved, and so they have already sent a Fraud Report to the Ombudsman.

text: Sandig sa pagkilala sa ghost project sang COA, ang ghost project either: (1) Wala gid natukod, (2) Misreported as “Completed”, ukon (3) Kulang sa veritable physical accomplishment nga gasantu (match) sa aktwal nga kagastuhan angot dira.
english: Based on the COA's definition of a ghost project, a ghost project is either: (1) Never established, (2) Misreported as “Completed”, or (3) Lacks a veritable physical accomplishment that matches the actual costs associated with it.

text: In other words, kon mapamatud-an nga wala gid man nasuguran man lang ang proyekto sa inspeksyon, ghost project ina.
english: In other words, if it is proven that the project did not start at all during the inspection, it is a ghost project.

text: Kon misreported nga “Completed”, apang poste pa lang, por ejemplo, ang nagatindug, ghost project ina.
english: If it is misreported as “Completed”, but only a pole, for example, is standing, it is a ghost project.

text: Kag kon ang mga dokumento kag verification gapakita nga may discrepancy, labi na gid kon lapaw sa “allowable”, sa physical accomplishment ang aktwal nga gingasto, katulad abi nga kon ang bagay nga galastuhon 100 ka milyon apang nadiskubrihan sa verification mga 50 lang ka milyon ka pesos ang gingasto sa aktwal, ukon sa 150 ka milyon tungod “bloated” ang pagpa-presyo sa project, ghost project man ina.
english: And if the documents and verification show that there is a discrepancy, especially if it exceeds the “allowable”, in the physical accomplishment is actually spent, for example if the thing to be spent 100 million but discovered in the verification only about 50 million pesos was spent in actual, or 150 million because of the “bloated” pricing project, ghost project man ina.

text: Kag, sa bahin kon sin-o ang may kahilabtanan, nga matindugan ini sang masaligan nga mga testigo “under oath”, labi na gid sang isa ka whistleblower ukon insider witness.
english: And, in terms of who is involved, that it can be established by reliable witnesses “under oath”, preferably a whistleblower or insider witness.

text: In fact, si Senador Joel Villanueva, nga isa sa mga suspetsado, ang naghingyo na nga ipasaka ang iya kaso sa korte sa iya kataka sa daw wala na katapusan nga pagbinaisay sa Blue Ribbon Committee.
english: In fact, Senator Joel Villanueva, one of the suspects, has already asked for his case to be filed in court in his frustration with the seemingly endless dispute with the Blue Ribbon Committee.

english: That, indeed, does not need to be argued!/PN

text: Ginpahangop ni Pope Leo XIV sa atubang sang mga tumuluo nga Katoliko nga ginasikway sang Ginuo ang mga pangamuyo sang mga lider nga naga-umpisa sang gyera.
english: Pope Leo XIV made it clear in front of the Catholic faithful that the Lord rejects the prayers of leaders who start wars.

text: Ini ang sentro sang misa sang Santo Papa kadungan sang Domingo de Ramos ukon Palm Sunday sa St.
english: It is the center of the Pope's mass on Palm Sunday at St.

text: Peter’s Square sa Vatican.
english: Peter’s Square in the Vatican.

text: “This is our God: Jesus, King of Peace, who rejects war, whom no one can use to justify war,” suno kay Pope Leo nga amo ang una nga Santo Papa halin sa Estados Unidos sang Amerika.
english: “This is our God: Jesus, King of Peace, who rejects war, whom no one can use to justify war,” said Pope Leo, the first Pope from the United States of America.

text: Sa misa, gintawag man sang Santo Papa ang gyera sa Middle East nga malaot.
english: During the mass, the Pope also called the war in the Middle East evil.

text: Ginbalikan man sang US Pope nga si Hesukristo amo ang Hari sang Kalinong kag ginasikway sini ang gyera.
english: The US Pope also reiterated that Jesus Christ is the King of Peace and rejects war.

text: “[Jesus] does not listen to the prayers of those who wage war, but rejects them, saying: ‘Even though you make many prayers, I will not listen: your hands are full of blood’,” pahayag sini samtang ginagamit ang Bible passage.
english: “[Jesus] does not listen to the prayers of those who wage war, but rejects them, saying: ‘Even though you make many prayers, I will not listen: your hands are full of blood’,” it said, using the Bible passage.

text: “[Jesus] did not arm himself, or defend himself, or fight any war,” suno pa sa iya.
english: “[Jesus] did not arm himself, or defend himself, or fight any war,” he added.

text: “He revealed the gentle face of God, who always rejects violence.
english: “He revealed the gentle face of God, who always rejects violence.

text:
Rather than saving himself, he allowed himself to be nailed to the cross.”

Wala sang ginhingadlan si Pope Leo kun sin-o nga world leaders ang iya buot-hambalon.
english:
Rather than saving himself, he allowed himself to be nailed to the cross.”

Pope Leo did not name which world leaders he meant.

text: Apang talalupangdon nga sa kada semana sa sulod na sang isa ka bulan nga gyera, nagapanawagan ini sang ceasefire sa Iran.
english: But it is noteworthy that every week during the month-long war, it calls for a ceasefire with Iran.

text: Gintawag man sini anay ang pagpang-atake sang militar nga “indiscriminate” kag dapat na nga untatan.
english: He also called the military's attacks “indiscriminate” and should be stopped.

text: Matandaan nga antes ini nga statement ni Pope Leo, may mga opisyal sa Estados Unidos sang Amerika nga naghiwat pa sang Christian prayer services sa Pentagon.
english: It can be recalled that before this statement of Pope Leo, there were officials in the United States of America who held Christian prayer services at the Pentagon.

text: Nanguna si Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth sa amo nga pagpangamuyo kun sa diin gingamit pa sini ang relihiyon agud nga pangapinan ang gyera sini kontra sa Iran.#
english: Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth led the prayer where he used religion to defend his war against Iran.

text: Sa National Basketball Association, ginpangunahan ni Kevin Durant ang Houston Rockets sa paglutos sa Charlotte Hornets.
english: In the National Basketball Association, Kevin Durant led the Houston Rockets to a win over the Charlotte Hornets.

text: Ini matapos ang iya duha ka free throws sa nabilin nga 3.2 seconds para makumpleto sini ang 35 points.
english: This was after he made two free throws with 3.2 seconds left to complete the 35 points.

text: Nagtakop ang hampang sa skor nga 105-101.
english: The game ended with a score of 105-101.

text: Samtang, ginpangunahan naman ni Grant Williams ang Hornets nga may ara sang 20 points.
english: Meanwhile, Grant Williams led the Hornets with 20 points.

text: Ang Hornets nga nagdaog sang 11 sa 12 sini nga hampang bag-o ang All Star break, nagpakita sang ila abilidad sa umpisa kag nakakuha sang 11 ka puntos nga abanse sa una nga bahin sang second quarter.
english: The Hornets, who won 11 of 12 this game before the All Star break, showed their ability early on and built an 11-point lead early in the second quarter.

text: Naglagas naman ang Rockets sa ika-apat nga quarter sang ginhimo ni Alperen Sengun ang spinning reverse batok sa 7-foot center nga si Ryan Kalkbrenner kag ginsunod naman sini ang baby hook shot agud makuha sang Houston ang pinakadako nga abanse sa score.
english: The Rockets chased in the fourth quarter when Alperen Sengun made a spinning reverse against 7-foot center Ryan Kalkbrenner and followed it up with a baby hook shot to give Houston its biggest lead in the score.

text: Gin-engganyo ni World no.
english: Encouraged by World no.

text: 4 Coco Gauff ang Filipino fans nga padayunon ang pagsuporta kay Alex Eala nga suno sa iya nagdala sang bag-o nga “demographic” sa tennis.
english: 4 Coco Gauff urged Filipino fans to continue supporting Alex Eala who she said brought a new demographic to tennis.

text: Kabahin ini sang sabat sang two-time Grand Slam Champion sa interview sa Women’s Tennis Association (WTA) matapos ginlutos si Eala sa quarterfinal round sang Dubai tennis championships, 6-2, 6-0.
english: This was part of the two-time Grand Slam Champion’s response in an interview with the Women’s Tennis Association (WTA) after beating Eala in the quarterfinal round of the Dubai tennis championships, 6-2, 6-0.

text: Gintawag man ni Gauff ang audience nga “home crowd” bangud sa tuman ka damo nga mga Pilipino nga nagsuporta sa world no.
english: Gauff also called the audience a “home crowd” because of the large number of Filipinos who supported the world no.

text: 47 — nga kaangay man sa natabo sa nauna nga mga hampang sini indi lamang sa Dubai kundi mangin sa Australian Open kag sa iban pa nga pungsod.
english: 47 — which is similar to what happened in its previous matches not only in Dubai but also in the Australian Open and other countries.

text: “I’d like to thank Alex for bringing a new demographic to the sport.
english: “I’d like to thank Alex for bringing a new demographic to the sport.

text: I really appreciate.
english: I really appreciate it.

text: I think it’s great.
english: I think it’s great.

text: I know sometimes, it’s tough when you are playing against a home crowd, but I think that it’s great for the sports so keep being enthusiastic and keep rooting for your player,” mensahe ni Gauff pagkatapos sang hampang nga ginpalakpakan naman sang Filipino fans.
english: I know sometimes, it’s tough when you are playing against a home crowd, but I think that it’s great for the sports so keep being enthusiastic and keep rooting for your player,” Gauff said after the game which was applauded by the Filipino fans.

text: “Alex is a tough competitor and even when I was up, I knew that she could come back at any given moment.
english: “Alex is a tough competitor and even when I was up, I knew that she could come back at any given moment.

text: I’ve seen her do it before so thank you guys for coming out here,” kabahin pa sang iya post-match interview.
english: I’ve seen her do it before so thank you guys for coming out here,” he said in his post-match interview.

text: Antes ang ila pag-atubangay ni Alex sa quarterfinal clash subong nga gab-i, nag-viral man video ni Gauff nga nag-sorry sa audience sa Dubai bangud naglawig ang iya hampang kag nadugayan sila sa paghulat sa Pinay tennis star.
english: Before their face-off with Alex in the quarterfinal clash tonight, a video of Gauff apologizing to the audience in Dubai for taking too long and waiting for the Pinay tennis star also went viral.

text: Nagpasalamat man ini sa Filipino tennis fans nga nagpalakpak kag nag-cheer para sa iya samtang wala pa si Alex sa court.
english: He also thanked the Filipino tennis fans who clapped and cheered for him while Alex was not on the court.

text: Abante na si Gauff sa semifinals kun sa diin posible nga atubangon sini si world no.
english: Gauff is advancing to the semifinals where he is likely to face world no.

text: 67 Antonia Ruzic ukon si world No.
english: 67 Antonia Ruzic or world No.

text: 9 Elina Svitolina.
english: 9 Elina Svitolina.

text: Ang Dubai Tennis Championships amo naman ang ikaanum nga tournament ni Eala subong nga tuig.#
english: The Dubai Tennis Championships is Eala's sixth tournament this year.

text: Ginpuno sang mga manugprotesta ang mga dalanon sa 50 ka mga estado sa Estados Unidos sang Amerika agud nga isikway ang pila sa mga polisa ni US President Donald Trump.
english: Protesters filled the streets in 50 states in the United States of America to reject some of the policies of US President Donald Trump.

text: 3,300 ka separado nga mga rally ang ginhimo sa lain-lain nga mga state.
english: 3,300 separate rallies were held in different states.

text: Gintawag ini nga “No Kings” Protest ukon ang movement nga ginahimo sa malinong nga paagi agud nga pamatukan ang mga authoritarian rulers sa White House.
english: It was called the “No Kings” Protest or the movement that is done in a peaceful way to oppose the authoritarian rulers in the White House.

text: Suno sa event organizers, masobra sa walo ka milyon nga mga tawo ang nagkadto sa ikatatlo na nga hugnat sang amo nga protesta.
english: According to event organizers, more than eight million people attended the third round of the protest.

text: Lakip sa ila ginsinggitan nga pamatukan nga mga polisa amo ang gyera sa Iran, ang immigration enforcement, kag ang mataas naman nga mga galastuhan sa palangabuhian.
english: Among the policies they shouted against were the war with Iran, immigration enforcement, and the high cost of living.

text: Kaangay sa nauna nga mga hugnat sini nga rally, nagdala ang mga protesters sang effigies nanday Trump, Vice President JD Vance, kag iban pa nga mga opisyal sa Trump administration.
english: As in earlier rounds of this rally, protesters carried effigies of Trump, Vice President JD Vance, and other officials in the Trump administration.

text: Ginpanawagan nila nga kakason sila sa pwesto.
english: They called for their removal from office.

text: Isa sa flagship “No Kings” protests natabo sa Minnesota kun sa diin ginpatay anay sang federal immigration agents ang duha ka American citizens nga sanday Renee Nicole Good kag Alex Pretti sang Enero.#
english: One of the flagship “No Kings” protests took place in Minnesota where federal immigration agents killed two American citizens, Renee Nicole Good and Alex Pretti, in January.

text: Indi lang sa pageant stage sarang mabantayan sang fans si Miss Universe 2018 Catriona Gray, kundi mangin sa silver screen!
english: Fans can watch Miss Universe 2018 Catriona Gray not only on the pageant stage, but also on the silver screen!

text: Kabahin si Catriona sang romantic film nga “The Loved One” nga amo man ang reunion film nanday Anne Curtis kag Jericho Rosales.
english: Catriona is part of the romantic film “The Loved One” which is also the reunion film of Anne Curtis and Jericho Rosales.

text: Ini ang acting debut sang beauty queen, apang antes sini, wala-tuo man ang iya nga television appearances bangud sa modelling, pageantry journey, kag hosting experiences.
english: This is the acting debut of the beauty queen, but before that, her television appearances were also limited due to modeling, pageantry journey, and hosting experiences.

text: Ang “The Loved One” nga malantaw sa Philippine cinemas sa Pebrero 11 ang sa idalom sang direksyon ni Irene Villamor.
english: “The Loved One” which will be released in Philippine cinemas on February 11 is directed by Irene Villamor.

text: Ini ang una nga pelikula nanday Anne kag Jericho halin sang nag-updanay sila sa 2008 Metro Manila Film Festival entry nga “Baler” kag sa 2011 series nga si “Green Rose.”
english: This is Anne and Jericho’s first film since they worked together in the 2008 Metro Manila Film Festival entry “Baler” and the 2011 series “Green Rose.”

text: Ginakonsiderar sang Department of Agriculture (DA) ang pagbutang sang price cap ukon maximum price sa bugas bangud sang epekto sang gyera sa Middle East sa presyuhanay sang produktong petrolyo.
english: The Department of Agriculture (DA) is considering imposing a price cap or maximum price on rice due to the impact of the war in the Middle East on the price of petroleum products.

text: Suno kay Agriculture Secretary Francisco Tiu Laurel, Jr., diskusyunan sang ahensya ang implementasyon sini una sa imported rice antes posible isunod ang local rice.
english: Agriculture Secretary Francisco Tiu Laurel, Jr. said the agency will discuss its implementation first with imported rice before possibly following local rice.

text: Pahayag sang tiglikom, ginalantaw sang DA nga may ceiling ukon indi dapat maglapaw sa P50 per kilo ang baligyaanay sang well-milled rice.
english: The secretary said the DA envisages a ceiling or should not exceed P50 per kilo for the sale of well-milled rice.

text: “Pag-aaralan namin moving forward kung pwede ba mag-impose ng price cap sa sitwasyon ngayon para di mapektuhan ang palay,” suno kay Laurel.
english: “We will study moving forward whether it is possible to impose a price cap in the current situation so that the rice will not be affected,” Laurel said.

text: Ginpaathag sini nga nagsaka ang presyo sang bugas sa nagligad nga binulan bangud sa manubo nga suplay kag bangud sa import ban nga ginpatuman anay.
english: He explained that the price of rice rose in the past month due to low supply and due to the import ban that was implemented earlier.

text: Apang bangud nagsugod na ang harvest season, ginalantaw suno sa iya nga maga-estable na liwat ang presyo.
english: However, since the harvest season has started, he said, the price is expected to stabilize again.

text: “Luckily, naman ang kasagsagan ng ating harvest season is starting today actually up to hanggang end of April.
english: “Luckily, the harvest season is starting today actually up to the end of April.

text: Marami tayo harvest.
english: We have a lot of harvest.

text: So there’s a chance ma temper rises in prices at baka may chance pa bumaba ng konti,” dugang niya.
english: So there's a chance to temper rises in prices and maybe there's a chance to go down a little bit,” he added.

text: Nakalab-ot naman sa ahensya ang reports nga may retailers sang imported rice nga nagamato-mato sa pagpasaka sang presyo nga nagalab-ot na sa P60 kada kilo.
english: The agency has received reports that some retailers of imported rice are reluctant to raise the price to P60 per kilo.

text: “Kung hindi tumino mga importer dyan sa Cebu at mataas pa rin benta nila, gagawin ko na lang kami na lang magbebenta sa Cebu, kami na mag iimport, kami na magbebenta.
english: “If the importers in Cebu don't stop and their sales are still high, I'll just make us sell in Cebu, we'll import, we'll sell.

text: Yung mga importer doon, wala na sila ibebenta,” suno sa tiglikom.
english: The importers there, they will not sell,” the secretary said.

text: Dapat suno sa iya nga yara lang ini sa P48 tubtub P50 per kilo.
english: He said it should be at P48 to P50 per kilo.

text: Magluwas diri, may reports man nga may traders nga gina-repack ang imported rice kag ginabutang sa sako nga may label nga local rice agud nga may rason sila sa mataas nga presyo.
english: Besides, there are also reports that some traders are repacking the imported rice and putting it in sacks labeled local rice so that they have a reason for the high price.

text: “May profiteering angle kami nakikita ngayon.
english: “We see a profiteering angle now.

text: At kailangan, iyon na nga, iyong pakiusap ko sa ating mga mamimili kung imported rice ‘yan, huwag kayong papayag na gano’n kataas iyong presyo.
english: And necessary, that's it, I ask our consumers if it's imported rice, don't agree that the price is so high.

text: At subukan ninyong tawaran dahil this is not the time for profiteering,” suno pa sa agriculture chief.
english: And try to bargain because this is not the time for profiteering,” the agriculture chief said.

text: Nagaplano ang DA nga mag-conduct sang mas masangkad nga market inspections sa bulig sang law enforcement kag regulatory agencies agud matapna ini nga mga buluhaton sang iban.#
english: The DA plans to conduct more extensive market inspections with the assistance of law enforcement and regulatory agencies to prevent these activities by others.

text: Nagapanikasog na ang Department of Health (DOH) matapos nga naka-record sang 6,703 ka kaso sang Human Immunodeficiency Virus (HIV) halin Enero tubtob Abril 2025.
english: The Department of Health (DOH) is already making efforts after recording 6,703 cases of Human Immunodeficiency Virus (HIV) from January to April 2025.

text: Ini nagaangut sang average nga 56 ka bag-o nga kaso kada adlaw sa una nga apat ka bulan sang tuig — 44% ini nga mas mataas kumpara sa amo man nga panahon sang 2024.
english: This correlates to an average of 56 new cases per day in the first four months of the year — this is 44% higher compared to the same period in 2024.

text: Ang kadam-an sa mga bag-o nga kaso amo ang mga pumuluyo nga naga-edad 15 tubtob 25 anyos, nga may 500% nga pagtaas.
english: The majority of new cases are residents between the ages of 15 and 25 years old, with a 500% increase.

text: Lakip man sa mga na-diagnose ang isa ka 12-anyos nga kabataan halin Palawan, nga naimpeksyon bangud sang pakighilawas.
english: Among those diagnosed was a 12-year-old child from Palawan, who was infected through sexual intercourse.

text: Suno kay Health Secretary Teodoro Herbosa, ang Pilipinas subong may pinakamadamo nga bag-o nga kaso sang HIV sa Western Pacific region.
english: According to Health Secretary Teodoro Herbosa, the Philippines now has the highest number of new HIV cases in the Western Pacific region.

text: Gani, ginpanawagan sang DOH kay President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.
english: Therefore, the DOH called on President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.

text: nga magdeklara sang national public health emergency batok sa HIV.
english: to declare a national public health emergency against HIV.

text: Ang proposal halin sa Philippine National AIDS Council, nga amo ang ahensya nga naga-atipan sang pagpugong kag kontrol sang HIV kag AIDS sa pungsod.
english: The proposal is from the Philippine National AIDS Council, which is the agency in charge of HIV and AIDS prevention and control in the country.

text: Suno kay Herbosa, dapat tani nga may pagtipon ang gabinete parte sini, apang masami napostpone tungod sang iban pa nga isyu.
english: According to Herbosa, the cabinet should have held a meeting on the matter, but it was often postponed due to other issues.

text: Bisan pa sini, nagapadayon ang DOH sa pagpreparar sang programa sa sulod sang anum ka bulan agud masabat ang padayon nga pagsaka sang kaso sang HIV.
english: However, the DOH continues to prepare a six-month program to address the continuous increase in HIV cases.

text: Sa kabug-usan, may 150,433 ka tawo nga nagakabuhi upod sa HIV (PLHIV) sa Pilipinas sang Abril 2025.
english: Overall, there are 150,433 people living with HIV (PLHIV) in the Philippines as of April 2025.

text: Ang kadam-an sang PLHIV subong yara sa mas bata nga age group — 50% naga-edad 25 tubtob 34 anyos.
english: The majority of PLHIV today are in the younger age group — 50% are aged 25 to 34 years old.

text: Sang 2002 tubtob 2005, ang 44% sang PLHIV yara sa 35-49 anyos nga age group.
english: In 2002 to 2005, 44% of PLHIV were in the 35–49 years age group.

text: Gintumod ni Herbosa ang pagdamo sang “risky behavior” pareho sang pakighilawas sa indi kilala nga tawo, indi protektado nga pakighilawas, kag ang epekto sang dating apps kag madali nga pag-access sang pornograpiya — nga nagadugang sa paglapta sang virus.
english: Herbosa cited the increase in “risky behavior” such as having sex with another person, unprotected sex, and the impact of dating apps and easy access to pornography — adding to the spread of the virus.

text: Suno sa DOH, sexual transmission gihapon ang nagapanguna nga rason sang paglapta sang virus.
english: According to the DOH, sexual transmission is still the main cause of the spread of the virus.

text: Mga 83% sang mga kaso halin 1984 amo ang mga lalaki nga may pakighilawas sa kapareho nga lalaki.
english: About 83% of cases since 1984 have been in men who have had sex with men.

text: May isa ka mag-asawa sa Guangdong province sa China nga nangin popular bangud pareho ang ila itsura.
english: There was a couple in Guangdong province in China who became popular because they look alike.

text: Suno pa sa iban, posible nga mag-utod kag nagseparar lang sang una.
english: According to others, it is possible that they are brothers and just separated in the past.

text: Ini amo sanday Liang Caiyu kag He Xiansheng, nagaedad sang masobra 20-anyos.
english: They are Liang Caiyu and He Xiansheng, aged over 20-years-old.

text: Nagadumala ang mga ini sang isa ka herbal medicine shop sa Dongguan, Guangdong province.
english: They run an herbal medicine shop in Dongguan, Guangdong province.

text: Sang una, mabudlay para sa ila ang nasambit nga negosyo, apang sang ulihi, gin-gamit nila ang pagkapareho sang ila mga itsura rason nga nagsanyog ang ila shop kag mas nakilala sila nga duwa.
english: At first, the business was difficult for them, but later, they used the similarity of their appearances so that their shop flourished and they became better known.

text: Kumpiyansa si Manila Rep.
english: Manila Rep.

text: Bienvenido Abante nga makakuha sang husto nga boto ang House of Representatives agud mapadala sa Senado ang impeachment complaint batok kay Vice President Sara Duterte, bisan pa may mga bag-o nga petisyon batok sa iya.
english: Bienvenido Abante said the House of Representatives will get the right vote to send the impeachment complaint against Vice President Sara Duterte to the Senate, despite new petitions against her.

text: Suno kay Abante, indi kinahanglan sang dako nga boto kay husto na ang one-third (1/3) sang mga miyembro sang Kamara para mapasar ang kaso kag masuguran ang impeachment trial sa Senado.
english: According to Abante, a large vote is not needed because one-third (1/3) of the members of the House is enough to pass the case and start the impeachment trial in the Senate.

text: Sa karon, apat na nga impeachment complaints ang na-file batok kay Duterte.
english: So far, four impeachment complaints have been filed against Duterte.

text: Isa na diri ang ika-apat nga gin-file ni Atty. Nathaniel Cabrera kag ginsuportahan nanday Deputy Speaker Paolo Ortega V kag Abante, nga may kaangtanan sa pagpahog ni Duterte sa kabuhi ni President Marcos, misuse of confidential funds, kag iban pa.
english: One of these is the fourth filed by Atty. Nathaniel Cabrera and supported by Deputy Speaker Paolo Ortega V and Abante, related to Duterte’s threat to the life of President Marcos, misuse of confidential funds, and others.

text: Matandaan nga na-impeach na si Duterte sang Kamara sang Pebrero 5, 2025, apang wala ini nagpadayon sa Senado kag ginbasura sang Korte Suprema.
english: Duterte was impeached by the House of Representatives on February 5, 2025, but it did not proceed to the Senate and was rejected by the Supreme Court.

text: MADAMO ang luyag maghalintulad sang 1986 Edsa People Power Revolution sa ginhiwat nga  People Power sa mga pungsod sang Nepal kag Indonesia.
english: MANY want to compare the 1986 Edsa People Power Revolution to the People Power held in Nepal and Indonesia.

text: Daku ugaling ang pagkatuhay sang Edsa sa ginhiwat nga People Power didto sa Nepal kag Indonesia, although pareho nga gingamit diri ang ultimate nga gahom sang mga pumuluyo bilang Supreme Sovereign, nga  labaw kag labi pa sa gahom sang gobyerno nga ginatugyanan lang sang mga pumuluyo agud magtrabaho para sa ila kaayuhan.
english: Edsa, however, is very different from the People Power held in Nepal and Indonesia, although both used the ultimate power of the people as Supreme Sovereign, which is above and beyond the power of the government that the people entrust to work for their good.

text: Isa ato ka prayer rally kag nonviolent nga mass-up sa Edsa Road sa Quezon City sang mga pumuluyo nga nakatipon sa sulod sang apat ka adlaw (Pebrero 22-25, 1986) sang mga duha ka milyon ka pumuluyo agud iduso ang protesta batok sa peke nga pagdaug ni anay Presidente, turned Dictator, Ferdinand Marcos Sr.
english: It was a prayer rally and nonviolent mass-up on Edsa Road in Quezon City by the people who gathered for four days (February 22-25, 1986) about two million people to protest against the fake victory of former President, turned Dictator, Ferdinand Marcos Sr.

text: sa Pebrero 7,1986 nga Snap Election nga ginmanipular sang Marcos-controlled Comelec.
english: in the February 7,1986 Snap Election manipulated by the Marcos-controlled Comelec.

text: Taliwas ato sa tally sang NAMFREL, nga sa madugay nga tinuig ginsaligan sang mga pumuluyo agud magpagwa sang honest result sa eleksyon.
english: That's contrary to the tally of NAMFREL, which for many years has been trusted by the people to produce honest results in elections.

text: Ang isip sang balota sang NAMFREL nagpakita sang pag-abanse ni Cory Aquino sing mga 800,000 ka boto batok kay Marcos.
english: The NAMFREL ballot count showed Cory Aquino leading by about 800,000 votes over Marcos.

text: Gn-updan ining non-violent rally sang nagakalain-lain nga mga sektor sang  sosyedad – sang mga estudyante, propesyonal, mga tigbatas kag mga obrero,  kag mga religioso sa pagpanguna ni Catholic Cardinal Sin – sa ila man pagpati sa kamatuoran sang pagdaug ni Cory sa Snap Election.
english: This non-violent rally was joined by various sectors of society – students, professionals, lawyers and workers, and religious led by Catholic Cardinal Sin – in their belief in the truth of Cory's victory in the Snap Election.

text: Tubtub napapati man sang grupo ang armadong kusog (military) nga si Cory gid ang nagdaug, nga dayon nangamot agud palayason si Marcos kag iya pamilya, nga natabo sadtong Pebrero 26 sang magpalagyo na sila sa Hawaii.
english: The group even convinced the military that Cory had won, which then took root to expel Marcos and his family, which happened on February 26 when they fled to Hawaii.

text:
***

On the other hand, liwan ang natabo sa paghiwat sang  People Power sa Nepal kag Indonesia, nga ginpangunahan sang mga pamatan-on (Gen Z generation) didto.
english:
***

On the other hand, the same thing happened in the holding of People Power in Nepal and Indonesia, which was led by the youth (Gen Z generation) there.

text: Sa panugod pa lang nangin magamo na ang ila ginhiwat nga mga march-rally batok sa gobyerno sa isyu sang kapiut sang pangabuhi, korapsyon sa gobyerno, kag pag-ipit sang kahilwayan sa komunikasyon (ban of social media sa Nepal) sang mga pumuluyo.
english: From the very beginning, their march-rally against the government on the issue of poverty, government corruption, and restrictions on freedom of communication (ban of social media in Nepal) of the people became chaotic.

text: Madamo ang nasaktan kag nagkalamatay samtang ginpanunog sang mga nagaprotesta ang mga government building, mga salakyan kag mga puluy-an sang mga opisyales sang gobyerno.
english: Many were injured and killed as protesters set fire to government buildings, vehicles and homes of government officials.

text: Ang masakit pa kay samtang ginasunog ang puluy-an sang Prime Minister sang Nepal, nadakpan nila ang asawa sini kag ginpulihan sakit nga wala na sing kabuhi sang gindul-ong sa ospital.
english: To make matters worse, while burning the home of the Prime Minister of Nepal, they captured his wife and replaced her with a disease that died when she was taken to hospital.

text: Madasig nga nagdaug ang mga nagaprotesta sa Nepal kag natukod dayon ang interim nga gobyerno sa pagpanguna sang retirado nga Chief Justice.
english: The protesters in Nepal quickly won and an interim government was formed under the leadership of the retired Chief Justice.

text: Maabtik naman naka-react ang gobyerno sang Presidente sang Indonesia kag nag-imponer sang crackdown sa mga nagaprotesta.
english: The Indonesian presidential government reacted quickly and imposed a crackdown on the protesters.

text: Ginlupot sa prisuhan ang mga nadakpan.
english: Those arrested were thrown into jail.

text: Meantime, at presstime, nagkalma anay ang pagprotesta tungod sining crackdown kag samtang ginpatuman ang  pila ka reporma nga ginapangayo sang mga nagaprotesta.
english: Meantime, at presstime, the protests calmed down due to this crackdown and while some of the reforms demanded by the protesters were implemented.

text: Samtang sa Metro Manila nag-protest rally man ang mga studyante sang UP kag pila ka grupo nga nagapanawagan sang maabtik nga aksyon agud pasabton ang mga na-involve sa anomaliya – mga opiyales sang DPWH, mga contractor, kag mga kongresista nga may palpak nga flood control project sa ila distrito, lakip na ang pila ka senador.
english: Meanwhile, in Metro Manila, UP students and several groups also held a protest rally calling for swift action to hold accountable those involved in the anomaly – DPWH officials, contractors, and congressmen who had a failed flood control project in their district, including several senators.

text: Well, si Presidente Marcos Jr.
english: Well, President Marcos Jr.

text: mismo ang nag-ungkat sang problema nga ini  sa iya SONA sadtong Hulyo 28 kag nagmando sang imbestigasyon sang isa ka masaligan nga Independent Body nga posible pangunahan ni retirado nga police officer kag Baguio City Mayor Benjamin Magalong.
english: himself raised the problem in his SONA on July 28 and ordered an investigation by a reliable Independent Body possibly led by retired police officer and Baguio City Mayor Benjamin Magalong.

text: Suportado man ining pagpa-imbestigar sa sining anomaliya sa flood projects sang mga retirado nga mga opisyales sang AFP sa ila manifesto nga nagapakamalaut sining anomaliya nga ginaugyunan man sang Dept.
english: The investigation into this anomaly in flood projects is also supported by retired AFP officers in their manifesto condemning this anomaly which is also approved by the Dept.

text: of National Defense kag bug-os nga pwersa sang AFP.
english: of National Defense and the entire AFP force.

text:
***

Gaupod kita sa paghatag sang suporta sa imbestigasyon sang Independent Body nga itukod sang Presidente, nga lakip man seguro sang parallel investigation sang Senate Blue Ribbon Committee nga ginapamunuan ni Senado Panflo Lacson, nga gapabilin nga wala nalamita sa ining anomaliya.
english:
***

We are united in supporting the investigation of the Independent Body to be established by the President, which will probably include the parallel investigation of the Senate Blue Ribbon Committee headed by Senator Panflo Lacson, which remains uninvolved in this anomaly.

text: Napamatud-an naman sang gobyerno ang mahimo sang kasubong nga imbestigasyon sa pagkapabilanggo sang Queen of Pork Barrel nga si Janet Napoles sang 100 gid ka tuig, although wala ginkalipay sang madamo ang pagpamatbat sa kaso sang duha ka senador.
english: The government has proven the potential of such an investigation in the 100-year imprisonment of Queen of Pork Barrel Janet Napoles, although many did not like the interpretation of the case of the two senators.

text: Wala man kita gaupod sa panawagan sang pila ka nagalider-lider sa mga protesta sa ila panawagan sa mapintas nga klase sang People Power nga ginhiwat sa Nepal kag Indonesia.
english: We also do not join the call of some of the leaders of the protests in their call for the brutal class of People Power held in Nepal and Indonesia.

text: Gasuporta lang kita sa non-violent nga mga protesta bisan galab-ut pa sa kadamuon sang nonviolent kag bloodless 1986 People Power Revolution, pero indi kasubong sing kapintas sang People Power sa  Nepal kag Indonesia.
english: We only support non-violent protests even if they reach the number of nonviolent and bloodless 1986 People Power Revolution, but not as brutal as People Power in Nepal and Indonesia.

text: Tagaan ta anay sing oportunidad ang imbestigasyon sang  Independent Body nga ginatukod sang Presidente kag ang parallel investigation sang Senate Blue Ribbon Committee.
english: Let us first give an opportunity to the investigation of the Independent Body being established by the President and the parallel investigation of the Senate Blue Ribbon Committee.

text:
Basi mapatigayon man nila sing mabungahon ining ila imbestigasyon nga indi kinahanglan mapadugay sang indi nagakabagay sa tindug nga “Justice delayed is justice denied”, kag “Injustice anywhere is Injustice everywhere.”

Indi lahog-lahog ang maka-experyensya sang crackdown labi na gid kon ma-imponer na ang martial law bisan sa sulod lang sang 60 ka adlaw nga ginatugot ang aton 1987 Constitution.
english:
Perhaps they can conduct their investigation fruitfully without having to be delayed by the inappropriate positions of “Justice delayed is justice denied”, and “Injustice anywhere is Injustice everywhere.”

It is not uncommon to experience a crackdown especially if martial law is imposed even within the 60 days allowed by our 1987 Constitution.

text: Ask me kag ang iban  pa nga naka-experyensya sini.
english: Ask me and others who have experienced this.

text: Gani, relax lang anay kita!
english: So, let's just relax!

english: Pinay tennis star Alex Eala's campaign at the Dubai Tennis Championships has come to an end after losing in the quarterfinals to world no.

english: 4 Coco Gauff, 6-0, 6-2.

text: Apisar sang matunog nga suporta sang Pinoy tennis fans sa Center Court, ginbudlayan ang 20-anyos nga rising star nga makakuha sang momentum batok sa two-time Grand Slam champion nga American player.
english: Despite the loud support of Pinoy tennis fans on Center Court, the 20-year-old rising star struggled to gain momentum against the two-time Grand Slam champion American player.

text: Sa imbukada pa lamang nga set, wala na nag-uyang sang tyempo si Gauff kag ginpaulan ang 26 points batok sa 11 nga nahimo ni Eala.
english: In the opening set, Gauff wasted no time and rained down 26 points against Eala's 11.

text: Ginpasagunsunan pa sini sang puntos sa second set, 4-0, tubtub nga nakapuntos na gid man si Eala nga amo ang nagbuhi sang paglaum sang fans matapos ang 53 minutos sini sa court.
english: He extended the score in the second set, 4-0, until Eala finally scored, which revived the hopes of the fans after 53 minutes on the court.

text: Apisar nagka-problema si Gauff sa service, tuman naman ka ulihi para kay Eala nga maka-recover.
english: Although Gauff had problems with the service, it was too late for Eala to recover.

text: Gintawag naman ni Gauff nga “home crowd” ang nagsuporta kay Eala bangud sa tuman ka damo nga Pinoy nga nagpungko sa venue.
english: Gauff called the support of Eala a “home crowd” because of the large number of Filipinos seated at the venue.

text: Gin-engganyo sini ang fans nga magpadayon sa pagsuporta sa Filipina player.
english: He encouraged fans to continue supporting the Filipina player.

text: “I’d like to thank Alex for bringing a new demographic to the sport.
english: “I’d like to thank Alex for bringing a new demographic to the sport.

text: I really appreciate.
english: I really appreciate it.

text: I think it’s great.
english: I think it’s great.

text: I know sometimes, it’s tough when you are playing against a home crowd, but I think that it’s great for the sports so keep being enthusiastic and keep rooting for your player,” mensahe ni Gauff pagkatapos sang hampang nga ginpalakpakan naman sang Filipino fans.
english: I know sometimes, it’s tough when you are playing against a home crowd, but I think that it’s great for the sports so keep being enthusiastic and keep rooting for your player,” Gauff said after the game which was applauded by the Filipino fans.

english: Gauff is advancing to the semifinals where he is likely to face world no.

english: 9 Elina Svitolina.

english: The Dubai Tennis Championships will be Eala’s sixth tournament this year.

text: Nagapang-47 subong ang Pinay tennis ace sa world rankings.
english: The Filipina tennis ace is currently ranked 47th in the world rankings.

english: She won her only WTA 125 crown in Guadalajara in Mexico last year.#

text: Kalabanan sa mga Filipino ang nagabutang gid sang bombay sa ila nga mga linuto.
english: Most Filipinos do put bombay in their dishes.

text: Magluwas nga nagapanamit ini sang sabor, madamo ini sang health benefits ilabi na kun ini ang kaunon nga hilaw.
english: Besides being delicious, it has many health benefits especially when eaten raw.

text: Santo sa U.S. Department of Agriculture, ang bombay ang manggaranon sa sodium, potassium, folates, vitamins A, C, E, calcium, magnesium, kag phosphorus.
english: According to the U.S. Department of Agriculture, bombay is rich in sodium, potassium, folates, vitamins A, C, E, calcium, magnesium, and phosphorus.

text: Ano bala ang mga health benefits sini?
english: What are the health benefits?

text: Una, ang pagkaon sang hilaw nga bombay ang makapa-improve sang heart health bangud may ara ini sang flavonoids kag thiosulfinates nga maka-reduce sang bad cholesterol sa imo nga lawas kag maka-likaw sa heart attack.
english: First, eating raw bombay can improve heart health because it contains flavonoids and thiosulfinates that can reduce bad cholesterol in your body and prevent heart attack.

text: Ikaduha, makapabaskog man ini sang tul-an bangud ang bombay ang may ara sang calcium.
english: Second, it also strengthens bones because bombay contains calcium.

text: Ikatatlo, makapa-improve sang sexual health, bangud makabulig ini sa pag-increase sang testosterone level sang lalaki.
english: Third, it can improve sexual health, as it can help increase a man’s testosterone level.

text:
Ikaapat, makapasanag man ini sang imo panulukan bangud manggaranon ini sa vitamin e.

Gani mga ka-bombo, ano pa ang ginahulat niyo, magpadulong na sa inyo kusina kag ilakip ang bombay sa inyo pamahaw.
english:
Fourth, it can also brighten your vision because it is rich in vitamin e.

So ka-bombo, what are you waiting for, go to your kitchen and include bombay in your breakfast.

text: Ginguba sang Iran ang fighter jets sang Estados Unidos samtang nagapatigayon ini sang search and rescue operations.
english: Iran destroyed US fighter jets while it was conducting search and rescue operations.

text: Natabo ang insidente isa ka adlaw matapos ang missile attack sang US sa taytay sang Iran.
english: The incident occurred a day after the US missile attack on the Iranian bridge.

text: Magluwas pa sini kadungan sang pagkahulog sang fighter jets sa kahawaan dala man nga nahulog kag naguba ang helicopter sang Estados Unidos matapos nga naigo sang projectile sang Iran.
english: In addition, at the same time as the fighter jets fell in the air, the US helicopter also fell and was destroyed after being hit by an Iranian projectile.

text: Nahibaluan nga halin sang ginsugudan sang US kag Israel ang pagpang-atake sa Iran sang Pebrero 28 naglab-ot na sa masobra 2,070 kag 26,500 ang iban pa nga nasamaran.
english: It is known that since the US and Israel launched attacks on Iran on February 28, more than 2,070 and 26,500 others have been injured.

text: Isa ka tumalagsahon nga palangitan-an subong sang mga tawo sa China amo ang pagbaligya nila sang ila kuko nga ginapatihan nga importante nga lakot ini sa traditional Chinese medicine!
english: One of the most unusual traditions of people in China is selling their nails which are believed to be an important ingredient in traditional Chinese medicine!

text: Kilala sa tawag nga “jin tui”, ang mga ginpang-utod nga kuko sang tawo ang ginapatihan nga epektibo sa pagkakas sang toxicity sa lawas kag pagkuyom sang mga pilas.
english: Known as “jin tui”, the clipped human nails are believed to be effective in removing toxicity from the body and healing wounds.

text: Suno sa sinang-una nga teksto nga medikal nga Qianjin Yaofanf nga ginsulat ni Sun Simiao (581-682), ginagamit ang mga ginpulbos nga kuko kag ginapahid sa dughan sang nagapa-dede nga iloy agud bulungon ang sakit sa tiyan sang lapsag.
english: According to the early medical text Qianjin Yaofanf written by Sun Simiao (581-682), powdered nails were used and applied to the breast of a nursing mother to treat the baby's abdominal pain.

text: Ang mga kumpanya nga nagahimo sang tradisyonal nga bulong ang nagabakal sang mga gin-utod nga kuko.
english: Companies that produce traditional medicine buy the clipped nails.

text: Ila ini ginahugasan kag pamalahon agud mangin pino nga pulbos kag ginasimpon sa mga produkto nga bulong.
english: They wash and dry it into a fine powder and mix it into pharmaceutical products.

text: Gin-athag naman sang mga kompaniya nga ginabusisi man nila ang mga kuko kag wala ginabaton ang halin sa tiil.
english: The companies explained that they also cut the nails and do not accept those from the feet.

text: Ginsabat sang Malacañang ang video ni Senator Imee Marcos nga nagapangayo sang pasaylo sa iya amay nga si late president Ferdinand Marcos Sr.
english: Malacañang has responded to the video of Senator Imee Marcos apologizing to her father, late President Ferdinand Marcos Sr.

text: bangud wala sini nabantayan sang maayo ang iya manghod nga si President Ferdinand “Bongbong” Marcos Jr.
english: because he did not take good care of his brother, President Ferdinand “Bongbong” Marcos Jr.

text: Ginkwestyon ni Palace Press Officer Undersecretary Atty. Claire Castro kun sin-o gid man bala ang wala nabantayan sang maayo.
english: Palace Press Officer Undersecretary Atty. Claire Castro who really was not watched properly.

text: Suno kay Castro, kun lantawon si President Marcos, wala ini nagapamuyayaw, wala nagapamahog, kasado, may pamilya, kag tubtub subong loyal sa iya asawa nga si First Lady Louise ”Liza” Araneta-Marcos.
english: According to Castro, if you look at President Marcos, he does not ridicule, does not threaten, is married, has a family, and is still loyal to his wife, First Lady Louise "Liza" Araneta-Marcos.

text: ”Ang sabi niya ay ‘hindi nabantayan.’ Sino kaya talaga ang hindi nabantayan ng magulang at sino ba talaga ang hindi nabantayan ang kapatid?” suno kay Castro.
english: "He said 'not watched.' Who really did not watch the parent and who really did not watch the brother?" according to Castro.

text: Dugang sini: ”Unang-una po, ang Pangulo, hindi po ito nagmumura, hindi ito nagmi-meltdown lalo na sa publiko at hindi po ito nagbabanta sa buhay ninuman.
english: He added: “First of all, the President, he does not curse, he does not meltdown especially in public and he does not threaten anyone's life.

text: Ang Pangulo po ay ikinasal, may pamilya, hanggang ngayon ay faithful sa asawa.
english: The President is married, has a family, and is still faithful to his wife.

text: So, sino po kaya ang naging pasaway?
english: So, who was the disobedient?

text:
Sino po kaya ang dapat binantayan?”

Nagdepensa man si Castro nga wala gin-guba ni Bongbong ang imahe sang iya mga utod.
english:
Who should be watched?”

Castro also defended that Bongbong did not tarnish the image of his brothers.

text: ”Alam po ng Pangulo ang nangyayari sa atin at sa mga pangyayari sa ating paligid.
english: "The President knows what is happening to us and the events around us.

text: At asahan po natin na ang Pangulo, hindi po siya naninira ng kaniyang kapatid,” pahayag pa ni Castro.
english: And we hope that the President, he does not destroy his brother,” Castro said.

text: Matandaan nga emosyonal si Imee sa iya video sang Lunes Santo nga nag-sorry kay Marcos, Sr.
english: Imee was emotional in her video on Good Monday apologizing to Marcos, Sr.

text: bangud suno sa iya, wala gid sini nasarangan nga bantayan si Bongbong apisar nga amo ini ang bilin sang ila amay.#
english: because according to him, he was never able to watch Bongbong even though it was their father's legacy.#

text: Mas nagluya pa ang balor sang Philippine Peso batok sa US Dollar samtang nagalala ang epekto sa global market nga resulta na sang giyera sa Middle East.
english: The Philippine Peso has weakened against the US Dollar as the impact on the global market as a result of the war in the Middle East worsens.

text: Nagtakop ang trading kahapon, Marso 16, nga P59.87 ang baylo sang kada US dollar nga amo ang bag-o nga historic low ukon pinakamaluya nga balor sang Philippine Peso sa bilog nga maragtas sang pungsod.
english: Trading closed yesterday, March 16, at P59.87 per US dollar, the new historic low or the weakest value of the Philippine Peso in the country's history.

text: Antes sini, nagbukas sa 59.71 ang local currency, kag nakalab-ot pa ang trading kahapon sa 59.95 antes ang pagsira sini sa P59.87.
english: Earlier, the local currency opened at 59.71, and yesterday's trading reached 59.95 before closing at P59.87.

text: Antes sang gyera sa Middle East nga nag-umpisa sang Pebrero 28, nakabangon-bangon pa ang Peso sa P57.665 sang Pebrero 27 nga amo man ang katapusan nga adlaw sang trading antes nag-ibwal ang tensyon.
english: Before the war in the Middle East that began on February 28, the peso had recovered to P57.665 on February 27, which was also the last day of trading before tensions erupted.

text: Sandig sa report sang Bloomberg, nag-intervene na ang Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas (BSP) sa currency market paagi sa pagbaligya sang dollars agud nga madepensahan ang peso antes pa ini magluya pa gid kag makalab-ot sa 60-to-the-dollar level.
english: According to a Bloomberg report, the Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas (BSP) has already intervened in the currency market by selling dollars to defend the peso before it weakens further and reaches the 60-to-the-dollar level.

text: Kun nagaluya ang balor sang peso, mas naga-kumplikado pa ang sitwasyon sa enerhiya sa Pilipinas bangud nagamahal ang imported goods lakip na ang langis bangud gina-purchase ang langis paagi sa dolyar.
english: When the peso weakens, the energy situation in the Philippines becomes more complicated because imported goods including oil become more expensive because oil is purchased in dollars.

text: Magluwas diri, bangud man sang pagluya sang peso, may impact man ini sa utang sang Pilipinas, ilabi na nga one-third sang amo nga utang ang naghalin sa foreign creditors ukon mga manugpautang halin sa luwas sang pungsod.
english: In addition, due to the weakening of the peso, it also has an impact on the Philippine debt, especially that one-third of the debt comes from foreign creditors or lenders from abroad.

text: Una na nga ginsiling ni President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.
english: Earlier, President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.

text: nga indi sini luyag nga makalapaw ang peso sa 60 pesos sa kada isa ka dolyar, bangud kun magluya ang balor sang Peso, pat-od nga magatimbuok na naman ang balayran sa utang.#
english: that he does not want the peso to exceed 60 pesos per dollar, because if the value of the peso weakens, the debt will surely increase again.

text: Estable na liwat ang suplay sang kuryente sa Tehran kag sa kaiping pa nga mga lugar sa Iran matapos ang pagpangbomba nga nag-igu sa ila nga power grids.
english: Power supply has been restored in Tehran and neighboring areas of Iran after bombings hit their power grids.

text: “Following last night’s enemy attack, the power grid in the provinces of Alborz and Tehran sustained damage and was affected,” suno sa deputy energy minister nga si Mostafa Rajabi-Mashhadi sa interview sa iya sa state television.
english: “Following last night’s enemy attack, the power grid in the provinces of Alborz and Tehran sustained damage and was affected,” deputy energy minister Mostafa Rajabi-Mashhadi said in an interview with state television.

text: “The power network across Iran’s national electricity grid is stable; in Tehran and Alborz the problems have also been resolved,” dugang sini.
english: “The power network across Iran’s national electricity grid is stable; in Tehran and Alborz the problems have also been resolved,” it added.

text: Nahibaluan nga na-report ang power interruption sa kapital nga Tehran matapos ang airstrike nga kabahin pa sang gyera sang US, Israel, kag Iran.
english: The power interruption was reported in the capital Tehran after the airstrike as part of the war between the US, Israel, and Iran.

text: Suno sa ministry sandig sa ginbalhag sang state media, naigu sang shrapnel ang parte sang electricity grid sa Alborz rason nga nagligum-dulom sa madamo nga parte sang Tehran kag syudad sang Karaj.
english: According to the ministry, according to state media, shrapnel hit part of the electricity grid in Alborz, causing darkness in many parts of Tehran and Karaj City.

text: Sa update sang Israel Defense Forces, ginsiling sini nga ginpuntariya nila ang “Iranian terror regime” sa Tehran.
english: In an update by the Israel Defense Forces, it said they targeted the “Iranian terror regime” in Tehran.

text: Matandaan nga nakabuya anay sang paandam si US President Donald Trump nga atakehon sini ang Iranian power stations kun indi pagbuksan sang Tehran ang Strait of Hormuz.

text: May yara bala sang malain ukon maayo nga dulot ang indi pagsuksok sang underwear sa mga babaye sa pagtulog?
english: Is there a bad or good gift of not wearing underwear to women to bed?

text: May mga estilo sang pagtulog ang mga babaye — una diri amo mga nagasuksok sang pajama kag ang ika-duha naman amo ang mga wala nagasuksok sang underwear.
english: Women have different sleeping styles — the first is those who wear pajamas and the second is those who do not wear underwear.

text: Suno kay Nancy Herta, M.D OB-GYN sa Michigan State University, mas maayo nga indi magsuksok sang underwear ang mga babaye agud malikawan ang mga vaginal issues.
english: According to Nancy Herta, M.D OB-GYN at Michigan State University, it is best for women not to wear underwear to avoid vaginal issues.

text: Ang vagina ang madasig nga tapikan sang moisture kag ini nagakabalabagan sang underwear nga nangin rason sang pagdamo sang mga bad bacteria sa lawas nga nagatuga sang balatian.
english: The vagina is easily covered with moisture and it is blocked by underwear which causes the growth of bad bacteria in the body that causes disease.

text: Gani nagabulig ang indi pagsuksok sang underwear agud nga makahatag sang ligwa nga makasulod ang hangin nga nagapamala kag nagapatinlo sa pribado nga parte sang lawas sang mga babaye.
english: So it helps not to wear underwear to allow air to enter that dries and cleans the private parts of women's bodies.

text: Ginpaboran naman ini ni Pari Ghodsi, isa ka board certified OB-GYN sa diin kun masami naga-eksperyensya sang yeast infection, makabulig gid ang indi pagsuksok sang underwear kun magtulog.
english: Pari Ghodsi, a board certified OB-GYN, said that if you often experience yeast infections, it is helpful not to wear underwear when sleeping.

text: Sa isa naman ka separado nga pagtuon, ang pagtulog nga wala sang underwear ang makabulig sa pagbuhin sang bug-at.
english: In a separate study, sleeping without underwear can help with weight loss.

text: Ang pagpabilin nga nagakatugnawan ang imo lawas nga nagabulig sa pag-boost sang imo nga calorie-burning abilities.
english: Keeping your body cool helps boost your calorie-burning abilities.

text: Apang kun luyag mo gid magsuksok sang underwear, siguraduhon nga loose cotton pajama ang imo nga suksok.
english: But if you really want to wear underwear, make sure you wear loose cotton pajamas.

text: Panugyan ni Ghodsi sa mga wala naanad nga wala sang suksok nga underwear, pilion ang loose-fitting cotton underwear bangud nagabulig ini sa pagsuyop sang moisture agud nga indi magtipon.
english: Ghodsi advises those who are not used to not wearing underwear to opt for loose-fitting cotton underwear as it helps absorb moisture so that it does not accumulate.

text: Ang silk kag lace nga mga underwear ang mahimo nga makairita pa sa imo nga panit kag sa vagina.
english: Silk and lace underwear can further irritate your skin and vagina.
