text: Nakabalik na sa normal ang sektor sang edukasyon sa Qatar kasunod sang pag-resume na sang in-person classes.
english: The education sector in Qatar has returned to normal following the resumption of in-person classes.

text: Ini matapos ang pila ka semana nga distance learning bangud sa giyera sa Middle East.
english: This comes after weeks of distance learning due to the war in the Middle East.

text: Suno kay Bombo Joseph Rivera, international correspondent sa Qatar, masobra sa 400,000 ka mga estudyante ang nagbalik sa una nga adlaw sang pag-resume sang face-to-face nga klase.
english: According to Bombo Joseph Rivera, international correspondent in Qatar, more than 400,000 students returned on the first day of the resumption of face-to-face classes.

text: Pahayag ni Rivera, ang resumption sang on-campus education ang resulta sang komprehensibo nga preparasyon sang Ministry of Education kag Higher Education (MoEHE), nga nagpatuman sang importante nga logistical, technical, kag safety measures agud masiguro ang stable learning environment sa mga estudyante.
english: Rivera said the resumption of on-campus education is the result of comprehensive preparations by the Ministry of Education and Higher Education (MoEHE), which implemented important logistical, technical, and safety measures to ensure a stable learning environment for students.

text: Apang suno kay Rivera, gin-require naman ang mga estudyante nga magdala sang go-bag ukon emergency bag pakadto sa sa eskwelahan magluwas pa sa ila mga school bags.
english: However, Rivera said, students are required to bring a go-bag or emergency bag to school in addition to their school bags.

text: Samtang, magluwas sa pagbalik sang face-to-face classes, gintugutan man ang pagbalik sa normal nila nga operasyon ang fishing industry apang limitado gid lamang ini sa pagpangisda kag indi para sa kalingawan.
english: Meanwhile, besides the resumption of face-to-face classes, the fishing industry was also allowed to return to normal operations but it was limited to fishing and not for recreation.

text: NAPULO’G LIMA (15) gid sa dalagku nga mga contractor ang ginmando ni PBBM nga imbestigaran mismo sadtong iya 2025 SONA sang Hulyo 28.
english: FIFTEEN (15) of the large contractors were ordered by PBBM to be investigated during its 2025 SONA on July 28.

text: Target sining imbestigasyon ang gin-alegar nga ma-anomaliya nga flood control projects, nga wala makapahagan-hagan man lang, kag nagpalala pa gani, sang pagbinaha sa pungsod nga dala sang mga bagyo Crising, Dante kag Emong.
english: The target of this investigation is the allegedly anomalous flood control projects, which failed to alleviate, and even exacerbated, the flooding in the country caused by typhoons Crising, Dante and Emong.

text: Sa pag-imbestigar mismo ni PBBM, nadiskubrihan niya ang palpak nga pagtukod sang pila ka flood control projects, nga ang iban indi matultulan kag indi makit-an (ghost projects) sa Bulacan kag sa Siyudad sang Iloilo.
english: In PBBM's own investigation, he discovered the failed construction of several flood control projects, some of which are ghost projects in Bulacan and Iloilo City.

text: Ebidensya diri sa Iloilo City ang isa ka proyekto nga nagdugang pa sang pagbinaha, nga samtang sadto 70 lang ka barangay ang ginbaha nangin 90 na, sunu kay Mayor Raisa Treñas.
english: Evidence here in Iloilo City is a project that has increased the flooding, which while previously only 70 barangays were flooded to 90, according to Mayor Raisa Treñas.

text: Sa pag-imbestigar naman sang upisina ni Senador Lacson sa Bulacan, Oriental Mindoro, kag Pampanga, nakita diri ang kapalpakan sang mga proyekto – nawas-ag nga seawall, wala matapos nga mga proyekto, kag ang pila sini mga ghost project pa.
english: In the investigation of Senator Lacson's office in Bulacan, Oriental Mindoro, and Pampanga, it was found that there are many projects – broken seawall, unfinished projects, and some of them are ghost projects.

text: Ining mga anomaliya galamita indi lang sang mga contractor, kundi pati man ang mga kongresista nga ang mga distrito may kasubong nga mga proyekto, kag bisan ang mga senador nga may kahilabtanan dira.
english: These anomalies are known not only to contractors, but also to congressmen whose districts have similar projects, and even senators involved.

text: Sang sini lang na-report gani nga nakabaton si Senate President Chiz Escudero sang P30 ka Milyon nga campaign donation halin sa Centerways Construction & Development Inc.
english: It was recently reported that Senate President Chiz Escudero received a P30 million campaign donation from Centerways Construction & Development Inc.

text: nga ang mga proyekto sa Sorsogon naglab-ot sa 96% sang kabilugan.
english: with Sorsogon projects accounting for 96% of the total.

text: Diri sa Sorsogon ga-dominar sa politika ang pamilya Escudero.
english: Here in Sorsogon, the Escudero family dominates politics.

text: Ining P30M nga campaign donation halin sa Centerways kay Escudero.
english: This P30M campaign donation from Centerways to Escudero.

text: Mga 20% ini sang P146.5 ka Milyon sang kabug-usan nga nabaton ni Escudero nga campaign donations, nga nadeklarar sa iya Statement of Expenditures and Contributions pagkatapos sang 2022 nga eleksyon.
english: This is about 20% of the P146.5 million of the total campaign donations received by Escudero, declared in his Statement of Expenditures and Contributions after the 2022 elections.

text: Hambalon pa, indi lahog-lahog ang kapalpakan sang mga flood control projects sa Sorsogon.
english: In other words, the failure of flood control projects in Sorsogon is not a joke.

text: Tugot sa aton eleksyon ang pagbaton sang campaign donations, apang kon naga-resulta ini sa anomaliya lain na ina nga istorya.
english: It is permissible in our elections to accept campaign donations, but if it results in anomalies that is another story.

text: Samtang, sunu sa Sumbong sa Pangulo website, ang probinsya sang Bulacan ang may pinakamahal kag pinakadamo nga kontrata sa flood control projects, nga nagabalor sang mga P44 ka Bilyon.
english: Meanwhile, according to the Sumbong sa Pangulo website, Bulacan province has the most expensive and largest number of contracts in flood control projects, worth about P44 billion.

text: Sunu sa AI, may isa pa gid ka senador nagbaton sang P20 ka Milyon nga campaign donations halin sa flood control projects sa Bulacan, nga sunu kay Lacson, may “Most Notorious” nga anomaliya.
english: According to AI, another senator received P20 million in campaign donations from flood control projects in Bulacan, which according to Lacson, has a “Most Notorious” anomaly.

text: In fact, luwas sa campaign donations, may yara man gani nga so-called SOP “commission” sa kada proyekto nga gina-sponsor sang kongresista kag senador, may eleksyon man ukon wala.
english: In fact, besides campaign donations, there is even a so-called SOP “commission” for each project sponsored by congressmen and senators, whether there is an election or not.

text:
***

Sa bahin sang mga contractor, makaluwas lang sila  seguro kon mapamatud-an nga halin lang ining campaign donations sa ila maganansya sa proyekto nga matindugan sang loaning bank sandig sa approved feasibility study  sang ila bank loans.
english:
***

On the part of the contractors, they will probably survive only if it is proven that these campaign donations are only from their profits from the project to be built by the loaning bank based on the approved feasibility study of their bank loans.

text: Ma-approve lang ang bangko sang business loan kon makapakita ang proponent sang feasibility study nga makaganansya ini sa business loan sang indi magnubo sa 30% nga makasabat sa loan payments.
english: The bank will only approve the business loan if the proponent can show a feasibility study that it can make a profit on the business loan of at least 30% to meet the loan payments.

text: Makatestigo kita sa ining bank requirement  sa business loan tungod kaagi kita trabaho sadto sa Chiongson Law & Consultant Firm nga kaupod si Eduardo Peñaredondo, nga sang ulihi nangin abogado kag konsehal pa sang Siyudad sang Iloilo.
english: We can testify to this bank requirement for business loans because we used to work at Chiongson Law & Consultant Firm with Eduardo Peñaredondo, who later became a lawyer and councilor of Iloilo City.

text: Na-hire ako sadto sang amo nga upisina bilang gradwet sang Banking & Finance kag si Peñaredondo nga tapos man sa Economics.
english: I was hired by the same office as a graduate of Banking & Finance and Peñaredondo who also graduated from Economics.

text: Ma-justify man sang contractor isa ka flood control project kon napatukod ini sa Quality Standard kag sa natalana nga panahon nga ma-confirm sang Oversight Monitoring sang DPWH.
english: The contractor can also justify a flood control project if it is built in accordance with the Quality Standard and within the stipulated time that can be confirmed by the Oversight Monitoring of the DPWH.

text:
***

Ginpanginwala ni DPWH Sec.
english:
***

DPWH Sec.

text: Manuel Bonoan nga may kahilabtanan siya sa sining mga anomaliya.
english: Manuel Bonoan that he is involved in these anomalies.

text: Mga “isolated cases” lang kuno ini.
english: These are supposedly isolated cases.

text: Ginkadlawan ini, ugaling, ni Senador Lacson  nga gintudlo ang pattern sang mga anomaliya sa ila pag-imbestigar sa Bulacan, Oriental Mindoro kag Pampanga, nga nagapakita, among others, sang pareho nga paggastuhanay sa flood control projects (P100M kada proyekto) nga indi mapatihan, nga nag-as-as sang pondo sang proyekto sa halos 40% na gid lang.
english: This, however, was laughed at by Senator Lacson who pointed out the pattern of anomalies in their investigation in Bulacan, Oriental Mindoro and Pampanga, which showed, among others, the same spending on flood control projects (P100M per project) that is unbelievable, which increased the funding of the project by almost 40%.

text: Ang allowable legal deduction lang sa pondo, sunu kay Lacson, mga 20% lang sang proyekto nga nagabilin sang P80M lang para working public fund para sa kada P100-M nga proyekto.
english: The only allowable legal deduction from the fund, according to Lacson, is only about 20% of the project leaving only P80M for working public fund for each P100-M project.

text: Pero, makuha pa gali sa project fund sang contractor ang dugang nga 20% para sa fundraiser ukon politiko nga ga-sponsor sang proyekto.
english: However, the contractor can get an additional 20% from the project fund for the fundraiser or politician who sponsors the project.
There are 5% , 3%, 1.5%, etc.

text: pa gani para sa kon sin-o pa nga buwitre, nga kon indi dayon maulian sang contractor halin sa iya maganansya, kag hampangan pa sing dula-dula, madisrasya gid ang proyekto.
english: even for any other vulture, that if the contractor does not immediately recover from his profits, and play games, the project will be a disaster.

text: Kon matabo ini, sa amo lang nga kantidad nga nabilin (P40M), ano pa abi  ang ma-expect sang mga pumuluyo sa proyekto kundi ang lutong macao nga daw apdo sa kapait ang sabaw.
english: If this happens, with the same amount left (P40M), what else can the residents expect from the project but the cooked macao soup that is like bile in the bitterness.

text: Ang problema pa kon ang contractor gasalig lang sa 15% advanced fee nga matugot sa pagsugod sang proyekto, katulad sang isa ka contractor nga ang kapital gali sobra-sobra lang sa isa ka milyon ka pesos apang ang ginatrabaho sobra P100-M nga proyekto.
english: The problem is if the contractor relies only on the 15% advanced fee that is allowed to start the project, such as a contractor whose capital is only more than one million pesos but the work is more than P100-M project.

text: Pwede pa gani ini mapasundan sang 15% nga advanced fee kon maubos ang nauna, kag kon wala makuha sini ang contractor segurado ma-aberiya gid ang trabaho nga indi matapos-tapos.
english: It can even be followed by a 15% advanced fee if the previous one is exhausted, and if the contractor does not get it, the work will surely be disrupted.

english: SUSMARIOSEP!/PN

text: Nagpagwa ang National Aeronautics and Space Administration (NASA) sang pila ka mga laragway sang Earth halin sa capsule window sang Artemis II samtang padayon nga nagabiyahe ang grupo pakadto sa bulan.
english: The National Aeronautics and Space Administration (NASA) has released several images of Earth from the Artemis II capsule window as the team continues its journey to the moon.

text: Sang Abril 1, 2026, ginlunsyar halin sa Kennedy Space Center sa United States ang isa ka “10-day mission” sang Artemis II nga ginalakipan sang apat ka mga astronaut.
english: On April 1, 2026, launched from the Kennedy Space Center in the United States is a “10-day mission” of Artemis II featuring four astronauts.

text: Ginalakipan ini nanday Reid Wiseman, ang Navy test pilot kag commander sang mission halin sa NASA.
english: This includes Reid Wiseman, the Navy test pilot and commander of the mission from NASA.

text: Kalakip man si Victor Glove, isa man ka naval test pilot, Christina Koch nga isa ka engineer ang record-holding astronaut nga una nga babayi nga magalupad pagwa sa kalibutan.
english: Victor Glove, also a naval test pilot, and Christina Koch, an engineer, are the record-holding astronaut who became the first woman to fly outside the earth.

text: Amo man ang Canadian Space Agency nga si Jeremy Hansen, isa ka fighter pilot nga una nga non-NASA astronaut nga magaupod sa lunar mission.
english: So is Canadian Space Agency Jeremy Hansen, a fighter pilot who will be the first non-NASA astronaut to join a lunar mission.

text: Amo ini ang una nga tion halin sang 1972 nga may mga astronaut liwat nga nakalab-ot lampas sa low Earth orbit.
english: It was the first time since 1972 that astronauts again made it beyond low Earth orbit.

text: Paano bala kun ang imo ginatago nga sekreto, mahibaluan lang bangud sang isa ka palpak nga pagbayad sang bulong?
english: What if your secret is only revealed because of a failed payment for medicine?

text: Isa ka lalaki sa China ang nabuking sang iya asawa matapos nga nagtuyo siya nga magbakal sang contraceptive pills sa isa ka botika paagi sa e-payment.
english: A man in China was arrested by his wife after he tried to buy contraceptive pills at a pharmacy through e-payment.

text: Apang nagka-aberya ang sistema, gani ginpanawagan sang staff ang numero nga nakalista sa iya membership card, nga sang ulihi, na-link gali sa iya misis.
english: But the system malfunctioned, so the staff called the number listed on his membership card, which turned out to be linked to his wife.

text: Hala ka!
english: Come on!

text: Nagkabalaka ang asawa sang nahibaluan niya ngaa birth control pills ang ginbakal sang iya bana, nga wala man siya nagagamit sini.
english: The wife became concerned when she learned why her husband had bought birth control pills, which he did not use.

text: Diri na nagwa ang kamatuoran nga may ‘other woman’ ang iya nga bana.
english: This is where the truth came out that her husband had another woman.

text: Subong, ang amo nga lalaki nagareklamo sa social media kag ginabasol ang botika sa pagkaguba sang duha ka pamilya.
english: Now, that man is complaining on social media and blaming the pharmacy for the destruction of two families.

text: Ginpahayag pa niya nga plano niya kasuhan ang botika bangud sang ginatawag niya nga paglapas sa privacy.
english: He said he plans to sue the pharmacy for what he calls a breach of privacy.

text: Apang suno sa mga legal expert, gamay ang posibilidad nga magdaog siya sa kaso.
english: But legal experts say he is unlikely to win the case.

text: Ginpunto pa sang madamo nga netizens nga kun wala siya nagluib sa iya asawa, wala kuntani sang problema.
english: Many netizens even pointed out that if he hadn't cheated on his wife, there would have been no problem.

text: Sa subong nga panahon sang teknolohiya, bisan ang mga sekreto, indi na masarangan nga taguon.
english: In today’s age of technology, even secrets, can no longer be kept hidden.

text: Gani antes mamasol, pamangkota anay ang kaugalingon: tsakto ni bala ang ginahimo ko?
english: So before you blame yourself, ask yourself: am I doing the right thing?

text: Ginpaathag ni Iloilo City Mayor Jerry Treñas kung ngaa indi pwede i-disclose ukon isa-publiko ang mga impormasyon sang mga nagpositibo sa Monkey pox (Mpox).
english: Iloilo City Mayor Jerry Treñas explained why the information of those who tested positive for Monkey pox (Mpox) cannot be disclosed or made public.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Mayor Treñas, iya ginpahayag nga may mga pagsulundan nga ginhatag ang Department of Health (DOH) sa ila, gani ginakinahanglan ini nga sundon.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Mayor Treñas said that there are guidelines given by the Department of Health (DOH) to them, so they need to be followed.

text: Suno man kay Dr. Mary Ann Diaz, head sang Iloilo City Health Office, ini man agud malikawan ang diskriminasyon nga matabo sa mga pasyente inkaso mabuyagyag ang ila mga pangalan.
english: According to Dr. Mary Ann Diaz, head of the Iloilo City Health Office, said this is also to avoid discrimination against patients in case their names are revealed.

text: Nagpasalig man si Treñas nga istrikto nga gina-monitor ang mga nagpositibo kag amo man ang tagsa ka mga barangay health workers sa siyudad.
english: Treñas also assured that the positives are being strictly monitored as well as each barangay health worker in the city.

text: Nakahanda man ang mga katapo sang City Social Welfare Development Office (CSWDO) agud maghatag sang assistance sa mga apektado sang Mpox.
english: Members of the City Social Welfare Development Office (CSWDO) are also ready to provide assistance to those affected by Mpox.

text: Nahibaluan man nga 4 na ang kumpirmado kag may duha ka mga suspected nga kaso sang Mpox sa siyudad.
english: It is also known that there are 4 confirmed and two suspected cases of Mpox in the city.

text: Naglunsar ang Social Security System (SSS) sang facial authentication para sa mga pensioners, agud makabulig sa pagkumpleto sang ila Annual Confirmation of Pensioners (ACOP) online nga indi na ang mga ini kinahanglan nga magpadulong sa tagsa ka mga SSS branch.
english: The Social Security System (SSS) has launched facial authentication for pensioners, to help them complete their Annual Confirmation of Pensioners (ACOP) online without having to visit each SSS branch.

text: Sa amo nga system upgrade sang ahensya, ang facial scan kag biometric check ang magasigurado nga lehitimo nga indibdiwal ang nagarehistro.
english: With the agency's system upgrade, facial scan and biometric check will ensure that a legitimate individual is registering.

text: Available ang amo nga feature sa mga pensioners nga may PhilSys National ID, mga pensioners nga yari sa Pilipinas kag abroad, lakip na ang mga nakabaton sang survivorship pension.
english: The feature is available to pensioners with PhilSys National ID, pensioners in the Philippines and abroad, including those who received survivorship pension.

text: Suno sa SSS, madasig kag safe ang amo nga proseso kag sarang ini mahimo sa bisan ano nga device nga may camera.
english: According to the SSS, the process is fast and safe and can be done on any device with a camera.

text: Para sa mga wala sang compatible device, mahimo man gihapon nga magpadulong sa tagsa ka mga SSS branches.
english: For those who do not have a compatible device, they can still visit the respective SSS branches.

text: Magabukas ang gobyerno sang isa ka bag-o nga talatapan nga magapokus sa pagpauswag sang industriya sang kape sa Pilipinas, suno sa Department of Agriculture (DA).
english: The government will open a new office that will focus on developing the Philippine coffee industry, according to the Department of Agriculture (DA).

text: Ini nga tikang sang DA ang may tinutuyo nga buhion ang sektor sang kape nga sa karon nagapangatubang sang dako nga mga pagpanghangkat.
english: The DA's move aims to revive the coffee sector which is currently facing major challenges.

text: Base sa Department Order No.
english: Based on Department Order No.

text: 06 nga ginpagwa ni DA Secretary Francisco Tiu Laurel Jr., iya ginmanduan ang pagtukod sang Coffee Industry Development Office (CIDO) agud hugpungon sa isa lamang ka opisina ang mga programa, pondo, kag polisiya para sa kape nga anay ginadumalahan sang nagkalain-lain nga mga unit.
english: 06 issued by DA Secretary Francisco Tiu Laurel Jr., he ordered the establishment of the Coffee Industry Development Office (CIDO) to bring together in one office the programs, funds, and policies for coffee that were previously managed by various units.

text: Suno kay Tiu Laurel, paagi sini makaangkun sang separado nga opisina nga magatutok lamang sa pagpauswag sang industriya sang kape.
english: According to Tiu Laurel, this will provide a separate office that will focus solely on the development of the coffee industry.

text: Dugang pa niya, madugay nga ginakabig nga ikaduha lamang nga tanum ang kape, apang karon kinahanglan na ini hatagan sang mas dako nga atensyon kag estratehiko nga pagdumala.
english: He added that coffee has long been considered a secondary crop, but now it needs to be given more attention and strategic management.

text: Ang bag-o nga talatapan ipahamtang sa idalum sang Office of the Undersecretary for Special Concerns and Official Development Assistance sang DA.
english: The new office will be placed under the Office of the Undersecretary for Special Concerns and Official Development Assistance of the DA.

text: Ang pagtukod sang CIDO nakabase sa Executive Order No.
english: The establishment of CIDO is based on Executive Order No.

english: 292 or the Administrative Code of 1987.

text: Ginpatpat sang isa ka public health expert ang pinaka-common nga problema sa mata nga nagaapekto sa bilyon-bilyon ka tawo sa bug-os nga kalibutan.
english: A public health expert has identified the most common eye problem that affects billions of people worldwide.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Dr. Irene Mirasol Peliño, Optometrist, iya ginpahayag nga tatlo sa mga pinaka-common amo ang Astigmatism, Hyperopia, kag Myopia.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Dr. Irene Mirasol Peliño, Optometrist, said three of the most common are Astigmatism, Hyperopia, and Myopia.

text: Ini nga mga kondisyon ginatawag nga refractive errors, kun sa diin indi insakto ang pagtutok sang kasanag sa retina sang mata, nga nagaresulta sang blurred ukon distorted vision.
english: These conditions are called refractive errors, where light is not properly focused on the retina of the eye, resulting in blurred or distorted vision.

text: Suno kay Peliño, ang tatlo ka mga balatian sa mata amo ang ginatawag nga Myopia ukon nearsightedness, amo ang kondisyon nga indi klaro ang mga bagay nga malayo, samtang sinew naman kon malapit sa panulukan.
english: According to Peliño, the three eye diseases are called Myopia or nearsightedness, which is a condition in which objects that are far away are not clear, while things are blurry when close to the eye.

text: Nagakatabo ini kun ang eyeball ang sobra ang kalabaon ukon sobra ang kurba sang cornea, gani ang kasanag naga-focus sa atubang sang retina.
english: It occurs when the eyeball is too long or the cornea is too curved, so light is focused in front of the retina.

text: Ginarekomendar sang mga eksperto nga magpa-eye check-up kada isa ukon duha ka tuig, labi na sa mga kabataan, tigulang, ukon may simtoma sang kabudlayan sa panulukan.
english: Experts recommend an eye check-up every one or two years, especially for children, the elderly, or those with symptoms of vision problems.

text: Santo sa World Health Organization (WHO), masobra 30% sang populasyon sang kalibutan ang apektado sang myopia.
english: According to the World Health Organization (WHO), more than 30% of the world's population is affected by myopia.

text: Nagataas pagid ini nga numero, labi na sa mga kabataan tungod sang sobra nga gamit sang gadgets.
english: This number is increasing, especially among children due to the excessive use of gadgets.

text: Pormal na nga nagkoordinar ang Department of Agriculture kag Sugar Regulatory Administration sa nagkalain-lain nga ahensya sang gobyerno, ilabi na sa Department of Energy, agud masiguro ang nagakaigo nga suplay sang produktong petrolyo kag fertilizer.
english: The Department of Agriculture and Sugar Regulatory Administration have formally coordinated with various government agencies, especially the Department of Energy, to ensure adequate supply of petroleum products and fertilizers.

text: Ini agud indi maparalisa ang produksyon sang kalamay sa pungsod kag agud maprotektahan ang mga mangunguma batok sa posible nga kakulangan kag pagsaka sang presyo sang gatong kag abono bangod sa padayon nga gyera sa Middle East.
english: This is to avoid paralyzing sugarcane production in the country and to protect farmers against possible shortages and rising fuel and fertilizer prices due to the ongoing war in the Middle East.

text: Ginkumpirmar man ni SRA Administrator Pablo Luis Azcona nga ginpabutyag na nila kay Agriculture Secretary Francisco Tiu Laurel Jr.
english: SRA Administrator Pablo Luis Azcona also confirmed that they have already expressed to Agriculture Secretary Francisco Tiu Laurel Jr.

text: ang sitwasyon agud pormal nga mapalab-ot sa DOE ang ginakabalak-an sang bug-os nga industriya sang kalamay.
english: the situation to formally convey to the DOE the concerns of the entire sugar industry.

text: Ginpabutyag naman ni Laurel nga handa ang gobyerno nga magbulig kag indi nila pagtugutan nga ma-delay ang operasyon sang sektor.
english: Laurel said the government is ready to help and will not allow the operation of the sector to be delayed.

text: Dugang pa sini, indi lamang ang mga producer sang kalamay ang ila protektahan kundi pati man ang bug-os nga suplay sang gatong kag abono para sa tanan nga mangunguma kag mangingisda sa bug-os nga pungsod.
english: In addition, they will protect not only sugarcane producers but also the entire supply of fuel and fertilizer for all farmers and fishermen across the country.

text: Gin-abandonar sang isa ka mag-asawa sa airport ang 10-anyos nga bata nila nga lalaki matapos madiskubrehan nga expired ang passport sini.
english: A couple abandoned their 10-year-old son at the airport after discovering his passport had expired.

text: Natabo ini sa El Prat Airport sa Barcelona, Spain.
english: It happened at El Prat Airport in Barcelona, ​​Spain.

text: Suno sa air traffic controller, nakit-an sang mga pulis ang bata nga nagaisahanon.
english: According to the air traffic controller, police found the child alone.

text: Sang ginpamangkot siya, nagsabat ang bata nga ginbilin siya sang ginikanan niya nga nagpadulong sa Morocco para sa bakasyon.
english: When asked, the boy replied that he was left by his parents who went to Morocco for a vacation.

text: Bangud diri, wala ginpalupad ang eroplano nga ginsakyan sang iya ginikanan.
english: As a result, the plane his parents were on was not allowed to fly.

text: Sang ila gin-istorya ang ginikanan, nakibot ang airport official sa sabat nila nga sang nadiksubre nga indi valid ang passport sang ila nga bata, nagdesisyon sila nga bayaan na lang ini sa airport.
english: When they spoke to the parents, the airport official was surprised by their answer that when they discovered that their child's passport was not valid, they decided to leave it at the airport.

text: Nagtawag na lang sila sa ila paryente nga sugaton ang bata sa airport kag nagsakay sila nga mag-asawa sa eroplano.
english: They simply called a relative to pick up the child at the airport and the couple boarded the plane.

text: Nagapangatubang subong ang mag-asawa sang kaso nga pag-abandonar sa ila nga anak kag pagtuga sang delay sa flight.
english: The couple is now facing charges of abandoning their child and causing a flight delay.

text: Ipaidalom man sila sa dugang nga imbestigasyon agud hibaluon ang ila silot bangud sa nahimo nila sa ila anak.
english: They will also be subjected to further investigation to determine their punishment for what they did to their son.

text: Ginmandu ni President Ferdinand Marcos, Jr.
english: President Ferdinand Marcos, Jr. ordered

text: ang paghatag sang local names sa 131 ka mga features sang Kalayaan Island Group (KIG) sa West Philippine Sea.
english: the assignment of local names to 131 features of the Kalayaan Island Group (KIG) in the West Philippine Sea.

text: Ini ang santo sa nakabutang sa Executive Order No.
english: This is in accordance with Executive Order No.

text: 111 nga pirmado ni Marcos sang Marso 26.
english: 111 signed by Marcos on March 26.

text: Sa amo nga order, ginmanduan ang National Mapping and Resource Information Authority nga mag-produce kag mag-publish sang updated charts kag mapa nga naga-reflect sang lokal nga mga pangalan sang mga lugar.
english: In that order, the National Mapping and Resource Information Authority was directed to produce and publish updated charts and maps reflecting local place names.

text: Ginmanduan man ang national government agencies kag instrumentalities nga gamiton ini nga lokal nga mga pangalan sa ila nga official communications, messages, kag documents.
english: National government agencies and instrumentalities are also instructed to use these local names in their official communications, messages, and documents.

text: Sa sektor sang edukasyon, dapat man nga gamiton ini nga mga pangalan sa educational kag training institutions amo man sa pag-conduct sang research, sa pagpaguwa sang mga textbooks, kag sa pagpreparar sang educational ukon instructional materials.
english: In the education sector, these names should also be used in educational and training institutions as well as in conducting research, publishing textbooks, and preparing educational or instructional materials.

text: Gin-cite sang EO ang rekomendasyon halin sa National Maritime Council nga i-adopt ang standard set sang Philippine names para sa 131 features sang KIG sa Kalayaan sa Palawan, agud masiguro ang maayo nga pang-dumalahan sa area kag agud mapakita ang soberanya sang Pilipinas sa West Philippine Sea.
english: The EO cited the recommendation from the National Maritime Council to adopt the standard set of Philippine names for the 131 features of the KIG in Kalayaan in Palawan, to ensure good governance in the area and to demonstrate Philippine sovereignty in the West Philippine Sea.

text: Nahibaluan nga sa idalom naman sang Philippine Maritime Zones Act, mahimo tawgon bilang West Philippine Sea ang maritime zones sang Pilipinas sa western side sang Philippine archipelago lakip na ang Luzon Sea kag Bajo de Masinloc kag maritime features sang KIG.
english: Under the Philippine Maritime Zones Act, the maritime zones of the Philippines on the western side of the Philippine archipelago including the Luzon Sea and Bajo de Masinloc and maritime features of the KIG can be called the West Philippine Sea.

text:
* Ka-Bombo, ini nga balita ang may yara sang kaundan kaangot sa mental health, kag nagamensyonar man sang depression kag bullying.*

Ginsapubliko ni Miss Universe Philippines 2020 Rabiya Mateo nga na-diagnose ini nga may Major Depressive Disorder with Anxious Distress sadtong 2025.
english:
* Ka-Bombo, this news contains content related to mental health, and also mentions depression and bullying.*

Miss Universe Philippines 2020 Rabiya Mateo announced that she will be diagnosed with Major Depressive Disorder with Anxious Distress in 2025.

text: Nagpaidalom ini sa medication kag nagkadto sa luwas sang pungsod agud nga indi siya ma-trigger sang mga tawo nga wala nakahibalo kun ano ang iya gina-agyan.
english: She underwent medication and went abroad so she wouldn’t be triggered by people who didn’t know what she was going through.

text: Suno kay Rabiya, tinuig man niya ini ginbatuan, kag wala siya sang plano nga isugid sa publiko ang iya kondisyon.
english: Rabiya said she had also resisted it for years, and had no plans to go public with her condition.

text: Apang gin-post sang Ilongga beauty queen ang diagnosis sa iya bilang panawagan nga untaton ang pagpang-bully.
english: But the Ilongga beauty queen posted her diagnosis as a call to stop bullying.

text: Kagab-i, sunod-sunod nga posts ang ginhimo ni Rabiya nga nagapautwas sang iya kalain sang buot.
english: Last night, Rabiya made a series of posts expressing her displeasure.

text: Nag-ugat ini matapos nag-abot siya sa Iloilo kahapon, kag nagpamangkot kun sa diin siya pwede makakaon.
english: It took root after he arrived in Iloilo yesterday, and asked where he could eat.

text: Apisar nga may mga sweet kag matarong nga komento, may ara man sang mga netizens nga nag-bash kag naghikay kay Rabiya.
english: Despite the sweet and righteous comments, there were also netizens who bashed and arranged Rabiya.

text: Bangud sang mga komento sang iban nga netizens, nagpahayag si Rabiya nga ginhimo man niya ang iya “best” nga i-represent ang Iloilo City, apang sobra-sobra na gid ang ginapanghambal sang iban nga mga tawo.
english: Due to the comments of other netizens, Rabiya said she did her “best” to represent Iloilo City, but some people are saying too much.

text: Nagpahanumdom ini nga maghinay-hinay lang kag magpakita sang kaayo ilabi na sa mga depressed nga mga tawo.
english: It reminded to just slow down and show kindness especially to depressed people.

text: Nahibaluan nga tumandok sang Balasan, Iloilo si Rabiya.
english: Rabiya is a native of Balasan, Iloilo.

text: Isa siya sa magapungko nga judge sa Miss Iloilo 2026 karon sa gab-i sa West Visayas State University Cultural Center.
english: She is one of the judges of Miss Iloilo 2026 tonight at the West Visayas State University Cultural Center.

text: Words by: Bombo Jissa Padios
english: Words by: Bombo Jissa Padios

text: Ginkumpirma ni Coach Tim Cone nga indi man maghampang si Quentin Millora-Brown para sa Gilas Pilipinas para sa nagahilapit nga second window sang FIBA Basketball World Cup Asian qualifiers.
english: Coach Tim Cone confirmed that Quentin Millora-Brown will also not play for Gilas Pilipinas for the upcoming second window of the FIBA ​​Basketball World Cup Asian qualifiers.

text: Wala sang ginhatag nga rason si Cone kun ngaa wala ang 25-anyos nga 6-foot-10 center, apang suno sa iya, ginpili ni Brown nga indi mag-upod sa Gilas sa hampang batok sa New Zealand kag sa Australia.
english: Cone did not give a reason for the absence of the 25-year-old 6-foot-10 center, but said Brown chose not to join the Gilas for games against New Zealand and Australia.

text: Matandaan nga malawig ang eligibility process nga gin-agyan sang Samahan ng Basketbol ng Pilipinas, kag pila ka bulan na ang nagligad, naaprubahan na ini nga makahampang kuntani bilang local player.
english: It can be recalled that the Philippine Basketball Association went through a long eligibility process, and a few months ago, he was approved to play as a local player.

text: Ini nga former UP Fighting Maroons big man ang eligible naman bilang Asian import sa mga liga sa luwas sang pungsod, kag subong nagahampang siya para sa Chiba Jets sa Japan’s B.League.
english: The former UP Fighting Maroons big man is also eligible as an Asian import in overseas leagues, and now plays for the Chiba Jets in Japan’s B.League.

text: Ginkumpirma man ni Cone nga ginpasulod sa training si Justine Baltazar nga amo ang posible magbulos sa national team.
english: Cone also confirmed that Justine Baltazar, who is likely to replace the national team, has been included in training.

text: Ini ang iya mangin una nga hampang sa Gilas halin sang 2021 FIBA Olympic Qualifying Tournament sa idalom anay ni head coach Tab Baldwin.
english: This will be his first game with the Gilas since the 2021 FIBA ​​Olympic Qualifying Tournament under former head coach Tab Baldwin.

text: Magluwas kay Millora-Brown, kumpirmado nga indi man makahampang ang 7-foot-3 center nga si Kai Sotto para sa Gilas subong nga window bangud bag-o lang ini nag-ayo sa iya nga injury.
english: Besides Millora-Brown, 7-foot-3 center Kai Sotto is also confirmed to be out for the Gilas this window as he recently recovered from an injury.

text: 2-0 subong ang record sang Pilipinas kag nagapanguna sa Group A. Target sang team nga maka-secure sang ikaapat nga sunod-sunod nga appearance sa World Cup.#
english: The Philippines currently has a 2-0 record and is leading Group A. The team's target is to secure a fourth consecutive World Cup appearance.

text: Maga-updanay bilang hosts sa Miss Iloilo 2026 sanday Bb.
english: The hosts of Miss Iloilo 2026 will be Bb.

text: Pilipinas Grand International Nicole Cordoves kag Miss Eco International 2025 Alexie Brooks.
english: Philippines Grand International Nicole Cordoves and Miss Eco International 2025 Alexie Brooks.

text: Ini na ang ikaapat nga tuig nga mangin host sa sini nga event si Cordoves, samtang balik-entablado naman si Brooks matapos ginkoronahan nga Miss Iloilo sadtong 2024.
english: This is the fourth year that Cordoves will host the event, while Brooks will be back on stage after being crowned Miss Iloilo in 2024.

text: Suno pa sa Miss Iloilo Organization, maka-upod man sang duha ka beauty queens ang Ilonggo host nga si Ryl Nuñez.
english: According to the Miss Iloilo Organization, Ilonggo host Ryl Nuñez will also be accompanied by two beauty queens.

text: Kumpirmado naman nga magapungko bilang judges sanday former Miss Iloilo kag Miss Universe Philippines 2020 Rabiya Mateo; visionary mentor kag “Queen Maker” nga si Jonas Gaffud; world-renowned shoe designer nga si Jose Joaquin “Jojo” Bragais; former IFFI President Joe Marie Layson Jr.; kag entrepreneur nga si Mags Cue.
english: Former Miss Iloilo and Miss Universe Philippines 2020 Rabiya Mateo; visionary mentor and “Queen Maker” Jonas Gaffud; world-renowned shoe designer Jose Joaquin “Jojo” Bragais; former IFFI President Joe Marie Layson Jr.; and entrepreneur Mags Cue.

text: Mangin special guest naman sa coronation night si Miss Universe Philippines 2023 Michelle Dee.
english: Miss Universe Philippines 2023 Michelle Dee will be a special guest at the coronation night.

text: Isa ang Miss Iloilo sa highlights sang iconic nga Dinagyang Festival 2026.
english: Miss Iloilo is one of the highlights of the iconic Dinagyang Festival 2026.

text: Matabo ang grand coronation night sa Sabado, Enero 17, sa West Visayas State University (WVSU) Cultural Center.
english: The grand coronation night will take place on Saturday, January 17, at the West Visayas State University (WVSU) Cultural Center.

Nagae sang Estancia, Wyncy Fatalino kag Mitch Samson sang Miagao, Lorraine Tajonera Mangubat sang Tubungan, Krshia Danica Ferguson sang Badiangan, Zestah Shalom Espinosa sang Anilao, Angel Ann Polines Teruel sang Tigbauan, Hana Tiffany Christen sang Janiuay, Mae Gatungay sang Guimbal, Gel Khyyzzll Zamora Gevero sang Iloilo City Proper, Jessica Patricia Lynn Beerda sang La Paz, Iloilo City, kag Mauluxielle Stacey De Ramos sang Batad.#
english: 12 candidates will compete for the title this year namely Yamika P. Nagae of Estancia, Wyncy Fatalino and Mitch Samson of Miagao, Lorraine Tajonera Mangubat of Tubungan, Krshia Danica Ferguson of Badiangan, Zestah Shalom Espinosa of Anilao, Angel Ann Polines of Tigbaany Teruan, Teruan Christian of Hana Janiuay, Mae Gatungay of Guimbal, Gel Khyyzzll Zamora Gevero of Iloilo City Proper, Jessica Patricia Lynn Beerda of La Paz, Iloilo City, and Mauluxielle Stacey De Ramos of Batad.#

text: ANG aton abyan nga si Pedro, may problema naman nga luyag i-share sa aton.
english: OUR friend Pedro has a problem to share with us.

text: Nalab-ut na niya ang edad nga 80, kag may nakapahibalo sa iya nga matagaan siya sang cash gift nga P10,000.
english: He has reached the age of 80, and someone informed him that he will be given a cash gift of P10,000.

text: Ugaling wala siya kuno kahibalo kon diin niya kuhaon kag kon san-o niya mabaton ini.
english: But he said he didn't know where to get it and when he would get it.

text: Kon diin mo makuha ini, Pedro, una mo duawon seguro ang inyo Office of Senior Citizens’ Affairs kag ang DSWD sa inyo banwa.
english: Where you can get it, Pedro, you should first visit your Office of Senior Citizens' Affairs and the DSWD in your town.

text: Kon san-o mo makuha ining cash gift mo nga P10,000, yari ang panugyan sang Republic Act 11982, nga nag-amendar sang RA 10868, ukon  ang Centenarians Act of 2016.
english: When you will receive your cash gift of P10,000, here is the advice of Republic Act 11982, which amended RA 10868, or the Centenarians Act of 2016.

text: Ining panugyan napahayag sa Section 1 sining RA 11982 nga gin-aprubahan kag ginpirmahan ni President Marcos Jr.
english: This advice is stated in Section 1 of this RA 11982 approved and signed by President Marcos Jr.

text: sadtong Pebrero 26, 2024.
english: on February 26, 2024.

text: Nagahatag ining Section 1 sang cash incentive nga P100,000 sa mga centenarian (edad 100) kag sang cash gift nga P10,000 sa gaedad 80, 85, 90, kag 95.
english: Section 1 provides a cash incentive of P100,000 to centenarians (age 100) and a cash gift of P10,000 to those aged 80, 85, 90, and 95.

text: Ini ugaling nga cash incentive kag cash gift mabaton lang “within one year” halin sa pag-selebrar sang pagkatawo (birthday) nila sa ina nga mga edad.So, hulat-hulata lang anay, Pedro, kay gapangita pa seguro sing source of funding of gobyerno.
english: However, this cash incentive and cash gift will only be received “within one year” from the celebration of their birthday at that age. So, just wait, Pedro, because they are still looking for a source of funding from the government.

text: Maswete  ka seguro, Pedro, kon mabaton mo ini sa sulod lang sang tatlo ka bulan despues.
english: You must be lucky, Peter, to receive it in three months.

text: Kag kabay lang nga indi magpalpak ining ginapasalig nga cash incentives kag cash gifts sa mga senior citizen.
english: And hopefully these promised cash incentives and cash gifts to senior citizens will not fail.

text: Nga posible matabo!
english: Which is likely to happen!

text: Kon paano magpalpak ini may napahayag si Senadora Riza Hontiveros sang sini  lang sa iya privileged speech sa Senado.
english: Senator Riza Hontiveros recently revealed how to fail in her privileged speech in the Senate.

text: Nagsuspetso siya nga basi nadisgrasya ang na-invest sang GSIS halin sa pondo sini sa online gambling kag mabutang sa peligro ang mga pension sang mga retirees, labi na gid sang pagkabalahuba sang mga ma-anomaliya nga paghiwat sining mga online gambling.
english: He suspected that the GSIS's investment from its funds in online gambling might have been accidentally compromised and the pensions of retirees could be endangered, especially by the exposure of these anomalous online gambling activities.

text: Wala niya mamensyonar ang mga ini, pero basi lakip dira ang napun-an sang korapsyon nga Philippine Offshore Gambling Operation (POGO) sa pungsod kag sang e-Sabong.
english: He did not mention these, but may include the corrupt Philippine Offshore Gambling Operation (POGO) in the country and e-Sabong.

text: Ang isa gani ka kongresista sadto, nga nagapanago karon sa luas,  bayaran gali kuno sang POGO agud ihinago kag pangapinan ang mga anomliya kag pang-abuso sini sa mga empleyado.
english: Even a former congressman, who is now hiding abroad, was allegedly paid by POGO to hide and defend its anomalies and abuses of employees.

text: Pati, kag labi na gid, ang mga kliyente sini nga ginaloko lang gali sa pasugal sang POGO nga sang ulihi ma-hostage kag makastigohan pa kon ma-delay sa pagbayad sang ginpautang sa ila sang POGO.
english: Even, and especially, its clients who are actually being cheated by POGO's gambling who will later be held hostage and punished if they delay in paying their loans.

text: Sobra pa gani ang nadangtan sang mga “missing sabungeros” nga may kahilabtanan sa e-Sabong (online cockfighting).
english: The “missing sabungeros” involved in e-Sabong (online cockfighting) have even suffered too much.

text: Nasapwan na gani ang mga bangkay sang pila sa ginsiling nga 30 ka sabungero nga ginbato-batohan kag gintagbong sa Taal Lake.
english: The bodies of some of the alleged 30 sabungero who were stoned and thrown into Taal Lake have even been found.

text: Angot sa sining iya privileged speech, ginapa-imbestigar na ni Hontiveros kon bala natabo gid man ining pagkadisgrasya sang na-invest nga pondo sang GSIS sa online gambling kag kon ano ka daku nga kantidad ini.
english: In connection with his privileged speech, Hontiveros said he is investigating whether the accident of the GSIS funds invested in online gambling really happened and how large the amount is.

text: Gin-suhestyon man niya gani nga kon tugtan pa ang pila ka online gambling indi lang i-promote sa online, sa iban lang nga paagi, kag dapat istriktuhon gid ang pagpatuman nga indi maka-entra sa pagtaya dira ang mga menor de edad.
english: He also suggested that if some online gambling is allowed, it should not be promoted online, but in other ways, and that enforcement should be strict so that minors cannot participate in betting there.

text: Kon matuod ining suspetso ni Hontiveros, tani indi maapektuhan ang social pension sang mga senior citizen nga P1,000 kada bulan kag mapadayon ang mga dugang nga benepisyo nga ginapatuman sang RA 11982.
english: If Hontiveros' suspicion is true, hopefully the social pension of senior citizens of P1,000 per month will not be affected and the additional benefits implemented by RA 11982 will continue.

text: Ining social pension sal-i ini seguro sa nursing home care nga ginapatigayon sang iban nga mga pungsod agud matatapan ang ila mga katigulangan sa gwa sang ila mga puluy-an.
english: This social pension is probably in addition to the nursing home care that other countries provide to care for their elderly outside their homes.

text: Labag ugaling ining klase sang live-in elderly care sang mga tigulang sa aton kultura nga nagakilala sang obligasyon sang mga kabataan agud sila mismo ang magtatap sa ila katigulangan balik man sa pagsapupo sadto sang mga ginikanan nila.
english: However, this kind of live-in elderly care of the elderly is contrary to our culture that recognizes the obligation of children to take care of their elderly themselves back to the care of their parents.

text: Ugaling, kulang seguro ang P1,000 kada bulan nga social pension.
english: However, the P1,000 monthly social pension is probably not enough.

text: Base sa akon experyensya nga senior citizen man, nagagasto ako sing indi magkulang sa  P3,000 kada bulan para sa akon maintenance medicine.
english: Based on my experience as a senior citizen, I spend at least P3,000 per month for my maintenance medicine.

text: Idugang pa dira ang luyag ko man kis-a nga makabakal-bakal sang makusam-kusam sa tyangge nga mga P1,500 kada bulan.
english: Add to that the fact that I sometimes want to buy something at the store for about P1,500 a month.

text: Well, sa aton kapid (mixed) nga ekonomiya (socialist/capitalist economy), nga ang obligasyon sa pangabuhi gina-share sang gobyerno kag sang mga pumuluyo, pwede na seguro mabuligan sang gobyerno ang mga kubos sa pangabuhi sing social pension nga P2,000, nga ang kulang sabton na sang ila kabataan nga may trabaho./PN
english: Well, in our mixed socialist/capitalist economy, where the obligation to live is shared by the government and the people, the government can probably help the poor with a social pension of P2,000, which will be covered by their children who have jobs.

text: Nag-ayo na ang kumpirmado nga kaso sang mpox sa probinsya sang Iloilo halin pa sang Mayo 23, suno sa Iloilo Provincial Health Office (IPHO).
english: The number of confirmed cases of mpox in Iloilo province has recovered since May 23, according to the Iloilo Provincial Health Office (IPHO).

text: Ginkumpirmar ini sang IPHO matapos ang 21 ka adlaw nga isolation kag wala na sang mga lesions.
english: The IPHO confirmed this after 21 days of isolation and no lesions.

text: Lima ka close contacts sang pasyente ang wala nagpakita sang sintomas sang mpox kag yara subong sa home quarantine.
english: Five close contacts of the patient did not show symptoms of mpox and are now under home quarantine.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay IPHO Head Dr. Maria Colmenares-Quiñon, Head sang Provincial Health Office, iya ginpahayag nga ginkumpirmar sang Research Institute for Tropical Medicine (RITM) ang positibo nga kaso matapos mapasa ang tatlo ka specimen para sa testing.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, IPHO Head Dr. Maria Colmenares-Quiñon, Head of the Provincial Health Office, said the Research Institute for Tropical Medicine (RITM) confirmed the positive case after three specimens were submitted for testing.

text: Duha sa mga sample ang nagnegatibo, samtang isa ang kumpirmado nga positibo.
english: Two of the samples tested negative, while one was confirmed positive.

text: Ang pasyente, nga wala sang travel history, subong yara sa home isolation kag padayon nga nagapahuway.
english: The patient, who has no travel history, is currently in home isolation and continues to rest.

text: Suno kay Quiñon, siyam ka close contacts sang pasyente ang nakilala na kag ginbutang man sa isolation, kag wala pa sang ginapakita nga sintomas tubtob subong.
english: Quiñon said nine close contacts of the patient have been identified and placed in isolation, and have not shown any symptoms so far.

text: Antes sini, una nga ginpahayag man sang Iloilo City Health Office nga may isa man nga kumpirmado nga kaso sang mpox kag apat ka suspected cases nga ginabantayan subong.
english: Earlier, the Iloilo City Health Office also said that there is also one confirmed case of mpox and four suspected cases that are currently being monitored.

text: Nagpanawagan naman si Dr. Quiñon sa publiko nga magpabilin nga kalmado apang magpabilin nga alerto, kag sundon gid ang tanan nga public health advisories.
english: Dr. Quiñon urged the public to remain calm but alert, and strictly follow all public health advisories.

text: Indi lang pag-suspend kundi dalayon gid nga pagbasura sa excise taxes sa produktong petrolyo ang ginaduso ni Gabriela Party-list Rep.
english: Gabriela Party-list Rep. Gabriela Party-list Rep.

text: Sarah Elago.
english: Sarah Elago.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Elago, iya ginpahayag nga daku nga buhin sa palas-anon sang mga Pilipino kun kakason ini nga buwis ilabi na nga may krisis subong sa langis nga ginaatubang sa pungsod nga epekto sang gyera sa Middle East.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Elago said the removal of the tax will greatly reduce the burden of Filipinos especially with the current oil crisis facing the country as a result of the war in the Middle East.

text: Yara subong sa P6 kada litro ang excise tax sa diesel, samtang P10 kada litro naman ang excise tax sa gasolina.
english: The excise tax on diesel is now at P6 per litre, while the excise tax on gasoline is P10 per litre.

text: Magluwas diri, ginaduso man sang kongresista ang pagkakas sang 12% nga Value Added Tax (VAT) sa serbisyo kag basic goods kaangay sang pagkaon, tubig, kag elekrisidad.
english: In addition, the congressman also proposes the abolition of the 12% Value Added Tax (VAT) on services and basic goods such as food, water, and electricity.

text: Nahibaluan nga madugay na ginapamatukan women’s group nga Gabriela ang implementasyon sini nga buwis bangud sang bug-at nga dala sini sa working class.
english: It is known that women's group Gabriela has long opposed the implementation of this tax because of the burden it brings to the working class.

text: Sa nauna nga mga protesta, ginlaragway sang grupo ini nga buwis bilang awtomatiko nga palas-anon nga naga-igo sa mga pigado sa kada tion nga may yara sila sang baklon.
english: In earlier protests, the group described this tax as an automatic burden that hits the poor every time they have something to buy.

text: Sa pihak nga bahin, matandaan nga ginsertipikahan na ni President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.
english: Meanwhile, it can be recalled that President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.

text: bilang urgent ang hagna sa Kamara nga amo ang magatugot sa presidente nga i-suspend ukon buhinan ang excise taxes sa petroleum products kun may yara sang national ukon global economic emergencies.
english: as urgent the bill in the House that would allow the president to suspend or reduce excise taxes on petroleum products in the event of national or global economic emergencies.

text: Sa idalom sang amo nga hagna, mahimo ma-adjust sang presidente ang excise tax sa fuel sandig sa mga rekomendasyon halin sa Development Budget Coordination Committee kag sa Department of Energy apang subject pa sa pila ka mga kondisyon.#
english: Under the bill, the president can adjust the excise tax on fuel based on recommendations from the Development Budget Coordination Committee and the Department of Energy but subject to certain conditions.

text: Ginhangkat sang grupo nga Bayan Panay ang mga local nga opisyal sang siyudad sang Iloilo nga mag-commute.
english: The group Bayan Panay challenged local officials of Iloilo City to commute.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Elmer Forro, Secretary General sang Bayan Panay, iya ginpahayag nga dapat mabatyagan man sang mga opisyal ang kabudlay sang mga commuters nga naga-antos sa kakulang sang Public Utility Vehicle (PUV), overloaded nga mga modernized jeepney, kag magutok nga dalan sa siyudad.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Elmer Forro, Secretary General of Bayan Panay, said officials should also feel the plight of commuters who are suffering from the lack of Public Utility Vehicles (PUVs), overloaded modernized jeepneys, and congested roads in the city.

text: Ginpaathag ni Forro nga dugay na ini nga problema sang siyudad, apang hasta subong, wala gihapon ini nasolusyunan.
english: Forro explained that this is a long-standing problem of the city, but until now, it has not been resolved.

text: Nagpanawagan man ang grupo sa publiko nga mag-upod sa ila kampanya kontra kurapsyon kag ipangabay sa lokal nga gobyerno ang nagakaangay nga solusyon sa problema sa transportasyon.
english: The group also called on the public to join their anti-corruption campaign and ask the local government for an appropriate solution to the transportation problem.

text: Ginhatagan man nila importansya ang accountability sang mga opisyal sang gobyerno sang Pilipinas nga ginakabig nga kurap.
english: They also emphasized the accountability of Philippine government officials who are considered corrupt.

text:
“Ginuo, amo bala ini ang gusto mo sa akon?”

Pila ka beses nga ginpamangkot ni Aura Landar ang Ginuo bangud sang asud-asud nga mga pagtilaw sa kabuhi nga nagtakos sang iya pagtuo.
english:
“Lord, is this what you want from me?”

Aura Landar asked the Lord several times because of the many trials in life that tested her faith.

text: Sa iya repleksyon sa Siete Palabras sa Jaro Metropolitan Cathedral subong nga hapon, nagsentro ang testimoniya ni Landar sang St.
english: In his reflection at the Siete Palabras at the Jaro Metropolitan Cathedral this afternoon, Landar's testimony focused on St.

text:
William Parish sa Passi City sa ikaapat nga pulong: “Dios ko, Dios ko, ngaa bala ginpatumbayaan mo ako?”

Panugiron sini, baliskad sa opinyon nga ang nagaserbisyo sa simbahan, indi malingkang, wala ginakapoy, kag puno sang determinasyon, puno sang mga masakit nga hitabo ang iya inagyan.
english:
William Parish in Passi City in the fourth word: “My God, my God, why have you forsaken me?”

He said that, contrary to the opinion that those who serve the church, do not give up, do not get tired, and are full of determination, his experience is full of painful events.

text: Sang 2010, napatay ang iya anak nga naga-edad sadto sang nueve anyos bangud sa dengue.
english: In 2010, her then nine-year-old son died of dengue.

text: “Ginuo, ano bala ang sala ko ngaa ginbawi mo siya sa akon?
english: “Lord, what have I done wrong that you have taken him away from me?

text: Wala pa gani ako maayawi sa iya,” pamangkot sini sa Ginuo bangud sa sobra nga kasakit sa pagtaliwan sang anak sa lamharon nga edad.
english: I haven't even been healed by him,” she asked the Lord because of the pain of losing her son at a young age.

text: Wala pa diri nag-untat ang pagtilaw.
english: The testing hasn’t stopped here.

text: Sang 2021, may pagpanghangkat sa iya nga ikaayong-lawas.
english: In 2021, there was a challenge to his health.

text: Inadlaw matapos nahibaluan ang iya balatian, naaresto ang iya bana bangud sa kaso nga murder.
english: Days after her illness was diagnosed, her husband was arrested on murder charges.

text: Duha ka semana ang nagligad, napatay ang iya Nanay Auring nga amo ang nag-giya sang iya pagtuo, ang iya “idol” nga amo ang nagtulod sa iya sa pagserbisyo sa simbahan.
english: Two weeks ago, his Nanay Auring who guided his faith, his “idol” who pushed him to serve the church, died.

text: “Sa sulod sang isa ka bulan, pamatyag ko gintakluban ako sang langit,” suno pa kay Landar.
english: “For a month, I felt like the sky was covering me,” Landar said.

text: May mga tion suno sa iya nga nagapungko siya kag ginakwestyon ang Ginuo kun ano gid bala ang pagbuot para sa iya.
english: He said there are times when he sits and questions the Lord about what He really wants for him.

text: Sa ikaduha nga bahin sang iya repleksyon, ginsugid naman ni Landar ang mga pagtilaw kadungan sang iya nga pagserbisyo sa simbahan.
english: In the second part of his reflection, Landar told of the trials he experienced during his service in the church.

text: “May mga gab-i nga ginaprangka ko si Lord, ‘Ginuo, gusto ko pa magserbisyo, pero ngaa pamatyag ko, nagapalayo na ako sa Simbahan?
english: “There are nights when I tell the Lord frankly, ‘Lord, I still want to serve, but why do I feel like I’m drifting away from the Church?

text: Ngaa nga naga-isahanon na lang ako?
english: Why am I alone?

text: Buhi pa bala ang akon pagtuo sa Imo?
english: Is my faith in You still alive?

text:
Ginuo, ginapatumbayaan mo bala ako?”

Sa pihak sini tanan suno kay Landar, diri nga mga pagtilaw kag mas nahangpan niya sang mas madalom ang paghilibion ni Hesus sang ginlansang siya sa Krus.
english:
Lord, are you forsaking me?”

Despite all this, Landar said, these trials and he understood more deeply the tears of Jesus when he was crucified.

text: “It was not a loss of faith, but a cry from a wounded heart.
english: “It was not a loss of faith, but a cry from a wounded heart.

text: Wala ako nadulaan sang pagtuo, kundi isa ini ka paghilibion sang napilasan nga tagipusuon.
english: I did not lose faith, but it was a lament of a wounded heart.

text: Nagahigugma, nagatuo, kag nagaserbisyo,” dugang niya.
english: Loving, believing, and serving,” he added.

text: Nagpadayon siya sa pagpangalagad sa Simbahan, ilabi na sa bulig sang mga nagapamati kag naga-upod sa iya nga wala nagahusgar, kag naga-upod sa iya sa tion sang kahuyang.
english: He continued to serve the Church, especially with the help of those who listened and accompanied him without judgment, and accompanied him in times of weakness.

text: “Ang panahon sang kabudlay wala nag-guba sang akon pagtuo, kundi ginpapuraw sini ang akon misyon.” dugang niya.
english: “The time of hardship did not destroy my faith, but it brightened my mission.” he added.

text: “Nagapadayon ako sa pagserbisyo tungod sa Diyos, tungod may mga kalag nga nagakinahanglan nga giyahan.
english: “I continue to serve for God, because there are souls who need guidance.

text:
Kag sa akon pagpanglakaton, gina-updan ako sang Diyos sa bokasyon nga akon ginpili.”

Sa iya padayon nga pagpanglakaton kag sa pag-balikid sini sa mga natabo sa iya kabuhi, sarang gid mahambal ni Landar nga tudok sa iya tagipusuon nga: “Ang pagserbisyo sa simbahan isa ka pagbalik sa Diyos sa tanan nga grasya kag bugay nga iya ginhatag sa akon.
english:
And in my journey, God is with me in the vocation I have chosen.”

In his continued journey and looking back on the events of his life, Landar can say from the bottom of his heart: “Serving in the church is a return to God for all the grace and blessings he has given me.

text: Isa gid ang klaro sa akon subong.
english: One thing is very clear to me now.

text: Wala ako ginpatumbayaaan sang Diyos.
english: God has not abandoned me.

text: Amen.”
english: Amen.”

text: Nagdiretso na ang Filipina tennis star nga si Alex Eala sa second round sang 2026 Dubai Tennis Championships matapos nga nakaangkon sang injury ang iya kasumpong.
english: Filipina tennis star Alex Eala has advanced to the second round of the 2026 Dubai Tennis Championships after her opponent suffered an injury.

text: Sa first set sang hampang, daog si Eala batok kay Hailey Baptiste, 6-4, apang nakabawi ang American player sa second frame, 1-0, antes ini nagkinahanglan sang treatment bangud sa abdomen pain.
english: In the first set of the match, Eala won against Hailey Baptiste, 6-4, but the American player recovered in the second frame, 1-0, before requiring treatment for abdomen pain.

text: Suno kay Eala, wala sang bisan sin-o nga player nga luyag mag-abante sa masunod nga round paagi sini.
english: Eala said neither player wants to advance to the next round through this.

text: “Obviously, no one likes advancing in this way,” suno kay Eala.
english: “Obviously, no one likes advancing in this way,” according to Eala.

text: “Being on tour, I’m starting to discover at this level how difficult it is to maintain your health physically.
english: “Being on tour, I’m starting to discover at this level how difficult it is to maintain your health physically.

text:
I hope Hailey is okay and will bounce back soon.”

Nagalaum siya nga mangin maayo ang kondisyon ni Baptiste nga subong nagapang-39 sa world rankings.
english:
I hope Hailey is okay and will bounce back soon.”

He hopes that Baptiste, who is currently ranked 39th in the world rankings, will be in good condition.

text: Sunod nga atubangon ni Eala si World no.
english: Eala will next face World no.
