text: Pagtimalos.
english: Revenge.

text: Sa bata pa lamang nga edad, nagtudok na sa tagipusuon ni Erica Joy Adeva nga himuon ini ilabi na bangud sa natabo sa iya amay — ginpaarakan sang luthang, may 10 ka igu sang bala, anum sa ulo, kag apat sa lawas.
english: At an early age, Erica Joy Adeva decided to do this especially because of what happened to her father — he was shot, with 10 bullet wounds, six in the head, and four in the body.

text: “Grabe ang akon kauhaw sa pagtimalos.
english: “I have a great thirst for revenge.

text: Akig, dumot, kag aligutgot nga masyado ka bug-at dal-on sang bata ko nga tagipusuon ang natuga,” suno kay Erica sa iya nga repleksyon sa Siete Palabras sa Jaro Metropolitan Cathedral subong nga hapon, Abril 3.
english: Anger, hatred, and resentment that is too heavy for my child's heart to carry,” Erica said in her reflection at Siete Palabras at the Jaro Metropolitan Cathedral this afternoon, April 3.

text:
Nagsentro ang iya testimoniya sa ika-lima nga pulong ni Kristo: “Gina-uhaw ako.”

Suno kay Erica, bangud sa kamatayon sang iya amay, nagdaku man siya nga kulang sa seguridad, may kahisa sa iban, kag kulang — indi pareho sa iban nga kabataan nga may kumpleto nga myembro sang pamilya.
english:
His testimony centered on the fifth word of Christ: “I thirst.”

According to Erica, because of her father's death, she also grew up insecure, jealous of others, and lacking — unlike other children who have complete family members.

text: Pahayag sini, may mga tion nga nagahambal ang iya iloy nga buligan siya sa pagpangamuyo nga makasulod ini sa public school agud nga makatibawas sila sa kapigaduhon.
english: He said there were times when his mother would tell him to help her pray that she would get into public school so that they could get out of poverty.

text: “Sa sulod sang akon huna-huna, may pamangkot nga indi ko mapunggan.
english: “In the back of my mind, there was a question I couldn’t help but ask.

text: ‘Ngaa may Diyos pa haw?
english: 'Why is there a God?

text: Kun may Diyos gid man, tani wala sang bata nga gina-uhaw sa paghigugma sang amay.
english: If there is a God, no child would be thirsty for a father's love.

text:
Kun may Diyos gid man, tani wala sang bata nga amo sini kabug-at ang ginadala sa iya kaugalingon.'”

Apisar sini nga “kauhaw”, nakilala ni Erica ang Ang Dios Gugma Community nga amo ang nagpabalik sang iya pagpati sa Diyos.
english:
If there is a God, I hope no child carries such a burden on himself.'”

Despite this “thirst”, Erica met the Ang Dios Gugma Community which restored her faith in God.

text: Paagi sa amo nga komunidad kag ila pagserbisyo suno kay Erica, na-islan sang pagpatawad, paglaum, kag pagpalangga ang iya ginbatyag halin sa bata nga edad.
english: Through that community and their service, Erica said, the forgiveness, hope, and love she felt from a young age were replaced.

text: Apang indi man mahapos ang banas para kay Erica.
english: But the path hasn’t been easy for Erica either.

text: Sang nakatapos na siya sa pag-eskwela kag nagaproseso na para nga makatudlo sa public school, na-diagnose man nga may breast cancer ang iya iloy.
english: When she finished school and was in the process of teaching in public school, her mother was also diagnosed with breast cancer.

text: Pahayag sini, madamo gid siya sang handum para sa iya nga iloy kag naga-amat-amat pa lang kuntani siya sa pagbawi sa mga sakripisyo sini nga ginhimo sa ila nga mag-ulutod.
english: He said he had many dreams for his mother and was slowly recovering from the sacrifices she made for them.

text: “Ang kontra ko, oras.
english: “My opponent is time.

text: Oras nga sa paglab-ot ko sini tanan, nagasige man sa pagluya ang akon nanay bangud sa iya masakit,” suno kay Erica.
english: While I was achieving all this, my mother was getting weaker because of her illness,” Erica said.

text: Sang ulihi, nagdangat na sa stage 4 ang cancer sang iya iloy.
english: Eventually, his mother's cancer reached stage 4.

text: “Ang akon kauhaw nga ginbulong sang Ginuo sang nagligad nga mga tinuig, liwat nabuksan.
english: “My thirst that the Lord cured years ago, has once again been uncovered.

text: Mas madalom nga kauhaw.
english: Deeper thirst.

text:
Ang kauhaw sa purpose sang akon existence.”

Nagtaliwan ang iloy ni Erica antes pa man sini dalayon nga malab-ot ang iya mga handum.
english:
The thirst for the purpose of my existence.”

Erica's mother passed away before she could consistently achieve her goals.

text: Binulan ang nagligad, ginpatawag siya agud magproseso para nga mangin regular school teacher nga amo na kuntani ang katumanan sang iya handum.
english: Months later, she was summoned to process to become a regular school teacher which would have been the fulfillment of her dream.

text: “Sa grasya sang kaisog nga ginhatag sang Diyos, gin-waive ko ang akon item.
english: “By the grace of God-given courage, I waived my item.

text: Ginsunod ko ang singgit sang akon tagipusuon nga indi magsulod sa public school, kag padayunon ang pag-serve sa Ginuo paagi sa pagpanglakaton sa community,” panugiron sini.
english: I followed the cry of my heart not to go to public school, and continue to serve the Lord by walking in the community,” she said.

text: Apisar wala sang palangabuhian kag apisar nga wala na sang ginikanan nga amo ang magabulig sa ila sang iya kauturan, ginpili sini ang pagsunod ang ‘calling” sa “Ang Dios Gugma Youth Ministry” sa Western Visayas.
english: Despite having no livelihood and despite having no parents to help them and his siblings, he chose to follow his calling in “Ang Dios Gugma Youth Ministry” in Western Visayas.

text: Isa ka tuig ang nagligad, nag-abot sa iya ang pribilehiyo nga makasulod sa Ang Dios Gugma Catholic School Inc.
english: A year later, the privilege of entering The God of Love Catholic School Inc. came to her.

text: rason nga nakabalik siya sa iya propesyon nga una na sini nga ginpaiway.
english: reason why he was able to return to his profession that he had previously avoided.

text: “It was His redirection,” suno kay Erica.
english: “It was His redirection,” according to Erica.

text: Paagi sa amo nga eskwelahan suno kay Erica, nakilala sini ang kabataan nga uhaw man sa pagpalangga, pagtatap, kag presensya sang Diyos nga sarang gid niya mabuligan.
english: Through the school, Erica said, she met children who were also thirsty for the love, care, and presence of God that she could help.

text: Sa iya pagbalik sa iya mga inagyan subong nga Semana Santa, nagpahayag si Erica, “Diyos ang nakahibalo sang palaabuton nga akon ginalauman.
english: Looking back on her experiences this Easter, Erica stated, “God knows the future I hope for.

text: Nahibaluan sang Diyos nga sa amo ni nga tinion, mangin ilo ako nga lubos sabagay nga ginbutang niya ako sa komunidad nga madamo ang akon instant tatay kag nanay.
english: God knew that at this time, I would be a complete orphan because he placed me in a community where I had many instant fathers and mothers.

text: Instant nga mga kauturan kay Kristo nga makabulig sa journey padulong sa duog nga wala sang kauhaw kag wala sang kasakit —ang langit.”
english: Instant brothers and sisters in Christ who can help the journey to the place where there is no thirst and no pain—heaven.”

text: Ginpaathag sang katapo sang Bureau of Fire Protection (BFP) nga wala sila nagkulang sa pagresponde sa sunog nga nagluntad sa Barangay Balabago, Jaro, Iloilo City kaina sang kaagahon.
english: Members of the Bureau of Fire Protection (BFP) explained that they did not fail to respond to the fire that broke out in Barangay Balabago, Jaro, Iloilo City this morning.

text: Ini matapos ginbatikos ang ahensya bangud sa alegasyon nga mahinay ang ila pagresponde sa insidente nga nagresulta sa pagkamatay sang 24-anyos nga isa ka Criminology graduate.
english: This comes after the agency was criticized for allegedly slow response to the incident that resulted in the death of a 24-year-old Criminology graduate.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Senior Fire Officer 1 (SFO) Denmark Macoco, Chief Investigator sang Iloilo Fire Station, iya ginpahayag nga nakabaton ang ila estasyon sang fire call las-3:08 sang kaagahon kag gilayon man sila nga nagresponde pakadto sa lugar sang insidente.
english: Senior Fire Officer 1 (SFO) Denmark Macoco, Chief Investigator of the Iloilo Fire Station, said the station received a fire call at 3:08 am and immediately responded to the scene.

text: Suno pa kay Macoco, las-3:38 sang kaagahon gindeklarar nga fire under control ang nasambit nga sunog, nga nagapakita nga madasig ang ila pagresponde sa nasambit nga insidente.
english: Macoco said the fire was declared fire under control at 3:38 am, indicating that they responded quickly to the incident.

text: Ang amo nga pahayag sang BFP ang nagaathag sa una nga pahayag sang pamilya sang biktima nga nag-alegar nga halos isa ka oras antes nakaresponde ang mga bombero sa lugar.
english: The statement of the BFP clarifies the initial statement of the victim's family who alleged that it took almost an hour before firefighters responded to the scene.

text: Magabalik ang BTS sa Pilipinas para sa ila world tour sa 2027!
english: BTS will return to the Philippines for their world tour in 2027!

text: Sa announcement sang Big Hit Music subong nga gab-i, nakalista ang Manila para sa duha ka adlaw nga show sa Marso 13-14.
english: In the announcement of Big Hit Music tonight, Manila is listed for the two-day show on March 13-14.

text: Ang BTS World Tour 2026-2027 amo ang ila nga una nga global performance matapos nakumpleto nila ang ila nga mandatory military service sa South Korea.
english: The BTS World Tour 2026-2027 will be their first global performance after completing their mandatory military service in South Korea.

text:
Katapusan nga naka-perform ang BTS sa Manila sa Mall of Asia Arena sadtong 2017 para sa “BTS Live Trilogy Episode III: The Wings Tour.”

Ini nga K-Pop supergroup ang ginabug-usan nanday RM, Jin, j-hope, Jimin, Suga, V, kag Jungkook.
english:
BTS last performed in Manila at the Mall of Asia Arena in 2017 for “BTS Live Trilogy Episode III: The Wings Tour.”

This K-Pop supergroup consists of RM, Jin, j-hope, Jimin, Suga, V, and Jungkook.

text: Balantayan man ang ila ipaguwa nga ika-lima nga album sa Marso matapos ang hiatus sang grupo halin sang 2022.
english: Their fifth album is also expected to be released in March after the group's hiatus since 2022.

text: Sa recent announcement sang BigHit Music, ini nga bag-o nga record ang naga-unod sang 14 tracks.
english: In BigHit Music’s recent announcement, this new record contains 14 tracks.

text: “The members were deeply involved in the creation of the songs, infusing their own thoughts and colors into them while musically expressing the emotions and struggles they have experienced along their journey,” suno sa BigHit.
english: “The members were deeply involved in the creation of the songs, infusing their own thoughts and colors into them while musically expressing the emotions and struggles they have experienced along their journey,” according to BigHit.

text: “Filled with the music that’s most true to BTS, the album is their heartfelt way of saying thank you to ARMY, who have been there this whole time,” dugang pa sang label.
english: “Filled with the music that’s most true to BTS, the album is their heartfelt way of saying thank you to ARMY, who have been there this whole time,” the label added.

text: Available na para sa pre-order ang album umpisa sa Enero 16 sa South Korea (11:00 a.m.), ukon 10:00 a.m. oras sa Pilipinas.#
english: The album will be available for pre-order starting January 16 in South Korea (11:00 a.m.), or 10:00 a.m. Philippine time.#

text: Iga-implementar subong nga Myerkules Santo ang half-day work from home arrangement para sa tanan nga naga-trabaho sa gobyerno.
english: The half-day work from home arrangement will be implemented this Good Wednesday for all government employees.

text: Sa idalom sini nga arrangement, ang tanan nga personnel sang gobyerno ang mahimo mag-trabaho sa ila nga mga balay halin 8:00 sa aga tubtub 12:00 sa udto, samtang suspendido naman ang trabaho halin sa udto panaog.
english: Under this arrangement, all government personnel can work from their homes from 8:00 am to 12:00 noon, while work is suspended from noon onwards.

text: Sa idalom sang Memorandum Circular No.
english: Under Memorandum Circular No.

text: 116, ginpaathag ni Executive Secretary Ralph Recto nga ang ginpanubo nga trabaho subong nga adlaw ang ginhimo agud nga mahatagan sang opurtunidad ang mga empleyado sang gobyerno nga mag-obserbar sang Huwebes Santo kag Byernes Santo sa Abril 2 kag 3.
english: 116, Executive Secretary Ralph Recto explained that the reduced work today was done to give government employees the opportunity to observe Good Thursday and Good Friday on April 2 and 3.

text: Bangud sa sini nga schedule, mahatagan sila sang ligwa nga makabyahe sa mga rehiyon ukon sa ila tagsa ka mga probinsya para sa malawig nga break.
english: Because of this schedule, they will be given the freedom to travel to the regions or their respective provinces for long breaks.

text: Apang ginklaro sa order nga magapadayon naman sa kinaandan nga mga operasyon ang mga ahensya nga nagahatag sang basic and health service, preparedness response sa disasters and calamities, kag iban pa pa nga vital services.
english: However, the order clarified that agencies providing basic and health services, preparedness response to disasters and calamities, and other vital services will continue with normal operations.

text: Magadepende naman sa mga employer kun sundon man ang work from home set-up kag ang suspension sang trabaho para sa Semana Santa.
english: It will be up to employers whether to follow the work from home set-up and the suspension of work for Easter.

text: Nahibaluan nga pila ka tuig na nga ginasunod ang work-from-home schedule sa kada Myerkules Santo sa Pilipinas kun sa diin kadam-an sa nagapuyo ang mga Katoliko.#
english: The work-from-home schedule has been followed for several years every Holy Wednesday in the Philippines where the majority of the population is Catholic.

text: Nagpanugyan ang public health expert sa publiko nga ipabilin ang healthy lifestyle agud nga malikawan ang makaangkon sang hypertension ukon high blood pressure.
english: The public health expert advised the public to maintain a healthy lifestyle to avoid developing hypertension or high blood pressure.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Dr. Philip Ian Padilla, Assistant to the Director for the Philippines Genome Center, iya ginpahayag nga agod malikawan ang hypertension, importante nga i-maintain ang healthy lifestyle.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Dr. Philip Ian Padilla, Assistant to the Director for the Philippines Genome Center, said that to prevent hypertension, it is important to maintain a healthy lifestyle.

text: Nagalakip ini sang pagkaon sang balance diet nga manubo sa asin kag saturated fats.
english: This includes eating a balance diet that is low in salt and saturated fats.

text: Ang regular nga pisikal nga aktibidad makabulig man sa pag-maintain sang imo presyon sang dugo.
english: Regular physical activity can also help maintain your blood pressure.

text: Suno kay Padilla, ang paglikaw sa sobra nga pag-inom sang alkohol kag pag-untat sa pagpanigarilyo amo man ang mga yabi nga tikang.
english: According to Padilla, avoiding excessive alcohol consumption and quitting smoking are also key steps.

text: Dugang pa, ang pagdumala sang stress kag pag-maintain sang isa ka healthy nga kabug-aton ang makapanubo sang risgo nga mag-angkon sang high blood.
english: In addition, managing stress and maintaining a healthy weight can reduce the risk of developing high blood pressure.

text: Nagpangabay man ini sa publiko nga regular nga magpa-checkup sa isa ka healthcare provider agud nga mabantayan ang blood pressure kag pag-angkon sang bisan ano nga mga problema sa ikaayong-lawas.
english: He also urged the public to regularly checkup with a healthcare provider to monitor blood pressure and develop any health problems.

text: Naglunsar sang missile attack ang Houthis sa Yemen batok sa Israel kahapon nga adlaw suno sa Iran.
english: The Houthis in Yemen launched a missile attack against Israel yesterday, Iran said.

text: Suno sa amo nga grupo nga magapadayon ang ila operasyon samtang indi mag-untat ang ginatawag nila nga “aggression” sang Israel kag Iran.
english: The group said it will continue its operations as long as what it calls “aggression” between Israel and Iran does not stop.

text: Ginpahayag naman sang Israel nga na-intercept sang mga ini ang missile sang Yemen.
english: Israel said it intercepted the Yemeni missile.

text: Nahibaluan nga kilala ang amo nga grupo sa ila abilidad nga maglunsar sang atake apisar sang distansya sang ila target kag amo man sa pagsabotahe sang mga barko nga nagalabay sa Red Sea.
english: The group is known for its ability to launch attacks despite the distance of their target and also for sabotaging ships passing through the Red Sea.

text: Makatulublag kag halos indi mapatihan ang isa ka case report nga ginpaguwa sang United States National Library of Medicine kaangot sa isa ka lalaki nga nadiskubrehan nga may kutsilyo sa iya dughan sa sulod na sang walo ka tuig.
english: A case report released by the United States National Library of Medicine involving a man who was found with a knife in his chest for eight years is disturbing and almost unbelievable.

text: Ini nga lalaki naga-edad sang 44-anyos kag tumandok sang Tanzania sa East Africa.
english: This man is 44-years-old and a native of Tanzania in East Africa.

text: Nangayo ini sang bulig sa mga doktor matapos nakit-an sini ang nana nga nagaguwa sa iya nga right nipple.
english: She sought medical help after she found pus coming out of her right nipple.

text: Wala siya sang na-eksperyensyahan nga pagpalanakit sang dughan, kabudlay sa pagginhawa, ubo, ukon hilanat, apang gin-ako sini nga walo ka tuig ang nakaligad, na-involve siya sang isa ka away kag nakaangkon sang samad sa iya nga nawong, likod, dughan, kag tiyan.
english: He did not experience chest pain, difficulty breathing, cough, or fever, but admitted that eight years ago, he was involved in a fight and sustained injuries to his face, back, chest, and abdomen.

text: Ginhatagan lang siya ang first aid halin sa primary health facility kag gintahi ang iya mga pilas, apang wala na sang body scans nga ginhimo bangud limitado man ang pasilidad sa ila nga lugar.
english: He was given first aid from the primary health facility and his wounds were stitched, but no body scans were done because of limited facilities in their area.

text: Apang sang nagguwa na ang nana, ginpa-X-ray ang lalaki, kag didto nakit-an sang mga doktor ang metallic object nga isa gali ka kutsilyo sa tuo nga bahin sang iya nga dughan.
english: But when the pus came out, the man was X-rayed, and there doctors found a metallic object that turned out to be a knife in the right side of his chest.

text: Gilayon nga gin-operahan ang lalaki kag ginkuha ang kutsilyo nga napalibutan na sang nana kag necrotic tissue.
english: The man was immediately operated on and the knife, which was already covered with pus and necrotic tissue, was removed.

text: Gin-monitor ang kondisyon sang lalaki kag ginpaguwa man sa ospital makaligad ang 10 ka adlaw.
english: The man's condition was monitored and he was discharged from the hospital after 10 days.

text: Bisan pa nga nag-recover ini sang mayo, nagakahangawa ang researchers nga may risgo nga dala ang halos isa ka dekada nga pagtinir sang kutsilyo sa iya lawas nga mahimo pa magresulta sa kamatayon.
english: Although he recovered well, researchers are concerned that there is a risk that nearly a decade of keeping the knife in his body could result in death.

text: “The prolonged asymptomatic period likely resulted from the body’s ability to encapsulate the foreign body within a fibrous capsule, limiting inflammation and tissue damage.

text: Ini nga adaptive response suno sa report ang mahimo nga magatabon sang seryoso nga kumplikasyon.

text: Kasunod sini, gina-engganyo sa report ang “increased awareness and improved protocols for trauma management, safe surgery and safe anaesthesia in low-resource settings” kag dapat ang mga pasyente ang i-refer gid gilayon sa higher-level healthcare facilities nga amo ang makahatag sang comprehensive diagnostic kag surgical care nga kinahanglanon.#

text: Nagsarurot sa panibag-o nga historic low ang balor sang Philippine Peso batok sa US dollar subong nga adlaw, Marso 13.

english: The local currency closed at P59.735 per US dollar.

text: Sang Lunes, P59.50 ang peso sa kada dollar nga amo na ang pinakamaluya nga lebel antes ang trading subong nga Byernes.
english: On Monday, the peso was at P59.50 per dollar, the weakest level before Friday's trading.

text: Kun nagaluya ang balor sang peso, mas naga-kumplikado pa ang sitwasyon sa enerhiya sa Pilipinas bangud nagamahal ang imported goods lakip na ang langis bangud gina-purchase ang langis paagi sa dolyar.
english: When the peso weakens, the energy situation in the Philippines becomes more complicated because imported goods including oil become more expensive because oil is purchased in dollars.

text: Magluwas diri, bangud man sang pagluya sang peso, may impact man ini sa utang sang Pilipinas, ilabi na nga one-third sang amo nga utang ang naghalin sa foreign creditors ukon mga manugpautang halin sa luwas sang pungsod.
english: In addition, due to the weakening of the peso, it also has an impact on the Philippine debt, especially that one-third of the debt comes from foreign creditors or lenders from abroad.

text: Una na nga ginsiling ni President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.
english: Earlier, President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.

text: nga indi sini luyag nga makalapaw ang peso sa 60 pesos sa kada isa ka dolyar, bangud kun magluya ang balor sang Peso, pat-od nga magatimbuok na naman ang balayran sa utang.
english: that he does not want the peso to exceed 60 pesos per dollar, because if the value of the peso weakens, the debt will surely increase again.

text: SA PAGHINUNOD na sang tauhanon nga kabuhi sa amat-amat man nga pagpadulong sini sa inangan sang kabuhi nga dayon (next life in the immortal spirit), mas gabaskug man ang panghagad sang mga nagliligad agud balikan ang mga ini para sa mas makahulugan nga pagtamod sa gapahunas na nga kabuhi tauhanon.
english: AS human life gradually approaches the next life in the immortal spirit, the invitation of the past to return to them for a more meaningful view of the fading human life is becoming stronger.

text: Isa sa sining makahulugan nga nagliligad ko amo kon paano nasolbar namon ang amon problema sadto sa tubig halin sa MIWD – kasosyo na ini karon sang MPIW – dira sa Panay News Compound Area.
english: One of these meaningful experiences of mine is how we solved our water problem from MIWD – now a partner of MPIW – here in the Panay News Compound Area.

text: Nakasaylo na kami sadto, sa hingyo ni asawahon, sa ila puluy-an diri sa PN Compound Area sadtong 1993.
english: We had already moved, at the request of my wife, to their home here in PN Compound Area in 1993.

text: Gin-okupar namon ang kwarto ni asawahon sadtong dalaga pa siya.
english: We occupied my wife's room when she was a girl.

text: Amat-amat namon ini na-extend tubtub may kaugalingon na kami nga kusina kag CR nga nadugangan pa sang gamay nga sala kag isa ka kwarto.
english: We gradually extended it until we had our own kitchen and CR plus a small living room and a bedroom.

text: Sadto, gatrabaho ako gihapon sa Panay News nga ang editorial compound  tupad gid namon.
english: At that time, I was still working at Panay News whose editorial compound was right next to us.

text: Sa karon, nangin residential home na lang ini sang ginsaylo sang Panay News ang editorial office sini sa Maliao, Pavia.
english: Now, it has become a residential home when Panay News moved its editorial office to Maliao, Pavia.

text: Gatrabaho ako sadto bilang tagbalita (reporter) kag sang ulihi bilang weekend editor, tubtub ginbaton ko ang tanyag nga mangin editor-in-chief sang isa man ka daily newspaper diri sa siyudad para masuporta sing mas maayo ang akon pamilya nga upod na ang amon duha ka kabataan.
english: I used to work as a reporter and later as a weekend editor, until I accepted the offer to become editor-in-chief of another daily newspaper here in the city to better support my family including our two children.

text: Pulos babaye kag mga propesyonal na ini sila sa karon.
english: They are all women and professionals now.

text: Sa pag-retire ko na sa SSS, nga may diutay nga pension agud makabakal sang akon maintenance medicine, ginhingyo ako ni PN publisher Danny Fajardo÷ nga magsulat liwat – sang kolum na sa Ilonggo.
english: When I retired from the SSS, with a small pension to buy my maintenance medicine, PN publisher Danny Fajardo÷ asked me to write again – a column in Ilonggo.

text: No problem kay nangin editor man ako sadto sang sister publication sa Ilonggo sang una nga English newspaper nga ginsayluhan ko bilang editor-in-chief.
english: No problem because I was also the editor of the sister publication in Ilonggo of the first English newspaper that I moved to as editor-in-chief.

text: Kag karon, yari na ako nga gasulat sang akon kolum nga Hilway nga Panugdaon diri sa Panay News.
english: And now, here I am writing my column Free Suggestion here in Panay News.

text:
***

Natung-an namon diri sang amon gina-istaran sa PN Compound Area kag sang main road sang Q. Abeto St.
english:
***

We are located between our residence in PN Compound Area and the main road of Q. Abeto St.

text: sa Mandurriao ang sadto na-abandonar na nga Philippine Oil Drilling Company (Podco).
english: in Mandurriao the then abandoned Philippine Oil Drilling Company (Podco).

text: Sa masami, ugaling, ginalakip pa namon nga mga pumuluyo ang ngalan nga Podco sa amon mga address agud mas mahapos matultulan kami diri.
english: Often, however, we residents still include the name Podco in our addresses to make it easier to find us here.

text: Diri sa Podco nahamtang pa sadto ang daan nga gripo sang MIWD, nga nahamtang man sa tupad sang  dalan nga gintukod sang Podco.
english: The old MIWD tap was located here in Podco, which was also located next to the road built by Podco.

text: Mga 200 ka metro ang layo sini halin sa main road kag 200 man ka metro pakadto sa amon gina-istaran, kon diin kinahanglan sang madamo ang mag-antos gid sa pagpanag-ob dira sang tubig sang MIWD.
english: It is about 200 meters away from the main road and 200 meters to our place of residence, where many have to struggle to get water from MIWD.

text: Ang iban dira may jetmatic pump, ang isa may dug well nga gina-motor ang tubig paibawbaw sa ila ikaduha nga panalgan, kag ang isa pa (Panay News Compound) may dug well man nga may elevated nga water tank.
english: Some of them have jetmatic pumps, one has a dug well that motors the water up to their second floor, and the other (Panay News Compound) also has a dug well with an elevated water tank.

text: Apang kami nagapanag-ob gid, kay sa amon jetmatic pump ang nagagwa baho langis nga nabilin pa sang Podco, nga ginpasarhan na namon.
english: But we are really worried, because our jetmatic pump smells of oil that is still left by Podco, which we have already passed.

text: Daku nga problema matuod ini sa amon.
english: This is a big problem for us.

text: Kag namensaron na ako kon ano ang maayo.
english: And I've thought about what's good.

text:
***

Natabuan sadto nga co-founder kag una nga presidente ako sang Iloilo City Hall Press Corps sadtong 1993.
english:
***

I happened to be the co-founder and first president of the Iloilo City Hall Press Corps in 1993.

text: Nangin kontrobesyal ini tungod sang wala pinilian nga pag-exercise namon sang Press Freedom sa city hall.
english: It became controversial because of our indiscriminate exercise of Press Freedom at city hall.

text: Labi na gid sa bahin sang Konseho, lakip si vice mayor, nga kon gina-isyuhan sila, ginabweltahan man kami sang atake sa radyo, lakip ang paggamit sang block time.
english: Especially on the part of the Council, including the vice mayor, who when they are issued, we also return with a radio attack, including the use of block time.

text: Ako pa gani ang sentro sang atake nga nagdalahig pa kay asawahon.
english: I was even the center of an attack that involved my wife.

text: Isa ka myembro namon ginsaka man sa iya program booth sa ila radio station.
english: One of our members was also promoted to his program booth at their radio station.

text: Believe you me, pero gin-atake pa gid kami sang pila sa ila sa isa ka pagtinipon-tipon sang councilors’ league sa Cebu City nga nabalahuba gid sa mga radyo didto.
english: Believe you me, but some of them attacked us at a gathering of the councilors' league in Cebu City that was broadcast on the radios there.

text: Ugaling wala kami sing nakita nga problema kay sadto Mayor Mansueto Malabor÷.
english: But we didn't see any problem because then Mayor Mansueto Malabor÷.

text: Simple lang ang iya panindugan parti sa Press Freedom nga amon gina-exercise sa city hall.
english: His position on Press Freedom that we exercise in city hall is simple.

text:
Kon isyuhan mo siya, siling lang niya: “Basta pasabta lang ninyo ako, a!”

Tungod sadtong panindugan ni Mayor Malabor, nangisog ako nga palapitan kag pangayuan siya sang bulig parti sa amon problema sa MIWD.
english:
If you question him, he just says: “Just explain to me!”

Because of Mayor Malabor's stand, I dared to approach him and ask for his help regarding our problem with MIWD.

text: Wala namalibad si meyor kag gintudlo ako kay Larry Jamora,  nga tsirman sang MIWD, nga nagpasikto sa ila Finance Officer kon pwede madesponeran inang amon problema.
english: The mayor did not refuse and pointed me to Larry Jamora, chairman of MIWD, who asked their Finance Officer if our problem could be disposed of.

text: Siling ugaling sang naulihi nga basi ma-pierde ang MIWD tungod diutay man lang kami ang naga-istar (mga 10 lang sadto) dira, kag mga PhP200,000 gid kuno ang gastuhon sa pagtakod pa lang sang MIWD lines diri sa amon.
english: However, the latter said that MIWD might lose because there were only a few of us (about 10) living there, and it would cost about PhP200,000 to install MIWD lines here.

text: Nakigpuis ako nga masarangan namon matumbasan ang gasto sini, indi lang magsaku ang MIWD, kay sige-sige man ang pag-serbisyo sang MIWD sa amon.
english: I argued that we can cover the cost, not just MIWD, because MIWD is constantly serving us.

text: Nakigsugilanon ako kay Danny parti sa  sining problema sa MIWD, nga nalipay gid sa akon ginhingyo.
english: I talked to Danny about this problem at MIWD, who was very happy with my request.

text: Kag nagsiling siya nga mabulig sa pagkumbinsir sa MIWD.
english: And he said that will help convince MIWD.

text: Kag natuman gid man nga maserbisyuhan kami sang MIWD sadtong 1994-1995.
english: And it came true that we were served by MIWD in 1994-1995.

text: Ang linya sang tubig ginpaagi sa daan nga dalan sang Podco, nga sobra 30 anyos na nga ginaagyan sang mga pumuluyo diri.
english: The water line was routed through the old Podco road, which has been used by residents here for over 30 years.

text: Para lang anay sa 10 ka balay ang pwersa nga ginhatag sang MIWD.
english: The force provided by MIWD was only for 10 houses.

text: Pagligad lang sang isa ka bulan amat-amat na apply sa MIWD ang amon mga kasilingan.
english: After only a month, our neighbors gradually applied for MIWD.

text: Tubtub nagdamo na ang mga puluy-an diri sa PN Compound Area kag nadugangan ang pwersa sang pagpatayon sang MIWD water diri sa amon, nga ang tubig pwede na  gani makasaka sa second floor.
english: Until the number of houses here in the PN Compound Area increased and the force of turning off the MIWD water here increased, that the water could even rise to the second floor.

text: Panahon na ato sang mabuligon man nga anay Mayor Jerry Treñas.
english: It was the time of the helpful former Mayor Jerry Treñas.

text: Salamat Mayor Jerry!/PN
english: Thank you Mayor Jerry!/PN

text: Ginapreparahan na sang mga awtoridad ang igapasaka nga kaso nga Reckless imprudence resulting to homicide, batok sa driver sang isa ka salakyan nga nakabunggo sa motorsiklo sang isa ka 20-anyos nga motorista, kagab-ihun sang Marso 15.
english: Authorities are preparing to file a case of reckless imprudence resulting to homicide, against the driver of a vehicle that collided with the motorcycle of a 20-year-old motorist, last night on March 15.

text: Ginkilala ang biktima kay Vhane Rodulf Idao, residente sang Purok 4 Brgy.
english: The victim was identified as Vhane Rodulf Idao, resident of Purok 4 Brgy.

text: Damires, New Lucena, Iloilo; Samtang ginkilala naman ang driver sang nakabunggo nga salakyan kay former Calinog Mayor Salvador Divinigracia.
english: Damires, New Lucena, Iloilo; Meanwhile, the driver of the vehicle was identified as former Calinog Mayor Salvador Divinigracia.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Plt.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Plt.

text: John Rey Laruan, Officer-in-charge sang New Lucena Municipal Police Station, iya ginpahayag nga nagapadulong sa siudad si Divinigracia, samtang nagapauli na man halin sa siudad si Idao sang nagsumalangay ang duha.
english: John Rey Laruan, Officer-in-charge of the New Lucena Municipal Police Station, said Divinigracia was on his way to the city, while Idao was returning home from the city when the two met.

text: Suno kay Laruan, nagaliko na ang biktima sang gulpi lang ini nga ginsalakay sang salakyan ni Divinigracia kun sa diin nayudyud pa sini ang motorsiklo tubob tatlo pa ka kilometro ang kalayuon.
english: According to Laruan, the victim was turning when he was suddenly attacked by Divinigracia's vehicle, which dragged the motorcycle three kilometers away.

text: Nasapwan naman si Idao nga puno sang pilas sa iya lawas bangud man sa mabaskug nga impact sang pagkabunggo sa iya.
english: Idao was found with injuries to his body due to the strong impact of the collision.

text: Gintuyo pa ini nga dal-on sa ospital, apang ginbawian gid sang kabuhi.
english: He was rushed to the hospital, but died.

text: “Tapos na.” Para sa iban, nagakahulugan ini sang katapusan; apang para kay Jerson Alagao sang Sacred Heart Chaplaincy, Western Visayas Sanitarium, Sta.
english: “It’s over.” For some, it means the end; but for Jerson Alagao of the Sacred Heart Chaplaincy, Western Visayas Sanitarium, Sta.

text: Barbara, Iloilo, ini nagakahulugan sang katumanan.
english: Barbara, Iloilo, it means fulfillment.

text: “Tapos na ang kabudlayan, ang gutom, ang kahadlok, ang pagduda.
english: “The hardship is over, the hunger, the fear, the suspicion.

text: Natapos na ina nga kabuhi ko, pero indi ini ang katapusan.
english: That life of mine is over, but it’s not the end.

text: Ini ang sugod sang akon misyon,” panugiron sini sa iya repleksyon sa Siete Palabras sa Jaro Metropolitan Cathedral subong nga hapon, Abril 3.
english: This is the beginning of my mission,” he said in his reflection at the Siete Palabras at the Jaro Metropolitan Cathedral this afternoon, April 3.

text: Nagdaku si Jerson sa pigado nga pamilya.
english: Jerson grew up in a poor family.

text: Naga-trabaho bilang construction worker ang iya amay samtang ang iya naman iloy amo ang naga-atipan sa anum sila nga mag-utod.
english: His father works as a construction worker while his mother takes care of six siblings.

text: “Ang balay namon, para lang gid nga may mapuy-an.
english: “Our house is just for someone to live in.

text: Gin-recycle nga mga materyales, kag amon atop daw dahon sang saging nga may mga buho-buho nga daw mga bituon sa aga,” pahayag sini samtang ginasugid ang ila kapigaduhon.
english: Recycled materials, and our roof looks like a banana leaf with holes like morning stars,” she said while narrating their ordeal.

text: Apisar sang puraot nga kabuhi, ginhuptan sini ang iya handum nga mangin accountant.
english: Despite a poor life, he maintained his dream of becoming an accountant.

text: May mga tion suno sa iya nga haluson na sila makakaon, naga-antos pa sa kalayuon sang ila eskwelahan, kag wala pa sang disente nga bag nga butangan sang iya panapton.
english: She said there were times when they barely had enough to eat, still struggling with the distance from their school, and didn’t have a decent bag to put her clothes in.

text: Sa kolehiyo, tatlo tubtub apat ka jeep ang kinahanglan sini sakyan agud makaabot sa ila eskwelahan, kag may mga adlaw nga wala gid sang inughatag nga kwarta ang ila iloy.
english: In college, they had to ride three to four jeeps to get to school, and there were days when their mother had no money to give them.

text: Suno kay Jerson, kun kaisa, naga-tutor siya sa iya classmates agud nga may inugplete siya pauli.
english: According to Jerson, sometimes, he tutors his classmates so that he can have a fare home.

text: “May tion nga kinahanglan ko na magpuli, wala gid ako sang kwarta.
english: “At one point I had to go home, I didn’t really have any money.

text: Kun magsakay ako sa jeep, nagapangamuyo na lang ako, ‘Lord, hatagi sang madamo nga pasahero ini nga jeep.’ Dira ko mapungko sa iya likod kag magdaho sang mga plete sang pasahero, para indi matalupangdan sang driver nga wala ako nakabayad.
english: When I get on the jeep, I just pray, 'Lord, give this jeep more passengers.' I'll sit behind it and increase the fares of the passengers, so that the driver doesn't notice that I haven't paid.

text:
Indi ko ina guisto, brothers and sisters, [pero] wala ako sang mahimo.”

Sa pihak sini tanan, ginpasalamatan ni Jerson ang iya iloy nga amo ang nagtudlo sa iya nga mangin malapit sa Simbahan halin sa bata pa lamang nga edad.
english:
I don't want that, brothers and sisters, [but] I have no choice.”

Despite all of this, Jerson thanked his mother for teaching him to be close to the Church from an early age.

text: Halin sang Grade 3 tubtub nakatapos sa college, nag-serbe si Jerson sa Simbahan bilang isa ka acólito, lector, myembro sang choir, kag katapo sang lain-lain nga mga organisasyon.
english: From Grade 3 until he graduated from college, Jerson served the Church as an acolyte, lector, choir member, and member of various organizations.

text: Mangin sa iya pag-eskwela, napamatud-an ni Jerson nga wala siya ginapabay-an sang Ginuo sang ginpa-istar siya, gintatap, kag ginpakaon sang pamilya nga indi man niya mga himata.
english: Even in his schooling, Jerson proved that the Lord did not abandon him when he was housed, cared for, and fed by a family that was not his relative.

text: Nag-apply man siya nga mangin scholar sang Jaro Archdiocesan Social Action Center.
english: He also applied to become a scholar of the Jaro Archdiocesan Social Action Center.

text: Ika-pito siya sa listahan, apang lima lamang ang ginkuha.
english: He was seventh on the list, but only five were taken.

text: “Pero sin-o bala ang makapakot sa plano sang Diyos?
english: “But who can understand the plans of God?

text: Pagligad sang pila ka adlaw, nagtawag sa akon ang JASAC, madugang pa kuno sila duha ka scholars.
english: A few days later, JASAC called me, saying they were going to add two more scholars.

text: Gani nga nakasulod ako,” suno kay Jerson.
english: That's why I got in,” Jerson said.

text:
Dugang sini: “Ang Ginuo gid nagapanghikot sa akon kabuhi.”

Subong, isa na ka Certified Public Accountant (CPA) si Jerson, may kaugalingon na nga accounting firm, kag may kaugalingon na nga mga propiedad, apang nagapabilin siya sa pagserbe sa simbahan.
english:
It added: “The Lord himself is at work in my life.”

Today, Jerson is a Certified Public Accountant (CPA), owns his own accounting firm, and owns his own properties, but he remains in service to the church.

text: Ginakabig niya ini nga panugod sang iya misyon nga amo ang pagbulig man sa iban nga nagakinahanglan.
english: He sees this as the beginning of his mission to help others in need.

text: “Sang ginbalikdan ko ini tanan, nabinag-binag ko, samtang naga-antos ako sa kabuhi, ginahulma ako sang Ginuo sa sulod sang Iya balay.
english: “When I looked back on it all, I thought, as I struggled through life, the Lord was molding me within His house.

text: Ginahanda Niya ako, kag nagpadala siya sang mga tawo,” dugang niya sa iya nga repleksyon.
english: He was preparing me, and he sent people,” he added in his reflection.

text: Pahayag pa sini: “Ang akon byahe, natapos na.
english: He added: “My journey is over.

text: Subong, akon naman turno, ang turno nga mangin kaayuhan sa iban, kay ako mismo ebidensya nga kun ang Ginuo yara sa imo, matapos mo gid.”#
english: Now, it's my turn, the turn to be good to others, because I am proof that if the Lord is with you, you will finish.”#

text:
Nag-abot na sa Iloilo ang Australian duo nga Air Supply kagab-i.

Ini amo sanday Graham Russell kag Russell Hitchcock nga nakatalana nga magpatigayon sang ila 50th anniversary concert sa City of Passi Arena subong nga adlaw, Enero 11, 2026.
english:
The Australian duo Air Supply arrived in Iloilo last night.

These are Graham Russell and Russell Hitchcock who are scheduled to perform their 50th anniversary concert at the City of Passi Arena today, January 11, 2026.

text: Tuman naman ang kalangkag sang mga fans sa Passi City kag sa bilog nga Iloilo nga nagahulat sa ila paborito nga banda.
english: Fans in Passi City and the whole of Iloilo are eagerly waiting for their favorite band.

text: Nakilala ang Air Supply sang 1975 kag nangin bantog sa ila sikat nga mga kanta pareho sang “Here I Am (Just When I Thought I Was Over You),” “Even the Nights Are Better,” kag “Making Love Out of Nothing at All.”
english: Air Supply met in 1975 and rose to fame with hits like “Here I Am (Just When I Thought I Was Over You),” “Even the Nights Are Better,” and “Making Love Out of Nothing at All.”

text: Isa ka babaye ang ginakabiliban sang kadam-an bangud sang istilo sini kun paano nalikawan nga mapreso apisar nga napamatud-an na nga guilty siya sa isa ka krimen.
english: A woman is admired by many for her style of how she avoided going to jail despite being proven guilty of a crime.

text: Ini nga babaye ginkilala kay Chen Hong, taga-China, kag ginsentensyahan sang apat ka tuig nga pagkapreso bangud sa fraud.
english: This woman was identified as Chen Hong, from China, and was sentenced to four years in prison for fraud.

text: Sang Disyembre 2020 pa siya na-convict sa Shanxi province.
english: He was convicted in Shanxi province in December 2020.

text: Apang tubtub subong, wala pa siya gihapon na-preso.
english: But so far, he has not been arrested.

text: Ang iya style?
english: His style?

text: Sa masobra apat ka tuig, tatlo ka beses na siya nga nagbusong.
english: In more than four years, she has been pregnant three times.

text: Sa China, ang mga indibidwal nga may prison sentences ang mahimo nga magserbe sang ila nga sentensya sa guwa sang presuhan kun may yara sila sang serious medical conditions, kun sila ang nagabusong, kun sila ang may lapsag nga kinahanglan atenderon, kag kun indi nila matatapan ang ila kaugalingon nga sila lang.
english: In China, individuals with prison sentences can serve their sentences outside of prison if they have serious medical conditions, if they are pregnant, if they have a baby to care for, and if they cannot take care of themselves alone.

text: Antes sila makaserbe sa guwa sang presuhan, ginaaprubahan man ini sang korte, kag kun may approval na, may yara sang istrikto nga supervision halin sa ila nga community correctional institutions.
english: Before they can serve outside the jail, they are also approved by the court, and once approved, there is strict supervision from their community correctional institutions.

text: Sa kaso ni Chen, natukiban nga ang iya ikatatlo nga bata ang ginhatag niya sa iya nga bayaw.
english: In Chen's case, it was discovered that her third child was given to her brother-in-law.

text: Gin-ako man sini nga nagbulagay na sila sang iya bana, kag ang bana amo ang nagtatap sang iya una nga duha ka bata.
english: She also admitted that she and her husband had separated, and that he had taken care of her first two children.

text: Nagapati ang local public prosecutor nga ginhungod ni Chen nga magpabusong para nga indi siya mapreso.
english: The local public prosecutor believes that Chen tried to get pregnant to avoid jail.

text: Sa baylo naman nga sa presuhan, ginbalik siya sa detention center agud nga tapuson ang iya nga jail term.
english: Instead of going to jail, he was returned to the detention center to finish his jail term.

text: Ginalauman nga maga-umpisa na ang Gilas Pilipinas sa pag-practice sa Lunes para sa FIBA World Cup 2027 Asian Qualifiers.
english: Gilas Pilipinas is expected to start practicing on Monday for the FIBA ​​World Cup 2027 Asian Qualifiers.

text: Ginahulat pa subong ni Coach Tim Cone ang pag-abot sang pila ka players sang national team halin sa South Korea kag sa Japan.
english: Coach Tim Cone is still waiting for the arrival of some national team players from South Korea and Japan.

text: Duha ka home games ang balantayan nga amo ang hampang batok sa New Zealand sa Pebrero 26, kag ang hampang batok sa Australia sa Marso 1.
english: Two home games are scheduled, the match against New Zealand on February 26, and the match against Australia on March 1.

text: Una nga magatingob ang team sa una nga practice sessions sa Pasig City antes magsaylo sa Inspire Sports Academy sa Calamba, Laguna para sa training camp.
english: The team will first come together for the first practice sessions in Pasig City before moving to Inspire Sports Academy in Calamba, Laguna for the training camp.

text: Lakip sa ginahulat subong amo ang Asian reinforcements nga sanday Carl Tamayo kag Kevin Quiambao halin sa Korean Basketball League kag Dwight Ramos, AJ Edu kag Quentin Millora-Brown halin naman sa Japan B.League.
english: Among the Asian reinforcements are Carl Tamayo and Kevin Quiambao from the Korean Basketball League and Dwight Ramos, AJ Edu and Quentin Millora-Brown from the Japan B.League.

text: 50-50 naman ang status ni Kai Sotto nga bag-o lang gid nakabalik sa paghampang sa luwas sang pungsod matapos ang ginsuprer nga knee injury.
english: Kai Sotto, who recently returned to play abroad after a knee injury, is 50-50.

text: Pangunahan sang three-time PBA Best Import nga si Justin Brownlee ang Pilipinas sa duha ka natalana nga home games.
english: Three-time PBA Best Import Justin Brownlee will lead the Philippines in two scheduled home games.

text:
Pahanugutan sang Government Service Insurance System (GSIS) ang mga government employees nga mag-loan sang hasta ₱500,000 agud mag-install sang solar panels sa ila tagsa ka puluy-an sa bulig sang “Ginhawa Solar Energy Loan program.”

Ang nasambit nga loan ang may yara sang 5% nga yearly interest kag sarang mabayaran hasta lima (5) ka tuig sa equal monthly payments.
english:
The Government Service Insurance System (GSIS) will allow government employees to borrow up to ₱500,000 to install solar panels in their respective homes with the help of the “Ginhawa Solar Energy Loan program.”

The said loan has 5% annual interest and can be repaid up to five (5) years in equal monthly payments.

text: Ang pag-install sang solar panel systems ang may yara man sang free insurance hasta sa tatlo (3) ka tuig batok sa mga trahedya ukon kalamidad pareho sang sunog, linog, kilat kag bagyo.
english: The installation of solar panel systems also comes with free insurance for up to three (3) years against tragedies or disasters such as fire, earthquake, lightning and typhoon.

text: Kun ang mga panels ang maga-produce sang mas madamo nga elektrisidad nga maga-sobra sa kinahanglanon sang isa ka panimalay, sarang gid mabaligya sang natungdan ang ila extra power pabalik sa electric grid paagi sa net metering, isa ka paagi agud mabuhinan ang electricity bills.
english: If the panels produce more electricity than a household needs, they can sell their extra power back to the electric grid through net metering, a way to reduce electricity bills.

text: Ang amo nga programa ang may tinutuyo nga mabuligan ang mga government workers nga makakinot sa ila energy costs kag maka-promote sang paggamit sang mas matinlo nga enerhiya, ilabi na sa karun nga nagapangatubang sa krisis sa gatong ang Pilipinas, amo man ang nagataas nga presyo sang kuryente dala sang kinagamo sa Middle East.
english: The program aims to help government workers save on their energy costs and promote the use of cleaner energy, especially now that the Philippines is facing a fuel crisis, as well as rising electricity prices due to the unrest in the Middle East.

text: Nakatalana nga ipatawag ni Iloilo City Councilor Romel Duron ang Bureau of Fisheries and Aquatic Resources (BFAR) kag Department of Environment and Natural Resources (DENR) kun paano nakakuha sang Fishpond Lease Agreement (FLA) ang 60 ka ektarya nga Mangrove area sa bahin sang Brgy.
english: Iloilo City Councilor Romel Duron is scheduled to summon the Bureau of Fisheries and Aquatic Resources (BFAR) and Department of Environment and Natural Resources (DENR) to discuss how the 60 hectares of mangrove area in Brgy.

text: Bitoon, Jaro Iloilo City.
english: Bitoon, Jaro Iloilo City.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Councilor Duron, iya ginpahayag nga sa palaabuton nga Huwebes, Pebrero 19, 2026, iya ipatawag ang BFAR kag DENR sa isa ka committee hearing sang City Council agud nga maklaruhan kag masabat ang tanan sini nga palamangkutanon natuhoy sa amo nga isyu.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Councilor Duron said that on Thursday, February 19, 2026, he will summon the BFAR and DENR to a committee hearing of the City Council to clarify and answer all their questions regarding the issue.

text: Dugang pa sini nga kun matuod nga may fishpond sa amo nga lugar, kinahanglan sang mga ini sikyarun ang permit halin sa city council agud nga maka-operate.
english: He added that if there is a fishpond in the area, they need to secure a permit from the city council to operate.

text: Matandaan nga ang ginapahayag nga Fishpond ang nakapangalan sa Diego Agri Aqua and Land Ventures, nga may lease agreement nga may petsa nga Pebrero 28, 2025 kag may numero nga 6351, kun sa diin sakop sini ang halos 35 ka ektarya sang lugar.
english: It can be recalled that the alleged fishpond is in the name of Diego Agri Aqua and Land Ventures, with a lease agreement dated February 28, 2025 and number 6351, which covers nearly 35 hectares of land.

text: Napetsahan man nga Pebrero 28,2025 ang isa ka agreement nga may numbero nga FLA No.
english: Also dated February 28, 2025 is an agreement with number FLA No.

text: 3483-8 nga sakop ang 25 ka ektarya kag ginapanag-iyahan sang pareho lamang nga indibidwal.
english: 3483-8 covering 25 hectares and owned by the same individual.

text: Ini na mga impormasyon ang nagtuhaw matapos nga nagpatigayon sang imbestigasyon si Duron bangud sa alegasyon nga gin-hatagan sang pribado nga land titles ang halos 50 ka ektarya nga mangrove areas sa Iloilo Strait nga ginakabig nga protektado nga public land.
english: This information came after Duron conducted an investigation into the allegation that private land titles were given to nearly 50 hectares of mangrove areas in the Iloilo Strait that are considered protected public land.

text: Nagpabutyag sang pagkadismaya ang pila ka mga progresibo nga grupo sa resulta sang imbestigasyon sang Independent Commission for Infrastructure sa isyu sang korapsyon sa flood control projects.
english: Some progressive groups have expressed disappointment over the outcome of the Independent Commission for Infrastructure's investigation into the issue of corruption in flood control projects.

text: Kadungan sang pagtakop sa operasyon sang amo nga komisyon, nakulangan ang mga grupo sa pagpasabat sa tanan nga involved sa korapsyon.
english: Along with the closure of the commission's operations, the groups failed to hold all those involved in corruption accountable.

text: Suno kay Teddy Casiño, Chairperson sang Bagong Alyansang Makabayan, indi sila kuntento sa imbestigasyon sang Independent Commission for Infratructure, Office of the Ombudsman kag Senado.
english: Teddy Casiño, Chairperson of the Bagong Alyansang Makabayan, said they are not satisfied with the investigation of the Independent Commission for Infrastructure, Office of the Ombudsman and Senate.

text: Ila nga ginreklamo partikular sanday former Undersecretary Adrian Bersamin kag former Department of Education Usec.
english: They complained particularly former Undersecretary Adrian Bersamin and former Department of Education Usec.

text: Trygve Olaivar.
english: Trygve Olaivar.

text: Suno naman kay David San Juan sang Kilusang Bayan Kontra Kurakot, nangin limitado lamang ang imbestigasyon sang Independent Commission for Infrastructure.
english: David San Juan of the People's Movement Against Corruption said the Independent Commission for Infrastructure's investigation was limited.

text: Pahayag niya, wala natumod sa imbestigasyon ang matuod nga ‘mastermind’ kag wala man sang napapreso nga mga matag-as nga opisyal kalakip na ang mga yara sa Palasyo sang Malakanyang.
english: He said the investigation did not identify the true mastermind and did not arrest any senior officials including those at Malakanyang Palace.

text: Nagpangabay si Pope Leo XIV sa mga manggaranon nga tawo nga ipaambit ang ila manggad sa mga pigado.
english: Pope Leo XIV asked rich people to share their wealth with the poor.

text: Ini nga mensahe sang santo Papa ang iya ginpakigbahin kadungan sang iya pagbisita sa Monaco, isa ka manggaranon nga microstate sa French Riviera.
english: The Pope shared this message during his visit to Monaco, a wealthy microstate on the French Riviera.

text: Sa amo man nga mensahe sang Santo Papa, iya ginkondena ang separasyon sa tunga sang manggaranon kag imol.
english: In the same message, the Pope condemned the separation between the rich and the poor.

text: Ginpunto man sini nga ang manggad ang dapat gamitun para sa katarungan kag ikaayo sang tanan.
english: He also pointed out that wealth should be used for justice and the good of all.

text: Gintalakay man ni Pope Leo ang mga isyu pareho sang pag-amlig sa dunang manggad, world peace kag pagprotekta sa kabuhi sang isa ka tawo, kun sa diin gintambungan sang linibo ka mga tumuluo ang amo nga pagbisita sang Santo Papa.
english: Pope Leo also discussed issues such as the protection of natural resources, world peace and the protection of human life, where thousands of believers attended the Pope's visit.

text: ANG PADAYON kag mapanghalit nga pagbinaha (flooding) sa bug-os nga kalibutan, sunu sa mga weather scientists, ang mabasol sing daku sa sige pagsanyog sang Climate Change.
english: CONTINUOUS and devastating flooding around the world, according to weather scientists, is largely to blame for the increasing climate change.

text: In fact, ang World Meteorolical Oganization (WMO) nag-report nga ang weather-related disasters nagsaka sing lima ka pilu sa sulod sang nagligad nga 50 anyos.
english: In fact, the World Meteorological Organization (WMO) reports that weather-related disasters have increased fivefold over the past 50 years.

text: Sa panahon na ini sang Industrial Revolution kon san-o masanyog na ang paggamit sang fossil fuel nga nagabuga sang greenhouse gas (GHG).
english: This is during the Industrial Revolution when the use of fossil fuels that emits greenhouse gases (GHG) is widespread.

text: Ining GHG nagadugang painit sang kalibutan nga nagapalain sang panahon samtang nagatunaw man sang nyebe (winter ice) nga nagatuga sang pagsaka sang dagat sa baybayon (sea level rise).
english: These GHGs increase global warming, which worsens the weather while also melting winter ice, which causes sea level rise.

text: Ugaling tubtub karon indi gihapon makatudlo ang mga mangin-alamon sang bisan isa man lang ka solusyon agud lubos makapauntat sining mas makapanghalit na nga pagbinaha.
english: But until now, scientists have not been able to come up with a single solution to completely stop this more destructive flooding.

text: Gani, ang ginahimo na lang sang gobyerno upod sa mga pumuluyo amo ang mga makapahagan-hagan na lang sang kahalitan nga dala sang baha paagi sa mga Mitigation kag Adaptation measures nga sa tion-tion dapat aksyunan gihapon sa pagbag-o bag-o man sang lakat sang panahon.
english: Therefore, what the government is doing with the people is to mitigate the damage caused by the floods through mitigation and adaptation measures that must be taken from time to time to change the weather.

text: Katulad sang engineering structures (dam, barriers, water storage, etc.) nga makasagang ukon makapalikaw sa baha, una nga pagpangamlig (community preparedness), kag kon ano pa nga mga pahito kag pagplano nga maayo, lakip na ang natural nga mga solusyon nga mahimo sa palibut, katulad sang pagpananom sang kahoy, pagtampok sa mga nalusod nga mga lugar (subsidence), buffer plants, etc.
english: Such as engineering structures (dams, barriers, water storage, etc.) that can prevent or avoid floods, community preparedness, and other measures and planning that are good, including natural solutions that can be done in the environment, such as planting trees, buffering areas, buffers, etc.

text:
***

Diri sa siyudad sang Iloilo, sa pag-abot sang malain nga panahon sa binulan sang Hunyo tubtub Oktubre, isa sang masakit naton nga experyensya amo ang pagbinaha nga dala sing masami sang mga bagyo.
english:
***

Here in Iloilo City, with the arrival of bad weather in the months of June to October, one of our painful experiences is the flooding that is often brought about by typhoons.

text: Katulad sang Typhoon Frank (international name Fengshen), nga una nag-landfall sa Bicol Region pakadto sa Mindoro kag sa Metro Manila bag-o maggwa sa pungsod pa-China sa kusog sini nga 165 km/hour.
english: Like Typhoon Frank (international name Fengshen), which first landfall in the Bicol Region to Mindoro and Metro Manila before leaving the country for China at 165 km/hour.

text: Malapad nga pag-inulan ang dala sini nga nagsakop sang siyudad sang Iloilo.
english: It brought widespread rains that covered Iloilo City.

text: Nagtuga ini sang pagpaawas sang mga suba sang Tigum kag Aganan pakadto sa mga kabanwhahan kag sa siyudad kag probinsya sang Iloilo.
english: This caused the Tigum and Aganan rivers to overflow into the towns and the city and province of Iloilo.

text: Sa probinsya sa Iloilo, 59 ang napatay kag 40 ang ginapangita pa.
english: In Iloilo province, 59 people were killed and 40 are still missing.

text: Sa siyudad sang Iloilo, ang pag-awas sang gasampukanay nga mga suba sang Tigum kag Aganan nagtuga pa sang madalom nga flashflood sa mga distrito sang Mandurriao kag Jaro sa kadalumon nga sobra isa ka metro, nga nagtulod sa madamo agud magdalagan pakadto sa atop sang ila mga balay.
english: In Iloilo City, the overflow of the Tigum and Aganan rivers caused deep flashfloods in Mandurriao and Jaro districts to a depth of more than one meter, prompting many to run to the roofs of their houses.

text: Ang baha, sa kabug-usan, nagsakop sang duha sa tatlo (2/3) gid sang 180 ka mga barangay sang siyudad.
english: The flood, in total, covered two-thirds of the city's 180 barangays.

text: Nangguba man ini sang mga 1,448 ka puluy-an kag nagpatay sang 26 ka tawo diri sa siyudad.
english: It also destroyed about 1,448 homes and killed 26 people in the city.

text: Sadtong Hulyo 2023 naman, nanghalit man sa siyudad ang Super Typhoon Goring (intenational name Gordon/Saola) samtang nag-igu sa Central Luzon sing Category 5 nga bagyo sa kusog nga 260 km/hour.
english: In July 2023, Super Typhoon Goring (international name Gordon/Saola) also damaged the city as it hit Central Luzon with a Category 5 typhoon with winds of 260 km/hour.

text: Nagdala man ini sing malapad nga pagbinaha sa siyudad sang Iloilo.
english: It also brought widespread flooding to Iloilo City.

text: Mga 90 sang 180 ka mga barangay ang ginbahaan, nga nagpilit sang madamo sa pagbakwit.
english: About 90 of the 180 barangays were flooded, forcing many to evacuate.

text:
***

Ang pamangkot: Ano naman ayhan ang mahimo naton nga maayo samtang yara kita subong sa mabagyuhon nga panahon sa siyudad Iloilo?
english:
***

The question: What can we do good while we are in the stormy weather in Iloilo City?

text: Sa nasiling ta na, bisan ang mga siyentipiko indi makatudlo sang bisan isa ka solusyon agud mapauntat sing lubos ang pagbinaha sa kon diin man nga bahin sang kalibutan.
english: As we have said, even scientists cannot point to a single solution to completely stop flooding anywhere in the world.

text: Gani, pabalik-balik na gid lang ang ginahimo nga mga medyos agud mapahagan-hagan ang problema sa baha, samtang gahimud-os to do better next time.
english: Therefore, repeated measures are being taken to alleviate the flood problem, while striving to do better next time.

text: In fact, bisan ang mga manggaran nga mga pungsod sa kalibutan padayon man nga ginabahaan.
english: In fact, even the rich countries of the world continue to be flooded.

text:
Sang nagligad lang nga Hulyo 4, 2025, nga Independence pa sang Amerika, gin-igu sang disastrous flashflood ang estado sang Texas, U.S.A.

Nagpatay ini sang ginatos samtang halos wala nahimo ang gobyerno sang Texas bisan man lang mag-evacuate sang pila nila ka mga pumuluyo dira.
english:
Just last July 4, 2025, when America was still Independent, a disastrous flashflood hit the state of Texas, U.S.A.

It killed hundreds while the Texas government barely managed to evacuate some of its residents.

text: Samtang, padayon man sadto ang pagbantay sa Amerika sang at least 18 ka most dangerous flood zones sini.
english: Meanwhile, the United States continues to monitor at least 18 of its most dangerous flood zones.

text: Makahaladlok man ang mga baha sa China, sa Uropa, kag bisan sa Middle East nga mas kilala sa tag-init nga panahon.
english: Floods in China, Europe, and even the Middle East, which are better known in the summer season, are also devastating.

text:
***

Diri sa siyudad sang Iloilo, wala man untat ang aton panikasug nga masabat ang problema sang pagbinaha sa mabagyuhon karon nga binulan.
english:
***

Here in Iloilo City, we are continuing our efforts to address the problem of flooding in this stormy month.

text: Salamat kay prioridad gid ni Mayor Raisa ang padayon nga pagsolbar sa aton problema sa baha.
english: Thank you for Mayor Raisa's priority to continue solving our flood problem.

text: Dayon niya ginpirmahan ang tatlo ka executive orders agud ma-reconstitute ang task forces sa drainage, anti-squatting kag illegal structures agud ma-relocate ang nabilin pa nga informal settlers sa lugar kon diin mahilway sila sa katalagman nga madala sang baha.
english: He then signed three executive orders to reconstitute the task forces on drainage, anti-squatting and illegal structures to relocate the remaining informal settlers to areas where they will be free from the danger of flooding.

text: Samtang sige man ang pagpanglimpyo kag pagtadlong sang drainage system nga may bulig sang DPWH.
english: Meanwhile, the drainage system is being cleaned and repaired with the help of the DPWH.

text: Ang DPWH nagpatukod na gani sang pila ka pumping stations agud suyupon ang gapabilin nga tubig sa manubo nga mga lugar pagwa sa Iloilo  River kag iban pa nga outlet.
english: The DPWH has even set up several pumping stations to suck the remaining water in low-lying areas out of the Iloilo River and other outlets.

text: Good move Mayor Raisa.
english: Good move Mayor Raisa.

text: Kabay mapatuman ining mga proyekto nga wala sing problema sa pag-ugyon man sang mga pumuluyo./PN
english: Hopefully these projects will be implemented without any problems with the consent of the people./PN

text: NAPULO’G isa (11) gid ang nagdaug sa mga kandidato sa pagka-konsehal sang nagligad nga eleksyon sa grupo ni Iloilo City Mayor Raisa Sarabia Treñas-Chu, samtang isa gid lang ang nagdaug –si Konsehal Sheen Mabilog –  halin sa grupo ni Cong.
english: Eleven (11) councilor candidates won the last election in the group of Iloilo City Mayor Raisa Sarabia Treñas-Chu, while only one won – Councilor Sheen Mabilog – from the group of Cong.

text: Jam Jam Baronda.
english: Clock Clock Baronda.

text: Si Mayor Raisa katapo sang Nationalist People’s Coalition (NPC) upod sang iya kapartido kag ka-coalition sa Konseho, samtang si Kongresista JamJam Baronda kag iya mga kagrupo katapo kag kaugyon sang Lakas-CMD.
english: Mayor Raisa is a member of the Nationalist People's Coalition (NPC) along with his party and coalition partners in the Council, while Congressman JamJam Baronda and his colleagues are members and allies of Lakas-CMD.

text: Isa pa, ang SK chairman kag presidente sang Liga ng mga Barangay kagrupo man ini sila ni anay Mayor Jerry Treñas kag sang nagdalaug nga mga konsehal.
english: In addition, the SK chairman and president of the League of Barangays are also members of former Mayor Jerry Treñas and the winning councilors.

text: Kon may kaugyon man sa Konseho si Mabilog, ang kapartido lang sini nga si Vice Mayor Love-Love Baronda nga ang rolyo sini sa Konseho amo lang ang mag-preside sa sesyon kag magboto kon may patas nga boto.
english: If Mabilog has any agreement with the Council, only his party member Vice Mayor Love-Love Baronda whose role in the Council is to preside over the session and vote if there is a tie.

text: Ex-officio member matuod si Vice Mayor Baronda sang 32 tanan nga mga komitiba, apang indi ini makabulig gid kay Mabilog.
english: Vice Mayor Baronda is an ex-officio member of all 32 committees, but this will not help Mabilog.

text: Ina tungod kay indi siya makapakigbahin kag makaboto sa deliberasyon sang plenaryo, ukon kabug-usan sang Konseho, luas lang sa pagboto kon may magpatas.
english: This is because he cannot participate and vote in the deliberations of the plenary, or the entire Council, except to vote in case of equality.

text: Isa pa, sandig sa aton Demokrasyahanon nga pang-gobyerno, nga nagasikway sang diniktador nga pangginahum, may ginakilala dira sa Konseho nga Ruling Party (ukon coalition) nga ginagamhan sang Mayoriya nga grupo, samtang ang Minoriya nga grupo ang nagadala sang obligasyon sang Opposition Party (ukon coalition) bilang Fiscalizer.
english: Furthermore, based on our Democratic system of government, which rejects dictatorial rule, there is recognized in the Council a Ruling Party (or coalition) ruled by the Majority group, while the Minority group carries the obligation of the Opposition Party (or coalition) as Fiscalizer.

text: Bilang Fiscalizer, ang Minoriya gina-expectar sa pagbantay sang pagpatikang sang kaban sang siyudad kag ang posible nga pagpatumbaya sa serbisyo kag korapsyon sa gobyerno.
english: As Fiscalizer, the Minority is expected to monitor the operation of the city coffers and possible negligence in service and corruption in the government.

text: Poder naman sang Ruling Majority ang pagpamuno sa pagpatuman sang kaayuhan sang mga pumuluyo, sandig sa ila ginpangako sa mga pumuluyo nga nagpadaug sa ila sang nagligad ng eleksyon.
english: The power of the Ruling Majority is to take the lead in implementing the welfare of the people, based on their promise to the people who won them in the last election.

text: Tungod sini, ang Mayoriya ang may kinamatarong sa pagpili kon sin-o sa mga konsehal ang mamuno sang nagakalain-lain nga mga komitiba.
english: Therefore, the Majority has the right to choose which of the councilors will head the various committees.

text: Gani indi katingalahan kon bisan isa sa Opposition ang indi matagaan sing chairmanship sang komitiba.
english: It is therefore not surprising that even one of the Opposition will not be given the chairmanship of the committee.

text: Apang indi man imposible nga matagaan sang chairmanship sa komitiba ang Opposition.
english: But it is not impossible for the Opposition to be given the chairmanship of the committee.

text: Katulad sang natabo sa Cebu City Council sadtong 2022, kag sa nagliligad pa nila nga mga Konseho.
english: As happened in the Cebu City Council in 2022, and in their previous Councils.

text: Sunu sa AI, kon korek ang report sini, sadtong 2022, si opposition councilor Nestor Archival na-appoint bilang chair sang Committee on Environment.
english: According to AI, if its report is correct, in 2022, opposition councilor Nestor Archival was appointed as chair of the Committee on Environment.

text: Subong man si  Cynthia de la Torre, sa Committee on Women and Family Affairs.
english: Also Cynthia de la Torre, on the Committee on Women and Family Affairs.

text: Ginhimo ini sang Cebu City Council, sa pagpamuno sang Mayoriya, “to foster collaboration between majority and minority parties within the council”.
english: This was done by the Cebu City Council, under the leadership of the Majority, “to foster collaboration between majority and minority parties within the council”.

text: Apang wala ini mahimo sang Iloilo City Council, nga wala matagaan sing  chairmanship sang komitiba si Mabilog.
english: However, the Iloilo City Council did not do so, which did not give Mabilog the chairmanship of the committee.

text: Ngaa ayhan?
english: Why maybe?

text: Sa nahibal-an ta halin sa mga balita, naghisugot si Mayor Raisa kag Vice Mayor Baronda nga magbinuligay ang ila grupo agud mahatag ang mas masangkad nga kaayuhan sa siyudad.
english: As we know from the news, Mayor Raisa and Vice Mayor Baronda agreed that their group will work together to provide greater good to the city.

text: Pero, ngaa wala matagaan sing chairmanship sang bisan isa lang ka komitiba si Mabilog?
english: But, why wasn't Mabilog given the chairmanship of even one committee?

text: Una, tungod ang Konseho independent body kag may kaugalingon man nga pamensaron sa Executive bisan magkagrupo sila.
english: First, because the Council is an independent body and has its own opinion on the Executive even if they are grouped.

text: Ikaduha, tungod seguro kay ang ginapangayo ni Mabilog gina-obligar na sing mabungahon sing madugay nga panahon sang yara gihapon sa pwesto halin sa nagligad nga Konseho, nga indi nila masalig sa bag-uhan nga konsehal katulad ni Mabilog.
english: Secondly, probably because Mabilog's demands have been fruitfully obliged for a long time by those still in office from the previous Council, that they cannot trust a new councilor like Mabilog.

text: Gani,  mas gustuhon sang Mayoriya nga mangin myembro na gid lang si Mabilog sang komitiba kon diin maka-upod man siya sa deliberasyon sini.
english: Therefore, the majority would prefer that Mabilog become a member of the committee where he can participate in its deliberations.

text: Ginpangayo sadto ni Mabilog ang mga komitiba sang Edukasyon kag Labor & Employment.
english: Mabilog then asked the Education and Labor & Employment committees.

text: Well, indi  man nangin problema ini sang mga konsehal sa Opposition katulad nanday Perla Zulueta, kag Joshua Alim kag Plaridel Nava sa ila kapanahunan.
english: Well, this was not a problem for Opposition councilors like Perla Zulueta, and Joshua Alim and Plaridel Nava in their time.

text: Sa ila ginpakita nga kinaalam, experyensya sa panghimanwa, kag kaisug napamuklat man nila ang Mayoriya, kag ang mga pumuluyo, sa bagay nga pagtadlong sa ginaduso sang Mayoriya nga mga hagna kag hilikuton, luas sa ila man kaugalingon nga mga inisyatibo.
english: With their demonstrated wisdom, civic experience, and courage, they have also opened the eyes of the Majority, and the people, to the correction of the Majority's proposed bills and activities, in addition to their own initiatives.

text: Segurado naton nga mahimo man ini ni Mabilog.
english: We are sure that Mabilog can do the same.

text: Tapos siya sa Bachelor of Politicial Science nga nagahanas sa pagdebate (sa subject nga Argumentation and Debate) agud madepensyahan sing maayo ang iya mga panindugan sa pagbulig man sang iya abogado, katulad ni Atty. Rex Salas nga sadto legal consultant ni Zulueta samtang indi abogado.
english: He is a graduate of Bachelor of Political Science who is training in debate (in the subject of Argumentation and Debate) to defend his positions well with the help of his lawyer, such as Atty. Rex Salas nga sadto legal consultant ni Zulueta samtang indi abogado.

text: Nangin kabahin man si Mabilog sang gobyerno sadtong tsirman pa siya sang SK kag ex-officio nga konsehal, kag assistant ni mayor sa pagpalakat sang gobyerno.
english: Mabilog was also part of the government when he was SK chairman and ex-officio councilor, and assistant to the mayor in running the government.

text: Kag sa padayon nga pagtuon, katulad sang ginahimo sadto ni Zulueta, gasalig kita nga mangin mas mabungahon man ini sa iya rolyo sa Konseho.
english: And with continued learning, as Zulueta was doing, we hope that it will also be more fruitful in its role in the Council.

text: Good luck, Konsehal Sheen Mabilog!
english: Good luck, Councilor Sheen Mabilog!

text: Pwede ka man mag-“play dirty”sa posible nga matudlo sang kagrupo mo, pero mas angayan ka, sa imo ginpakita nga ugali sang tsirman ka pa sang SK, sa pagpasanyog lang sang “constructive criticism”./PN
english: You can also “play dirty” with what your groupmates might point out, but you are more suitable, in your behavior when you were chairman of the SK, to promote “constructive criticism”./PN

text: May nabilin pa nga mga target ang City Drug Enforcement Unit (CDEU) sa Barangay Bakhaw, Mandurriao, Iloilo City magluwas sa 35-anyos nga babaye nga nadakpan subong nga semana kag nakuhaan sang malapit P2-million nga balor sang iligal nga droga.
english: The City Drug Enforcement Unit (CDEU) still has targets in Barangay Bakhaw, Mandurriao, Iloilo City besides the 35-year-old woman who was arrested this week and seized with nearly P2-million worth of illegal drugs.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Captain Roque Gimeno III, Officer-in-Charge sang CDEU, iya ginpahayag nga tatlo ang ila gina-puntariya nga madakop, apang sang gin-conduct ang operasyon, si alias Ala lamang ang naaresto.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Police Captain Roque Gimeno III, Officer-in-Charge of the CDEU, said they were targeting three suspects, but when the operation was conducted, only alias Ala was arrested.

text: Nagdangat sa 280 gramos sang ginapasuni shabu ang nakuha kay alias Ala, kag natigayon na ini nga mapasakaan sang panumbungon nga paglapas sa Republic Act 9165 ukon Comprehensive Dangerous Drugs Act of 2002.
english: A total of 280 grams of suspected shabu was recovered from alias Ala, who was charged with violation of Republic Act 9165 or the Comprehensive Dangerous Drugs Act of 2002.

text: Malapit lima ka bulan ang ila nga monitoring sa amo nga high-value individual bangud madanlog ini sa awtoridad.
english: They have been monitoring the high-value individual for nearly five months because he is suspicious of the authorities.

text: Gin-identify ni Gimeno ang isa ka source ni alias Ala nga si alias Mike.
english: Gimeno identified a source of alias Ala as alias Mike.

text: Pahayag ni Roque, bisan sang tion nga na-assign pa lang siya bilang OIC sa Iloilo City Police Station 1, nabatian na sini ang pangalan ni alias Ala nga amo ang source sang iligal nga droga sang mga nadakpan sa drug buy bust sa Zamora kag Veterans Village sa Iloilo City Proper.
english: Roque said that even when he was assigned as OIC in Iloilo City Police Station 1, he heard the name of alias Ala who is the source of illegal drugs of those arrested in drug buy bust in Zamora and Veterans Village in Iloilo City Proper.

text: Ginalauman sang Filipina golfer nga si Rianne Malixi ang isa ka mapag-on nga pagbalik sa iya sports career subong nga tuig 2026 samtang maga-compete ini sa Women’s Amateur Asia-Pacific (WAAP) Championship sa New Zealand.
english: Filipina golfer Rianne Malixi is looking forward to a strong return to her sports career this year 2026 as she competes in the Women’s Amateur Asia-Pacific (WAAP) Championship in New Zealand.

text: Ang 18 anyos nga Filipino player, nga sa karon ika-21 sa World Amateur Golf Ranking, nakaagom sang back injury sang 2025 nga nakaapekto sa iya performance, lakip na diri ang pagkapaslaw sini nga maka-podium sa Southeast Asian Games.
english: The 18-year-old Filipino player, currently ranked 21st in the World Amateur Golf Ranking, suffered a back injury in 2025 that affected his performance, including his failure to make the podium at the Southeast Asian Games.

text: Pagkatapos sang pila ka bulan nga therapy kag rehabilitasyon, nagpakita sang pagbangon si Malixi kag nangin runner-up pa ini sa Espirito Santo Trophy kag nagdaog sang iya una nga U.S. collegiate tournament para sa Duke University.
english: After months of therapy and rehabilitation, Malixi showed recovery and even finished runner-up in the Espirito Santo Trophy and won his first U.S. collegiate tournament for Duke University.

text: Sa iya ika-anom nga pagpasakop sa Women’s Amateur Asia-Pacific (WAAP), nagalaom ini nga magadaog para sa iya pinakadako nga comeback sa iya amateur career.
english: In her sixth Women’s Amateur Asia-Pacific (WAAP) appearance, she hopes to win for her biggest comeback of her amateur career.

text: Maatubang ni Malixi ang pila ka mga mabaskog nga mga kontra, lakip ang defending champion nga si Jeneath Wong sang Malaysia.
english: Malixi will face some formidable opponents, including defending champion Jeneath Wong of Malaysia.

text: Nahibaluan nga wala pa sang Pilipina nga nakadaog sa Women’s Amateur Asia-Pacific (WAAP) halin sang pagsugod sini sang tuig 2018.
english: It is known that no Filipina has won the Women's Amateur Asia-Pacific (WAAP) since its inception in 2018.

text: Anne Parish, Molo, Iloilo City ang iya tyempo sa Syete Palabras subong nga adlaw, Abril 3, agud isugid ang istorya sang isa ka tumuluo nga nagtaliwan nga may hugot nga pagtuo sa Diyos.
english: Anne Parish, Molo, Iloilo City spent her time at Syete Palabras today, April 3, to tell the story of a believer who passed away with strong faith in God.

text: Istorya ini ni Carlene, 49-anyos, isa ka abyan ni Msgr.
english: This is the story of Carlene, 49, a friend of Msgr.

text: Delgado sa Parokya ni San Miguel, nga ginlubong sang nagligad lang nga Marso 26.
english: Delgado in the Parish of San Miguel, who was buried last March 26.
