english: According to Msgr.

text: Delgado, gin-agda sang Jaro Archdiocesan Pastoral Secretariat (JAPS) si Carlene nga isa kuntani sa magapakigbahin sa Syete Palabras sa Jaro Metropolitan Cathedral subong nga Semana Santa.
english: Delgado, the Jaro Archdiocesan Pastoral Secretariat (JAPS) invited Carlene to be one of the participants in the Syete Palabras at the Jaro Metropolitan Cathedral this Holy Week.

text: Nakasabat pa ini nga: “For God’s Greatest Glory, Sir.” Apang lain ang plano sang Ginuo.
english: He even replied: “For God’s Greatest Glory, Sir.” But the Lord had a different plan.

text: Duha ka adlaw matapos ang iya sabat, nagtaliwan si Carlene.
english: Two days after her response, Carlene passed away.

text: “Now, I am standing before you to continue her unfinished narrative of faith as we reflect on this seventh last word [of Christ],” suno kay Msgr.
english: “Now, I am standing before you to continue her unfinished narrative of faith as we reflect on this seventh last word [of Christ],” according to Msgr.

text:
Delgado nga amo ang nagpakigbahin sang repleksyon sa ika-pito nga pulong ni Kristo nga, ‘Amay, sa Imo mga kamot ginatugyan ko Ang Akon Espiritu.’

Nagsugod ang pag-abyanay nanday Msgr.
english:
Delgado who shared the reflection on the seventh word of Christ, 'Father, into Your hands I commend My Spirit.'

The friendship between Msgr.

text: Delgado kag Carlene 14 anyos na ang nagligad sang katapo si Carlene sang Flock of Divine Mercy nga mapisan nga naga-ugyon sa programa sang ebanghelisasyon sa amo nga parokya.
english: Delgado and Carlene 14 years ago, Carlene was a member of the Flock of Divine Mercy who was actively involved in the evangelization program in the parish.

text: Apisar lain na ang assignment ni Msgr.

text: Delgado, nangin regular ang ila komunikasyon gani nga nahangpan kag nabatyagan sang pari ang pagtuo ni Carlene sa pihak sang anum ka tuig nga pag-antos sang lupus nga isa ka chronic autoimmune disease.
english: Delgado said their communication became regular so that the priest understood and felt Carlene's faith despite her six-year suffering from lupus, a chronic autoimmune disease.

text: “Ang masakit nga tayuyon, nagapahina sang aton kusog, nagapadula sang aton gana sa pagkaon, nagapaubos sang aton kwarta, kag kun kaisa, nagakatublag ang aton pagsalig sa Diyos.
english: “Constant illness weakens our strength, depletes our appetite, depletes our money, and sometimes disturbs our trust in God.

text: Gani kun may masakit kita, we found ourselves helpless,” suno kay Msgr.
english: So when we are sick, we found ourselves helpless,” said Msgr.

text: Apang sa baylo nga amo sini ang batyagon, tubtub sa iya katapusan nga ginhawa, gin-gamit ni Carlene ang iya tyempo para sa ebanghelisasyon.
english: But instead of feeling that way, until her last breath, Carlene used her time for evangelization.

text: But you know, the Lord told me in my prayer, he is not done with me yet.

text:
In my greatest pains, I thank God that he had made the hospital ward to be my place of evangelization.”

english:
In my greatest pains, I thank God that he had made the hospital ward to be my place of evangelization.”

Statement by Msgr.

text: Delgado, nangin palaagyan si Carlene agud nga makatawag ang isa man ka pasyente sa pari para nga maka-kumpisar ini samtang yara sila sa ospital.
english: Delgado, Carlene became a conduit for another patient to call the priest so that he could confess while they were in the hospital.

text: “In this hospital ward, He’s not only processing the healing of my physical body, but also my soul.
english: “In this hospital ward, He’s not only processing the healing of my physical body, but also my soul.

text: It’s so sweet to be more in love with Jesus every day in pains and suffering,” suno kay Carlene, santo sa panugiron ni Msgr.
english: It’s so sweet to be more in love with Jesus every day in pains and suffering,” Carlene said, according to Msgr.

english: The priest added: “He did not focus on his own situation.

text:
She turned her gaze on others, and so the hospital ward became a place of mission for her from God.”

Sa pagtapos sang iya repleksyon, ginpahangop ni Msgr.
english:
She turned her gaze on others, and so the hospital ward became a place of mission for her from God.”

At the end of his reflection, Msgr.

text: Delgado nga sa kada pag-antos sang tawo, may importante nga dapat tandaan: “With nothing on to cling on to, we realize we only live in the love of the Lord.
english: Delgado said that in every human suffering, there is something important to remember: “With nothing on to cling on to, we realize we only live in the love of the Lord.

text:
Gani indi uyang kundi manggad ang aton pag-antos, kay ini nagapamanggaranon sa aton sa gugma sang Diyos.”

Gindumdom man sini si Carlene kag ang iya kabuhi — kag ang iya katapusan nga mensahe kay Msgr.
english:
So our suffering is not a waste but a riches, for it makes us rich in the love of God.”

text: Delgado antes siya nagsulod sa ganhaan sang kamatayon: “God will keep us in His love.”#

text: Nagpanawagan ang isa ka international rights group sa International Criminal Court (ICC) nga gilayon magpagwa sang arrest warrants batok sa mga former kag current official sang gobyerno nga ginakabig sang ICC bilang “co-perpetrators” sa ginapahayag nga crimes against humanity nga may kaangtanan sa war on drugs ni anay Presidente Rodrigo Duterte.
english: An international rights group has called on the International Criminal Court (ICC) to immediately issue arrest warrants against former and current government officials whom the ICC considers “co-perpetrators” of alleged crimes against humanity related to former President Rodrigo Duterte’s war on drugs.

text: Sa pahayag sang International Coalition for Human Rights in the Philippines (ICHRP) chairman nga si Peter Murphy, iya ginpunto nga dapat maupod sa imbestigasyon ang mga ginhingadlan nga opisyal kag indi pagbay-an nga magpabilin nga hilway ang mga bangud posible nga maapektuhan ang ebidensya kag ma-intimidar ang mga testigo.
english: In a statement, International Coalition for Human Rights in the Philippines (ICHRP) chairman Peter Murphy pointed out that the named officials should be involved in the investigation and not allowed to remain free because it is possible to affect the evidence and intimidate witnesses.

text: Matandaan nga gindeklarar sang ICC nga lakip sa ginhingadlan sanday Senators Bato dela Rosa kag Bong Go, anay Justice Secretary Vitaliano Aguirre, kag pila ka anay hepe sang Philippine National Police.
english: The ICC declared that Senators Bato dela Rosa and Bong Go, former Justice Secretary Vitaliano Aguirre, and several former chiefs of the Philippine National Police were among those named.

text: Ginpanindugan naman nanday Go kag Aguirre nga wala sila sang kahilabtanan sa amo nga alegasyon.
english: Go and Aguirre insisted that they had nothing to do with the allegation.

text: Gintawag ni Go ini nga “baseless” nga akusasyon, samtang nagpahayag si Aguirre nga magapaidalom siya sa legal nga proseso kun may warrant nga ipagwa ang ICC kag indi ini magpanago.
english: Go called this “baseless” accusation, while Aguirre said he will undergo legal proceedings if the ICC issues a warrant and he does not hide.

text: Sa karon, nakatalana sa Pebrero 23 ang confirmation of charges hearing batok kay Duterte, nga yara sa kustodiya sang ICC.
english: The confirmation of charges hearing against Duterte, who is in ICC custody, is currently scheduled for February 23.

text: Nagpaandam ang pungsod Iran sa mga sibilyan sini sa Middle East nga magpalayo sa mga lugar nga malapit sa pwersa sang United States samtang padayon ang tensyon sa giyera nga gina-updan sang Israel.
english: Iran has warned its civilians in the Middle East to stay away from areas near US forces as tensions continue over a war with Israel.

text: Nagpahayag si US President Donald Trump nga “maayo” ang dalagan sang ila peace talks nga ginpatigayon kag ginpalawig sini ang deadline may kaangtanan sa Strait of Hormuz.
english: US President Donald Trump said the peace talks were going “good” and extended the deadline regarding the Strait of Hormuz.

text: Apang padayon sa gihapon ang pag-inaway sang duwa ka pungsod kag may ara naman sang bag-o nga airstrike nga natabo sa Tehran kag iban pa nga mga syudad.
english: However, the two countries continue to fight and there have been new airstrikes in Tehran and other cities.

text: Nahibaluan nga tuman ka dako na ang halit sang giyera nga nagakatabo sa nagkalain-lain nga pungsod lakip na ang pagkaguba sang mga lugar nga may cultural heritage, kag naapektuhan man ang suplay sang langis kag global market.
english: It is known that the war in various countries has caused a lot of damage including the destruction of cultural heritage sites, and has also affected the supply of oil and the global market.

text: Nagpaandam ang Iran sang dugang nga pag-atake batok sa mga kaalyado sang U.S. kag importante nga oil facilities kon maglala pa gid ang sitwasyon.
english: Iran has warned of more strikes against U.S. allies and vital oil facilities if the situation escalates further.

text: Apisar sa pagpaninguha nga makuha ang kahilwayan, padayon sa gihapon ang pagtimalos sang militar sang duha ka grupo.
english: Despite efforts to gain independence, military retaliation by both groups continues.

text: Ini nagahatag sang kakugmat sang mas dako nga giyera nga matabo amo man sa epekto sini sa ekonomiya sa bilog nga kalibutan.
english: This raises the specter of a larger war as well as its impact on the global economy.

text: Ginpaanggid ni San Juan Ciy Rep.
english: San Juan Ciy Rep.

text: Ysabel Maria Zamora, Vice Chairman sang House Justice panel, kay anay Chief Justice Renato Corona ang kapalaran nga nagahulat kay Vice President Sara Duterte.
english: Ysabel Maria Zamora, Vice Chairman of the House Justice panel, to former Chief Justice Renato Corona the fate that awaits Vice President Sara Duterte.

text: May kaangtanan ini sa pagbusisi sa Statements of Assets, Liabilities ang Net Worth (SALNs) kaangot sa impeachment complaints nga ginapangatubang sang bise president sa House committe on justice.
english: This is in connection with the review of the Statements of Assets, Liabilities and Net Worth (SALNs) in connection with the impeachment complaints facing the vice president in the House committee on justice.

text: Suno kay Zamora, iga-review sang ila nga komitiba ang non-disclosure kag indi mapaathag nga manggad ni VP Sara.
english: Zamora said their committee will review the non-disclosure and unexplained wealth of VP Sara.

text: Matandaan nga na-impeach si Corona kag na-convict sa Senado sang 2012 bangud sa kapaslawan nga mapagwa ang tanan nga assets kag bank accounts nga yara sa iya nga SALN.
english: Corona was impeached and convicted in the Senate in 2012 for failing to disclose all assets and bank accounts in his SALN.

text: Paathag ni Zamora, mahimo nga mangin ground sang impeachment sa idalom sang ‘betrayal of public trust’ ang bisan pagpanas lang sang indi mapaathag nga manggad.
english: Zamora explained that even the mere erasure of unexplained wealth can be grounds for impeachment under 'betrayal of public trust'.

text: Madumduman nga isyu sang SALN ang nalakip sa complaints batok kay Duterte.
english: It can be recalled that the SALN issue is included in the complaints against Duterte.

text: Magatapak sa isa ka iconic stage sa Hollywood ang global icon nga si Lalisa Manobal ukon mas kilala bilang si Lisa sang BLACKPINK.
english: Global icon Lalisa Manobal or better known as Lisa of BLACKPINK will step on an iconic stage in Hollywood.

text: Isa si Lisa sa ginpili nga mag-present sang mga magadaog sa 83rd Annual Golden Globe Award.
english: Lisa was one of those selected to present the winners of the 83rd Annual Golden Globe Award.

text: Siya ang una nga K-pop member nga mangin presenter sang amo nga prestihiyoso nga award-giving body.
english: He is the first K-pop member to be the presenter of such a prestigious award-giving body.

text: Sa ginpagwa nga listahan sang organizer, kaupod niya bilang presenters sanday Snoop Dogg, Miley Cyrus, kag Orlando Bloom.
english: According to the list released by the organizer, he will be joined as presenters by Snoop Dogg, Miley Cyrus, and Orlando Bloom.

text: Magabalik naman bilang host ang komedyante nga si Nikki Glaser.
english: Comedian Nikki Glaser will return as host.

text: Patigayunon ang awarding ceremony sa Enero 12 sa Los Angeles, California, USA.
english: The awarding ceremony will be held on January 12 in Los Angeles, California, USA.

text: Ang Golden Globe Awards amo ang prestihiyoso nga American accolades nga nagakilala sang excellence sa film and television — domestic kag foreign.
english: The Golden Globe Awards are prestigious American accolades that recognize excellence in film and television — domestic and foreign.

text: Ang naga-presentar sang award amo ang Hollywood Foreign Press Association (HFPA).
english: Presenting the award is the Hollywood Foreign Press Association (HFPA).

text: Nagsaka ang presyo sang pila ka mga produkto nga pagkaon bangod sang bag-o nga pagsaka sang presyo sang produktong petrolyo.
english: The prices of some food products have increased due to the recent increase in the price of petroleum products.

text: Lakip sa mga nagtaas nga balaklon amo ang tamodios, baboy kag pila ka mga utanon, samtang ginapaabot man nga maapektuhan ang presyo sang bugas.
english: Among the commodities that rose were tomatoes, pork and some vegetables, while rice prices were also expected to be affected.

text: Suno kay Arnel de Mesa, tagpamaba sang Department of Agriculture, iya ginpahayag nga nagtaas sang P30 ang presyo sang liempo bangod sang mas mataas nga gasto sa pag-transport sang mga produkto.
english: According to Arnel de Mesa, spokesperson of the Department of Agriculture, he said the price of liempo increased by P30 due to the higher cost of transporting the products.

text: Dugang pa niya, kun magasaka ang presyo sang mga imported feeds nga ginakaon sang mga baboy, nagadugang man ini sa gasto sa produksyon kun sa diin nagaresulta sa pagsaka sang presyo sang karne.
english: He added that if the price of imported feeds eaten by pigs increases, it also increases the cost of production which results in an increase in the price of meat.

text: Nagpaandam ang Department of Agriculture nga posible man nga magsaka ang presyo sang bugas kun magpadayon ang krisis sa presyo sang gatong.
english: The Department of Agriculture has warned that rice prices could also rise if the fuel price crisis continues.

text: Agud mabuligan ang mga apektado, magahatag ang gobyerno sang fuel subsidy sa mga kwalipikado nga mga mangunguma kag mangingisda sa sulod sang masunod nga duha ka semana.
english: To help those affected, the government will provide fuel subsidy to eligible farmers and fishermen within the next two weeks.

text: Nahibaluan nga may yara sang gin-alokar nga P10 bilyon nga pondo nagikan sa Presidential Assistance to Farmers, Fisherfolk, and Families nga ginalantaw nga magamit agud mabuligan ang mga apektado sang pagsaka sang presyo sang produktong-petrolyo.
english: It is known that there is an allocated P10 billion fund from the Presidential Assistance to Farmers, Fisherfolk, and Families which is expected to be used to help those affected by the increase in the price of petroleum products.

text: Sa tagsa ka mga kumpaniya may yara sang mga pagsulundan kaangay lamang sang indi mahimo magtrabaho sang iban nga trabaho ukon sideline jobs.
english: In each of the companies there are rules just like cannot work any other job or sideline jobs.

text: Kaangay lamang sa Japan, nakakas sa iya nga trabaho ang isa ka manunudlo sa Okayama matapos madakpan nga naga-sideline sa isa ka convenience store nga isa ka hilimuon nga paglapas sa kontrata sang madamo nga empleyado sa Japan, kalakip na ang mga public teachers.
english: Just like in Japan, a teacher in Okayama lost his job after being caught sidelining in a convenience store which is a violation of the contract of many employees in Japan, including public teachers.

text: Suno sa report, isa ka 60-anyos nga manunudlo ang nakit-an kag gin-report sa Okayama City Board of Education nga nagatrabaho sa isa ka convenience store.
english: According to the report, a 60-year-old teacher was found and reported to the Okayama City Board of Education working at a convenience store.

text: Ini ang ginkumpirmar sang iya nga school principal, nga personal nga nagpadulong sa convenience store, adlaw sang Sabado, kun sa diin ang adlaw sang pahuway ukon rest day sang manunudlo.
english: This was confirmed by his school principal, who personally went to the convenience store on Saturday, which is the teacher's rest day.

text: Sa Japan, kinaandan sa mga kontrata sa trabaho ang pagbawal sa pag-angkon sang pangaduha nga trabaho.
english: In Japan, it is common for employment contracts to prohibit having a second job.

text: Ang logic sa likod sini agud masiguro nga ang bug-os nga atensiyon kag enerhiya sang isa ka empleyado ang nakatutok sa iya nagapanguna nga trabaho.
english: The logic behind this is to ensure that an employee’s full attention and energy is focused on his or her core work.

text: Gin-ako sang manunudlo nga nagatrabaho siya sa convenience store humalin pa sadtong November 2023 agud madugangan ang iya nga kita, matapos siya nga “i-rehire” sang iya nga ginatrabahuan nga eskuwelahan.
english: The teacher admitted that she has been working at the convenience store since November 2023 to increase her income, after she was “rehired” by her school.

text: Ang “rehiring” isa ka hiring process sa Japan kun sa diin ang isa ka empleyado nga naglab-ot na sa retirement age ang liwat nga gina-employed para sa pareho nga posisyon apang may mas manubo nga sweldo.
english: Rehiring is a hiring process in Japan where an employee who has reached retirement age is re-employed for the same position but with a lower salary.

text: Nagpangayo sang pasaylo ang manunudlo para sa iya ‘unethical’ nga hilimuon nga nakaguba sa pagsalig sang publiko sa mga manunudlo.
english: The teacher apologized for his 'unethical' act that undermined public trust in teachers.

text: Nag-sorry man ang Okayama City Board of Education sa ila nga mga estudyante.
english: The Okayama City Board of Education also apologized to their students.

text: Ang kaso nagresulta sang mainit nga pagdiskusyon online, kun sa diin madamo ang nagakuwestiyon sa patakaran sang pagbawal sa side job, ilabi na kun ini ang isa ka dungganon nga trabaho kag ginahimo sa gwa sang oras sang nagapanguna nga trabaho.
english: The case has sparked a heated discussion online, with many questioning the policy of banning side jobs, especially when it is a prestigious job and is done outside the hours of the main job.

text: Malipayon nga ginpahibalo sang celebrity host nga si Robi Domingo nga nagabusong na ang iya asawa nga si Maiqui Pineda.
english: Celebrity host Robi Domingo happily announced that his wife Maiqui Pineda is pregnant.

text: Ginhimo sang mag-asawa ang announcement kadungan sang ila ikaduha nga wedding anniversary.
english: The couple made the announcement in conjunction with their second wedding anniversary.

text: Gintawag nila ang ila baby nga “greatest blessing” nga magaabot sa ila.
english: They called their baby the “greatest blessing” to come their way.

text: “Two years married… and now our greatest blessing is on the way.
english: “Two years married… and now our greatest blessing is on the way.

text: Happy 2nd anniversary!
english: Happy 2nd anniversary!

text: We’re ready to give you all our love,” caption ni Robi sa video nga iya gin-post.
english: We’re ready to give you all our love,” Robi captioned the video he posted.

text: Nalakip sa video ang footage sang Septyembre sa pregnancy test ni Maiqui, ang ila reaksyon sang nakumpirma nga nagabusong ini, tubtub nga ginpahibalo na nila ang maayong balita sa ila suod nga mga abyan sa showbiz lakip kanday Darren Espanto, Donny Pangilinan, Vice Ganda, Anne Curtis, Coco Martin, Kathryn Bernardo, kag iban pa.
english: The video includes footage of Maiqui's September pregnancy test, their reaction when she was confirmed pregnant, until they announced the good news to their close showbiz friends including Darren Espanto, Donny Pangilinan, Vice Ganda, Anne Curtis, Coco Martin, Kathryn Bernardo, and others.

text: Nag-umpisa sa pag-date sanday Robi kag Maiqui sang 2018 kag na-engage sang Nobyembre 2022.
english: Robi and Maiqui started dating in 2018 and got engaged in November 2022.

text: Sang 2023, na-diagnose si Maiqui nga may dermatomyositis nga isa ka rare autoimmune disease nga rason sang muscle weakness, inflammation, kag skin rashes.
english: In 2023, Maiqui was diagnosed with dermatomyositis, a rare autoimmune disease that causes muscle weakness, inflammation, and skin rashes.

text: Apisar sang diagnosis, ginpadayon ang ila kasal sang January 6, 2024 sa isa ka matahum nga seremonya sa Bulacan.
english: Despite the diagnosis, they went ahead with their wedding on January 6, 2024 in a beautiful ceremony in Bulacan.

text: Sang amo man nga tuig, nag-improve ang kondisyon ni Maiqui kasunod sang pagpaidalom sini sa intensive treatment.
english: In the same year, Maiqui's condition improved following intensive treatment.

text: Nagapang-agda ang local government unit sa pagtambong kag pag-upod sa ika-50 na nga ‘Taltal sa Barotac Viejo’ sa Iloilo subong nga Byernes Santo, Abril 3.
english: The local government unit invites you to attend and join the 50th 'Taltal sa Barotac Viejo' in Iloilo this Good Friday, April 3.

text: Suno kay Barotac Viejo Mayor Nielo “Bongbong” Tupas, magasugod ang aktibidad 8:00 subong nga aga sa Barotac Viejo Municipal Gymnasium.
english: According to Barotac Viejo Mayor Nielo “Bongbong” Tupas, the activity will start at 8:00 this morning at the Barotac Viejo Municipal Gymnasium.

text: Magatapos ini sa Pal-ac Hills sa Poblacion kun sa diin masaksihan ang highlight sang Taltal.
english: It will end at Pal-ac Hills in Poblacion where you can witness the highlight of Taltal.

text: Nakaalerto naman ang mga katapo sang Bureau of Fire Protection (BFP), Philippine National Police, kag Philippine Army sa pagpat-od sang seguridad kadungan sang relihiyoso nga aktibidad.
english: Members of the Bureau of Fire Protection (BFP), Philippine National Police, and Philippine Army are on alert to ensure security during the religious activity.

text: Ang “Taltal sa Barotac Viejo” amo ang live drama presentation sang kabuhi ni Hesukristo tubtub sa iya nga kamatayon.
english: “Taltal sa Barotac Viejo” is a live drama presentation of the life of Jesus Christ until his death.

text: Ini nga solemn Holy Week tradition isa ka reenactment sang kasakit, pag-antos, kag kamatayon ni Hesus kag nagapakita sang madalom nga pagtuo kag debosyon sang komunidad.#
english: This solemn Holy Week tradition is a reenactment of the pain, suffering, and death of Jesus and reflects the deep faith and devotion of the community.#

text: Gintugutan sang Iran ang mga barko sang Malaysia nga makalabay sa Strait of Hormuz.
english: Iran allowed Malaysian ships to pass through the Strait of Hormuz.

text: Ginsapubliko ini ni Malaysian Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim kasunod sang iya pagpakig-istorya sa mga lider sang Iran, Egypt, Turkey kag iban pa nga regional countries.
english: This was made public by Malaysian Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim following his talks with the leaders of Iran, Egypt, Turkey and other regional countries.

text: Sa iya televised address, nagpasalamat si Anwar sa Iran.
english: In his televised address, Anwar thanked Iran.

text: “We are now in the process of releasing the Malaysian oil tankers and the workers involved so that they may continue their journey home,” suno sa opisyal.
english: “We are now in the process of releasing the Malaysian oil tankers and the workers involved so that they may continue their journey home,” the official said.

text: Pahayag pa sini, ang iya dayalogo sa Tehran kag sa iban nga mga pungsod ang kabahin sang mga tikang agud nga ma-facilitate ang pagbalik sang kalinong sa Middle East.
english: He said his dialogue with Tehran and other countries is part of the steps to facilitate the return of peace in the Middle East.

text: Gin-ako sini nga mabudlay ini himuon ilabi na nga sa pamatyagan sang Iran, makapila ka beses na ini nga gintiplang gani nga wala ini halos nagabaton sang mga tikang nga ginatanyag para sa kalinong sang rehiyon.
english: He acknowledged that this is difficult to do especially since Iran feels that it has been repeatedly deceived and does not accept the measures offered for regional peace.

text: “But it is not easy, as Iran feels it has been deceived repeatedly and finds it difficult to accept steps toward peace without a clear and binding security guarantee for their nation,” suno sa iya.
english: “But it is not easy, as Iran feels it has been deceived repeatedly and finds it difficult to accept steps toward peace without a clear and binding security guarantee for their nation,” he said.

text: Nauna na nga ginpahayag sang Malaysian government nga padayon sila nga magahatag sang oil price subsidies, apang may ginahimo man ini agud nga mapahina ang epekto sang supply disruptions lakip na ang pagbuhin sa monthly allocations sang subsidized fuel.
english: The Malaysian government has previously said it will continue to provide oil price subsidies, but it is also taking steps to mitigate the impact of supply disruptions including reducing monthly allocations of subsidized fuel.

text: “For us now, we are compelled to manage the situation because the effects of the blockade at the Strait of Hormuz, the war, and the halted supply of oil and gas all have an impact on us,” dugang sini.
english: “For us now, we are compelled to manage the situation because the effects of the blockade at the Strait of Hormuz, the war, and the halted supply of oil and gas all have an impact on us,” it added.

text: Una na nga ginklaro sang Iran sa United Nations body nga International Maritime Organization (IMO) nga mahimo makaagi sa Strait of Hormuz ang indi peligroso ukon “non-hostile” nga mga barko.
english: Iran has previously clarified to the United Nations body the International Maritime Organization (IMO) that non-dangerous or “non-hostile” ships can pass through the Strait of Hormuz.

text: Ang kondisyon sang Tehran amo nga makalabay ang barko basta wala dapat naga-partisipar ukon nagasuporta sa gyera kontra sa Iran, kag dapat man nga magsunod sa tanan nga safety and security regulations.
english: Tehran's condition is that the ship can pass as long as it does not participate in or support the war against Iran, and must also comply with all safety and security regulations.

text:
Makalabay man ang mga barko sa amo nga strait sa kondisyon nga may yara sang koordinasyon sa Iranian authorities.#

(AFP file photo)
english:
Ships can also pass through the strait provided there is coordination with Iranian authorities.

(AFP file photo)

text: Ginpagwa sa hampang ang apat ka players matapos ang rambol nga natabo sa tunga sang Detroit Pistons kag Charlotte Hornets.
english: Four players were ejected from the game after a fight between the Detroit Pistons and Charlotte Hornets.

text: Natabo ang insidente sa third quarter sang gin-foul ni Moussa Diabate sang Hornets si Jalen Duren sang Pistons.
english: The incident occurred in the third quarter when the Hornets’ Moussa Diabate fouled the Pistons’ Jalen Duren.

text: Nag-initay ang duha tubtub nga naglapta na ang tensyon sa court kag may nga mga nagtapungulay.
english: The two fought until the tension spread to the court and there were fights.

text: Magluwas kanday Diabate kag Duren, ginpaguwa man sa game sanday Isaiah Stewart sang Pistons kag Miles Bridges sang Hornets.
english: In addition to Diabate and Duren, Isaiah Stewart of the Pistons and Miles Bridges of the Hornets were also ejected from the game.

text: Halin pa si Stewart sa bench apang nagdalagan ini pa-tunga agud mag-intra man sa tapungulay.
english: Stewart came off the bench but ran into the middle to join the fight.

text: Nadugangan pa ang tensyon sa fourth quarter sang mismo na ang coach sang Hornets nga si Coach Charles Lee ang ginpaguwa sa hampang.
english: The tension was heightened in the fourth quarter when Hornets coach Coach Charles Lee was ejected from the game.

text: Ini matapos nga ginkaakig sini ang foul nga gintawag sang game official sa iya nga team, kag ginkinahanglan pa nga punggan sang iban nga coaching staff agud indi ini makapanakit.
english: This was after he was angry at the foul called by the game official on his team, and had to be stopped by other coaching staff so that he would not hurt himself.

text: Nagtakop ang amo nga game pabor sa Pistons, 110-104, nga amo ang nagtapos sang winning streak sang Hornets sa siyam ka mga hampang.
english: The game ended in favor of the Pistons, 110-104, ending the Hornets' winning streak of nine games.

text: Nagapanguna subong ang Pistons sa Eastern Conference standings (39-13) samtang nagapabilin sa ika-10 ang Hornets (25-29).
english: The Pistons currently lead the Eastern Conference standings (39-13) while the Hornets remain in 10th place (25-29).

text: Ginpalab-ot ni Bingawan, Iloilo Sangguniang Bayan Member Jofe Celeste ang iya personal experience sa pag-refer sang mga pasyente nga nagahalin sa district hospital sa probinsya sang Iloilo padulong sa Iloilo City.
english: Bingawan, Iloilo Sangguniang Bayan Member Jofe Celeste shared his personal experience in referring patients from district hospitals in Iloilo province to Iloilo City.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay SB Celeste, iya ginpahayag nga tuman ka dako nga pagpanghangkat para sa mga pasyente kon indi makahatag sang salakyan ukon ambulansya ang isa ka hospital.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, SB Celeste said it is a big challenge for patients if a hospital cannot provide a vehicle or ambulance.

text: Suno kay Celeste, kapareho ini sa natabo sa iya nga bata nga may special needs sang Mayo 14, 2025 kon sa diin, nangluya ini kag kinahanglan sang gilayon nga pagbulong.
english: According to Celeste, this is similar to what happened to her child with special needs on May 14, 2025 where he became weak and needed immediate treatment.

text: Gintuad sang opisyal nga nagpakig-angot sila sa ila banwa agud nga makapangayo sang Patient Transport Vehicle (PTV) kag madul-ong ang iya nga bata, apang nagpahayag ang Local Government Unit (LGU) sang Bingawan nga tubtob sa District Hospital sang Calinog lang sila.
english: The official admitted that they contacted their town to ask for a Patient Transport Vehicle (PTV) and take her child, but the Local Government Unit (LGU) of Bingawan said that they only went to the District Hospital of Calinog.

text: Ginbuyagyag man sini nga kon luyag nila nga madul-ong sa syudad ang pasyente, magamit na lang sang pribado nga salakyan.
english: He also revealed that if they want to take the patient to the city, they can use a private vehicle.

text: Nagapanghakroy man ini bangud wala sang kagamitan sa ambulansya para sa pasyente agud ma-sustain kontani ang kahimtangan sini tubtob makalab-ot sa ospital sa syudad.
english: He also complained that there was no equipment in the ambulance for the patient to sustain his condition until he reached the hospital in the city.

text: Nagapati man ini nga ang nagakatabo sa pila ka banwa amo ang kinahanglan nga i-admit anay ang bata sa hospital agud nga makakuha sang bastante nga ambulansya para sa pasyente.
english: He also believes that what happens in some towns is that the child needs to be admitted to the hospital in order to get enough ambulances for the patient.

text: Gin-athag sini nga tinutuyo lamang niya nga mapanami ang referral system sang probinsya ilabi na kon emergency cases.
english: He explained that he only aims to improve the referral system of the province especially in emergency cases.

text: Nagpanawagan man ini kay Iloilo Governor Defensor Jr.
english: He also called on Iloilo Governor Defensor Jr.

text: nga mahatagan sang igtalupangod ang amo nga issue agud nga indi na masulit pa kag makatuga sang huol sa mga nagamasakit.
english: to pay attention to the issue so that it will not happen again and cause distress to the sick.

text: Nagpakigbahin sang iya hibubun-ot si Senador Robin Padilla nga ginakasubo gid sini ang balita matapos nga ginhigadlan sang International Criminal Court (ICC) nga co-perpetrators ang iya duha ka abyan nga sanday Senators Bong Go kag Ronald “Bato” Dela Rosa, kaupod si anay Presidente Rodrigo Duterte sa ginapahayag nga “war on drugs” halin sang in ang alkalde pa sang Davao asta sa sang ini ang nangin Presidente.
english: Senator Robin Padilla expressed his sadness over the news after the International Criminal Court (ICC) named his two friends, Senators Bong Go and Ronald “Bato” Dela Rosa, as co-perpetrators, along with former President Rodrigo Duterte in the alleged drug war. Davao until he became President.

text: Suno kay Padilla, kasubong nga “nagaulan sang luha” kag nakabatyag ini sang depresyon.
english: According to Padilla, it was like “tears were falling” and she felt depressed.

text: Ginpahayag man niya ang iya kabalaka kun sin-o ang magasuporta sa iya sa Senado kung mapagwa na ang warrant of arrest batok sa duha ka senador.
english: He also expressed concern about who will support him in the Senate if the warrant of arrest against the two senators is issued.

text: Dugang pa ni Padilla nga gilayun ini nga nakigsugilanon sa ila ni Go kag Dela Rosa agud hibaluon kun paano siya makabulig, kag nakig-angut man ini sa minority floor leader nga si Sen.
english: Padilla said he immediately spoke with Go and Dela Rosa to find out how he could help, and he also contacted minority floor leader Sen.

text: Alan Peter Cayetano.
english: Alan Peter Cayetano.

text: Nagapanawagan si Padilla sa gobyerno nga indi pagtugutan nga ipaidaum sa ICC ang mga Pilipino kag hugot nga nanindugan nga dapat protektahan ang soberanya sang pungsod.
english: Padilla called on the government not to allow Filipinos to be brought before the ICC and insisted that the country's sovereignty must be protected.

text: Matandaan nga nangin kontrobersyal ang iya mga pahayag ni Padilla sang nagligad nga mga inadlaw, kun sa diin gintawag niya ang subong nga henerasyon nga “weak” bangud nagaka-experyensya sang ‘depression’.
english: It can be recalled that Padilla's statements in recent days have become controversial, where he called the current generation “weak” because they are experiencing “depression”.

text: NORMAL man lang sa mga botante, bisan gani sa America, ang magpasaring nga butigon ang pulitiko.
english: IT IS normal for voters, even in America, to pretend that a politician is a liar.

text: Ina tungod, sa masami, lain ang nagakatabo pagdaug na nila.
english: That's because, often, something else happens when they win.

text: Fuera los buenos, pero kon sadto paryente, pare ukon kumare ang pagkilala sa imo sa tion sang kampanya, sa pagpungko na nila sa pwesto ni nihoy kag nihay indi ka na nila bisan mabugno man lang.
english: Fuera los buenos, but if you were known as a relative, priest or cousin during the campaign, when they sit in the position of nihoy and nihay, they won't even beat you.
